class AddMonoid (R : Type) where
  zero      : R
  add       : R → R → R
  add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)

namespace CircleAverage
variable {R : Type} [AddMonoid R]

axiom integral       : (R → R) → R
axiom integral_ext   : ∀ (g h : R → R), (∀ θ, g θ = h θ) → integral g = integral h
axiom integral_const : ∀ (c : R), integral (fun _ => c) = c
axiom integral_add   : ∀ (f g : R → R),
  integral (fun θ => AddMonoid.add (f θ) (g θ)) =
  AddMonoid.add (integral f) (integral g)
axiom integral_shift : ∀ (f : R → R) (c : R),
  integral (fun θ => f (AddMonoid.add θ c)) = integral f

def circleMap (c θ : R) : R := AddMonoid.add θ c
noncomputable def circleAverage (f : R → R) (c : R) : R :=
  integral (fun θ => f (circleMap c θ))

theorem circleMap_zero (θ : R) :
  circleMap AddMonoid.zero θ = θ := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_zero (f : R → R) :
  circleAverage f AddMonoid.zero = integral f := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_add (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c) := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_fun_add (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => f (AddMonoid.add z c)) AddMonoid.zero =
  circleAverage f c := by sorry
theorem circleMap_add (c d θ : R) :
  circleMap (AddMonoid.add c d) θ =
  circleMap c (circleMap d θ) := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_shift (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add c d) =
  circleAverage (fun z => f (AddMonoid.add z d)) c := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_const (k c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun _ => k) c = k := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_add_const (f : R → R) (k c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) k) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c) k := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_comm_add (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (g z) (f z)) c := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_add_assoc (f g h : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c)
              (AddMonoid.add (circleAverage g c) (circleAverage h c)) := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_center_comm (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add c d) =
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add d c) := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_center_independent (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage f c = integral f := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_center_eq (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage f c = circleAverage f d := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_idempotent (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => circleAverage f z) c = circleAverage f c := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_of_zero_integral (f : R → R) (c : R) (H : integral f = AddMonoid.zero) :
  circleAverage f c = AddMonoid.zero := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_linear (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c) := by sorry
theorem circleAverage_shift_commute (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => f (circleMap d z)) c =
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add c d) := by sorry
end CircleAverage

Class AddMonoid (R : Type) := {

  add_comm  : forall x y, add x y = add y x;
  add_assoc : forall x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
}.

Section CircleAverage.
  Context {R : Type} {M : AddMonoid R}.

  Axiom integral       : (R -> R) -> R.
  Axiom integral_ext   : forall g h,
      (forall θ, g θ = h θ) ->
      integral g = integral h.
  Axiom integral_const : forall c,
      integral (fun _ => c) = c.
  Axiom integral_add   : forall f g,
      integral (fun θ => add (f θ) (g θ)) =
      add (integral f) (integral g).

  Axiom integral_shift : forall f c,
    integral (fun θ => f (add θ c)) = integral f.


  Definition circleMap (c θ : R) : R := add θ c.

  Definition circleAverage (f : R -> R) (c : R) : R :=
    integral (fun θ => f (circleMap c θ)).

  Lemma circleMap_zero :
    forall θ, circleMap zero θ = θ.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_zero :
    forall f, circleAverage f zero = integral f.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_add :
    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Theorem circleAverage_fun_add :
    forall f c,
      circleAverage (fun z => f (add z c)) zero =
      circleAverage f c.
Proof.
Admitted.

 Lemma circleMap_add :
    forall c d θ,
      circleMap (add c d) θ =
      circleMap c (circleMap d θ).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_shift :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f (add c d) =
      circleAverage (fun z => f (add z d)) c.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_const :
    forall k c, circleAverage (fun _ => k) c = k.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_add_const :
    forall f k c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) k) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) k.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_comm_add :
    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      circleAverage (fun z => add (g z) (f z)) c.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_add_assoc :
    forall f g h c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c)
          (add (circleAverage g c) (circleAverage h c)).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_center_comm :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f (add c d) =
      circleAverage f (add d c).
Proof.
Admitted.
  Lemma circleAverage_center_independent :
    forall f c,
      circleAverage f c = integral f.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_center_eq :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f c = circleAverage f d.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_idempotent :
  forall f c,
    circleAverage (fun z => circleAverage f z) c = circleAverage f c.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_of_zero_integral :
    forall f c,
      integral f = zero -> circleAverage f c = zero.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma circleAverage_linear :
    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c).
Proof.
Admitted.
  
  Lemma circleAverage_shift_commute :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage (fun z => f (circleMap d z)) c =
      circleAverage f (add c d).
Proof.
Admitted.
End CircleAverage.

theory circle_average
  imports Main
begin

locale circle_average_setup =
  fixes zero     :: "'r"
    and add      :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"     (infixl "+C" 65)
    and integral :: "('r \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  assumes add_zero      : "\<And>x. x +C zero = x"
    and   add_comm      : "\<And>x y. x +C y = y +C x"
    and   add_assoc     : "\<And>x y z. (x +C y) +C z = x +C (y +C z)"
    and   integral_ext  : "\<And>g h. (\<forall>\<theta>. g \<theta> = h \<theta>) \<Longrightarrow> integral g = integral h"
    and   integral_const: "\<And>c. integral (\<lambda>_. c) = c"
    and   integral_add  : "\<And>f g. integral (\<lambda>\<theta>. f \<theta> +C g \<theta>) = integral f +C integral g"
    and   integral_shift: "\<And>f c. integral (\<lambda>\<theta>. f (\<theta> +C c)) = integral f"
begin





definition circleMap :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  where "circleMap c \<theta> \<equiv> \<theta> +C c"

definition circleAverage :: "('r \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  where "circleAverage f c \<equiv> integral (\<lambda>\<theta>. f (circleMap c \<theta>))"





lemma circleMap_zero: "circleMap zero \<theta> = \<theta>"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_zero: "circleAverage f zero = integral f"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_add:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f z +C g z) c =
   circleAverage f c +C circleAverage g c"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_fun_add:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f (z +C c)) zero = circleAverage f c"
  sorry
lemma circleMap_add:
  "circleMap (c +C d) \<theta> = circleMap c (circleMap d \<theta>)"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_shift:
  "circleAverage f (c +C d) = circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f (z +C d)) c"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_const:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>_. k) c = k"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_add_const:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f z +C k) c = circleAverage f c +C k"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_comm_add:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f z +C g z) c =
   circleAverage (\<lambda>z. g z +C f z) c"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_add_assoc:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. (f z +C g z) +C h z) c =
   circleAverage f c +C (circleAverage g c +C circleAverage h c)"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_center_comm:
  "circleAverage f (c +C d) = circleAverage f (d +C c)"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_center_independent:
  "circleAverage f c = integral f"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_center_eq:
  "circleAverage f c = circleAverage f d"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_idempotent:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. circleAverage f z) c = circleAverage f c"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_of_zero_integral:
  "integral f = zero \<Longrightarrow> circleAverage f c = zero"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_linear:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f z +C g z) c =
   circleAverage f c +C circleAverage g c"
  sorry
lemma circleAverage_shift_commute:
  "circleAverage (\<lambda>z. f (circleMap d z)) c =
   circleAverage f (c +C d)"
  sorry
end

end

;; monoid with an extensional, constant-preserving, additive, and
;; translation-invariant integral, asserting the source's seventeen
;; identities. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative symbols present an arbitrary carrier, an unbounded sort
;; of unary functions on that carrier, their application operation, and the
;; generic integral.  The constructor symbols represent exactly the lambda
;; terms used by the source statements.  Their typing and evaluation rules,

(defstub ca-r-p (x) t)
(defstub ca-function-p (function) t)
(defstub ca-zero () t)
(defstub ca-add (left right) t)
(defstub ca-apply (function argument) t)
(defstub ca-integral (function) t)
(defstub ca-constant-function (constant) t)
(defstub ca-pointwise-add-function (left right) t)
(defstub ca-shift-function (function center) t)
(defstub ca-average-function (function) t)

(defun ca-circle-map (center theta)
  (ca-add theta center))

(defun ca-circle-average (function center)
  (ca-integral (ca-shift-function function center)))

(defun-sk ca-add-monoid-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (ca-r-p x)
          (ca-r-p y)
          (ca-r-p z))
     (and
      (ca-r-p (ca-add x y))
      (equal (ca-add x (ca-zero)) x)
      (equal (ca-add x y) (ca-add y x))
      (equal (ca-add (ca-add x y) z)
             (ca-add x (ca-add y z)))))))

(defun-sk ca-functions-extensionally-equal-p (left right)
  (forall (theta)
    (implies
     (ca-r-p theta)
     (equal (ca-apply left theta)
            (ca-apply right theta)))))

(defun-sk ca-function-space-laws-p ()
  (forall (f g c theta)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (ca-function-p f)
           (ca-r-p theta))
      (ca-r-p (ca-apply f theta)))
     (implies
      (ca-r-p c)
      (and
       (ca-function-p (ca-constant-function c))
       (implies
        (ca-r-p theta)
        (equal
         (ca-apply (ca-constant-function c) theta)
         c))))
     (implies
      (and (ca-function-p f)
           (ca-function-p g))
      (and
       (ca-function-p (ca-pointwise-add-function f g))
       (implies
        (ca-r-p theta)
        (equal
         (ca-apply
          (ca-pointwise-add-function f g)
          theta)
         (ca-add (ca-apply f theta)
                 (ca-apply g theta))))))
     (implies
      (and (ca-function-p f)
           (ca-r-p c))
      (and
       (ca-function-p (ca-shift-function f c))
       (implies
        (ca-r-p theta)
        (equal
         (ca-apply (ca-shift-function f c) theta)
         (ca-apply f (ca-add theta c))))))
     (implies
      (ca-function-p f)
      (and
       (ca-function-p (ca-average-function f))
       (implies
        (ca-r-p theta)
        (equal
         (ca-apply (ca-average-function f) theta)
         (ca-circle-average f theta))))))))

(defun-sk ca-integral-laws-p ()
  (forall (f g c)
    (and
     (implies
      (ca-function-p f)
      (ca-r-p (ca-integral f)))
     (implies
      (and (ca-function-p f)

      (equal (ca-integral f)

     (implies

      (equal
       (ca-integral (ca-constant-function c))
       c))
     (implies
      (and (ca-function-p f)
           (ca-function-p g))
      (equal
       (ca-integral (ca-pointwise-add-function f g))
       (ca-add (ca-integral f)
               (ca-integral g))))
     (implies
      (and (ca-function-p f)
           (ca-r-p c))
      (equal
       (ca-integral (ca-shift-function f c))
       (ca-integral f))))))

(defun ca-circle-average-context-p ()

   (ca-r-p (ca-zero))
   (ca-add-monoid-laws-p)
   (ca-function-space-laws-p)

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic circle_average. This file contains no
-- proof.

module circle_average where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

record AddMonoid {ℓ : Level} (R : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    zero      : R
    add       : R → R → R
    add-zero  : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-comm  : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : R) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)

record IntegralStructure {ℓ : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
                         (M : AddMonoid R) : Set ℓ where
  open AddMonoid M

  field
    integral       : (R → R) → R
    integral-ext   : (g h : R → R) →
                     ((θ : R) → g θ ≡ h θ) →
                     integral g ≡ integral h
    integral-const : (c : R) → integral (λ _ → c) ≡ c
    integral-add   : (f g : R → R) →
                     integral (λ θ → add (f θ) (g θ)) ≡
                     add (integral f) (integral g)
    integral-shift : (f : R → R) (c : R) →
                     integral (λ θ → f (add θ c)) ≡ integral f

module CircleAverage {ℓ : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
                     (M : AddMonoid R)
                     (I : IntegralStructure M) where
  open AddMonoid M
  open IntegralStructure I

  circleMap : R → R → R
  circleMap c θ = add θ c

  circleAverage : (R → R) → R → R
  circleAverage f c = integral (λ θ → f (circleMap c θ))

  circleMap-zero : Set ℓ
  circleMap-zero =
    (θ : R) → circleMap zero θ ≡ θ

  circleAverage-zero : Set ℓ
  circleAverage-zero =
    (f : R → R) → circleAverage f zero ≡ integral f

  circleAverage-center-eq : Set ℓ

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val is_add_monoid_def = new_definition (
  "is_add_monoid_def",
  ``is_add_monoid (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z))``);

val is_integral_def = new_definition (
  "is_integral_def",
  ``is_integral (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a)
                 (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (zero : 'a) <=>
      (!g h. (!t. g t = h t) ==> integral g = integral h) /\
      (!c. integral (\t. c) = c) /\
      (!f g. integral (\t. add (f t) (g t)) =
             add (integral f) (integral g)) /\
      (!f c. integral (\t. f (add t c)) = integral f)``);

val circleMap_def = new_definition (
  "circleMap_def",
  ``circleMap (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) c t = add t c``);

val circleAverage_def = new_definition (
  "circleAverage_def",
  ``circleAverage (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a)
                   (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (f : 'a -> 'a) c =
      integral (\t. f (circleMap add c t))``);

val circleMap_zero =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add ==>
      !t. circleMap add zero t = t``;

val circleAverage_zero =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !f. circleAverage integral add f zero = integral f``;

val circleAverage_add =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) g c.
        circleAverage integral add (\z. add (f z) (g z)) c =
        add (circleAverage integral add f c)
            (circleAverage integral add g c)``;

val circleAverage_fun_add =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c.
        circleAverage integral add (\z. f (add z c)) zero =
        circleAverage integral add f c``;

val circleMap_add =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add ==>
      !c d t.
        circleMap add (add c d) t =
        circleMap add c (circleMap add d t)``;

val circleAverage_shift =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c d.
        circleAverage integral add f (add c d) =
        circleAverage integral add (\z. f (add z d)) c``;

val circleAverage_const =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !k c. circleAverage integral add (\z. k) c = k``;

val circleAverage_add_const =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) k c.
        circleAverage integral add (\z. add (f z) k) c =
        add (circleAverage integral add f c) k``;

val circleAverage_comm_add =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) g c.
        circleAverage integral add (\z. add (f z) (g z)) c =
        circleAverage integral add (\z. add (g z) (f z)) c``;

val circleAverage_add_assoc =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) g h c.
        circleAverage integral add
          (\z. add (add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
        add (circleAverage integral add f c)
            (add (circleAverage integral add g c)
                 (circleAverage integral add h c))``;

val circleAverage_center_comm =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c d.
        circleAverage integral add f (add c d) =
        circleAverage integral add f (add d c)``;

val circleAverage_center_independent =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c.
        circleAverage integral add f c = integral f``;

val circleAverage_center_eq =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c d.
        circleAverage integral add f c =
        circleAverage integral add f d``;

val circleAverage_idempotent =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c.
        circleAverage integral add
          (\z. circleAverage integral add f z) c =
        circleAverage integral add f c``;

val circleAverage_of_zero_integral =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c.
        integral f = zero ==>
        circleAverage integral add f c = zero``;

val circleAverage_linear =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) g c.
        circleAverage integral add (\z. add (f z) (g z)) c =
        add (circleAverage integral add f c)
            (circleAverage integral add g c)``;

val circleAverage_shift_commute =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (integral : ('a -> 'a) -> 'a).
      is_add_monoid zero add /\ is_integral integral add zero ==>
      !(f : 'a -> 'a) c d.
        circleAverage integral add
          (\z. f (circleMap add d z)) c =
        circleAverage integral add f (add c d)``;

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic circle_average. This file contains no
% proof.

circle_average[
  R: TYPE+,
  zero: R,
  add: [R, R -> R],
  integral: [[R -> R] -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  add_monoid: bool =
    (FORALL (x: R): add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))

  integral_structure: bool =
    (FORALL (g, h: [R -> R]):
      (FORALL (theta: R): g(theta) = h(theta))
        IMPLIES integral(g) = integral(h))
      AND (FORALL (k: R):
        integral(LAMBDA (theta: R): k) = k)
      AND (FORALL (f, g: [R -> R]):
        integral(LAMBDA (theta: R): add(f(theta), g(theta))) =
          add(integral(f), integral(g)))
      AND (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          integral(LAMBDA (theta: R): f(add(theta, c))) = integral(f))

  circle_average_setup: bool = add_monoid AND integral_structure

  circleMap(c, theta: R): R = add(theta, c)

  circleAverage(f: [R -> R], c: R): R =
    integral(LAMBDA (theta: R): f(circleMap(c, theta)))

  circleMap_zero: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (theta: R): circleMap(zero, theta) = theta)

  circleAverage_zero: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        circleAverage(f, zero) = integral(f))

  circleAverage_add: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): add(f(z), g(z)), c) =
              add(circleAverage(f, c), circleAverage(g, c)))

  circleAverage_fun_add: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): f(add(z, c)), zero) =
              circleAverage(f, c))

  circleMap_add: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (c, d, theta: R):
        circleMap(add(c, d), theta) =
          circleMap(c, circleMap(d, theta)))

  circleAverage_shift: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c, d: R):
          circleAverage(f, add(c, d)) =
            circleAverage(LAMBDA (z: R): f(add(z, d)), c))

  circleAverage_const: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (k, c: R):
        circleAverage(LAMBDA (z: R): k, c) = k)

  circleAverage_add_const: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (k, c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): add(f(z), k), c) =
              add(circleAverage(f, c), k))

  circleAverage_comm_add: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): add(f(z), g(z)), c) =
              circleAverage(
                LAMBDA (z: R): add(g(z), f(z)), c))

  circleAverage_add_assoc: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g, h: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): add(add(f(z), g(z)), h(z)), c) =
              add(
                circleAverage(f, c),
                add(circleAverage(g, c), circleAverage(h, c))))

  circleAverage_center_comm: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c, d: R):
          circleAverage(f, add(c, d)) =
            circleAverage(f, add(d, c)))

  circleAverage_center_independent: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(f, c) = integral(f))

  circleAverage_center_eq: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c, d: R):
          circleAverage(f, c) = circleAverage(f, d))

  circleAverage_idempotent: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): circleAverage(f, z), c) =
              circleAverage(f, c))

  circleAverage_of_zero_integral: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          integral(f) = zero IMPLIES circleAverage(f, c) = zero)

  circleAverage_linear: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): add(f(z), g(z)), c) =
              add(circleAverage(f, c), circleAverage(g, c)))

  circleAverage_shift_commute: bool =
    circle_average_setup IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        FORALL (c, d: R):
          circleAverage(
            LAMBDA (z: R): f(circleMap(d, z)), c) =
              circleAverage(f, add(c, d)))
END circle_average

universe u v w

namespace CompCommute

variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w}

def comp {α β γ} (g : β → γ) (f : α → β) : α → γ := fun x => g (f x)
def id {α} : α → α := fun x => x

axiom comp_assoc : ∀ {α β γ δ} (h : γ → δ) (g : β → γ) (f : α → β), comp h (comp g f) = comp (comp h g) f
axiom comp_id_l  : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β), comp (id) f = f
axiom comp_id_r  : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β), comp f id = f

def commute {α} (f g : α → α) : Prop := comp f g = comp g f

theorem commute_symm {α} (f g : α → α) : commute f g → commute g f := by sorry
theorem commute_with_id_l {α} (f : α → α) : commute f (id) := by sorry
theorem commute_with_id_r {α} (f : α → α) : commute (id) f := by sorry
theorem commute_refl {α} (f : α → α) : commute f f := by sorry
theorem commute_congr {α} (f1 f2 g1 g2 : α → α) :
  f1 = f2 → g1 = g2 → commute f1 g1 → commute f2 g2 := by sorry
theorem commute_transport_left_id {α} (f g : α → α) :
  commute f g → commute (comp (id) f) g := by sorry
theorem commute_transport_right_id {α} (f g : α → α) :
  commute f g → commute f (comp (id) g) := by sorry
end CompCommute

theory comp_commute
  imports Main
begin

definition myComp :: "('b \<Rightarrow> 'c) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'c)"
  where "myComp g f \<equiv> \<lambda>x. g (f x)"

definition myId :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  where "myId \<equiv> \<lambda>x. x"



lemma comp_assoc:
  "myComp h (myComp g f) = myComp (myComp h g) f"
  sorry
lemma comp_id_l:
  "myComp myId f = f"
  sorry
lemma comp_id_r:
  "myComp f myId = f"
  sorry


definition commute :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "commute f g \<equiv> myComp f g = myComp g f"

lemma commute_symm:
  "commute f g \<Longrightarrow> commute g f"
  sorry
lemma commute_with_id_l:
  "commute f myId"
  sorry
lemma commute_with_id_r:
  "commute myId f"
  sorry
lemma commute_refl:
  "commute f f"
  sorry
lemma commute_congr:
  "f1 = f2 \<Longrightarrow> g1 = g2 \<Longrightarrow> commute f1 g1 \<Longrightarrow> commute f2 g2"
  sorry
lemma commute_transport_left_id:
  "commute f g \<Longrightarrow> commute (myComp myId f) g"
  sorry
lemma commute_transport_right_id:
  "commute f g \<Longrightarrow> commute f (myComp myId g)"
  sorry
end

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic comp_commute. This file contains no
-- proof.

module comp_commute where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

comp : ∀ {a b c : Level}
         {A : Set a} {B : Set b} {C : Set c} →
       (B → C) → (A → B) → A → C
comp g f x = g (f x)

id : ∀ {a : Level} {A : Set a} → A → A
id x = x

record FunProps : Setω where
  field
    comp-assoc :
      ∀ {a b c d : Level}
        {A : Set a} {B : Set b} {C : Set c} {D : Set d}
        (h : C → D) (g : B → C) (f : A → B) →
        comp h (comp g f) ≡ comp (comp h g) f

    comp-id-l :
      ∀ {a b : Level} {A : Set a} {B : Set b}
        (f : A → B) →
        comp id f ≡ f

    comp-id-r :
      ∀ {a b : Level} {A : Set a} {B : Set b}
        (f : A → B) →
        comp f id ≡ f

commute : ∀ {a : Level} {A : Set a} → (A → A) → (A → A) → Set a
commute f g = comp f g ≡ comp g f

module CompCommute {a : Level} {A : Set a} (FP : FunProps) where
  open FunProps FP

  commute-symm : Set a
  commute-symm =
    (f g : A → A) →
    commute f g →
    commute g f

  commute-with-id-l : Set a
  commute-with-id-l =
    (f : A → A) →
    commute f id

  commute-with-id-r : Set a
  commute-with-id-r =
    (f : A → A) →
    commute id f

  commute-refl : Set a
  commute-refl =
    (f : A → A) →
    commute f f

  commute-congr : Set a
  commute-congr =
    (f1 f2 g1 g2 : A → A) →
    f1 ≡ f2 →
    g1 ≡ g2 →
    commute f1 g1 →
    commute f2 g2

  commute-transport-left-id : Set a
  commute-transport-left-id =
    (f g : A → A) →
    commute f g →
    commute (comp id f) g

  commute-transport-right-id : Set a
  commute-transport-right-id =
    (f g : A → A) →
    commute f g →
    commute f (comp id g)

  ``cc_commute (f : 'a -> 'a) (g : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      cc_comp f g = cc_comp g f``);

  ``!(f : 'a -> 'a).
      cc_commute (cc_id : 'a -> 'a) f``;

val commute_refl =
  ``!(f : 'a -> 'a).
      cc_commute f f``;

val commute_congr =
  ``!(f1 : 'a -> 'a) f2 g1 g2.
      f1 = f2 ==>
      g1 = g2 ==>
      cc_commute f1 g1 ==>
      cc_commute f2 g2``;

val commute_transport_left_id =
  ``!(f : 'a -> 'a) g.
      cc_commute f g ==>
      cc_commute (cc_comp (cc_id : 'a -> 'a) f) g``;

val commute_transport_right_id =
  ``!(f : 'a -> 'a) g.
      cc_commute f g ==>
      cc_commute f (cc_comp (cc_id : 'a -> 'a) g)``;

% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic comp_commute. This file contains no
% proof.

comp_commute[A: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  myComp(g, f: [A -> A]): [A -> A] =
    LAMBDA (x: A): g(f(x))

  myId(x: A): A = x

  comp_assoc: bool =
    FORALL (h, g, f: [A -> A]):
      myComp(h, myComp(g, f)) = myComp(myComp(h, g), f)

  comp_id_l: bool =
    FORALL (f: [A -> A]): myComp(myId, f) = f

  comp_id_r: bool =
    FORALL (f: [A -> A]): myComp(f, myId) = f

  fun_props: bool = comp_assoc AND comp_id_l AND comp_id_r

  commute(f, g: [A -> A]): bool =
    myComp(f, g) = myComp(g, f)

  commute_symm: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g: [A -> A]):
        commute(f, g) IMPLIES commute(g, f))

  commute_with_id_l: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [A -> A]): commute(f, myId))

  commute_with_id_r: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [A -> A]): commute(myId, f))

  commute_refl: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [A -> A]): commute(f, f))

  commute_congr: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f1, f2, g1, g2: [A -> A]):
        f1 = f2 IMPLIES
          (g1 = g2 IMPLIES
            (commute(f1, g1) IMPLIES commute(f2, g2))))

  commute_transport_left_id: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g: [A -> A]):
        commute(f, g) IMPLIES commute(myComp(myId, f), g))

  commute_transport_right_id: bool =
    fun_props IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f, g: [A -> A]):
        commute(f, g) IMPLIES commute(f, myComp(myId, g)))
END comp_commute

theory galois
  imports Main
begin





locale field_like =
  fixes zero_F one_F :: "'f"
    and add_F :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"  (infixl "+F" 65)
    and mul_F :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"  (infixl "*F" 70)
    and opp_F :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and inv_F :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
  assumes add_comm    : "\<And>x y. x +F y = y +F x"
    and   add_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x +F y) +F z = x +F (y +F z)"
    and   add_zero    : "\<And>x. x +F zero_F = x"
    and   add_inv_l   : "\<And>x. opp_F x +F x = zero_F"
    and   mul_comm    : "\<And>x y. x *F y = y *F x"
    and   mul_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x *F y) *F z = x *F (y *F z)"
    and   mul_one_l   : "\<And>x. one_F *F x = x"
    and   mul_inv_l   : "\<And>x. x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> inv_F x *F x = one_F"
    and   distrib_l   : "\<And>x y z. x *F (y +F z) = (x *F y) +F (x *F z)"
    and   zero_neq_one: "zero_F \<noteq> one_F"
    and   inv_nonzero : "\<And>x. x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> inv_F x \<noteq> zero_F"
begin


lemma zero_add: "zero_F +F x = x"
  sorry
lemma mul_one_r: "x *F one_F = x"
  sorry
lemma mul_inv_r: "x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> x *F inv_F x = one_F"
  sorry


lemma add_cancel_l: "x +F y = x +F z \<Longrightarrow> y = z"
  sorry
lemma add_cancel_r: "y +F x = z +F x \<Longrightarrow> y = z"
  sorry
lemma mul_cancel_l: "x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> x *F y = x *F z \<Longrightarrow> y = z"
  sorry
lemma mul_cancel_r: "x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> y *F x = z *F x \<Longrightarrow> y = z"
  sorry
lemma inv_unique: "x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> x *F y = one_F \<Longrightarrow> y = inv_F x"
  sorry
lemma inv_involutive: "x \<noteq> zero_F \<Longrightarrow> inv_F (inv_F x) = x"
  sorry
end









locale tower =
  fixes S    :: "'p \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and mp   :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and splt :: "'p \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes scalar_tower : "\<And>p q. S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp q) \<Longrightarrow> S q"
    and   map_solv     : "\<And>p. S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp p)"
    and   splits_solv  : "\<And>p. splt p \<Longrightarrow> S p"
begin

lemma gal_isSolvable_tower:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp q) \<Longrightarrow> S q"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_double_tower:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp q) \<Longrightarrow> S (mp r) \<Longrightarrow> S r"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_triple_tower:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp q) \<Longrightarrow> S (mp r) \<Longrightarrow> S (mp s) \<Longrightarrow> S s"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp q) \<Longrightarrow> S (mp r) \<Longrightarrow> S (mp s) \<Longrightarrow> S (mp t) \<Longrightarrow> S t"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_map_poly:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp p)"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_of_split:
  "splt p \<Longrightarrow> S p"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_split_tower:
  "splt q \<Longrightarrow> S q"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_two_step_map:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp (mp p))"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_three_step_map:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp (mp (mp p)))"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp:
  "S p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp (mp p))"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_mutual_split:
  "splt p \<Longrightarrow> splt q \<Longrightarrow> S p \<and> S q"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_map_after_split:
  "splt p \<Longrightarrow> S (mp p)"
  sorry
lemma gal_isSolvable_tower_split:
  "splt q \<Longrightarrow> S (mp r) \<Longrightarrow> S r"
  sorry
end

end

title: galois
galois
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal corpus artifact galois:
;; cancellation and inverse laws for arbitrary fields, and solvability
;; propagation through map-sensitive polynomial maps and splitting-field
;; towers over arbitrary types. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A field structure is represented by a tag together with conservative
;; operations indexed by that tag. Its carrier is an arbitrary predicate,
;; not an enumeration, and every source law and typing condition is explicit.

(defstub galois-field-element-p (field value) t)
(defstub galois-field-zero (field) t)
(defstub galois-field-one (field) t)
(defstub galois-field-add (field x y) t)
(defstub galois-field-mul (field x y) t)
(defstub galois-field-opp (field x) t)
(defstub galois-field-inv (field x) t)

(defun-sk galois-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (galois-field-element-p field x)
       (galois-field-element-p field y))
      (and
       (galois-field-element-p
        field (galois-field-add field x y))
       (galois-field-element-p
        field (galois-field-mul field x y))
       (equal
        (galois-field-add field x y)
        (galois-field-add field y x))
       (equal
        (galois-field-mul field x y)
        (galois-field-mul field y x))))
     (implies
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (and
       (galois-field-element-p
        field (galois-field-opp field x))
       (galois-field-element-p
        field (galois-field-inv field x))
       (equal
        (galois-field-add
         field x (galois-field-zero field))
        x)
       (equal
        (galois-field-add
         field (galois-field-opp field x) x)
        (galois-field-zero field))
       (equal
        (galois-field-mul
         field (galois-field-one field) x)
        x)
       (implies
        (not (equal x (galois-field-zero field)))
        (and
         (equal
          (galois-field-mul
           field (galois-field-inv field x) x)
          (galois-field-one field))
         (not
          (equal
           (galois-field-inv field x)
           (galois-field-zero field)))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (galois-field-element-p field x)
       (galois-field-element-p field y)
       (galois-field-element-p field z))
      (and
       (equal
        (galois-field-add
         field (galois-field-add field x y) z)
        (galois-field-add
         field x (galois-field-add field y z)))
       (equal
        (galois-field-mul
         field (galois-field-mul field x y) z)
        (galois-field-mul
         field x (galois-field-mul field y z)))
       (equal
        (galois-field-mul
         field x (galois-field-add field y z))
        (galois-field-add
         field
         (galois-field-mul field x y)
         (galois-field-mul field x z))))))))

(defun galois-field-p (field)
  (and
   (galois-field-element-p
    field (galois-field-zero field))
   (galois-field-element-p
    field (galois-field-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (galois-field-zero field)
     (galois-field-one field)))
   (galois-field-laws-p field)))

(defun-sk galois-add-cancel-left-statement ()
  (forall (field x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-field-p field)
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (galois-field-element-p field y)
      (galois-field-element-p field z)
      (equal
       (galois-field-add field x y)
       (galois-field-add field x z)))
     (equal y z))))

(defun-sk galois-add-cancel-right-statement ()
  (forall (field x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-field-p field)
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (galois-field-element-p field y)
      (galois-field-element-p field z)
      (equal
       (galois-field-add field y x)
       (galois-field-add field z x)))
     (equal y z))))

(defun-sk galois-mul-cancel-left-statement ()
  (forall (field x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-field-p field)
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (galois-field-element-p field y)
      (galois-field-element-p field z)
      (not (equal x (galois-field-zero field)))
      (equal
       (galois-field-mul field x y)
       (galois-field-mul field x z)))
     (equal y z))))

(defun-sk galois-mul-cancel-right-statement ()
  (forall (field x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-field-p field)
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (galois-field-element-p field y)
      (galois-field-element-p field z)
      (not (equal x (galois-field-zero field)))
      (equal
       (galois-field-mul field y x)
       (galois-field-mul field z x)))
     (equal y z))))

(defun-sk galois-inverse-unique-statement ()
  (forall (field x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-field-p field)
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (galois-field-element-p field y)
      (not (equal x (galois-field-zero field)))
      (equal
       (galois-field-mul field x y)
       (galois-field-one field)))
     (equal y (galois-field-inv field x)))))

(defun-sk galois-inverse-involutive-statement ()
  (forall (field x)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-field-p field)
      (galois-field-element-p field x)
      (not (equal x (galois-field-zero field))))
     (equal
      (galois-field-inv
       field (galois-field-inv field x))
      x))))

;; The tower tag packages the source's polymorphic polynomial family,
;; splitting-field family, algebra maps, Splits predicate, polynomial mapping,
;; Gal family, and IsSolvable predicate. Types, polynomials, and coefficient
;; maps remain arbitrary ACL2 objects guarded by predicates. Map application
;; and composition are explicit, so map_poly and Splits can distinguish maps
;; having the same source and target types.

(defstub galois-type-p (tower type) t)
(defstub galois-type-element-p (tower type value) t)
(defstub galois-polynomial-p (tower coefficient-type polynomial) t)

(defstub galois-coefficient-map-apply (tower map value) t)
(defstub galois-algebra-map (tower source-type target-type) t)
(defstub galois-compose-coefficient-maps
  (tower source-type middle-type target-type first-map second-map)
  t)

(defstub galois-splitting-field
  (tower coefficient-type polynomial)
  t)
(defstub galois-map-poly
  (tower source-type target-type polynomial coefficient-map)
  t)
(defstub galois-splits-p
  (tower source-type target-type polynomial coefficient-map)
  t)
(defstub galois-gal
  (tower coefficient-type polynomial)
  t)
(defstub galois-is-solvable-p (tower group-type) t)

(defun-sk galois-coefficient-map-p
    (tower source-type target-type map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (galois-type-element-p tower source-type x)
     (galois-type-element-p
      tower target-type
      (galois-coefficient-map-apply tower map x)))))

(defun-sk galois-tower-signature-p (tower)
  (forall
    (source-type middle-type target-type polynomial
                 first-map second-map x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (galois-type-p tower source-type)
       (galois-polynomial-p
        tower source-type polynomial))
      (and
       (galois-type-p
        tower
        (galois-splitting-field
         tower source-type polynomial))
       (galois-type-p
        tower
        (galois-gal tower source-type polynomial))))
     (implies
      (and
       (galois-type-p tower source-type)
       (galois-type-p tower target-type))
      (galois-coefficient-map-p
       tower source-type target-type
       (galois-algebra-map
        tower source-type target-type)))
     (implies
      (and
       (galois-type-p tower source-type)
       (galois-type-p tower target-type)
       (galois-polynomial-p
        tower source-type polynomial)
       (galois-coefficient-map-p
        tower source-type target-type first-map))
      (galois-polynomial-p
       tower target-type
       (galois-map-poly
        tower source-type target-type
        polynomial first-map)))
     (implies
      (and
       (galois-type-p tower source-type)
       (galois-type-p tower middle-type)
       (galois-type-p tower target-type)
       (galois-coefficient-map-p
        tower source-type middle-type first-map)
       (galois-coefficient-map-p
        tower middle-type target-type second-map))
      (and
       (galois-coefficient-map-p
        tower source-type target-type
        (galois-compose-coefficient-maps
         tower source-type middle-type target-type
         first-map second-map))
       (implies
        (galois-type-element-p tower source-type x)
        (equal
         (galois-coefficient-map-apply
          tower
          (galois-compose-coefficient-maps
           tower source-type middle-type target-type
           first-map second-map)
          x)
         (galois-coefficient-map-apply
          tower second-map
          (galois-coefficient-map-apply
           tower first-map x)))))))))

(defun galois-polynomial-solvable-p
    (tower coefficient-type polynomial)
  (galois-is-solvable-p
   tower
   (galois-gal tower coefficient-type polynomial)))

(defun-sk galois-map-poly-comp-assumption-p (tower)
  (forall
    (source-type middle-type target-type polynomial
                 first-map second-map)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-type-p tower source-type)
      (galois-type-p tower middle-type)
      (galois-type-p tower target-type)
      (galois-polynomial-p
       tower source-type polynomial)
      (galois-coefficient-map-p
       tower source-type middle-type first-map)
      (galois-coefficient-map-p
       tower middle-type target-type second-map))
     (equal
      (galois-map-poly
       tower middle-type target-type
       (galois-map-poly
        tower source-type middle-type polynomial first-map)
       second-map)
      (galois-map-poly
       tower source-type target-type polynomial
       (galois-compose-coefficient-maps
        tower source-type middle-type target-type
        first-map second-map))))))

(defun-sk galois-scalar-tower-assumption-p (tower)
  (forall (source-type target-type p q)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-type-p tower source-type)
      (galois-type-p tower target-type)
      (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type p)
      (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type q)
      (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
       tower source-type p)
      (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
       tower target-type
       (galois-map-poly
        tower source-type target-type q
        (galois-algebra-map
         tower source-type target-type))))
     (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
      tower source-type q))))

(defun-sk galois-map-solvable-assumption-p (tower)
  (forall (source-type target-type polynomial)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-type-p tower source-type)
      (galois-type-p tower target-type)
      (galois-polynomial-p
       tower source-type polynomial)
      (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
       tower source-type polynomial))
     (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
      tower target-type
      (galois-map-poly
       tower source-type target-type polynomial
       (galois-algebra-map
        tower source-type target-type))))))

(defun-sk galois-splits-solvable-assumption-p (tower)
  (forall
    (source-type target-type polynomial coefficient-map)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-type-p tower source-type)
      (galois-type-p tower target-type)
      (galois-polynomial-p
       tower source-type polynomial)
      (galois-coefficient-map-p
       tower source-type target-type coefficient-map)
      (galois-splits-p
       tower source-type target-type
       polynomial coefficient-map))
     (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
      tower source-type polynomial))))

(defun galois-tower-context-p (tower)
  (and
   (galois-tower-signature-p tower)
   (galois-map-poly-comp-assumption-p tower)
   (galois-scalar-tower-assumption-p tower)
   (galois-map-solvable-assumption-p tower)
   (galois-splits-solvable-assumption-p tower)))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-tower-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type p q)
    (let ((split-p
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type p)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type q)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-p
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-p q
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-p))))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower source-type q)))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-double-tower-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type p q r)
    (let ((split-p
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type p))
          (split-q
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type q)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type q)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type r)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-p
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-p q
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-p)))
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-q
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-q r
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-q))))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower source-type r)))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-triple-tower-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type p q r s)
    (let ((split-p
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type p))
          (split-q
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type q))
          (split-r
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type r)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type q)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type r)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type s)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-p
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-p q
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-p)))
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-q
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-q r
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-q)))
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-r
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-r s
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-r))))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower source-type s)))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-quadruple-tower-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type p q r s u)
    (let ((split-p
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type p))
          (split-q
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type q))
          (split-r
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type r))
          (split-s
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type s)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type q)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type r)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type s)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type u)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-p
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-p q
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-p)))
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-q
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-q r
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-q)))
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-r
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-r s
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-r)))
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower split-s
         (galois-map-poly
          tower source-type split-s u
          (galois-algebra-map
           tower source-type split-s))))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower source-type u)))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-map-poly-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type target-type polynomial)
    (implies
     (and
      (galois-tower-context-p tower)
      (galois-type-p tower source-type)
      (galois-type-p tower target-type)
      (galois-polynomial-p
       tower source-type polynomial)
      (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
       tower source-type polynomial))
     (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
      tower target-type
      (galois-map-poly
       tower source-type target-type polynomial
       (galois-algebra-map
        tower source-type target-type))))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-of-split-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type polynomial)
    (let ((split-type
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type polynomial)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p
         tower source-type polynomial)
        (galois-splits-p
         tower source-type split-type polynomial
         (galois-algebra-map
          tower source-type split-type)))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower source-type polynomial)))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-split-tower-statement ()
  (forall (tower source-type p q)
    (let ((split-p
           (galois-splitting-field
            tower source-type p)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type p)
        (galois-polynomial-p tower source-type q)
        (galois-splits-p
         tower source-type split-p q
         (galois-algebra-map
          tower source-type split-p)))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower source-type q)))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-two-step-map-statement ()
  (forall
    (tower source-type middle-type target-type polynomial)
    (let* ((first-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower source-type middle-type))
           (second-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower middle-type target-type))
           (first-polynomial
            (galois-map-poly
             tower source-type middle-type
             polynomial first-map)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-type-p tower middle-type)
        (galois-type-p tower target-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p
         tower source-type polynomial)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower source-type polynomial))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower target-type
        (galois-map-poly
         tower middle-type target-type
         first-polynomial second-map))))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-three-step-map-statement ()
  (forall
    (tower source-type first-type second-type target-type polynomial)
    (let* ((first-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower source-type first-type))
           (second-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower first-type second-type))
           (third-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower second-type target-type))
           (first-polynomial
            (galois-map-poly
             tower source-type first-type
             polynomial first-map))
           (second-polynomial
            (galois-map-poly
             tower first-type second-type
             first-polynomial second-map)))
      (implies
       (and
        (galois-tower-context-p tower)
        (galois-type-p tower source-type)
        (galois-type-p tower first-type)
        (galois-type-p tower second-type)
        (galois-type-p tower target-type)
        (galois-polynomial-p
         tower source-type polynomial)
        (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
         tower source-type polynomial))
       (galois-polynomial-solvable-p
        tower target-type
        (galois-map-poly
         tower second-type target-type
         second-polynomial third-map))))))

(defun-sk galois-solvable-map-poly-comp-statement ()
  (forall
    (tower source-type middle-type target-type polynomial)
    (let* ((first-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower source-type middle-type))
           (second-map
            (galois-algebra-map
             tower middle-type target-type))
           (first-polynomial

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic galois. This file contains no proof.

module galois where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

data ⊥ : Set where

infix 4 _≢_
_≢_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≢ y = x ≡ y → ⊥

infixr 2 _∧_
record _∧_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    left  : A
    right : B

record Field (F : Set) : Set where
  field
    zero     : F
    one      : F
    add      : F → F → F
    multiply : F → F → F
    negate   : F → F
    inverse  : F → F

    add-commutative : (x y : F) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : F) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero : (x : F) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left : (x : F) → add (negate x) x ≡ zero

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : F) → multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : F) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one-left : (x : F) → multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-inverse-left :
      (x : F) → x ≢ zero → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ one

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : F) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡ add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)

    zero-not-one    : zero ≢ one
    inverse-nonzero : (x : F) → x ≢ zero → inverse x ≢ zero

module FieldProperties {F : Set} (structure : Field F) where
  open Field structure

  add-cancel-left : Set
  add-cancel-left =
    (x y z : F) → add x y ≡ add x z → y ≡ z

  add-cancel-right : Set
  add-cancel-right =
    (x y z : F) → add y x ≡ add z x → y ≡ z

  multiply-cancel-left : Set
  multiply-cancel-left =
    (x y z : F) →
    x ≢ zero →
    multiply x y ≡ multiply x z →
    y ≡ z

  multiply-cancel-right : Set
  multiply-cancel-right =
    (x y z : F) →
    x ≢ zero →
    multiply y x ≡ multiply z x →
    y ≡ z

  inverse-unique : Set
  inverse-unique =
    (x y : F) →
    x ≢ zero →
    multiply x y ≡ one →
    y ≡ inverse x

  inverse-involutive : Set
  inverse-involutive =
    (x : F) → x ≢ zero → inverse (inverse x) ≡ x

module Tower
  (Polynomial : Set → Set)
  (SplittingField : {F : Set} → Polynomial F → Set)
  (algebraMap : {F K : Set} → F → K)
  (Splits : {F K : Set} → Polynomial F → (F → K) → Set)
  (mapPolynomial :
    {F K : Set} → Polynomial F → (F → K) → Polynomial K)
  (GaloisGroup : {F : Set} → Polynomial F → Set)
  (IsSolvable : Set → Set)
  where

  record TowerAxioms : Set₁ where
    field
      map-polynomial-compose :
        {F K L : Set} →
        (p : Polynomial F) →
        (f : F → K) →
        (g : K → L) →
        mapPolynomial (mapPolynomial p f) g ≡
        mapPolynomial p (λ x → g (f x))

      is-solvable-of-scalar-tower :
        {F K : Set} {p q : Polynomial F} →
        IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
        IsSolvable
          (GaloisGroup
            (mapPolynomial q (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K}))) →
        IsSolvable (GaloisGroup q)

      is-solvable-map-polynomial :
        {F K : Set} →
        (p : Polynomial F) →
        IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
        IsSolvable
          (GaloisGroup
            (mapPolynomial p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K})))

      is-solvable-of-splits :
        {F K : Set} →
        (p : Polynomial F) →
        (f : F → K) →
        Splits p f →
        IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p)

  gal-isSolvable-tower :
    {F : Set} → (p q : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-tower {F} p q =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial q
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}))) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup q)

  gal-isSolvable-double-tower :
    {F : Set} → (p q r : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-double-tower {F} p q r =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial q
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}))) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial r
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField q}))) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup r)

  gal-isSolvable-triple-tower :
    {F : Set} → (p q r s : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-triple-tower {F} p q r s =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial q
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}))) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial r
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField q}))) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial s
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField r}))) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup s)

  gal-isSolvable-quadruple-tower :
    {F : Set} → (p q r s t : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-quadruple-tower {F} p q r s t =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial q
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}))) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial r
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField q}))) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial s
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField r}))) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial t
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField s}))) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup t)

  gal-isSolvable-map-polynomial :
    {F : Set} → (p : Polynomial F) → (K : Set) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-map-polynomial {F} p K =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K})))

  gal-isSolvable-of-split :
    {F : Set} → (p : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-of-split {F} p =
    TowerAxioms →
    Splits p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p)

  gal-isSolvable-split-tower :
    {F : Set} → (p q : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-split-tower {F} p q =
    TowerAxioms →
    Splits q (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup q)

  gal-isSolvable-two-step-map :
    {F : Set} → (p : Polynomial F) → (K L : Set) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-two-step-map {F} p K L =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial
          (mapPolynomial p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K}))
          (algebraMap {F = K} {K = L})))

  gal-isSolvable-three-step-map :
    {F : Set} → (p : Polynomial F) → (K L M : Set) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-three-step-map {F} p K L M =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial
          (mapPolynomial
            (mapPolynomial p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K}))
            (algebraMap {F = K} {K = L}))
          (algebraMap {F = L} {K = M})))

  gal-isSolvable-map-polynomial-compose :
    {F : Set} → (p : Polynomial F) → (K L : Set) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-map-polynomial-compose {F} p K L =
    TowerAxioms →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial
          (mapPolynomial p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K}))
          (algebraMap {F = K} {K = L})))

  gal-isSolvable-mutual-split :
    {F : Set} → (p q : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-mutual-split {F} p q =
    TowerAxioms →
    Splits p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField q}) →
    Splits q (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup p) ∧ IsSolvable (GaloisGroup q)

  gal-isSolvable-tower-split :
    {F : Set} → (p q r : Polynomial F) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-tower-split {F} p q r =
    TowerAxioms →
    Splits q (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial r
          (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField q}))) →
    IsSolvable (GaloisGroup r)

  gal-isSolvable-map-after-split :
    {F : Set} → (p : Polynomial F) → (K : Set) → Set₁
  gal-isSolvable-map-after-split {F} p K =
    TowerAxioms →
    Splits p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = SplittingField p}) →
    IsSolvable
      (GaloisGroup
        (mapPolynomial p (algebraMap {F = F} {K = K})))

(*

  towers. This file contains no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val add_cancel_l =
  ``!(zerof : 'f) (onef : 'f)
      (addf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (oppf : 'f -> 'f) (invf : 'f -> 'f).
      ((!x y. addf x y = addf y x) /\
       (!x y z. addf (addf x y) z = addf x (addf y z)) /\
       (!x. addf x zerof = x) /\
       (!x. addf (oppf x) x = zerof) /\
       (!x y. mulf x y = mulf y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulf (mulf x y) z = mulf x (mulf y z)) /\
       (!x. mulf onef x = x) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zerof) ==> mulf (invf x) x = onef) /\
       (!x y z.
          mulf x (addf y z) = addf (mulf x y) (mulf x z)) /\
       ~(zerof = onef) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zerof) ==> ~(invf x = zerof))) ==>
      !x y z. addf x y = addf x z ==> y = z``;

val add_cancel_r =
  ``!(zerof : 'f) (onef : 'f)
      (addf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)

      ((!x y. addf x y = addf y x) /\
       (!x y z. addf (addf x y) z = addf x (addf y z)) /\
       (!x. addf x zerof = x) /\

       (!x y. mulf x y = mulf y x) /\

val mul_cancel_l =
  ``!(zerof : 'f) (onef : 'f)
      (addf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (oppf : 'f -> 'f) (invf : 'f -> 'f).
      ((!x y. addf x y = addf y x) /\
       (!x y z. addf (addf x y) z = addf x (addf y z)) /\
       (!x. addf x zerof = x) /\
       (!x. addf (oppf x) x = zerof) /\

val mul_cancel_r =
  ``!(zerof : 'f) (onef : 'f)
      (addf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (oppf : 'f -> 'f) (invf : 'f -> 'f).
      ((!x y. addf x y = addf y x) /\
       (!x y z. addf (addf x y) z = addf x (addf y z)) /\
       (!x. addf x zerof = x) /\

val inv_unique =
  ``!(zerof : 'f) (onef : 'f)
      (addf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (oppf : 'f -> 'f) (invf : 'f -> 'f).
      ((!x y. addf x y = addf y x) /\
       (!x y z. addf (addf x y) z = addf x (addf y z)) /\
       (!x. addf x zerof = x) /\
       (!x. addf (oppf x) x = zerof) /\
       (!x y. mulf x y = mulf y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulf (mulf x y) z = mulf x (mulf y z)) /\
       (!x. mulf onef x = x) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zerof) ==> mulf (invf x) x = onef) /\
       (!x y z.
          mulf x (addf y z) = addf (mulf x y) (mulf x z)) /\
       ~(zerof = onef) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zerof) ==> ~(invf x = zerof))) ==>
      !x y.
        ~(x = zerof) ==> mulf x y = onef ==> y = invf x``;

val inv_involutive =
  ``!(zerof : 'f) (onef : 'f)
      (addf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (mulf : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (oppf : 'f -> 'f) (invf : 'f -> 'f).
      ((!x y. addf x y = addf y x) /\
       (!x y z. addf (addf x y) z = addf x (addf y z)) /\
       (!x. addf x zerof = x) /\
       (!x. addf (oppf x) x = zerof) /\
       (!x y. mulf x y = mulf y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulf (mulf x y) z = mulf x (mulf y z)) /\
       (!x. mulf onef x = x) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zerof) ==> mulf (invf x) x = onef) /\
       (!x y z.
          mulf x (addf y z) = addf (mulf x y) (mulf x z)) /\
       ~(zerof = onef) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zerof) ==> ~(invf x = zerof))) ==>
      !x. ~(x = zerof) ==> invf (invf x) = x``;

val map_poly_comp =
  ``!(mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (mapkl : 'pk -> ('k -> 'l) -> 'pl)
      (mapfl : 'pf -> ('f -> 'l) -> 'pl)
      (p : 'pf) (f : 'f -> 'k) (g : 'k -> 'l).
      mapkl (mapfk p f) g = mapfl p (\x. g (f x))``;

val isSolvable_of_isScalarTower =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k) (p : 'pf) q.
      solvf p ==>
      solvk (mapfk q algebrafk) ==>
      solvf q``;

val isSolvable_map_poly =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k) (p : 'pf).
      solvf p ==> solvk (mapfk p algebrafk)``;

val isSolvable_of_splits =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool)
      (splitsfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> bool)
      (p : 'pf) (f : 'f -> 'k).
      splitsfk p f ==> solvf p``;

val gal_isSolvable_tower =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool) (solvfp : 'pp -> bool)
      (mapfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> 'pp)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp) (p : 'p) q.
      (!u v.
         solvf u ==>
         solvfp (mapfp v (splitmapfp p)) ==>
         solvf v) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvfp (mapfp q (splitmapfp p)) ==>
      solvf q``;

val gal_isSolvable_double_tower =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool)
      (solvfp : 'pp -> bool) (solvfq : 'pq -> bool)
      (mapfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> 'pp)
      (mapfq : 'p -> ('f -> 'fq) -> 'pq)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp)
      (splitmapfq : 'p -> 'f -> 'fq)
      (p : 'p) q r.
      ((!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfp (mapfp v (splitmapfp p)) ==>
          solvf v) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfq (mapfq v (splitmapfq q)) ==>
          solvf v)) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvfp (mapfp q (splitmapfp p)) ==>
      solvfq (mapfq r (splitmapfq q)) ==>
      solvf r``;

val gal_isSolvable_triple_tower =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool)
      (solvfp : 'pp -> bool) (solvfq : 'pq -> bool)
      (solvfr : 'pr -> bool)
      (mapfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> 'pp)
      (mapfq : 'p -> ('f -> 'fq) -> 'pq)
      (mapfr : 'p -> ('f -> 'fr) -> 'pr)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp)
      (splitmapfq : 'p -> 'f -> 'fq)
      (splitmapfr : 'p -> 'f -> 'fr) (p : 'p) q r s.
      ((!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfp (mapfp v (splitmapfp p)) ==>
          solvf v) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfq (mapfq v (splitmapfq q)) ==>
          solvf v) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfr (mapfr v (splitmapfr r)) ==>
          solvf v)) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvfp (mapfp q (splitmapfp p)) ==>
      solvfq (mapfq r (splitmapfq q)) ==>
      solvfr (mapfr s (splitmapfr r)) ==>
      solvf s``;

val gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool)
      (solvfp : 'pp -> bool) (solvfq : 'pq -> bool)
      (solvfr : 'pr -> bool) (solvfs : 'ps -> bool)
      (mapfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> 'pp)
      (mapfq : 'p -> ('f -> 'fq) -> 'pq)
      (mapfr : 'p -> ('f -> 'fr) -> 'pr)
      (mapfs : 'p -> ('f -> 'fs) -> 'ps)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp)
      (splitmapfq : 'p -> 'f -> 'fq)
      (splitmapfr : 'p -> 'f -> 'fr)
      (splitmapfs : 'p -> 'f -> 'fs)
      (p : 'p) q r s t.
      ((!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfp (mapfp v (splitmapfp p)) ==>
          solvf v) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfq (mapfq v (splitmapfq q)) ==>
          solvf v) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfr (mapfr v (splitmapfr r)) ==>
          solvf v) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfs (mapfs v (splitmapfs s)) ==>
          solvf v)) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvfp (mapfp q (splitmapfp p)) ==>
      solvfq (mapfq r (splitmapfq q)) ==>
      solvfr (mapfr s (splitmapfr r)) ==>
      solvfs (mapfs t (splitmapfs s)) ==>
      solvf t``;

val gal_isSolvable_map_poly =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k) (p : 'pf).
      (!u. solvf u ==> solvk (mapfk u algebrafk)) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvk (mapfk p algebrafk)``;

val gal_isSolvable_of_split =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool)
      (splitsfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> bool)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp) (p : 'p).
      (!u f. splitsfp u f ==> solvf u) ==>
      splitsfp p (splitmapfp p) ==>
      solvf p``;

val gal_isSolvable_split_tower =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool)
      (splitsfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> bool)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp) (p : 'p) q.
      (!u f. splitsfp u f ==> solvf u) ==>
      splitsfp q (splitmapfp p) ==>
      solvf q``;

val gal_isSolvable_two_step_map =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (solvl : 'pl -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (mapkl : 'pk -> ('k -> 'l) -> 'pl)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k) (algebrakl : 'k -> 'l)
      (p : 'pf).
      ((!u. solvf u ==> solvk (mapfk u algebrafk)) /\
       (!v. solvk v ==> solvl (mapkl v algebrakl))) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvl (mapkl (mapfk p algebrafk) algebrakl)``;

val gal_isSolvable_three_step_map =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (solvl : 'pl -> bool) (solvm : 'pm -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (mapkl : 'pk -> ('k -> 'l) -> 'pl)
      (maplm : 'pl -> ('l -> 'm) -> 'pm)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k) (algebrakl : 'k -> 'l)
      (algebralm : 'l -> 'm) (p : 'pf).
      ((!u. solvf u ==> solvk (mapfk u algebrafk)) /\
       (!v. solvk v ==> solvl (mapkl v algebrakl)) /\
       (!w. solvl w ==> solvm (maplm w algebralm))) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvm
        (maplm
          (mapkl (mapfk p algebrafk) algebrakl)
          algebralm)``;

val gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (solvl : 'pl -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (mapkl : 'pk -> ('k -> 'l) -> 'pl)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k) (algebrakl : 'k -> 'l)
      (p : 'pf).
      ((!u. solvf u ==> solvk (mapfk u algebrafk)) /\
       (!v. solvk v ==> solvl (mapkl v algebrakl))) ==>
      solvf p ==>
      solvl (mapkl (mapfk p algebrafk) algebrakl)``;

val gal_isSolvable_mutual_split =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool)
      (splitsfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> bool)
      (splitsfq : 'p -> ('f -> 'fq) -> bool)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp)
      (splitmapfq : 'p -> 'f -> 'fq)
      (p : 'p) q.
      ((!u f. splitsfp u f ==> solvf u) /\
       (!u f. splitsfq u f ==> solvf u)) ==>
      splitsfq p (splitmapfq q) ==>
      splitsfp q (splitmapfp p) ==>
      solvf p /\ solvf q``;

val gal_isSolvable_tower_split =
  ``!(solvf : 'p -> bool) (solvfq : 'pq -> bool)
      (mapfq : 'p -> ('f -> 'fq) -> 'pq)
      (splitsfp : 'p -> ('f -> 'fp) -> bool)
      (splitmapfp : 'p -> 'f -> 'fp)
      (splitmapfq : 'p -> 'f -> 'fq)
      (p : 'p) q r.
      ((!u f. splitsfp u f ==> solvf u) /\
       (!u v.
          solvf u ==>
          solvfq (mapfq v (splitmapfq q)) ==>
          solvf v)) ==>
      splitsfp q (splitmapfp p) ==>
      solvfq (mapfq r (splitmapfq q)) ==>
      solvf r``;

val gal_isSolvable_map_after_split =
  ``!(solvf : 'pf -> bool) (solvk : 'pk -> bool)
      (mapfk : 'pf -> ('f -> 'k) -> 'pk)
      (splitsfp : 'pf -> ('f -> 'fp) -> bool)
      (algebrafk : 'f -> 'k)
      (splitmapfp : 'pf -> 'f -> 'fp)
      (p : 'pf).
      ((!u f. splitsfp u f ==> solvf u) /\
       (!u. solvf u ==> solvk (mapfk u algebrafk))) ==>
      splitsfp p (splitmapfp p) ==>
      solvk (mapfk p algebrafk)``;

val _ = export_theory();

$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal galois artifact: field
  cancellation and inverses, and solvability of Galois groups along polynomial
  splitting-field towers. This file contains no proof.
$)

$(
  Statement-only translation of the Babel-formal galois artifact.

  The object language is many-sorted.  Field elements remain indexed by an
  explicit ambient type through In, while PolyOver and MapFrom retain the
  coefficient-field domains of polynomials and maps.  The endpoint-indexed
  term compose F K L g f is the source function x |-> g (f x).  Field and
  Tower are defined bidirectionally from the reified typing obligations and
  exactly the assumptions used by the source statements.  Every mathematical
  declaration below is an unproved $a assertion; this database has no proofs.
$)

$c type elem poly map group wff |- $.
$c ( ) -> <-> /\ -. A.t A.e A.p A.m $.
