$(
  Field is definitionally equivalent to the source structure.  FieldOps
  reifies the closure facts supplied by the source types; FieldLaws is exactly
  the eleven proposition-valued fields of the Lean and Rocq classes.
$)

fieldopsdef $a |- ( ( FieldOps F ) <->
  ( ( In ( zero F ) F ) /\
    ( ( In ( one F ) F ) /\
      ( ( A.e x (
            ( In x F ) ->
            ( ( In ( opp F x ) F ) /\ ( In ( inv F x ) F ) )
          ) ) /\
        ( A.e x ( A.e y (
            ( ( In x F ) /\ ( In y F ) ) ->
            ( ( In ( add F x y ) F ) /\ ( In ( mul F x y ) F ) )
          ) ) ) ) ) )
) $.

fieldlawsdef $a |- ( ( FieldLaws F ) <->
  ( ( A.e x ( A.e y (
        ( ( In x F ) /\ ( In y F ) ) ->
        ( ( add F x y ) =e ( add F y x ) )
      ) ) ) /\
    ( ( A.e x ( A.e y ( A.e z (
          ( ( In x F ) /\ ( ( In y F ) /\ ( In z F ) ) ) ->
          ( ( add F ( add F x y ) z ) =e
            ( add F x ( add F y z ) ) )
        ) ) ) ) /\
      ( ( A.e x (
            ( In x F ) -> ( ( add F x ( zero F ) ) =e x )
          ) ) /\
        ( ( A.e x (
              ( In x F ) ->
              ( ( add F ( opp F x ) x ) =e ( zero F ) )
            ) ) /\
          ( ( A.e x ( A.e y (
                ( ( In x F ) /\ ( In y F ) ) ->
                ( ( mul F x y ) =e ( mul F y x ) )
              ) ) ) /\
            ( ( A.e x ( A.e y ( A.e z (
                  ( ( In x F ) /\ ( ( In y F ) /\ ( In z F ) ) ) ->
                  ( ( mul F ( mul F x y ) z ) =e
                    ( mul F x ( mul F y z ) ) )
                ) ) ) ) /\
              ( ( A.e x (
                    ( In x F ) -> ( ( mul F ( one F ) x ) =e x )
                  ) ) /\
                ( ( A.e x (
                      ( In x F ) ->
                      ( ( -. ( x =e ( zero F ) ) ) ->
                        ( ( mul F ( inv F x ) x ) =e ( one F ) ) )
                    ) ) /\
                  ( ( A.e x ( A.e y ( A.e z (
                        ( ( In x F ) /\
                          ( ( In y F ) /\ ( In z F ) ) ) ->
                        ( ( mul F x ( add F y z ) ) =e
                          ( add F
                            ( mul F x y )
                            ( mul F x z ) ) )
                      ) ) ) ) /\
                    ( ( -. ( ( zero F ) =e ( one F ) ) ) /\
                      ( A.e x (
                          ( In x F ) ->
                          ( ( -. ( x =e ( zero F ) ) ) ->
                            ( -. ( ( inv F x ) =e ( zero F ) ) ) )
                        ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) )
) $.

fielddef $a |- ( ( Field F ) <->
  ( ( FieldOps F ) /\ ( FieldLaws F ) )
) $.

$(
  Tower is definitionally equivalent to the typed polynomial interface and
  the four polymorphic axioms in the source namespace.
$)

towertypingdef $a |- ( TowerTyping <->
  ( ( A.t F ( A.t K ( MapFrom ( alg F K ) F K ) ) ) /\
    ( ( A.t F ( A.t K (
          ( A.m f ( A.e x (
            ( ( MapFrom f F K ) /\ ( In x F ) ) ->
            ( In ( apply F K f x ) K )
          ) ) )
        ) ) ) /\
      ( ( A.t F ( A.t K ( A.t L (
            ( A.m f ( A.m g (
              ( ( MapFrom f F K ) /\ ( MapFrom g K L ) ) ->
              ( MapFrom ( compose F K L g f ) F L )
            ) ) )
          ) ) ) ) /\
        ( A.t F ( A.t K (
            ( A.p p ( A.m f (
              ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\ ( MapFrom f F K ) ) ->
              ( PolyOver ( mapPoly p f ) K )
            ) ) )
          ) ) ) ) ) )
) $.

$(
  This is the pointwise definition of the endpoint-indexed composition term.
  Its argument order follows the source lambda: compose F K L g f sends x to
  g (f x).
$)

composepointdef $a |- (
  A.t F ( A.t K ( A.t L (
    A.m f ( A.m g ( A.e x (
      ( ( MapFrom f F K ) /\
        ( ( MapFrom g K L ) /\ ( In x F ) ) ) ->
      ( ( apply F L ( compose F K L g f ) x ) =e
        ( apply K L g ( apply F K f x ) ) )
    ) ) )
  ) ) )
) $.

towerlawsdef $a |- ( TowerLaws <->
  ( ( A.t F ( A.t K ( A.t L (
        ( A.p p ( A.m f ( A.m g (
          ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\
            ( ( MapFrom f F K ) /\ ( MapFrom g K L ) ) ) ->
          ( ( mapPoly ( mapPoly p f ) g ) =p
            ( mapPoly p ( compose F K L g f ) ) )
        ) ) ) )
      ) ) ) ) /\
    ( ( A.t F ( A.t K (
          ( A.p p ( A.p q (
            ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\ ( PolyOver q F ) ) ->
            ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
              ( ( IsSolvable
                    ( Gal ( mapPoly q ( alg F K ) ) ) ) ->
                ( IsSolvable ( Gal q ) ) ) )
          ) ) )
        ) ) ) /\
      ( ( A.t F ( A.t K (
            ( A.p p (
              ( PolyOver p F ) ->
              ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
                ( IsSolvable
                  ( Gal ( mapPoly p ( alg F K ) ) ) )
            ) )
          ) ) ) /\
        ( A.t F ( A.t K (
            ( A.p p ( A.m f (
              ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\ ( MapFrom f F K ) ) ->
              ( ( Splits p f ) -> ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) )
            ) ) )
          ) ) ) ) ) )
) $.

$(

  ( A.t F ( A.t K ( A.t L (
    ( A.p p ( A.m f ( A.m g (

  ( A.t F ( A.t K (

  ( A.t F ( A.t K (

    ) ) )
  ) ) )

$(
  Galois-solvability tower statements.
$)

galtower $a |- ( Tower ->
  ( A.t F (
    ( A.p p ( A.p q (
      ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\ ( PolyOver q F ) ) ->
      ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
        ( ( IsSolvable
              ( Gal ( mapPoly q ( alg F ( splitField p ) ) ) ) ) ->
          ( IsSolvable ( Gal q ) ) ) )
    ) ) )
  ) )

galdoubletower $a |- ( Tower ->
  ( A.t F (
    ( A.p p ( A.p q ( A.p r (
      ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\
        ( ( PolyOver q F ) /\ ( PolyOver r F ) ) ) ->
      ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
        ( ( IsSolvable
              ( Gal ( mapPoly q ( alg F ( splitField p ) ) ) ) ) ->
          ( ( IsSolvable
                ( Gal ( mapPoly r ( alg F ( splitField q ) ) ) ) ) ->
            ( IsSolvable ( Gal r ) ) ) ) )
    ) ) ) )
  ) )
) $.

galtripletower $a |- ( Tower ->
  ( A.t F (
    ( A.p p ( A.p q ( A.p r ( A.p s (
      ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\
        ( ( PolyOver q F ) /\
          ( ( PolyOver r F ) /\ ( PolyOver s F ) ) ) ) ->
      ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
        ( ( IsSolvable
              ( Gal ( mapPoly q ( alg F ( splitField p ) ) ) ) ) ->
          ( ( IsSolvable
                ( Gal ( mapPoly r ( alg F ( splitField q ) ) ) ) ) ->
            ( ( IsSolvable
                  ( Gal ( mapPoly s ( alg F ( splitField r ) ) ) ) ) ->
              ( IsSolvable ( Gal s ) ) ) ) ) )
    ) ) ) ) )
  ) )
) $.

galquadtower $a |- ( Tower ->
  ( A.t F (
    ( A.p p ( A.p q ( A.p r ( A.p s ( A.p t (
      ( ( PolyOver p F ) /\
        ( ( PolyOver q F ) /\
          ( ( PolyOver r F ) /\
            ( ( PolyOver s F ) /\ ( PolyOver t F ) ) ) ) ) ->
      ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
        ( ( IsSolvable
              ( Gal ( mapPoly q ( alg F ( splitField p ) ) ) ) ) ->
          ( ( IsSolvable
                ( Gal ( mapPoly r ( alg F ( splitField q ) ) ) ) ) ->
            ( ( IsSolvable
                  ( Gal ( mapPoly s ( alg F ( splitField r ) ) ) ) ) ->
              ( ( IsSolvable
                    ( Gal ( mapPoly t ( alg F ( splitField s ) ) ) ) ) ->
                ( IsSolvable ( Gal t ) ) ) ) ) ) )
    ) ) ) ) ) )
  ) )
) $.

galmap $a |- ( Tower ->
  ( A.t F ( A.t K (
    ( A.p p (
      ( PolyOver p F ) ->
      ( ( IsSolvable ( Gal p ) ) ->
        ( IsSolvable ( Gal ( mapPoly p ( alg F K ) ) ) )
    ) )
  ) ) )
) $.

galofsplit $a |- ( Tower ->
  ( A.t F (
    ( A.p p (
      ( PolyOver p F ) ->

environ

    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, XTUPLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  constructors TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, XTUPLE_0, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, XTUPLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_2;

begin

reserve C for non empty set;
reserve z,o,x,y,w for Element of C;
reserve add,mul for BinOp of C;
reserve neg,inv for UnOp of C;

:: add_cancel_l
::$P-
theorem
  (for a,b being Element of C holds add.(a,b) = add.(b,a)) &
  (for a,b,c being Element of C holds
    add.(add.(a,b),c) = add.(a,add.(b,c))) &
  (for a being Element of C holds add.(a,z) = a) &
  (for a being Element of C holds add.(neg.a,a) = z) &
  (for a,b being Element of C holds mul.(a,b) = mul.(b,a)) &
  (for a,b,c being Element of C holds
    mul.(mul.(a,b),c) = mul.(a,mul.(b,c))) &
  (for a being Element of C holds mul.(o,a) = a) &
  (for a being Element of C st a <> z holds mul.(inv.a,a) = o) &
  (for a,b,c being Element of C holds
    mul.(a,add.(b,c)) = add.(mul.(a,b),mul.(a,c))) &
  z <> o &
  (for a being Element of C st a <> z holds inv.a <> z) &
  add.(x,y) = add.(x,w)
  implies y = w
proof
end;
::$P+

:: add_cancel_r

theorem
  (for a,b being Element of C holds add.(a,b) = add.(b,a)) &

::$P+

:: mul_cancel_l

theorem
  (for a,b being Element of C holds add.(a,b) = add.(b,a)) &

    add.(add.(a,b),c) = add.(a,add.(b,c))) &

:: mul_cancel_r

theorem
  (for a,b being Element of C holds add.(a,b) = add.(b,a)) &

:: inv_unique

theorem
  (for a,b being Element of C holds add.(a,b) = add.(b,a)) &

    add.(add.(a,b),c) = add.(a,add.(b,c))) &

title: galois
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact galois, concerning field
% cancellation laws and solvability across Galois-theoretic polynomial towers. This file
% contains no proof.

galois_field[
  FieldElem: TYPE,
  zero_F: FieldElem,
  one_F: FieldElem,
  add_F: [FieldElem, FieldElem -> FieldElem],
  mul_F: [FieldElem, FieldElem -> FieldElem],
  opp_F: [FieldElem -> FieldElem],
  inv_F: [FieldElem -> FieldElem]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_like: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: FieldElem): add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElem): add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElem): add_F(opp_F(x), x) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: FieldElem): mul_F(x, y) = mul_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        mul_F(mul_F(x, y), z) = mul_F(x, mul_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElem): mul_F(one_F, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElem):
        NOT (x = zero_F) IMPLIES mul_F(inv_F(x), x) = one_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        mul_F(x, add_F(y, z)) =
          add_F(mul_F(x, y), mul_F(x, z)))
      AND NOT (zero_F = one_F)
      AND (FORALL (x: FieldElem):
        NOT (x = zero_F) IMPLIES NOT (inv_F(x) = zero_F))

  add_cancel_l: bool =
    field_like IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        add_F(x, y) = add_F(x, z) IMPLIES y = z)

  add_cancel_r: bool =
    field_like IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        add_F(y, x) = add_F(z, x) IMPLIES y = z)

  mul_cancel_l: bool =
    field_like IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        NOT (x = zero_F) IMPLIES
          (mul_F(x, y) = mul_F(x, z) IMPLIES y = z))

  mul_cancel_r: bool =
    field_like IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: FieldElem):
        NOT (x = zero_F) IMPLIES
          (mul_F(y, x) = mul_F(z, x) IMPLIES y = z))

  inv_unique: bool =
    field_like IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: FieldElem):
        NOT (x = zero_F) IMPLIES
          (mul_F(x, y) = one_F IMPLIES y = inv_F(x)))

  inv_involutive: bool =
    field_like IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: FieldElem):
        NOT (x = zero_F) IMPLIES inv_F(inv_F(x)) = x)
END galois_field

galois_tower[
  F, K, L, M: TYPE,
  PolyF, PolyK, PolyL, PolyM: TYPE,
  SplitElem, SplitPoly: TYPE,
  split_member: [PolyF, SplitElem -> bool],
  split_poly_member: [PolyF, SplitPoly -> bool],
  algebra_map_FK: [F -> K],
  algebra_map_KL: [K -> L],
  algebra_map_LM: [L -> M],
  algebra_map_to_split:
    [controller: PolyF ->
      [F -> {x: SplitElem | split_member(controller, x)}]],
  splits_FK: [PolyF, [F -> K] -> bool],
  splits_to_split:
    [controller: PolyF ->
      [PolyF,
       [F -> {x: SplitElem | split_member(controller, x)}] -> bool]],
  map_poly_FK: [PolyF, [F -> K] -> PolyK],
  map_poly_KL: [PolyK, [K -> L] -> PolyL],
  map_poly_LM: [PolyL, [L -> M] -> PolyM],
  map_poly_FL: [PolyF, [F -> L] -> PolyL],
  map_poly_to_split:
    [controller: PolyF ->
      [PolyF,
       [F -> {x: SplitElem | split_member(controller, x)}] ->
       {u: SplitPoly | split_poly_member(controller, u)}]],
  solvable_F: [PolyF -> bool],
  solvable_K: [PolyK -> bool],
  solvable_L: [PolyL -> bool],
  solvable_M: [PolyM -> bool],
  solvable_over_split:
    [controller: PolyF ->
      [{u: SplitPoly | split_poly_member(controller, u)} -> bool]]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  splitting_field(controller: PolyF): TYPE =
    {x: SplitElem | split_member(controller, x)}

  polynomial_over_split(controller: PolyF): TYPE =
    {u: SplitPoly | split_poly_member(controller, u)}

  mapped_to_split(
    controller: PolyF,
    p: PolyF
  ): polynomial_over_split(controller) =
    map_poly_to_split(controller)(p, algebra_map_to_split(controller))

  map_poly_comp: bool =
    FORALL (p: PolyF), (f: [F -> K]), (g: [K -> L]):
      map_poly_KL(map_poly_FK(p, f), g) =
        map_poly_FL(p, LAMBDA (x: F): g(f(x)))

  isSolvable_of_isScalarTower: bool =
    (FORALL (p, q: PolyF):
      solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
        (solvable_K(map_poly_FK(q, algebra_map_FK))
          IMPLIES solvable_F(q)))
      AND
    (FORALL (controller, p, q: PolyF):
      solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
        (solvable_over_split(controller)(mapped_to_split(controller, q))
          IMPLIES solvable_F(q)))

  isSolvable_map_poly: bool =
    (FORALL (p: PolyF):
      solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
        solvable_K(map_poly_FK(p, algebra_map_FK)))
      AND
    (FORALL (p: PolyK):
      solvable_K(p) IMPLIES
        solvable_L(map_poly_KL(p, algebra_map_KL)))
      AND
    (FORALL (p: PolyL):
      solvable_L(p) IMPLIES
        solvable_M(map_poly_LM(p, algebra_map_LM)))
      AND
    (FORALL (controller, p: PolyF):
      solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
        solvable_over_split(controller)(mapped_to_split(controller, p)))

  isSolvable_of_splits: bool =
    (FORALL (p: PolyF), (f: [F -> K]):
      splits_FK(p, f) IMPLIES solvable_F(p))
      AND
    (FORALL (controller, p: PolyF):
      splits_to_split(controller)(p, algebra_map_to_split(controller))
        IMPLIES solvable_F(p))

  tower_axioms: bool =
    map_poly_comp
      AND isSolvable_of_isScalarTower
      AND isSolvable_map_poly
      AND isSolvable_of_splits

  gal_isSolvable_tower: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          (solvable_over_split(p)(mapped_to_split(p, q))
            IMPLIES solvable_F(q)))

  gal_isSolvable_double_tower: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q, r: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          (solvable_over_split(p)(mapped_to_split(p, q)) IMPLIES
            (solvable_over_split(q)(mapped_to_split(q, r))
              IMPLIES solvable_F(r))))

  gal_isSolvable_triple_tower: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q, r, s: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          (solvable_over_split(p)(mapped_to_split(p, q)) IMPLIES
            (solvable_over_split(q)(mapped_to_split(q, r)) IMPLIES
              (solvable_over_split(r)(mapped_to_split(r, s))
                IMPLIES solvable_F(s)))))

  gal_isSolvable_quadruple_tower: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q, r, s, t: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          (solvable_over_split(p)(mapped_to_split(p, q)) IMPLIES
            (solvable_over_split(q)(mapped_to_split(q, r)) IMPLIES
              (solvable_over_split(r)(mapped_to_split(r, s)) IMPLIES
                (solvable_over_split(s)(mapped_to_split(s, t))
                  IMPLIES solvable_F(t))))))

  gal_isSolvable_map_poly: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          solvable_K(map_poly_FK(p, algebra_map_FK)))

  gal_isSolvable_of_split: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: PolyF):
        splits_to_split(p)(p, algebra_map_to_split(p))
          IMPLIES solvable_F(p))

  gal_isSolvable_split_tower: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q: PolyF):
        splits_to_split(p)(q, algebra_map_to_split(p))
          IMPLIES solvable_F(q))

  gal_isSolvable_two_step_map: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          solvable_L(
            map_poly_KL(
              map_poly_FK(p, algebra_map_FK),
              algebra_map_KL)))

  gal_isSolvable_three_step_map: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          solvable_M(
            map_poly_LM(
              map_poly_KL(
                map_poly_FK(p, algebra_map_FK),
                algebra_map_KL),
              algebra_map_LM)))

  gal_isSolvable_map_poly_comp: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: PolyF):
        solvable_F(p) IMPLIES
          solvable_L(
            map_poly_KL(
              map_poly_FK(p, algebra_map_FK),
              algebra_map_KL)))

  gal_isSolvable_mutual_split: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q: PolyF):
        splits_to_split(q)(p, algebra_map_to_split(q)) IMPLIES
          (splits_to_split(p)(q, algebra_map_to_split(p)) IMPLIES
            (solvable_F(p) AND solvable_F(q))))

  gal_isSolvable_tower_split: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q, r: PolyF):
        splits_to_split(p)(q, algebra_map_to_split(p)) IMPLIES
          (solvable_over_split(q)(mapped_to_split(q, r))
            IMPLIES solvable_F(r)))

  gal_isSolvable_map_after_split: bool =
    tower_axioms IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: PolyF):
        splits_to_split(p)(p, algebra_map_to_split(p)) IMPLIES
          solvable_K(map_poly_FK(p, algebra_map_FK)))
END galois_tower

universe u

namespace GraphPath

variable {V : Type u}

def Edge (V : Type u) := V → V → Prop

inductive Path (E : Edge V) : V → V → Prop
| nil  : ∀ v, Path E v v
| step : ∀ {u v w}, Path E u v → E v w → Path E u w


variable {E : Edge V}

theorem refl (v : V) : Path (E:=E) v v := Path.nil v

theorem trans {u v w : V} : Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) u w := by sorry
def Erev (E : Edge V) : Edge V := fun x y => E y x

def undirected (E : Edge V) : Prop := ∀ x y, E x y → E y x

theorem reverse_path {u v : V} (hE : undirected E) :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v u := by sorry
theorem concat_edge_right {u v w : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → E v w → Path (E:=E) u w := by sorry
theorem concat {u v w : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) u w := by sorry
theorem edge_path {u v : V} : E u v → Path (E:=E) u v := by sorry
theorem concat_edge_left {u v w : V} :
  E u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) u w := by sorry
theorem concat3 {u v w t : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) w t → Path (E:=E) u t := by sorry
theorem reverse_in_Erev {u v : V} :
  Path (E:=E) u v → Path (E:=Erev E) v u := by sorry
theorem cycle_refl {v w : V} :
  Path (E:=E) v w → Path (E:=E) w v → Path (E:=E) v v := by sorry
end GraphPath

theory graph_paths
  imports Main
begin

inductive Path :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  for E :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  Pnil:  "Path E v v"
| Pstep: "Path E u v \<Longrightarrow> E v w \<Longrightarrow> Path E u w"

definition undirected :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "undirected E \<equiv> \<forall>x y. E x y \<longrightarrow> E y x"

definition Erev :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "Erev E x y \<equiv> E y x"

lemma path_refl: "Path E v v"
  sorry

lemma path_trans:
  assumes "Path E u v" "Path E v w" shows "Path E u w"
  sorry

lemma trans: "Path E u v \<Longrightarrow> Path E v w \<Longrightarrow> Path E u w"
  sorry


lemma edge_path: "E u v \<Longrightarrow> Path E u v"
  sorry

lemma concat_edge_right: "Path E u v \<Longrightarrow> E v w \<Longrightarrow> Path E u w"
  sorry

  sorry

lemma concat_edge_left: "E u v \<Longrightarrow> Path E v w \<Longrightarrow> Path E u w"
  sorry

lemma concat3:
  "Path E u v \<Longrightarrow> Path E v w \<Longrightarrow> Path E w t \<Longrightarrow> Path E u t"
  sorry


lemma reverse_cons:
  assumes hE: "undirected E" and e: "E m v" and ih: "Path E m u"
  shows "Path E v u"
  sorry

lemma reverse_path:
  assumes hE: "undirected E" and p: "Path E u v"
  shows "Path E v u"
  sorry


lemma reverse_cons_Erev:

  shows "Path (Erev E) v u"
  sorry

lemma reverse_in_Erev:
  assumes p: "Path E u v"
  shows "Path (Erev E) v u"
  sorry

lemma cycle_refl:
  "Path E v w \<Longrightarrow> Path E w v \<Longrightarrow> Path E v v"
  sorry

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact graph_paths:
;; reflexive-transitive paths in arbitrary directed relations, path
;; concatenation, edge reversal, and reversal for undirected relations. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; CARRIER and EDGE are ACL2 function objects evaluated by APPLY$.  They
;; represent an arbitrary vertex-domain predicate and binary edge relation,
;; without enumerating either one as a finite table.

(defun graph-paths-vertexp (carrier vertex)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list vertex))
      t
    nil))

(defun graph-paths-edgep (edge u v)
  (if (apply$ edge (list u v))
      t
    nil))

(defun graph-paths-oriented-edgep (edge orientation u v)
  (cond ((equal orientation :reverse)
         (graph-paths-edgep edge v u))
        ((equal orientation :symmetric)
         (or (graph-paths-edgep edge u v)
             (graph-paths-edgep edge v u)))
        (t
         (graph-paths-edgep edge u v))))

(defun graph-paths-edges-alongp (edge orientation vertices)
  (if (and (consp vertices)
           (consp (cdr vertices)))
      (and (graph-paths-oriented-edgep
            edge orientation (car vertices) (cadr vertices))
           (graph-paths-edges-alongp
            edge orientation (cdr vertices)))
    t))

(defun graph-paths-vertices-in-carrierp (carrier vertices)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (and (graph-paths-vertexp carrier (car vertices))
           (graph-paths-vertices-in-carrierp carrier (cdr vertices)))
    (equal vertices nil)))

(defun graph-paths-last-vertex (vertices)
  (if (and (consp vertices)
           (consp (cdr vertices)))
      (graph-paths-last-vertex (cdr vertices))
    (if (consp vertices)
        (car vertices)
      nil)))

;; A nonempty vertex list is constructor evidence for the inductive Path
;; relation: a singleton is Pnil, and each additional vertex is a Pstep.

(defun graph-paths-pathp (carrier edge orientation u v vertices)
  (and (true-listp vertices)
       (consp vertices)
       (graph-paths-vertices-in-carrierp carrier vertices)
       (equal (car vertices) u)
       (equal (graph-paths-last-vertex vertices) v)
       (graph-paths-edges-alongp edge orientation vertices)))

(defun graph-paths-snoc (vertices vertex)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (cons (car vertices)
            (graph-paths-snoc (cdr vertices) vertex))
    (list vertex)))

(defun graph-paths-append-paths (left right)
  (if (and (consp left)
           (consp (cdr left)))
      (cons (car left)
            (graph-paths-append-paths (cdr left) right))
    right))

(defun graph-paths-reverse-onto (vertices accumulator)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (graph-paths-reverse-onto
       (cdr vertices)
       (cons (car vertices) accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun graph-paths-reverse-path (vertices)
  (graph-paths-reverse-onto vertices nil))

(defun graph-paths-refl-statement (carrier edge v)
  (implies (graph-paths-vertexp carrier v)
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward v v (list v))))

(defun graph-paths-trans-statement
  (carrier edge u v w path-uv path-vw)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward u v path-uv)
                (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward v w path-vw))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u w
            (graph-paths-append-paths path-uv path-vw))))

;; Every undirected relation E is extensionally equal to the symmetrization of
;; E itself.  Conversely, symmetrizing any relation always gives an
;; undirected relation.  Quantifying EDGE here therefore ranges over exactly
;; all undirected relations without restricting the vertex domain.

(defun graph-paths-reverse-path-statement
  (carrier edge u v path-uv)
  (implies (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :symmetric u v path-uv)
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :symmetric v u
            (graph-paths-reverse-path path-uv))))

(defun graph-paths-concat-edge-right-statement
  (carrier edge u v w path-uv)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward u v path-uv)
                (graph-paths-vertexp carrier w)
                (graph-paths-edgep edge v w))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u w
            (graph-paths-snoc path-uv w))))

(defun graph-paths-concat-statement
  (carrier edge u v w path-uv path-vw)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward u v path-uv)
                (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward v w path-vw))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u w
            (graph-paths-append-paths path-uv path-vw))))

(defun graph-paths-edge-path-statement (carrier edge u v)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-vertexp carrier u)
                (graph-paths-vertexp carrier v)
                (graph-paths-edgep edge u v))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u v (list u v))))

(defun graph-paths-concat-edge-left-statement
  (carrier edge u v w path-vw)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-vertexp carrier u)
                (graph-paths-edgep edge u v)
                (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward v w path-vw))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u w (cons u path-vw))))

(defun graph-paths-concat3-statement
  (carrier edge u v w terminal path-uv path-vw path-wt)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward u v path-uv)
                (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward v w path-vw)
                (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward w terminal path-wt))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u terminal
            (graph-paths-append-paths
             (graph-paths-append-paths path-uv path-vw)
             path-wt))))

(defun graph-paths-reverse-in-erev-statement
  (carrier edge u v path-uv)
  (implies (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward u v path-uv)
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :reverse v u
            (graph-paths-reverse-path path-uv))))

(defun graph-paths-cycle-refl-statement
  (carrier edge v w path-vw path-wv)
  (implies (and (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward v w path-vw)
                (graph-paths-pathp
                 carrier edge :forward w v path-wv))
           (graph-paths-pathp
            carrier edge :forward v v
            (graph-paths-append-paths path-vw path-wv))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic graph_paths. This file contains no
-- proof.

module graph_paths where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)

Edge : forall {l : Level} -> Set l -> Set (lsuc l)
Edge {l} V = V -> V -> Set l

data Path {l : Level} {V : Set l} (E : Edge V) : V -> V -> Set l where
  nil  : (v : V) -> Path E v v
  step : forall {u v w : V} -> Path E u v -> E v w -> Path E u w

Erev : forall {l : Level} {V : Set l} -> Edge V -> Edge V
Erev E x y = E y x

Undirected : forall {l : Level} {V : Set l} -> Edge V -> Set l
Undirected {V = V} E = (x y : V) -> E x y -> E y x

module GraphPathStatements
  {l : Level} {V : Set l} (E : Edge V) where

  path-refl : Set l
  path-refl =
    (v : V) -> Path E v v

  path-append-right : Set l
  path-append-right =
    (v w : V) -> Path E v w ->
    (u : V) -> Path E u v -> Path E u w

  path-trans : Set l
  path-trans =
    (u v w : V) ->
    Path E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E u w

  reverse-path : Set l
  reverse-path =
    (u v : V) ->
    Undirected E -> Path E u v -> Path E v u

  concat-edge-right : Set l
  concat-edge-right =
    (u v w : V) ->
    Path E u v -> E v w -> Path E u w

  concat : Set l
  concat =
    (u v w : V) ->
    Path E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E u w

  edge-path : Set l
  edge-path =
    (u v : V) -> E u v -> Path E u v

  concat-edge-left : Set l
  concat-edge-left =
    (u v w : V) ->
    E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E u w

  concat3 : Set l
  concat3 =
    (u v w t : V) ->
    Path E u v -> Path E v w -> Path E w t -> Path E u t

  reverse-in-Erev : Set l
  reverse-in-Erev =
    (u v : V) -> Path E u v -> Path (Erev E) v u

  cycle-refl : Set l
  cycle-refl =
    (v w : V) ->
    Path E v w -> Path E w v -> Path E v v

:: Path reflexivity.
::$P-
theorem

  for v being Element of V
  holds E reduces v,v
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Path transitivity.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v,w being Element of V
  st E reduces u,v & E reduces v,w
  holds E reduces u,w
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Reversing a path in an undirected graph.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v being Element of V
  st E is symmetric & E reduces u,v
  holds E reduces v,u
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Concatenating an edge on the right.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v,w being Element of V
  st E reduces u,v & [v,w] in E
  holds E reduces u,w
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Concatenating two paths.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v,w being Element of V
  st E reduces u,v & E reduces v,w
  holds E reduces u,w
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Every edge is a path.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v being Element of V
  st [u,v] in E
  holds E reduces u,v
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Concatenating an edge on the left.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v,w being Element of V
  st [u,v] in E & E reduces v,w
  holds E reduces u,w
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Concatenating three paths.
::$P-
theorem
  for V being set, E being Relation of V
  for u,v,w,t being Element of V
  st E reduces u,v & E reduces v,w & E reduces w,t
  holds E reduces u,t
proof

  st E reduces u,v
  holds E~ reduces v,u
proof

theorem

title: graph_paths
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic graph_paths. This file contains no
% proof.

graph_paths[V: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  edge: TYPE = [V, V -> bool]

  path(E: edge, u, v: V): bool =
    FORALL (R: edge):
      ((FORALL (x: V): R(x, x))
        AND (FORALL (x, y, z: V):
          R(x, y) AND E(y, z) IMPLIES R(x, z)))
      IMPLIES R(u, v)

  erev(E: edge): edge =
    LAMBDA (x, y: V): E(y, x)

  undirected(E: edge): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: V): E(x, y) IMPLIES E(y, x)

  path_refl: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (v: V): path(E, v, v)

  path_trans: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        path(E, u, v) IMPLIES
          path(E, v, w) IMPLIES path(E, u, w)

  reverse_path: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v: V):
        undirected(E) IMPLIES
          path(E, u, v) IMPLIES path(E, v, u)

  concat_edge_right: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        path(E, u, v) IMPLIES E(v, w) IMPLIES path(E, u, w)

  concat: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        path(E, u, v) IMPLIES
          path(E, v, w) IMPLIES path(E, u, w)

  edge_path: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v: V): E(u, v) IMPLIES path(E, u, v)

  concat_edge_left: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        E(u, v) IMPLIES path(E, v, w) IMPLIES path(E, u, w)

  concat3: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v, w, t: V):
        path(E, u, v) IMPLIES
          path(E, v, w) IMPLIES
            path(E, w, t) IMPLIES path(E, u, t)

  reverse_in_erev: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (u, v: V):
        path(E, u, v) IMPLIES path(erev(E), v, u)

  cycle_refl: bool =
    FORALL (E: edge):
      FORALL (v, w: V):
        path(E, v, w) IMPLIES
          path(E, w, v) IMPLIES path(E, v, v)
END graph_paths

class Group (G : Type) where
  inv : G → G
  one : G
  mul : G → G → G
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : G, mul a (mul b c) = mul (mul a b) c
  mul_one   : ∀ a : G, mul a one = a
  one_mul   : ∀ a : G, mul one a = a
  mul_inv_l : ∀ a : G, mul (inv a) a = one
  mul_inv_r : ∀ a : G, mul a (inv a) = one

namespace Group

infixl:70 " * " => Group.mul
postfix:max "⁻¹" => Group.inv

class GroupComm (G : Type) [Group G] where
  mul_comm : ∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a

section MulRotate
  variable {G : Type} [Group G] [GroupComm G]

  theorem mul_rotate' (a b c : G) : a * (b * c) = b * (c * a) := by sorry
end MulRotate
section GroupLemmas
  variable {G : Type} [Group G]

  theorem mul_left_cancel (a b c : G) (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c := by sorry
  theorem mul_right_cancel (a b c : G) (h : b * a = c * a) : b = c := by sorry
  theorem inv_inv (a : G) : (a⁻¹)⁻¹ = a := by sorry
  theorem inv_mul (a b : G) : (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := by sorry
  theorem inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one (a b : G) (h : a * b = one) : b = a⁻¹ := by sorry
end GroupLemmas

class Act (G : Type) (X : Type) [Group G] where
  act : G → X → X
  act_one : ∀ x : X, act one x = x
  act_mul : ∀ g h : G, ∀ x : X, act (g * h) x = act g (act h x)


section ActionLemmas
  variable {G : Type} {X : Type}
  [Group G] [Act G X]

  infixr:73 " • " => Act.act

  theorem act_inv (g : G) (x : X) : g⁻¹ • (g • x) = x := by sorry
  theorem act_inv_r (g : G) (x : X) : g • (g⁻¹ • x) = x := by sorry
  def orbit {G : Type} {X : Type} [Group G] [Act G X] (x : X) : X → Prop :=
    fun y => ∃ g : G, g • x = y

  def stabilizer (x : X) : G → Prop := fun g => g • x = x

  theorem orbit_refl
    (x : X) : orbit (G:=G) x x := by sorry
  theorem orbit_sym (x y : X) (h : orbit (G:=G) x y) : orbit (G:=G) y x := by sorry
  theorem orbit_trans (x y z : X) (h1 : orbit (G:=G) x y) (h2 : orbit (G:=G) y z) : orbit (G:=G) x z := by sorry
  theorem orbit_partition (x y : X) (hxy : orbit (G:=G) x y) (z : X) :
      orbit (G:=G) x z ↔ orbit (G:=G) y z := by sorry
  theorem stabilizer_mul (x : X) (g h : G)
    (hg : stabilizer x g) (hh : stabilizer x h) : stabilizer x (g * h) := by sorry
  theorem stabilizer_inv (x : X) (g : G) (hg : stabilizer x g) : stabilizer x g⁻¹ := by sorry
  theorem stabilizer_one (x : X) : stabilizer (G:=G) x one := by sorry
  theorem stabilizer_conjugate (x : X) (g h : G)
    (hh : stabilizer x h) : stabilizer (g • x) (g * h * g⁻¹) := by sorry
  theorem stabilizer_conjugate_orbit (x y : X) (g : G) (hxy : g • x = y) (h : G) :
      stabilizer y h ↔ stabilizer x (g⁻¹ * h * g) := by sorry
end ActionLemmas

end Group

Proof.

theory group
  imports Main
begin



locale group =
  fixes mul :: "'a => 'a => 'a"  (infixl "**" 70)
    and one :: "'a"
    and inv :: "'a => 'a"
  assumes mul_assoc : "a ** (b ** c) = (a ** b) ** c"
    and   mul_one   : "a ** one = a"
    and   one_mul   : "one ** a = a"
    and   mul_inv_l : "inv a ** a = one"
    and   mul_inv_r : "a ** inv a = one"
begin



lemma mul_left_cancel:
  assumes h: "a ** b = a ** c"
  shows "b = c"
  sorry
lemma mul_right_cancel:
  assumes h: "b ** a = c ** a"
  shows "b = c"
  sorry
lemma inv_inv: "inv (inv a) = a"
  sorry
lemma inv_mul: "inv (a ** b) = inv b ** inv a"
  sorry
lemma inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one:
  assumes h: "a ** b = one"
  shows "b = inv a"
  sorry
end




locale group_comm = group +
  assumes mul_comm : "a ** b = b ** a"
begin

lemma mul_rotate': "a ** (b ** c) = b ** (c ** a)"
  sorry
end




locale group_action =
  group mul one inv
    for mul :: "'a => 'a => 'a"  (infixl "**" 70)
    and one :: "'a"
    and inv :: "'a => 'a" +
  fixes act :: "'a => 'b => 'b"  (infixr "acts" 73)
  assumes act_one : "one acts x = x"
    and   act_mul : "(g ** h) acts x = g acts (h acts x)"
begin



lemma act_inv: "inv g acts (g acts x) = x"
  sorry
lemma act_inv_r: "g acts (inv g acts x) = x"
  sorry
definition orbit :: "'b => 'b => bool"
  where "orbit x y == (EX g. g acts x = y)"

definition stabilizer :: "'b => 'a => bool"
  where "stabilizer x g == g acts x = x"

lemma orbit_refl: "orbit x x"
  sorry
lemma orbit_sym:
  assumes "orbit x y"
  shows "orbit y x"
  sorry
lemma orbit_trans:
  assumes "orbit x y" "orbit y z"
  shows "orbit x z"
  sorry
lemma orbit_partition:
  assumes hxy: "orbit x y"
  shows "orbit x z = orbit y z"
  sorry
lemma stabilizer_mul:
  assumes "stabilizer x g" "stabilizer x h"
  shows "stabilizer x (g ** h)"
  sorry
lemma stabilizer_inv:
  assumes hg: "stabilizer x g"
  shows "stabilizer x (inv g)"
  sorry
lemma stabilizer_one: "stabilizer x one"
  sorry
lemma stabilizer_conjugate:
  assumes hh: "stabilizer x h"
  shows "stabilizer (g acts x) (g ** h ** inv g)"
  sorry
lemma stabilizer_conjugate_orbit:
  assumes hxy: "g acts x = y"
  shows "stabilizer y h = stabilizer x (inv g ** h ** g)"
  sorry
end

end

;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact group: arbitrary
;; groups and group actions, elementary cancellation and inverse laws, and
;; orbit and stabilizer properties. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic interfaces represent arbitrary carrier predicates,
;; group operations, and actions. Structure tags distinguish instances but do
;; not enumerate or otherwise restrict either carrier.

(defstub babel-group-element-p (group value) t)
(defstub babel-space-element-p (space value) t)
(defstub babel-group-one (group) t)
(defstub babel-group-mul (group left right) t)
(defstub babel-group-inv (group value) t)
(defstub babel-group-act (action group-element point) t)

(defun-sk babel-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall (a b c)
    (and
     (implies
      (babel-group-element-p group a)
      (and
       (babel-group-element-p
        group (babel-group-inv group a))
       (equal
        (babel-group-mul
         group a (babel-group-one group))
        a)
       (equal
        (babel-group-mul
         group (babel-group-one group) a)
        a)
       (equal
        (babel-group-mul
         group (babel-group-inv group a) a)
        (babel-group-one group))
       (equal
        (babel-group-mul
         group a (babel-group-inv group a))
        (babel-group-one group))))
     (implies
      (and
       (babel-group-element-p group a)
       (babel-group-element-p group b))
      (babel-group-element-p
       group (babel-group-mul group a b)))
     (implies
      (and
       (babel-group-element-p group a)
       (babel-group-element-p group b)
       (babel-group-element-p group c))
      (equal
       (babel-group-mul
        group a (babel-group-mul group b c))
       (babel-group-mul
        group (babel-group-mul group a b) c))))))

(defun babel-group-p (group)
  (and
   (babel-group-element-p
    group (babel-group-one group))
   (babel-group-laws-p group)))

(defun-sk babel-group-commutative-law-p (group)
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (babel-group-element-p group a)
      (babel-group-element-p group b))
     (equal
      (babel-group-mul group a b)
      (babel-group-mul group b a)))))

(defun babel-commutative-group-p (group)
  (and
   (babel-group-p group)
   (babel-group-commutative-law-p group)))

(defun-sk babel-group-action-laws-p (group space action)
  (forall (g h x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (babel-group-element-p group g)
       (babel-space-element-p space x))
      (babel-space-element-p
       space (babel-group-act action g x)))
     (implies
      (babel-space-element-p space x)
      (equal
       (babel-group-act
        action (babel-group-one group) x)
       x))
     (implies
      (and
       (babel-group-element-p group g)
       (babel-group-element-p group h)
       (babel-space-element-p space x))
      (equal
       (babel-group-act
        action (babel-group-mul group g h) x)
       (babel-group-act
        action g (babel-group-act action h x)))))))

(defun babel-group-action-p (group space action)
  (and
   (babel-group-p group)
   (babel-group-action-laws-p group space action)))

(defun-sk babel-group-orbit-p (group action x y)
  (exists (g)
    (and
     (babel-group-element-p group g)
     (equal (babel-group-act action g x) y))))

(defun babel-group-stabilizer-p (action x g)
  (equal (babel-group-act action g x) x))

;; Commutative-group and elementary group statements.

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-mul-rotate-statement ()
  (forall (group a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (babel-commutative-group-p group)
      (babel-group-element-p group a)
      (babel-group-element-p group b)
      (babel-group-element-p group c))
     (equal
      (babel-group-mul
       group a (babel-group-mul group b c))
      (babel-group-mul
       group b (babel-group-mul group c a))))))

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-mul-left-cancel-statement ()
  (forall (group a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (babel-group-p group)
      (babel-group-element-p group a)
      (babel-group-element-p group b)
      (babel-group-element-p group c)
      (equal
       (babel-group-mul group a b)
       (babel-group-mul group a c)))
     (equal b c))))

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-mul-right-cancel-statement ()
  (forall (group a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (babel-group-p group)
      (babel-group-element-p group a)
      (babel-group-element-p group b)
      (babel-group-element-p group c)
      (equal
       (babel-group-mul group b a)
       (babel-group-mul group c a)))
     (equal b c))))

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-inv-inv-statement ()
  (forall (group a)
    (implies
     (and
      (babel-group-p group)
      (babel-group-element-p group a))
     (equal
      (babel-group-inv
       group (babel-group-inv group a))
      a))))

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-inv-mul-statement ()
  (forall (group a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (babel-group-p group)
      (babel-group-element-p group a)
      (babel-group-element-p group b))
     (equal
      (babel-group-inv
       group (babel-group-mul group a b))
      (babel-group-mul
       group
       (babel-group-inv group b)
       (babel-group-inv group a))))))

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-inv-eq-of-mul-eq-one-statement ()
  (forall (group a b)
    (implies
     (and

(defun-sk babel-formal-group-stabilizer-inv-statement ()

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic group. This file contains no proof.

module group where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 2 _↔_

record _↔_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    inv       : G → G
    one       : G
    mul       : G → G → G
    mul-assoc : (a b c : G) →
                mul a (mul b c) ≡ mul (mul a b) c
    mul-one   : (a : G) → mul a one ≡ a
    one-mul   : (a : G) → mul one a ≡ a
    mul-inv-l : (a : G) → mul (inv a) a ≡ one
    mul-inv-r : (a : G) → mul a (inv a) ≡ one

record GroupComm {ℓ : Level} {G : Set ℓ}
                 (S : Group G) : Set ℓ where
  open Group S

  field
    mul-comm : (a b : G) → mul a b ≡ mul b a

module CommutativeGroupStatements
  {ℓ : Level} {G : Set ℓ}
  (S : Group G) (C : GroupComm S) where

  open Group S

  mul-rotate' : Set ℓ
  mul-rotate' =
    (a b c : G) → mul a (mul b c) ≡ mul b (mul c a)

module GroupStatements
  {ℓ : Level} {G : Set ℓ}
  (S : Group G) where

  open Group S

  mul-left-cancel : Set ℓ
  mul-left-cancel =
    (a b c : G) → mul a b ≡ mul a c → b ≡ c

  mul-right-cancel : Set ℓ
  mul-right-cancel =
    (a b c : G) → mul b a ≡ mul c a → b ≡ c

  inv-inv : Set ℓ
  inv-inv =
    (a : G) → inv (inv a) ≡ a

  inv-mul : Set ℓ
  inv-mul =
    (a b : G) → inv (mul a b) ≡ mul (inv b) (inv a)

  inv-eq-of-mul-eq-one : Set ℓ
  inv-eq-of-mul-eq-one =
    (a b : G) → mul a b ≡ one → b ≡ inv a

record Act {ℓG ℓX : Level} {G : Set ℓG}
           (S : Group G) (X : Set ℓX) : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX) where
  open Group S

  field
    act     : G → X → X
    act-one : (x : X) → act one x ≡ x
    act-mul : (g h : G) (x : X) →
              act (mul g h) x ≡ act g (act h x)

module ActionStatements
  {ℓG ℓX : Level} {G : Set ℓG} {X : Set ℓX}
  (S : Group G) (A : Act S X) where

  open Group S
  open Act A

  orbit : X → X → Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  orbit x y = Σ G (λ g → act g x ≡ y)

  stabilizer : X → G → Set ℓX
  stabilizer x g = act g x ≡ x

  act-inv : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  act-inv =
    (g : G) (x : X) → act (inv g) (act g x) ≡ x

  act-inv-r : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  act-inv-r =
    (g : G) (x : X) → act g (act (inv g) x) ≡ x

  orbit-refl : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  orbit-refl =
    (x : X) → orbit x x

  orbit-sym : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  orbit-sym =
    (x y : X) → orbit x y → orbit y x

  orbit-trans : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  orbit-trans =
    (x y z : X) → orbit x y → orbit y z → orbit x z

  orbit-partition : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  orbit-partition =
    (x y : X) → orbit x y → (z : X) →
    orbit x z ↔ orbit y z

  stabilizer-mul : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  stabilizer-mul =
    (x : X) (g h : G) →
    stabilizer x g →
    stabilizer x h →
    stabilizer x (mul g h)

  stabilizer-inv : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  stabilizer-inv =
    (x : X) (g : G) →
    stabilizer x g →
    stabilizer x (inv g)

  stabilizer-one : Set ℓX
  stabilizer-one =
    (x : X) → stabilizer x one

  stabilizer-conjugate : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  stabilizer-conjugate =
    (x : X) (g h : G) →
    stabilizer x h →
    stabilizer (act g x) (mul (mul g h) (inv g))

  stabilizer-conjugate-orbit : Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX)
  stabilizer-conjugate-orbit =
    (x y : X) (g : G) →
    act g x ≡ y →
    (h : G) →
    stabilizer y h ↔
    stabilizer x (mul (mul (inv g) h) g)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact group: group laws,
  commutative multiplication, group actions, orbits, and stabilizers. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val babel_group_def = new_definition (
  "babel_group_def",
  ``babel_group (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!a b c. mul a (mul b c) = mul (mul a b) c) /\
      (!a. mul a e = a) /\
      (!a. mul e a = a) /\
      (!a. mul (ginv a) a = e) /\
      (!a. mul a (ginv a) = e)``);

val babel_group_comm_def = new_definition (
  "babel_group_comm_def",
  ``babel_group_comm (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a)
                     (ginv : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      babel_group mul e ginv /\
      (!a b. mul a b = mul b a)``);

val mul_rotate_prime =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a).
      babel_group_comm mul e ginv ==>
      !a b c. mul a (mul b c) = mul b (mul c a)``;

val mul_left_cancel =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a).
      babel_group mul e ginv ==>
      !a b c. mul a b = mul a c ==> b = c``;

val mul_right_cancel =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a).
      babel_group mul e ginv ==>
      !a b c. mul b a = mul c a ==> b = c``;

val inv_inv =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a).
      babel_group mul e ginv ==>
      !a. ginv (ginv a) = a``;

val inv_mul =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a).
      babel_group mul e ginv ==>
      !a b. ginv (mul a b) = mul (ginv b) (ginv a)``;

val inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a).
      babel_group mul e ginv ==>
      !a b. mul a b = e ==> b = ginv a``;

val babel_group_action_def = new_definition (
  "babel_group_action_def",
  ``babel_group_action (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a)
                      (ginv : 'a -> 'a) (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b) <=>
      babel_group mul e ginv /\
      (!x. act e x = x) /\
      (!g h x. act (mul g h) x = act g (act h x))``);

val act_inv =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !g x. act (ginv g) (act g x) = x``;

val act_inv_r =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !g x. act g (act (ginv g) x) = x``;

val babel_orbit_def = new_definition (
  "babel_orbit_def",
  ``babel_orbit (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b) x y <=>
      ?g. act g x = y``);

val babel_stabilizer_def = new_definition (
  "babel_stabilizer_def",
  ``babel_stabilizer (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b) x g <=>
      act g x = x``);

val orbit_refl =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x. babel_orbit act x x``;

val orbit_sym =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x y. babel_orbit act x y ==> babel_orbit act y x``;

val orbit_trans =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x y z.
        babel_orbit act x y ==>
        babel_orbit act y z ==>
        babel_orbit act x z``;

val orbit_partition =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x y z.
        babel_orbit act x y ==>
        (babel_orbit act x z <=> babel_orbit act y z)``;

val stabilizer_mul =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x g h.
        babel_stabilizer act x g ==>
        babel_stabilizer act x h ==>
        babel_stabilizer act x (mul g h)``;

val stabilizer_inv =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x g.
        babel_stabilizer act x g ==>
        babel_stabilizer act x (ginv g)``;

val stabilizer_one =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x. babel_stabilizer act x e``;

val stabilizer_conjugate =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x g h.
        babel_stabilizer act x h ==>
        babel_stabilizer act (act g x)
          (mul (mul g h) (ginv g))``;

val stabilizer_conjugate_orbit =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (act : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      babel_group_action mul e ginv act ==>
      !x y g.
        act g x = y ==>
        !h. (babel_stabilizer act y h <=>
             babel_stabilizer act x
               (mul (mul (ginv g) h) g))``;

% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact group: group and commutative-group
% laws, group actions, orbits, stabilizers, and their stated identities. This file contains no proof.

group[
  G: TYPE+,
  X: TYPE,
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  act: [G, X -> X]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b, c: G):
      mul(a, mul(b, c)) = mul(mul(a, b), c))
      AND (FORALL (a: G): mul(a, one) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: G): mul(one, a) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: G): mul(inv(a), a) = one)
      AND (FORALL (a: G): mul(a, inv(a)) = one)

  comm_group_laws: bool =
    group_laws
      AND (FORALL (a, b: G): mul(a, b) = mul(b, a))

  mul_rotate: bool =
    comm_group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c: G):
        mul(a, mul(b, c)) = mul(b, mul(c, a)))

  mul_left_cancel: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c: G):
        mul(a, b) = mul(a, c) IMPLIES b = c)

  mul_right_cancel: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c: G):
        mul(b, a) = mul(c, a) IMPLIES b = c)

  inv_inv: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a: G): inv(inv(a)) = a)

  inv_mul: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: G):
        inv(mul(a, b)) = mul(inv(b), inv(a)))

  inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: G):
        mul(a, b) = one IMPLIES b = inv(a))

  group_action_laws: bool =
    group_laws
      AND (FORALL (x: X): act(one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (g, h: G), (x: X):
        act(mul(g, h), x) = act(g, act(h, x)))

  act_inv: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (g: G), (x: X):
        act(inv(g), act(g, x)) = x)

  act_inv_r: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (g: G), (x: X):
        act(g, act(inv(g), x)) = x)

  orbit(x, y: X): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G): act(g, x) = y

  stabilizer(x: X, g: G): bool =
    act(g, x) = x

  orbit_refl: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: X): orbit(x, x))

  orbit_sym: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: X):
        orbit(x, y) IMPLIES orbit(y, x))

  orbit_trans: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        orbit(x, y) AND orbit(y, z) IMPLIES orbit(x, z))

  orbit_partition: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: X):
        orbit(x, y) IMPLIES
          (FORALL (z: X): orbit(x, z) = orbit(y, z)))

  stabilizer_mul: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: X), (g, h: G):
        stabilizer(x, g) AND stabilizer(x, h) IMPLIES
          stabilizer(x, mul(g, h)))

  stabilizer_inv: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: X), (g: G):
        stabilizer(x, g) IMPLIES stabilizer(x, inv(g)))

  stabilizer_one: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: X): stabilizer(x, one))

  stabilizer_conjugate: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: X), (g, h: G):
        stabilizer(x, h) IMPLIES
          stabilizer(act(g, x), mul(mul(g, h), inv(g))))

  stabilizer_conjugate_orbit: bool =
    group_action_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: X), (g, h: G):
        act(g, x) = y IMPLIES
          stabilizer(y, h) =
            stabilizer(x, mul(mul(inv(g), h), g)))
END group

class CRing (R : Type) where
  zero  : R
  one   : R
  add   : R → R → R
  mul   : R → R → R
  opp   : R → R

  add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_opp   : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero

  mul_comm  : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one   : ∀ x, mul x one = x
  dist_l    : ∀ a x y, mul a (add x y) = add (mul a x) (mul a y)
  opp_add   : ∀ x y, opp (add x y) = add (opp x) (opp y)

namespace Ideals

variable {R : Type} [CR : CRing R]
open CRing

infixl:65 "+R" => CRing.add
infixl:70 "*R" => CRing.mul
prefix:100 "-R" => CRing.opp

def IsIdeal (I : R → Prop) : Prop :=
  (I CR.zero) ∧
  (∀ x y, I x → I y → I (x +R y)) ∧
  (∀ x, I x → I (-R x)) ∧
  (∀ a x, I x → I (a *R x))

def Inter {ι : Type} (F : ι → (R → Prop)) : R → Prop :=
  fun x => ∀ i, F i x

theorem inter_isIdeal {ι : Type} (F : ι → (R → Prop))
  (h : ∀ i, IsIdeal (F i)) : IsIdeal (Inter F) := by sorry
def sum (I J : R → Prop) : R → Prop :=
  fun x => ∃ a b, I a ∧ J b ∧ x = a +R b

theorem sum_isIdeal (I J : R → Prop) (hI : IsIdeal I) (hJ : IsIdeal J) :
  IsIdeal (sum I J) := by sorry
end Ideals

theory ideals

begin

locale cring =
  fixes zero :: "'r"
    and one  :: "'r"
    and add  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"  (infixl "+R" 65)
    and mul  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"  (infixl "*R" 70)
    and opp  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  assumes add_comm  : "\<And>x y. x +R y = y +R x"
    and   add_assoc : "\<And>x y z. (x +R y) +R z = x +R (y +R z)"
    and   add_zero  : "\<And>x. x +R zero = x"
    and   add_opp   : "\<And>x. x +R opp x = zero"
    and   mul_comm  : "\<And>x y. x *R y = y *R x"
    and   mul_assoc : "\<And>x y z. (x *R y) *R z = x *R (y *R z)"
    and   mul_one   : "\<And>x. x *R one = x"
    and   dist_l    : "\<And>a x y. a *R (x +R y) = (a *R x) +R (a *R y)"
    and   opp_add   : "\<And>x y. opp (x +R y) = opp x +R opp y"
begin


lemma add_left_comm: "x +R (y +R z) = y +R (x +R z)"
  sorry
lemma zero_add: "zero +R x = x"
  sorry




definition IsIdeal :: "('r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "IsIdeal I \<equiv>
    I zero \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. I x \<longrightarrow> I y \<longrightarrow> I (x +R y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x.   I x \<longrightarrow> I (opp x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. I x \<longrightarrow> I (a *R x))"





definition Inter :: "('i \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "Inter F \<equiv> \<lambda>x. \<forall>i. F i x"

lemma inter_isIdeal:
  assumes h: "\<forall>i. IsIdeal (F i)"
  shows "IsIdeal (Inter F)"
  sorry




definition isum :: "('r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "isum I J \<equiv> \<lambda>x. \<exists>a b. I a \<and> J b \<and> x = a +R b"

lemma sum_isIdeal:
  assumes hI: "IsIdeal I" and hJ: "IsIdeal J"
  shows "IsIdeal (isum I J)"
  sorry
end

end

let cring = new_definition
  `cring (zero:'r) (oneR:'r) (add:'r->'r->'r) (mul:'r->'r->'r) (opp:'r->'r) <=>
     (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
     (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
     (!x. add x zero = x) /\
     (!x. add x (opp x) = zero) /\
     (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
     (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
     (!x. mul x oneR = x) /\
     (!a x y. mul a (add x y) = add (mul a x) (mul a y)) /\
     (!x y. opp (add x y) = add (opp x) (opp y))`;;

let IsIdeal = new_definition
  `IsIdeal (zero:'r) (add:'r->'r->'r) (mul:'r->'r->'r) (opp:'r->'r)
           (ideal:'r->bool) <=>
     ideal zero /\
     (!x y. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (add x y)) /\
     (!x. ideal x ==> ideal (opp x)) /\
     (!a x. ideal x ==> ideal (mul a x))`;;

let inter = new_definition
  `inter (fam:'i->'r->bool) = (\x:'r. !i. fam i x)`;;

let add_rearrange =
  `!zeroR:'r oneR:'r (add:'r->'r->'r) (mul:'r->'r->'r) (opp:'r->'r).
      cring zeroR oneR add mul opp ==>
      !a:'r b c d. add (add a b) (add c d) = add (add a c) (add b d)`;;

let ideal_sum = new_definition
  `ideal_sum (add:'r->'r->'r) (ideal1:'r->bool) (ideal2:'r->bool) =
     (\x:'r. ?a b. ideal1 a /\ ideal2 b /\ x = add a b)`;;

let inter_isIdeal =
  `!zeroR oneR add mul opp (fam:'i->'r->bool).
      cring zeroR oneR add mul opp ==>
      (!i. IsIdeal zeroR add mul opp (fam i)) ==>
      IsIdeal zeroR add mul opp (inter fam)`;;

let sum_isIdeal =
  `!zeroR oneR add mul opp (ideal1:'r->bool) (ideal2:'r->bool).
      cring zeroR oneR add mul opp ==>
      IsIdeal zeroR add mul opp ideal1 ==>
      IsIdeal zeroR add mul opp ideal2 ==>
      IsIdeal zeroR add mul opp (ideal_sum add ideal1 ideal2)`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact ideals: in an
;; arbitrary commutative ring, an arbitrarily indexed intersection of ideals
;; and the sum of two ideals are ideals. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces represent the source's arbitrary carrier,
;; operations, index type, family of predicates, and two individual
;; predicates. No carrier, function, family, or predicate is enumerated.

(defstub ideals-carrier-p (ring value) t)
(defstub ideals-index-member-p (index-type index) t)
(defstub ideals-zero (ring) t)
(defstub ideals-one (ring) t)
(defstub ideals-add (ring left right) t)
(defstub ideals-mul (ring left right) t)
(defstub ideals-opp (ring value) t)
(defstub ideals-family-member-p (family index value) t)
(defstub ideals-ideal-member-p (ideal value) t)

(defun-sk ideals-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y))
      (and
       (ideals-carrier-p ring (ideals-add ring x y))
       (ideals-carrier-p ring (ideals-mul ring x y))
       (equal (ideals-add ring x y)
              (ideals-add ring y x))
       (equal (ideals-mul ring x y)
              (ideals-mul ring y x))
       (equal
        (ideals-opp ring (ideals-add ring x y))
        (ideals-add ring
                    (ideals-opp ring x)
                    (ideals-opp ring y)))))
     (implies
      (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
      (and
       (ideals-carrier-p ring (ideals-opp ring x))
       (equal (ideals-add ring x (ideals-zero ring)) x)
       (equal
        (ideals-add ring x (ideals-opp ring x))
        (ideals-zero ring))
       (equal (ideals-mul ring x (ideals-one ring)) x)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (ideals-add ring (ideals-add ring x y) z)
        (ideals-add ring x (ideals-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (ideals-mul ring (ideals-mul ring x y) z)
        (ideals-mul ring x (ideals-mul ring y z)))))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring a)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y))
      (equal
       (ideals-mul ring a (ideals-add ring x y))
       (ideals-add ring
                   (ideals-mul ring a x)
                   (ideals-mul ring a y)))))))

(defun ideals-commutative-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (ideals-carrier-p ring (ideals-zero ring))
   (ideals-carrier-p ring (ideals-one ring))
   (ideals-ring-laws-p ring)))

(defun-sk ideals-ideal-closure-p (ring ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y)
           (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal x)
           (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal y))
      (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal (ideals-add ring x y)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal x))
      (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal (ideals-opp ring x)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring a)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal x))
      (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal (ideals-mul ring a x))))))

(defun ideals-is-ideal-p (ring ideal)
  (and
   (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal (ideals-zero ring))
   (ideals-ideal-closure-p ring ideal)))

(defun-sk ideals-family-entry-closure-p (ring family index)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y)
           (ideals-family-member-p family index x)
           (ideals-family-member-p family index y))
      (ideals-family-member-p
       family index (ideals-add ring x y)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-family-member-p family index x))
      (ideals-family-member-p
       family index (ideals-opp ring x)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring a)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-family-member-p family index x))
      (ideals-family-member-p
       family index (ideals-mul ring a x))))))

(defun ideals-family-entry-is-ideal-p (ring family index)
  (and
   (ideals-family-member-p
    family index (ideals-zero ring))
   (ideals-family-entry-closure-p ring family index)))

(defun-sk ideals-family-all-ideals-p
    (ring index-type family)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (ideals-index-member-p index-type index)
     (ideals-family-entry-is-ideal-p ring family index))))

(defun-sk ideals-intersection-member-p
    (index-type family value)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (ideals-index-member-p index-type index)
     (ideals-family-member-p family index value))))

(defun-sk ideals-intersection-closure-p
    (ring index-type family)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y)
           (ideals-intersection-member-p index-type family x)
           (ideals-intersection-member-p index-type family y))
      (ideals-intersection-member-p
       index-type family (ideals-add ring x y)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-intersection-member-p index-type family x))
      (ideals-intersection-member-p
       index-type family (ideals-opp ring x)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring a)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-intersection-member-p index-type family x))
      (ideals-intersection-member-p
       index-type family (ideals-mul ring a x))))))

(defun ideals-intersection-is-ideal-p
    (ring index-type family)
  (and
   (ideals-intersection-member-p
    index-type family (ideals-zero ring))
   (ideals-intersection-closure-p ring index-type family)))

(defun-sk ideals-sum-member-p
    (ring ideal1 ideal2 value)
  (exists (left right)
    (and
     (ideals-carrier-p ring left)
     (ideals-carrier-p ring right)
     (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal1 left)
     (ideals-ideal-member-p ideal2 right)
     (equal value (ideals-add ring left right)))))

(defun-sk ideals-sum-closure-p (ring ideal1 ideal2)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring y)
           (ideals-sum-member-p ring ideal1 ideal2 x)
           (ideals-sum-member-p ring ideal1 ideal2 y))
      (ideals-sum-member-p
       ring ideal1 ideal2 (ideals-add ring x y)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-sum-member-p ring ideal1 ideal2 x))
      (ideals-sum-member-p
       ring ideal1 ideal2 (ideals-opp ring x)))
     (implies
      (and (ideals-carrier-p ring a)
           (ideals-carrier-p ring x)
           (ideals-sum-member-p ring ideal1 ideal2 x))
      (ideals-sum-member-p
       ring ideal1 ideal2 (ideals-mul ring a x))))))

(defun ideals-sum-is-ideal-p (ring ideal1 ideal2)
  (and
   (ideals-sum-member-p
    ring ideal1 ideal2 (ideals-zero ring))
   (ideals-sum-closure-p ring ideal1 ideal2)))

(defun-sk ideals-inter-is-ideal-statement ()
  (forall (ring index-type family)
    (implies
     (and
      (ideals-commutative-ring-p ring)
      (ideals-family-all-ideals-p
       ring index-type family))
     (ideals-intersection-is-ideal-p
      ring index-type family))))

(defun-sk ideals-sum-is-ideal-statement ()
  (forall (ring ideal1 ideal2)
    (implies
     (and
      (ideals-commutative-ring-p ring)
      (ideals-is-ideal-p ring ideal1)
      (ideals-is-ideal-p ring ideal2))
     (ideals-sum-is-ideal-p ring ideal1 ideal2))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic ideals. This file contains no proof.

module ideals where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _∧_

record _∧_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    left  : A
    right : B

record CRing {ℓ : Level} (R : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    zero : R
    one  : R
    add  : R → R → R
    mul  : R → R → R
    opp  : R → R

    add-comm  : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : R) →
                add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero  : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-opp   : (x : R) → add x (opp x) ≡ zero

    mul-comm  : (x y : R) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc : (x y z : R) →
                mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one   : (x : R) → mul x one ≡ x
    dist-left : (a x y : R) →
                mul a (add x y) ≡ add (mul a x) (mul a y)
    opp-add   : (x y : R) →
                opp (add x y) ≡ add (opp x) (opp y)

record IsIdeal
  {ℓ p : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
  (S : CRing R) (I : R → Set p) : Set (ℓ ⊔ p) where

  open CRing S

  field
    contains-zero : I zero
    closed-add    : (x y : R) → I x → I y → I (add x y)
    closed-opp    : (x : R) → I x → I (opp x)
    closed-mul    : (a x : R) → I x → I (mul a x)

Inter :
  ∀ {ℓ i p : Level} {R : Set ℓ} {A : Set i} →
  (A → R → Set p) → R → Set (i ⊔ p)
Inter {A = A} F x = (a : A) → F a x

IdealSum :
  ∀ {ℓ p : Level} {R : Set ℓ} →
  CRing R → (R → Set p) → (R → Set p) → R → Set (ℓ ⊔ p)
IdealSum {R = R} S I J x =
  Σ R (λ a →
    Σ R (λ b →
      I a ∧ (J b ∧ x ≡ CRing.add S a b)))

module IdealStatements
  {ℓ i p : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
  (S : CRing R) where

  inter-isIdeal :
    {A : Set i} →
    (F : A → R → Set p) →
    Set (ℓ ⊔ i ⊔ p)
  inter-isIdeal {A} F =
    ((a : A) → IsIdeal S (F a)) →
    IsIdeal S (Inter F)

  sum-isIdeal :
    (I J : R → Set p) →
    Set (ℓ ⊔ p)
  sum-isIdeal I J =
    IsIdeal S I →
    IsIdeal S J →
    IsIdeal S (IdealSum S I J)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact ideals: arbitrary
  intersections and binary sums of ideals in a commutative ring are ideals.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val babel_cring_def = new_definition (
  "babel_cring_def",
  ``babel_cring (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (opp : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zeroR = x) /\
      (!x. add x (opp x) = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul x oneR = x) /\
      (!a x y. mul a (add x y) = add (mul a x) (mul a y)) /\
      (!x y. opp (add x y) = add (opp x) (opp y))``);

val babel_is_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "babel_is_ideal_def",
  ``babel_is_ideal (zeroR : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (opp : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r -> bool) <=>
      ideal zeroR /\
      (!x y. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (add x y)) /\
      (!x. ideal x ==> ideal (opp x)) /\
      (!a x. ideal x ==> ideal (mul a x))``);

val babel_ideal_inter_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ideal_inter_def",
  ``babel_ideal_inter (index : 'i -> bool)
      (fam : 'i -> 'r -> bool) =
      (\x. !i. index i ==> fam i x)``);

val inter_isIdeal =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (opp : 'r -> 'r) (index : 'i -> bool)
      (fam : 'i -> 'r -> bool).
      babel_cring zeroR oneR add mul opp ==>
      (!i. index i ==>
           babel_is_ideal zeroR add mul opp (fam i)) ==>
      babel_is_ideal zeroR add mul opp
        (babel_ideal_inter index fam)``;

val babel_ideal_sum_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ideal_sum_def",
  ``babel_ideal_sum (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal1 : 'r -> bool) (ideal2 : 'r -> bool) =
      (\x. ?a b. ideal1 a /\ ideal2 b /\ x = add a b)``);

val sum_isIdeal =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (opp : 'r -> 'r) (ideal1 : 'r -> bool) (ideal2 : 'r -> bool).
      babel_cring zeroR oneR add mul opp ==>
      babel_is_ideal zeroR add mul opp ideal1 ==>
      babel_is_ideal zeroR add mul opp ideal2 ==>
      babel_is_ideal zeroR add mul opp
        (babel_ideal_sum add ideal1 ideal2)``;

val _ = export_theory();

title: ideals
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic ideals. This file contains no proof.

ideals[
  R: TYPE+,
  Index: TYPE,
  zero: R,
  one: R,
  add: [R, R -> R],
  mul: [R, R -> R],
  opp: [R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  cring: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R): add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): add(x, opp(x)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, x, y: R):
        mul(a, add(x, y)) = add(mul(a, x), mul(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        opp(add(x, y)) = add(opp(x), opp(y)))

  isIdeal(ideal: [R -> bool]): bool =
    ideal(zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        ideal(x) AND ideal(y) IMPLIES ideal(add(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        ideal(x) IMPLIES ideal(opp(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, x: R):
        ideal(x) IMPLIES ideal(mul(a, x)))

  inter(family: [Index, R -> bool]): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): FORALL (i: Index): family(i, x)

  ideal_sum(ideal1, ideal2: [R -> bool]): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R):
      EXISTS (a, b: R):
        ideal1(a) AND ideal2(b) AND x = add(a, b)

  inter_isIdeal: bool =
    cring IMPLIES
      (FORALL (family: [Index, R -> bool]):
        (FORALL (i: Index):
          isIdeal(LAMBDA (x: R): family(i, x)))
          IMPLIES isIdeal(inter(family)))

  sum_isIdeal: bool =
    cring IMPLIES
      (FORALL (ideal1, ideal2: [R -> bool]):
        (isIdeal(ideal1) AND isIdeal(ideal2))
          IMPLIES isIdeal(ideal_sum(ideal1, ideal2)))
END ideals

title: inner_product
content:
namespace Linear

class Field (R : Type) where
  zero    : R
  one     : R
  add     : R → R → R
  mul     : R → R → R
  opp     : R → R

  add_comm    : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc   : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero    : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  zero_add    : ∀ x, add zero x = x
  add_opp     : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero

  mul_comm    : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc   : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one     : ∀ x, mul x one = x
  dist_l      : ∀ x y z, mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)

  opp_add     : ∀ x y, opp (add x y) = add (opp x) (opp y)
  mul_opp_one : ∀ x, mul (opp one) x = opp x
  opp_opp     : ∀ x, opp (opp x) = x

infixl:65  "+R"  => Field.add
infixl:70  "*R"  => Field.mul
prefix:100 "-R"  => Field.opp

class VSpace (R : Type) [Field R] (V : Type) where
  zeroV : V
  addV  : V → V → V
  oppV  : V → V
  smul  : R → V → V

  addV_comm  : ∀ u v, addV u v = addV v u
  addV_assoc : ∀ u v w, addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)
  addV_zero  : ∀ u, addV u zeroV = u
  addV_opp   : ∀ u, addV u (oppV u) = zeroV

  smul_addV  : ∀ a u v, smul a (addV u v) = addV (smul a u) (smul a v)
  addR_smul  : ∀ a b u, smul (a +R b) u = addV (smul a u) (smul b u)
  mul_smul   : ∀ a b u, smul (a *R b) u = smul a (smul b u)
  one_smul   : ∀ u, smul Field.one u = u
  smul_zero  : ∀ a, smul a zeroV = zeroV
  opp_smul_one : ∀ u, oppV u = smul (Field.opp Field.one) u

infixl:65  "+V"  => VSpace.addV
prefix:100 "-V"  => VSpace.oppV
notation:70 a " •V " u => VSpace.smul a u

def subV {R : Type} {V : Type} [Field R] [VSpace R V] (u v : V) : V :=
  VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
infixl:65  " -V " => subV

class Inner (R : Type) (V : Type) [Field R] [VSpace R V] where
  ip : V → V → R

  lin_left_add  : ∀ u v w,
    ip (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v) w = (ip u w) +R (ip v w)
  lin_left_smul : ∀ a u v,
    ip (VSpace.smul (R := R) (V := V) a u) v = a *R (ip u v)

  lin_right_add  : ∀ u v w,
    ip u (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) v w) = (ip u v) +R (ip u w)
  lin_right_smul : ∀ a u v,
    ip u (VSpace.smul (R := R) (V := V) a v) = a *R (ip u v)

  symm : ∀ u v, ip u v = ip v u


variable {R : Type} {V : Type}
variable [Field R] [VSpace R V] [Inner R V]

theorem ip_neg_left (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
    (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) u) v
    = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) := by sorry
theorem ip_neg_right (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u
    (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
    = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) := by sorry
theorem ip_add_add (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u)
       +R (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by sorry
theorem ip_sub_sub (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u))
       +R (Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by sorry
theorem pythagoras (u v : V)
  (h : Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v = Field.zero) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v) := by sorry
theorem parallelogram (u v : V) :
  (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
     +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
          (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
          (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v))
    = (((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u)
         +R (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v))
       +R ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u))
           +R ((Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v))
               +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v))) := by sorry
end Linear

theory inner_product
  imports Main
begin

locale inner_product =
  fixes zero_R one_R :: "'r"
    and add_R :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"  (infixl "+R" 65)
    and mul_R :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"  (infixl "*R" 70)
    and opp_R :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and zeroV :: "'v"
    and addV  :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"  (infixl "+V" 65)
    and oppV  :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and smul  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and ip    :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'r"

  assumes add_R_comm    : "\<And>x y. x +R y = y +R x"
    and   add_R_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x +R y) +R z = x +R (y +R z)"
    and   add_R_zero    : "\<And>x. x +R zero_R = x"
    and   zero_R_add    : "\<And>x. zero_R +R x = x"
    and   add_R_opp     : "\<And>x. x +R opp_R x = zero_R"
