;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact inner_product: six
;; negation, expansion, Pythagorean, and parallelogram identities for a
;; symmetric bilinear inner product over arbitrary scalar and vector carriers
;; satisfying the source's algebraic laws. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent the two arbitrary source types and
;; every operation carried by Field, VSpace, and Inner. All typing and
;; algebraic laws are explicit below; no carrier or function is finite-coded.

(defstub bf-ip-scalar-member-p (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub bf-ip-vector-member-p (vector-type x) t)

(defstub bf-ip-zero-r (scalar-type) t)
(defstub bf-ip-one-r (scalar-type) t)
(defstub bf-ip-add-r (scalar-type x y) t)
(defstub bf-ip-mul-r (scalar-type x y) t)
(defstub bf-ip-opp-r (scalar-type x) t)

(defstub bf-ip-zero-v (scalar-type vector-type) t)
(defstub bf-ip-add-v (scalar-type vector-type x y) t)
(defstub bf-ip-opp-v (scalar-type vector-type x) t)
(defstub bf-ip-smul (scalar-type vector-type a x) t)
(defstub bf-ip-inner (scalar-type vector-type x y) t)

(defun-sk bf-ip-field-laws-p (scalar-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p scalar-type y)
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p scalar-type z))
     (let ((zero (bf-ip-zero-r scalar-type))
           (one (bf-ip-one-r scalar-type)))
       (and
        ;; Closure is the ACL2 rendering of the source operations' result
        ;; types.
        (bf-ip-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type x y))
        (bf-ip-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type x y))
        (bf-ip-scalar-member-p
         scalar-type (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type x))

        (equal (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type x y)
               (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type y x))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-add-r
          scalar-type (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type x y) z)
         (bf-ip-add-r
          scalar-type x (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type y z)))
        (equal (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type x zero) x)
        (equal (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type zero x) x)
        (equal
         (bf-ip-add-r
          scalar-type x (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type x))
         zero)

        (equal (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type x y)
               (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type y x))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-mul-r
          scalar-type (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type x y) z)
         (bf-ip-mul-r
          scalar-type x (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type y z)))
        (equal (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type x one) x)
        (equal
         (bf-ip-mul-r
          scalar-type x (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type y z))
         (bf-ip-add-r
          scalar-type
          (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type x y)
          (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type x z)))

        (equal
         (bf-ip-opp-r
          scalar-type (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type x y))
         (bf-ip-add-r
          scalar-type
          (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type x)
          (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type y)))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-mul-r
          scalar-type (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type one) x)
         (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type x))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-opp-r
          scalar-type (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type x))
         x))))))

(defun bf-ip-field-p (scalar-type)
  (and
   (bf-ip-scalar-member-p
    scalar-type (bf-ip-zero-r scalar-type))
   (bf-ip-scalar-member-p
    scalar-type (bf-ip-one-r scalar-type))
   (bf-ip-field-laws-p scalar-type)))

(defun-sk bf-ip-vector-space-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p scalar-type b)
      (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type u)
      (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type v)
      (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type w))
     (let ((one-r (bf-ip-one-r scalar-type))
           (zero-v (bf-ip-zero-v scalar-type vector-type)))
       (and
        (bf-ip-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v))
        (bf-ip-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (bf-ip-opp-v scalar-type vector-type u))
        (bf-ip-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a u))

        (equal
         (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
         (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type v u))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
          w)
         (bf-ip-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          u
          (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type v w)))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type u zero-v)
         u)
        (equal
         (bf-ip-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          u
          (bf-ip-opp-v scalar-type vector-type u))
         zero-v)

        (equal
         (bf-ip-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          a
          (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v))
         (bf-ip-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a u)
          (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a v)))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          (bf-ip-add-r scalar-type a b)
          u)
         (bf-ip-add-v
          scalar-type vector-type
          (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a u)
          (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type b u)))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          (bf-ip-mul-r scalar-type a b)
          u)
         (bf-ip-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          a
          (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type b u)))
        (equal
         (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type one-r u)
         u)
        (equal
         (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a zero-v)
         zero-v)
        (equal
         (bf-ip-opp-v scalar-type vector-type u)
         (bf-ip-smul
          scalar-type vector-type
          (bf-ip-opp-r scalar-type one-r)
          u)))))))

(defun bf-ip-vector-space-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (bf-ip-vector-member-p
    vector-type (bf-ip-zero-v scalar-type vector-type))
   (bf-ip-vector-space-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)))

(defun-sk bf-ip-inner-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
      (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type u)
      (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type v)
      (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type w))
     (and
      (bf-ip-scalar-member-p
       scalar-type
       (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v))
      (equal
       (bf-ip-inner
        scalar-type vector-type
        (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type u v)
        w)
       (bf-ip-add-r
        scalar-type
        (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u w)
        (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type v w)))
      (equal
       (bf-ip-inner
        scalar-type vector-type
        (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a u)
        v)
       (bf-ip-mul-r
        scalar-type
        a
        (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)))
      (equal
       (bf-ip-inner
        scalar-type vector-type
        u
        (bf-ip-add-v scalar-type vector-type v w))
       (bf-ip-add-r
        scalar-type
        (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)
        (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u w)))
      (equal
       (bf-ip-inner
        scalar-type vector-type
        u
        (bf-ip-smul scalar-type vector-type a v))
       (bf-ip-mul-r
        scalar-type
        a
        (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)))
      (equal
       (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)
       (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type v u))))))

(defun bf-ip-context-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (bf-ip-field-p scalar-type)
   (bf-ip-vector-space-p scalar-type vector-type)
   (bf-ip-inner-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)))

(defun bf-ip-sub-v (scalar-type vector-type u v)
  (bf-ip-add-v
   scalar-type vector-type
   u
   (bf-ip-opp-v scalar-type vector-type v)))

(defun bf-ip-sum-expansion (scalar-type vector-type u v)
  (bf-ip-add-r
   scalar-type
   (bf-ip-add-r
    scalar-type
    (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u u)
    (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type v u))

    scalar-type
    (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v)
    (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type v v))))

(defun bf-ip-difference-expansion
    (scalar-type vector-type u v)
  (bf-ip-add-r
   scalar-type

    scalar-type
    (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u u)

    scalar-type
    (bf-ip-opp-r

    (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type v v))))

(defun bf-ip-typed-pair-p (scalar-type vector-type u v)
  (and
   (bf-ip-context-p scalar-type vector-type)
   (bf-ip-vector-member-p vector-type u)

(defun-sk bf-ip-neg-left-statement (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (u v)
    (implies
     (bf-ip-typed-pair-p scalar-type vector-type u v)
     (equal
      (bf-ip-inner
       scalar-type vector-type
       (bf-ip-opp-v scalar-type vector-type u)
       v)
      (bf-ip-opp-r
       scalar-type
       (bf-ip-inner scalar-type vector-type u v))))))

(defun-sk bf-ip-neg-right-statement (scalar-type vector-type)

(defun-sk bf-ip-add-add-statement (scalar-type vector-type)

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic inner_product. This file contains no
-- proof.

module inner_product where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

record Field {ℓ : Level} (R : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    zero : R
    one  : R
    add  : R → R → R
    mul  : R → R → R
    opp  : R → R

    add-comm  : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : R) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero  : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    zero-add  : (x : R) → add zero x ≡ x
    add-opp   : (x : R) → add x (opp x) ≡ zero

    mul-comm    : (x y : R) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc   : (x y z : R) → mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one     : (x : R) → mul x one ≡ x
    distribute  : (x y z : R) →
                  mul x (add y z) ≡ add (mul x y) (mul x z)

    opp-add     : (x y : R) → opp (add x y) ≡ add (opp x) (opp y)
    mul-opp-one : (x : R) → mul (opp one) x ≡ opp x
    opp-opp     : (x : R) → opp (opp x) ≡ x

record VSpace {ℓR ℓV : Level} {R : Set ℓR}
              (F : Field R) (V : Set ℓV) : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV) where
  open Field F

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV  : V → V → V
    oppV  : V → V
    smul  : R → V → V

    addV-comm  : (u v : V) → addV u v ≡ addV v u
    addV-assoc : (u v w : V) → addV (addV u v) w ≡ addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero  : (u : V) → addV u zeroV ≡ u
    addV-opp   : (u : V) → addV u (oppV u) ≡ zeroV

    smul-addV : (a : R) (u v : V) →
                smul a (addV u v) ≡ addV (smul a u) (smul a v)
    add-smul  : (a b : R) (u : V) →
                smul (add a b) u ≡ addV (smul a u) (smul b u)
    mul-smul  : (a b : R) (u : V) →
                smul (mul a b) u ≡ smul a (smul b u)
    one-smul  : (u : V) → smul one u ≡ u
    smul-zero : (a : R) → smul a zeroV ≡ zeroV
    opp-smul-one : (u : V) → oppV u ≡ smul (opp one) u

record Inner {ℓR ℓV : Level} {R : Set ℓR} {V : Set ℓV}
             (F : Field R) (S : VSpace F V) : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV) where
  open Field F
  open VSpace S

  field
    ip : V → V → R

    linear-left-add : (u v w : V) →
      ip (addV u v) w ≡ add (ip u w) (ip v w)
    linear-left-smul : (a : R) (u v : V) →
      ip (smul a u) v ≡ mul a (ip u v)

    linear-right-add : (u v w : V) →
      ip u (addV v w) ≡ add (ip u v) (ip u w)
    linear-right-smul : (a : R) (u v : V) →
      ip u (smul a v) ≡ mul a (ip u v)

    symmetric : (u v : V) → ip u v ≡ ip v u

module InnerProductStatements
  {ℓR ℓV : Level} {R : Set ℓR} {V : Set ℓV}
  (F : Field R) (S : VSpace F V) (I : Inner F S) where

  open Field F
  open VSpace S
  open Inner I

  subV : V → V → V
  subV u v = addV u (oppV v)

  ip-neg-left : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV)
  ip-neg-left =
    (u v : V) →
    ip (oppV u) v ≡ opp (ip u v)

  ip-neg-right : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV)
  ip-neg-right =
    (u v : V) →
    ip u (oppV v) ≡ opp (ip u v)

  ip-add-add : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV)
  ip-add-add =
    (u v : V) →
    ip (addV u v) (addV u v) ≡
    add (add (ip u u) (ip v u))
        (add (ip u v) (ip v v))

  ip-sub-sub : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV)
  ip-sub-sub =
    (u v : V) →
    ip (subV u v) (subV u v) ≡
    add (add (ip u u) (opp (ip v u)))
        (add (opp (ip u v)) (ip v v))

  pythagoras : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV)
  pythagoras =
    (u v : V) →
    ip u v ≡ zero →
    ip (addV u v) (addV u v) ≡ add (ip u u) (ip v v)

  parallelogram : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV)
  parallelogram =
    (u v : V) →
    add (ip (addV u v) (addV u v))
        (ip (subV u v) (subV u v)) ≡
    add (add (add (ip u u) (ip v u))
             (add (ip u v) (ip v v)))
        (add (add (ip u u) (opp (ip v u)))
             (add (opp (ip u v)) (ip v v)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact inner_product:
  abstract vector spaces with a symmetric bilinear form and its sum,
  difference, Pythagoras, and parallelogram identities. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val inner_product_context_def = new_definition (
  "inner_product_context_def",
  ``inner_product_context
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x. addR x zeroR = x) /\
      (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
      (!x. addR x (oppR x) = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x. mulR x oneR = x) /\
      (!x y z.
         mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
      (!x y. oppR (addR x y) = addR (oppR x) (oppR y)) /\
      (!x. mulR (oppR oneR) x = oppR x) /\
      (!x. oppR (oppR x) = x) /\
      (!u v. addV u v = addV v u) /\
      (!u v w. addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)) /\
      (!u. addV u zeroV = u) /\
      (!u. addV u (oppV u) = zeroV) /\
      (!a u v. smul a (addV u v) = addV (smul a u) (smul a v)) /\
      (!a b u. smul (addR a b) u = addV (smul a u) (smul b u)) /\
      (!a b u. smul (mulR a b) u = smul a (smul b u)) /\
      (!u. smul oneR u = u) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroV = zeroV) /\
      (!u. oppV u = smul (oppR oneR) u) /\
      (!u v w. ip (addV u v) w = addR (ip u w) (ip v w)) /\
      (!a u v. ip (smul a u) v = mulR a (ip u v)) /\
      (!u v w. ip u (addV v w) = addR (ip u v) (ip u w)) /\
      (!a u v. ip u (smul a v) = mulR a (ip u v)) /\
      (!u v. ip u v = ip v u)``);

val inner_subV_def = new_definition (
  "inner_subV_def",
  ``inner_subV (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v) u v =
      addV u (oppV v)``);

val ip_neg_left =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r).
      inner_product_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smul ip ==>
      !u v. ip (oppV u) v = oppR (ip u v)``;

val ip_neg_right =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r).
      inner_product_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smul ip ==>
      !u v. ip u (oppV v) = oppR (ip u v)``;

val ip_add_add =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r).
      inner_product_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smul ip ==>
      !u v.
        ip (addV u v) (addV u v) =
          addR (addR (ip u u) (ip v u))
               (addR (ip u v) (ip v v))``;

val ip_sub_sub =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r).
      inner_product_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smul ip ==>
      !u v.
        ip (inner_subV addV oppV u v) (inner_subV addV oppV u v) =
          addR (addR (ip u u) (oppR (ip v u)))
               (addR (oppR (ip u v)) (ip v v))``;

val pythagoras =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r).
      inner_product_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smul ip ==>
      !u v.
        ip u v = zeroR ==>
        ip (addV u v) (addV u v) = addR (ip u u) (ip v v)``;

val parallelogram =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) (ip : 'v -> 'v -> 'r).
      inner_product_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smul ip ==>
      !u v.
        addR (ip (addV u v) (addV u v))
             (ip (inner_subV addV oppV u v)
                 (inner_subV addV oppV u v)) =
          addR
            (addR (addR (ip u u) (ip v u))
                  (addR (ip u v) (ip v v)))
            (addR (addR (ip u u) (oppR (ip v u)))
                  (addR (oppR (ip u v)) (ip v v)))``;

val _ = export_theory();

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1,
    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1;
  notations XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R,V being non empty set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      oppR being UnOp of R,
      zeroV being Element of V,
      addV being BinOp of V,
      oppV being UnOp of V,
      smul being Function of [:R,V:],V,
      ip being Function of [:V,V:],R
  st
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,y) = addR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(x,y),z) = addR.(x,addR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,zeroR) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(zeroR,x) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,oppR.x) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,y) = mulR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(x,y),z) = mulR.(x,mulR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,oneR) = x) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,addR.(y,z)) =
        addR.(mulR.(x,y),mulR.(x,z))) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      oppR.(addR.(x,y)) = addR.(oppR.x,oppR.y)) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(oppR.oneR,x) = oppR.x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      oppR.(oppR.x) = x) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,v) = addV.(v,u)) &
    (for u,v,w being Element of V holds
      addV.(addV.(u,v),w) = addV.(u,addV.(v,w))) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,zeroV) = u) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,oppV.u) = zeroV) &
    (for a being Element of R, u,v being Element of V holds
      smul.(a,addV.(u,v)) =
        addV.(smul.(a,u),smul.(a,v))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      smul.(addR.(a,b),u) =
        addV.(smul.(a,u),smul.(b,u))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      smul.(mulR.(a,b),u) = smul.(a,smul.(b,u))) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      smul.(oneR,u) = u) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      smul.(a,zeroV) = zeroV) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      oppV.u = smul.(oppR.oneR,u)) &
    (for u,v,w being Element of V holds
      ip.(addV.(u,v),w) = addR.(ip.(u,w),ip.(v,w))) &
    (for a being Element of R, u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(smul.(a,u),v) = mulR.(a,ip.(u,v))) &
    (for u,v,w being Element of V holds
      ip.(u,addV.(v,w)) = addR.(ip.(u,v),ip.(u,w))) &
    (for a being Element of R, u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(u,smul.(a,v)) = mulR.(a,ip.(u,v))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(u,v) = ip.(v,u))
  holds
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(oppV.u,v) = oppR.(ip.(u,v))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(u,oppV.v) = oppR.(ip.(u,v))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(addV.(u,v),addV.(u,v)) =
        addR.(addR.(ip.(u,u),ip.(v,u)),
          addR.(ip.(u,v),ip.(v,v)))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      ip.(addV.(u,oppV.v),addV.(u,oppV.v)) =
        addR.(addR.(ip.(u,u),oppR.(ip.(v,u))),
          addR.(oppR.(ip.(u,v)),ip.(v,v)))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V st
      ip.(u,v) = zeroR
      holds
        ip.(addV.(u,v),addV.(u,v)) =
          addR.(ip.(u,u),ip.(v,v))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      addR.(
        ip.(addV.(u,v),addV.(u,v)),
        ip.(addV.(u,oppV.v),addV.(u,oppV.v))
      ) =
        addR.(
          addR.(
            addR.(ip.(u,u),ip.(v,u)),
            addR.(ip.(u,v),ip.(v,v))
          ),
          addR.(
            addR.(ip.(u,u),oppR.(ip.(v,u))),
            addR.(oppR.(ip.(u,v)),ip.(v,v))
          )
        ))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: inner_product
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic inner_product. This file contains no
% proof.

inner_product[
  R: TYPE+,
  V: TYPE+,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R],
  oppR: [R -> R],
  zeroV: V,
  addV: [V, V -> V],
  oppV: [V -> V],
  smul: [R, V -> V],
  ip: [V, V -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R): addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(zeroR, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, oppR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(x, addR(y, z)) =
          addR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        oppR(addR(x, y)) = addR(oppR(x), oppR(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(oppR(oneR), x) = oppR(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): oppR(oppR(x)) = x)

  vspace_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): addV(u, v) = addV(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        addV(addV(u, v), w) = addV(u, addV(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): addV(u, zeroV) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): addV(u, oppV(u)) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (u, v: V):
        smul(a, addV(u, v)) = addV(smul(a, u), smul(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (u: V):
        smul(addR(a, b), u) = addV(smul(a, u), smul(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (u: V):
        smul(mulR(a, b), u) = smul(a, smul(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): smul(oneR, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (a: R): smul(a, zeroV) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): oppV(u) = smul(oppR(oneR), u))

  inner_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      ip(addV(u, v), w) = addR(ip(u, w), ip(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (u, v: V):
        ip(smul(a, u), v) = mulR(a, ip(u, v)))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        ip(u, addV(v, w)) = addR(ip(u, v), ip(u, w)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (u, v: V):
        ip(u, smul(a, v)) = mulR(a, ip(u, v)))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): ip(u, v) = ip(v, u))

  inner_context: bool = field_laws AND vspace_laws AND inner_laws

  subV(u, v: V): V = addV(u, oppV(v))

  ip_neg_left: bool =
    inner_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u, v: V):
        ip(oppV(u), v) = oppR(ip(u, v)))

  ip_neg_right: bool =
    inner_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u, v: V):
        ip(u, oppV(v)) = oppR(ip(u, v)))

  ip_add_add: bool =
    inner_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u, v: V):
        ip(addV(u, v), addV(u, v)) =
          addR(
            addR(ip(u, u), ip(v, u)),
            addR(ip(u, v), ip(v, v))))

  ip_sub_sub: bool =
    inner_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u, v: V):
        ip(subV(u, v), subV(u, v)) =
          addR(
            addR(ip(u, u), oppR(ip(v, u))),
            addR(oppR(ip(u, v)), ip(v, v))))

  pythagoras: bool =
    inner_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u, v: V):
        ip(u, v) = zeroR IMPLIES
          ip(addV(u, v), addV(u, v)) =
            addR(ip(u, u), ip(v, v)))

  parallelogram: bool =
    inner_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u, v: V):
        addR(
          ip(addV(u, v), addV(u, v)),
          ip(subV(u, v), subV(u, v))) =
            addR(
              addR(
                addR(ip(u, u), ip(v, u)),
                addR(ip(u, v), ip(v, v))),
              addR(
                addR(ip(u, u), oppR(ip(v, u))),
                addR(oppR(ip(u, v)), ip(v, v)))))
END inner_product

content:
class RField (R : Type) where
  zero   : R
  one    : R
  add    : R → R → R
  opp    : R → R
  mul    : R → R → R
  le     : R → R → Prop
  lt     : R → R → Prop
  abs    : R → R

  add_comm      : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc     : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero      : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_opp       : ∀ x, add (opp x) x = zero
  add_right_cancel : ∀ x y z, add x z = add y z → x = y

  mul_comm      : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc     : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one       : ∀ x, mul x one = x
  dist_l        : ∀ x y z, mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)
  opp_involutive : ∀ x, opp (opp x) = x

  add_le_compat : ∀ x y z, le x y → le (add x z) (add y z)
  mul_le_compat : ∀ x y z, le zero z → le x y → le (mul x z) (mul y z)
  zero_le_one   : le zero one
  le_total      : ∀ x y, le x y ∨ le y x

  le_dec : ∀ x y, (le x y) ∨ ¬ (le x y)

  le_opp        : ∀ x y, le x y → le (opp y) (opp x)
  le_antisymm   : ∀ x y, le x y → le y x → x = y
  lt_opp        : ∀ x y, lt x y → lt (opp y) (opp x)
  le_refl       : ∀ x, le x x
  le_trans      : ∀ x y z, le x y → le y z → le x z
  lt_def        : ∀ x y, lt x y ↔ (le x y ∧ x ≠ y)

  abs_pos       : ∀ x, le zero x → abs x = x
  abs_neg       : ∀ x, le x zero → abs x = opp x
  abs_nonneg    : ∀ x, le zero (abs x)
  abs_opp       : ∀ x, abs (opp x) = abs x
  abs_triangle  : ∀ x y, le (abs (add x y)) (add (abs x) (abs y))

class Integral (R : Type) [RField R] where
  sigma       : (R → Prop) → (R → R) → R
  sigma_mul_const : ∀ (D : R → Prop) (f : R → R) (c : R),
    sigma D (fun x => RField.mul c (f x)) = RField.mul c (sigma D f)
  sigma_congr : ∀ D f g, (∀ x, D x → f x = g x) → sigma D f = sigma D g
  sigma_zero  : ∀ D, sigma D (fun _ => RField.zero) = RField.zero
  sigma_add   : ∀ D f g, sigma D (fun x => RField.add (f x) (g x)) = RField.add (sigma D f) (sigma D g)

  sigma_union_disjoint : ∀ (D E : R → Prop) (f : R → R),
    (∀ x, D x → E x → False) →
    sigma (fun x => D x ∨ E x) f = RField.add (sigma D f) (sigma E f)
  sigma_le : ∀ D f g, (∀ x, D x → RField.le (f x) (g x)) → RField.le (sigma D f) (sigma D g)
  sigma_dom_congr : ∀ D E f, (∀ x, D x ↔ E x) → sigma D f = sigma E f

namespace Integrals

variable {R : Type} [RF : RField R] [I : Integral R]
open RField
open Integral

-- Notations
prefix:100 "-" => opp
infixl:65 " + " => add
infixl:70 " * " => mul
infixl:70 " <= " => le
infixl:70 " < " => lt

-- Domains
def Iic (c : R) : R → Prop := fun x => x <= c
def Ioi (c : R) : R → Prop := fun x => c < x
def Iio (c : R) : R → Prop := fun x => x < c
def union (D E : R → Prop) : R → Prop := fun x => D x ∨ E x
def inter (D E : R → Prop) : R → Prop := fun x => D x ∧ E x

-- Lemma lt_irrefl
theorem lt_irrefl (x : R) : ¬ (x < x) := by sorry
theorem lt_trans_strict (x y z : R) (Hxy : x < y) (Hyz : y < z) : x < z := by sorry
def preimage (g : R → R) (D : R → Prop) : R → Prop :=
  fun x => D (g x)

theorem preimage_union (D E : R → Prop) (g : R → R) (x : R) :
  preimage g (union D E) x ↔ preimage g D x ∨ preimage g E x := by sorry
theorem preimage_inter (D E : R → Prop) (g : R → R) (x : R) :
  preimage g (inter D E) x ↔ preimage g D x ∧ preimage g E x := by sorry
theorem preimage_neg_Ioi (c x : R) :
  preimage opp (Ioi c) x ↔ x < opp c := by sorry
theorem preimage_neg_Iic (c x : R) :
  preimage opp (Iic c) x ↔ Iic x (opp c) := by sorry
theorem preimage_comp (D : R → Prop) (g h : R → R) (x : R) :
  preimage g (preimage h D) x ↔ preimage (fun x => h (g x)) D x := by sorry
theorem integral_neg (D : R → Prop) (f : R → R) :
  sigma D (fun x => opp (f x)) = opp (sigma D f) := by sorry
theorem integral_sub (D : R → Prop) (f g : R → R) :
  sigma D (fun x => add (f x) (opp (g x))) = add (sigma D f) (opp (sigma D g)) := by sorry
theorem sigma_empty (f : R → R) :
  sigma (fun _ => False) f = zero := by sorry
theorem sigma_bilinear (D : R → Prop) (f g : R → R) (c d : R) :
  sigma D (fun x => add (mul c (f x)) (mul d (g x))) =
    add (mul c (sigma D f)) (mul d (sigma D g)) := by sorry
theorem sigma_le_monotone (D : R → Prop) (f g : R → R) :
  (∀ x, D x → le (f x) (g x)) → le (sigma D f) (sigma D g) := by sorry
theorem sigma_nonneg (D : R → Prop) (f : R → R) :
  (∀ x, D x → le zero (f x)) → le zero (sigma D f) := by sorry
theorem sigma_split (D : R → Prop) (P : R → Prop) (f : R → R)
  (P_dec : ∀ x, D x → P x ∨ ¬ P x) :
  sigma D f =
    add (sigma (fun x => D x ∧ P x) f)
        (sigma (fun x => D x ∧ ¬ P x) f) := by sorry
theorem sigma_preimage_neg_Ioi (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  sigma (preimage opp (Ioi c)) f = sigma (Iio (opp c)) f := by sorry
theorem sigma_abs_bound (D : R → Prop) (f : R → R) :
  le (abs (sigma D f)) (sigma D (fun x => abs (f x))) := by sorry
end Integrals

theory integral_comp_neg_Iic
  imports Main
begin

locale integrals_setup =
  fixes zero one  :: "'r"
    and add       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"   (infixl "+R" 65)
    and opp       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and mul       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"   (infixl "*R" 70)
    and leR       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"  (infix "\<le>R" 50)
    and ltR       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"  (infix "<R" 50)
    and absR      :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and sigma     :: "('r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> 'r"

  assumes
    add_comm      : "\<And>x y.   x +R y = y +R x"
    and add_assoc : "\<And>x y z. (x +R y) +R z = x +R (y +R z)"
    and add_zero  : "\<And>x.     x +R zero = x"
    and add_opp   : "\<And>x.     opp x +R x = zero"
    and add_right_cancel : "\<And>x y z. x +R z = y +R z \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
    and mul_comm  : "\<And>x y.   x *R y = y *R x"
    and mul_assoc : "\<And>x y z. (x *R y) *R z = x *R (y *R z)"
    and mul_one   : "\<And>x.     x *R one = x"
    and dist_l    : "\<And>x y z. x *R (y +R z) = (x *R y) +R (x *R z)"
    and opp_inv   : "\<And>x.     opp (opp x) = x"
    and add_le_compat : "\<And>x y z. x \<le>R y \<Longrightarrow> (x +R z) \<le>R (y +R z)"
    and le_opp    : "\<And>x y.   x \<le>R y \<Longrightarrow> opp y \<le>R opp x"
    and le_antisymm : "\<And>x y. x \<le>R y \<Longrightarrow> y \<le>R x \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
    and lt_opp    : "\<And>x y.   x <R y \<Longrightarrow> opp y <R opp x"
    and le_refl   : "\<And>x.     x \<le>R x"
    and le_trans  : "\<And>x y z. x \<le>R y \<Longrightarrow> y \<le>R z \<Longrightarrow> x \<le>R z"
    and le_total  : "\<And>x y.   x \<le>R y \<or> y \<le>R x"
    and lt_def    : "\<And>x y.   (x <R y) \<longleftrightarrow> (x \<le>R y \<and> x \<noteq> y)"
    and abs_pos   : "\<And>x.     zero \<le>R x \<Longrightarrow> absR x = x"
    and abs_neg   : "\<And>x.     x \<le>R zero \<Longrightarrow> absR x = opp x"
    and abs_nonneg : "\<And>x.    zero \<le>R absR x"
    and abs_opp   : "\<And>x.     absR (opp x) = absR x"
    and abs_triangle : "\<And>x y. absR (x +R y) \<le>R (absR x +R absR y)"

    and sigma_mul_const : "\<And>D f c. sigma D (\<lambda>x. c *R f x) = c *R sigma D f"
    and sigma_congr : "\<And>D f g. (\<forall>x. D x \<longrightarrow> f x = g x) \<Longrightarrow> sigma D f = sigma D g"
    and sigma_zero  : "\<And>D.     sigma D (\<lambda>_. zero) = zero"
    and sigma_add   : "\<And>D f g. sigma D (\<lambda>x. f x +R g x) = sigma D f +R sigma D g"
    and sigma_union_disjoint :
          "\<And>D E f. (\<forall>x. D x \<longrightarrow> E x \<longrightarrow> False) \<Longrightarrow>
            sigma (\<lambda>x. D x \<or> E x) f = sigma D f +R sigma E f"
    and sigma_le    : "\<And>D f g. (\<forall>x. D x \<longrightarrow> f x \<le>R g x) \<Longrightarrow> sigma D f \<le>R sigma D g"
    and sigma_dom_congr :
          "\<And>D E f. (\<forall>x. D x \<longleftrightarrow> E x) \<Longrightarrow> sigma D f = sigma E f"
begin





definition Iic :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool" where "Iic c x \<equiv> x \<le>R c"
definition Ioi :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool" where "Ioi c x \<equiv> c <R x"
definition Iio :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool" where "Iio c x \<equiv> x <R c"

definition preimage :: "('r \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "preimage g D x \<equiv> D (g x)"





lemma add_opp_r: "x +R opp x = zero"
  sorry




lemma lt_irrefl: "\<not> (x <R x)"
  sorry
lemma lt_trans_strict: "x <R y \<Longrightarrow> y <R z \<Longrightarrow> x <R z"
  sorry




lemma preimage_union:
  "preimage g (\<lambda>x. D x \<or> E x) x \<longleftrightarrow> preimage g D x \<or> preimage g E x"
  sorry
lemma preimage_inter:
  "preimage g (\<lambda>x. D x \<and> E x) x \<longleftrightarrow> preimage g D x \<and> preimage g E x"
  sorry
lemma preimage_neg_Ioi: "preimage opp (Ioi c) x \<longleftrightarrow> x <R opp c"
  sorry
lemma preimage_neg_Iic: "preimage opp (Iic c) x \<longleftrightarrow> opp c \<le>R x"
  sorry
lemma preimage_comp:
  "preimage g (preimage h D) x \<longleftrightarrow> preimage (\<lambda>x. h (g x)) D x"
  sorry




lemma integral_neg: "sigma D (\<lambda>x. opp (f x)) = opp (sigma D f)"
  sorry
lemma integral_sub:
  "sigma D (\<lambda>x. f x +R opp (g x)) = sigma D f +R opp (sigma D g)"
  sorry




lemma sigma_empty: "sigma (\<lambda>_. False) f = zero"
  sorry




lemma sigma_bilinear:
  "sigma D (\<lambda>x. (c *R f x) +R (d *R g x)) =
   (c *R sigma D f) +R (d *R sigma D g)"
  sorry




lemma sigma_le_monotone:
  "(\<forall>x. D x \<longrightarrow> f x \<le>R g x) \<Longrightarrow> sigma D f \<le>R sigma D g"
  sorry
lemma sigma_nonneg:
  "(\<forall>x. D x \<longrightarrow> zero \<le>R f x) \<Longrightarrow> zero \<le>R sigma D f"
  sorry




lemma sigma_split:
  "sigma D f =
   sigma (\<lambda>x. D x \<and> P x) f +R sigma (\<lambda>x. D x \<and> \<not> P x) f"
  sorry




lemma sigma_preimage_neg_Ioi:
  "sigma (preimage opp (Ioi c)) f = sigma (Iio (opp c)) f"
  sorry




lemma sigma_abs_bound:
  "absR (sigma D f) \<le>R sigma D (\<lambda>x. absR (f x))"
  sorry
end

end

title: integral_comp_neg_Iic
integral_comp_neg_Iic
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact
;; integral_comp_neg_Iic. The arbitrary source carrier, functions, and
;; predicates remain arbitrary here; no finite enumeration is used.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The token R-TYPE identifies an arbitrary carrier together with its RField
;; operations. INTEGRAL-TYPE distinguishes integral structures on that carrier.

(defstub icni-member-p (r-type x) t)

(defstub icni-zero (r-type) t)
(defstub icni-one (r-type) t)
(defstub icni-add (r-type x y) t)
(defstub icni-opp (r-type x) t)
(defstub icni-mul (r-type x y) t)
(defstub icni-le (r-type x y) t)
(defstub icni-lt (r-type x y) t)
(defstub icni-abs (r-type x) t)

;; ACL2 is first order, so arbitrary source functions and predicates are
;; represented by codes interpreted by these two conservative evaluators.
;; Tagged codes below represent the lambda terms constructed in the source.

(defstub icni-base-function-value (r-type function-code x) t)
(defstub icni-base-domain-holds (r-type domain-code x) t)

(defun icni-function-const (value)
  (list :icni-const value))

(defun icni-function-opp (function)
  (list :icni-opp function))

(defun icni-function-add (function-f function-g)
  (list :icni-add function-f function-g))

(defun icni-function-scale (coefficient function)
  (list :icni-scale coefficient function))

(defun icni-function-abs (function)
  (list :icni-abs function))

(defun icni-function-compose (outer-function inner-function)
  (list :icni-compose outer-function inner-function))

(defun icni-function-carrier-opp ()
  (list :icni-carrier-opp))

(defun icni-function-value (r-type function x)
  (cond
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-const))
    (cadr function))
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-opp))
    (icni-opp
     r-type
     (icni-function-value r-type (cadr function) x)))
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-add))
    (icni-add
     r-type
     (icni-function-value r-type (cadr function) x)
     (icni-function-value r-type (caddr function) x)))
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-scale))
    (icni-mul
     r-type
     (cadr function)
     (icni-function-value r-type (caddr function) x)))
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-abs))
    (icni-abs
     r-type
     (icni-function-value r-type (cadr function) x)))
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-compose))
    (icni-function-value
     r-type
     (cadr function)
     (icni-function-value r-type (caddr function) x)))
   ((and (consp function)
         (eq (car function) :icni-carrier-opp))
    (icni-opp r-type x))
   (t
    (icni-base-function-value r-type function x))))

(defun icni-domain-false ()
  (list :icni-false))

(defun icni-domain-iic (cutoff)
  (list :icni-iic cutoff))

(defun icni-domain-ioi (cutoff)
  (list :icni-ioi cutoff))

(defun icni-domain-iio (cutoff)
  (list :icni-iio cutoff))

(defun icni-domain-union (domain-d domain-e)
  (list :icni-union domain-d domain-e))

(defun icni-domain-inter (domain-d domain-e)
  (list :icni-inter domain-d domain-e))

(defun icni-domain-difference (domain-d domain-p)
  (list :icni-difference domain-d domain-p))

(defun icni-domain-preimage (function domain)
  (list :icni-preimage function domain))

(defun icni-domain-holds (r-type domain x)
  (cond
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-false))
    nil)
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-iic))
    (icni-le r-type x (cadr domain)))
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-ioi))
    (icni-lt r-type (cadr domain) x))
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-iio))
    (icni-lt r-type x (cadr domain)))
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-union))
    (or
     (icni-domain-holds r-type (cadr domain) x)
     (icni-domain-holds r-type (caddr domain) x)))
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-inter))
    (and
     (icni-domain-holds r-type (cadr domain) x)
     (icni-domain-holds r-type (caddr domain) x)))
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-difference))
    (and
     (icni-domain-holds r-type (cadr domain) x)
     (not
      (icni-domain-holds r-type (caddr domain) x))))
   ((and (consp domain)
         (eq (car domain) :icni-preimage))
    (icni-domain-holds
     r-type
     (caddr domain)
     (icni-function-value r-type (cadr domain) x)))
   (t
    (icni-base-domain-holds r-type domain x))))

(defstub icni-sigma (r-type integral-type domain function) t)

(defun-sk icni-function-typed-p (r-type function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (icni-member-p r-type x)
     (icni-member-p
      r-type
      (icni-function-value r-type function x)))))

(defun-sk icni-functions-agree-on-p
    (r-type domain function-f function-g)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain x))
     (equal
      (icni-function-value r-type function-f x)
      (icni-function-value r-type function-g x)))))

(defun-sk icni-functions-ordered-on-p
    (r-type domain function-f function-g)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain x))
     (icni-le
      r-type
      (icni-function-value r-type function-f x)
      (icni-function-value r-type function-g x)))))

(defun-sk icni-function-nonnegative-on-p
    (r-type domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain x))
     (icni-le
      r-type
      (icni-zero r-type)
      (icni-function-value r-type function x)))))

(defun-sk icni-domains-disjoint-p
    (r-type domain-d domain-e)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (icni-member-p r-type x)
     (not
      (and
       (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-d x)
       (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-e x))))))

(defun-sk icni-domains-equal-p
    (r-type domain-d domain-e)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (icni-member-p r-type x)
     (iff
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-d x)
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-e x)))))

(defun-sk icni-domain-decidable-on-p
    (r-type domain-d domain-p)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-d x))
     (or
      (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-p x)
      (not
       (icni-domain-holds r-type domain-p x))))))

;; The source RField class has exactly these 26 laws. Splitting laws by
;; arity keeps ACL2 admission tractable without changing their conjunction.

(defun-sk icni-rfield-unary-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (icni-member-p r-type x)
     (let ((zero (icni-zero r-type))
           (one (icni-one r-type)))
       (and
        (icni-member-p r-type (icni-opp r-type x))
        (icni-member-p r-type (icni-abs r-type x))
        (equal (icni-add r-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (icni-add r-type (icni-opp r-type x) x)
         zero)
        (equal (icni-mul r-type x one) x)
        (equal
         (icni-opp r-type (icni-opp r-type x))
         x)
        (icni-le r-type x x)
        (implies
         (icni-le r-type zero x)
         (equal (icni-abs r-type x) x))
        (implies
         (icni-le r-type x zero)
         (equal
          (icni-abs r-type x)
          (icni-opp r-type x)))
        (icni-le
         r-type zero (icni-abs r-type x))
        (equal
         (icni-abs r-type (icni-opp r-type x))
         (icni-abs r-type x)))))))

(defun-sk icni-rfield-binary-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-member-p r-type y))
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type (icni-add r-type x y))
      (icni-member-p r-type (icni-mul r-type x y))
      (equal
       (icni-add r-type x y)
       (icni-add r-type y x))
      (equal
       (icni-mul r-type x y)
       (icni-mul r-type y x))
      (or
       (icni-le r-type x y)
       (icni-le r-type y x))
      (or
       (icni-le r-type x y)
       (not (icni-le r-type x y)))
      (implies
       (icni-le r-type x y)
       (icni-le
        r-type
        (icni-opp r-type y)
        (icni-opp r-type x)))
      (implies
       (and
        (icni-le r-type x y)
        (icni-le r-type y x))
       (equal x y))
      (implies
       (icni-lt r-type x y)
       (icni-lt
        r-type
        (icni-opp r-type y)
        (icni-opp r-type x)))
      (iff
       (icni-lt r-type x y)
       (and
        (icni-le r-type x y)
        (not (equal x y))))
      (icni-le
       r-type
       (icni-abs r-type (icni-add r-type x y))
       (icni-add
        r-type
        (icni-abs r-type x)
        (icni-abs r-type y)))))))

(defun-sk icni-rfield-ternary-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-member-p r-type y)
      (icni-member-p r-type z))
     (let ((zero (icni-zero r-type)))
       (and
        (equal
         (icni-add r-type (icni-add r-type x y) z)
         (icni-add r-type x (icni-add r-type y z)))
        (implies
         (equal
          (icni-add r-type x z)
          (icni-add r-type y z))
         (equal x y))
        (equal
         (icni-mul r-type (icni-mul r-type x y) z)
         (icni-mul r-type x (icni-mul r-type y z)))
        (equal
         (icni-mul r-type x (icni-add r-type y z))
         (icni-add
          r-type
          (icni-mul r-type x y)
          (icni-mul r-type x z)))
        (implies
         (icni-le r-type x y)
         (icni-le
          r-type
          (icni-add r-type x z)
          (icni-add r-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (icni-le r-type zero z)
          (icni-le r-type x y))
         (icni-le
          r-type
          (icni-mul r-type x z)
          (icni-mul r-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (icni-le r-type x y)
          (icni-le r-type y z))
         (icni-le r-type x z)))))))

(defun icni-rfield-laws-p (r-type)
  (and
   (icni-rfield-unary-laws-p r-type)
   (icni-rfield-binary-laws-p r-type)
   (icni-rfield-ternary-laws-p r-type)))

(defun icni-rfield-p (r-type)
  (and
   (icni-member-p r-type (icni-zero r-type))
   (icni-member-p r-type (icni-one r-type))
   (icni-le r-type (icni-zero r-type) (icni-one r-type))
   (icni-rfield-laws-p r-type)))

;; The source Integral class has exactly seven laws. The closure predicate
;; expresses SIGMA's source result type and is not an additional algebraic law.

(defun-sk icni-sigma-closed-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain function)
    (implies
     (icni-function-typed-p r-type function)
     (icni-member-p
      r-type
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain function)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-mul-const-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain function coefficient)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function)
      (icni-member-p r-type coefficient))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       domain
       (icni-function-scale coefficient function))
      (icni-mul
       r-type
       coefficient
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain function))))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-congr-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain function-f function-g)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-functions-agree-on-p
       r-type domain function-f function-g))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain function-f)
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain function-g)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-zero-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain)
    (equal
     (icni-sigma
      r-type
      integral-type
      domain
      (icni-function-const (icni-zero r-type)))
     (icni-zero r-type))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-add-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain function-f function-g)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       domain
       (icni-function-add function-f function-g))
      (icni-add
       r-type
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain function-f)
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain function-g))))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-union-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain-d domain-e function)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function)
      (icni-domains-disjoint-p
       r-type domain-d domain-e))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       (icni-domain-union domain-d domain-e)
       function)
      (icni-add
       r-type
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain-d function)
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain-e function))))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-le-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain function-f function-g)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-functions-ordered-on-p
       r-type domain function-f function-g))
     (icni-le
      r-type
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain function-f)
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain function-g)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-domain-congr-law-p (r-type integral-type)
  (forall (domain-d domain-e function)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function)
      (icni-domains-equal-p
       r-type domain-d domain-e))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain-d function)
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain-e function)))))

(defun icni-integral-laws-p (r-type integral-type)
  (and
   (icni-sigma-closed-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-mul-const-law-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-congr-law-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-zero-law-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-add-law-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-union-law-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-le-law-p r-type integral-type)
   (icni-sigma-domain-congr-law-p r-type integral-type)))

(defun icni-integral-context-p (r-type integral-type)
  (and
   (icni-rfield-p r-type)
   (icni-integral-laws-p r-type integral-type)))

;; Each predicate below corresponds, in source order, to one indexed theorem.

(defun-sk icni-lt-irrefl-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-member-p r-type x))
     (not (icni-lt r-type x x)))))

(defun-sk icni-lt-trans-strict-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-member-p r-type x)
      (icni-member-p r-type y)
      (icni-member-p r-type z)
      (icni-lt r-type x y)
      (icni-lt r-type y z))
     (icni-lt r-type x z))))

(defun-sk icni-preimage-union-statement ()
  (forall (r-type domain-d domain-e function-g x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-member-p r-type x))
     (iff
      (icni-domain-holds
       r-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        function-g
        (icni-domain-union domain-d domain-e))
       x)
      (or
       (icni-domain-holds
        r-type
        (icni-domain-preimage function-g domain-d)
        x)
       (icni-domain-holds
        r-type
        (icni-domain-preimage function-g domain-e)
        x))))))

(defun-sk icni-preimage-inter-statement ()
  (forall (r-type domain-d domain-e function-g x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-member-p r-type x))
     (iff
      (icni-domain-holds
       r-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        function-g
        (icni-domain-inter domain-d domain-e))
       x)
      (and
       (icni-domain-holds
        r-type
        (icni-domain-preimage function-g domain-d)
        x)
       (icni-domain-holds
        r-type
        (icni-domain-preimage function-g domain-e)
        x))))))

(defun-sk icni-preimage-neg-ioi-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type cutoff x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-member-p r-type cutoff)
      (icni-member-p r-type x))
     (iff
      (icni-domain-holds
       r-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        (icni-function-carrier-opp)
        (icni-domain-ioi cutoff))
       x)
      (icni-lt r-type x (icni-opp r-type cutoff))))))

(defun-sk icni-preimage-neg-iic-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type cutoff x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-member-p r-type cutoff)
      (icni-member-p r-type x))
     (iff
      (icni-domain-holds
       r-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        (icni-function-carrier-opp)
        (icni-domain-iic cutoff))
       x)
      (icni-le r-type (icni-opp r-type cutoff) x)))))

(defun-sk icni-preimage-comp-statement ()
  (forall
   (r-type domain-d function-g function-h x)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-h)
      (icni-member-p r-type x))
     (iff
      (icni-domain-holds
       r-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        function-g
        (icni-domain-preimage function-h domain-d))
       x)
      (icni-domain-holds
       r-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        (icni-function-compose function-h function-g)
        domain-d)
       x)))))

(defun-sk icni-integral-neg-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       domain-d
       (icni-function-opp function-f))
      (icni-opp
       r-type
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain-d function-f))))))

(defun-sk icni-integral-sub-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type domain-d function-f function-g)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       domain-d
       (icni-function-add
        function-f
        (icni-function-opp function-g)))
      (icni-add
       r-type
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)
       (icni-opp
        r-type
        (icni-sigma
         r-type integral-type domain-d function-g)))))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-empty-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type function-f)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       (icni-domain-false)
       function-f)
      (icni-zero r-type)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-bilinear-statement ()
  (forall
   (r-type integral-type domain-d function-f function-g
           coefficient-c coefficient-d)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-member-p r-type coefficient-c)
      (icni-member-p r-type coefficient-d))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       domain-d
       (icni-function-add
        (icni-function-scale coefficient-c function-f)
        (icni-function-scale coefficient-d function-g)))
      (icni-add
       r-type
       (icni-mul
        r-type
        coefficient-c
        (icni-sigma
         r-type integral-type domain-d function-f))
       (icni-mul
        r-type
        coefficient-d
        (icni-sigma
         r-type integral-type domain-d function-g)))))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-le-monotone-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type domain-d function-f function-g)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-g)
      (icni-functions-ordered-on-p
       r-type domain-d function-f function-g))
     (icni-le
      r-type
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain-d function-g)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-nonneg-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-function-nonnegative-on-p
       r-type domain-d function-f))
     (icni-le
      r-type
      (icni-zero r-type)
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-split-statement ()
  (forall
   (r-type integral-type domain-d domain-p function-f)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-domain-decidable-on-p
       r-type domain-d domain-p))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)
      (icni-add
       r-type
       (icni-sigma
        r-type
        integral-type
        (icni-domain-inter domain-d domain-p)
        function-f)
       (icni-sigma
        r-type
        integral-type
        (icni-domain-difference domain-d domain-p)
        function-f))))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-preimage-neg-ioi-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type function-f cutoff)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f)
      (icni-member-p r-type cutoff))
     (equal
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       (icni-domain-preimage
        (icni-function-carrier-opp)
        (icni-domain-ioi cutoff))
       function-f)
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       (icni-domain-iio (icni-opp r-type cutoff))
       function-f)))))

(defun-sk icni-sigma-abs-bound-statement ()
  (forall (r-type integral-type domain-d function-f)
    (implies
     (and
      (icni-integral-context-p r-type integral-type)
      (icni-function-typed-p r-type function-f))
     (icni-le
      r-type
      (icni-abs
       r-type
       (icni-sigma
        r-type integral-type domain-d function-f))
      (icni-sigma
       r-type
       integral-type
       domain-d
       (icni-function-abs function-f))))))

(defun integral-comp-neg-iic-statement ()
  (and
   (icni-lt-irrefl-statement)
   (icni-lt-trans-strict-statement)
   (icni-preimage-union-statement)
   (icni-preimage-inter-statement)
   (icni-preimage-neg-ioi-statement)
   (icni-preimage-neg-iic-statement)
   (icni-preimage-comp-statement)
   (icni-integral-neg-statement)
   (icni-integral-sub-statement)
   (icni-sigma-empty-statement)
   (icni-sigma-bilinear-statement)
   (icni-sigma-le-monotone-statement)
   (icni-sigma-nonneg-statement)
   (icni-sigma-split-statement)
   (icni-sigma-preimage-neg-ioi-statement)
   (icni-sigma-abs-bound-statement)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: integral_comp_neg_Iic
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact integral_comp_neg_Iic:
-- abstract ordered-field integral identities and negated interval preimages.
-- This file contains no proof.

module integral_comp_neg_Iic where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

infixr 4 _∧_
infixr 3 _∨_
infix 2 _↔_

data ⊥ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

Not : ∀ {ℓ} → Set ℓ → Set ℓ
Not {ℓ} A = A → ⊥ {ℓ}

record _∧_ {p q : Level} (A : Set p) (B : Set q) : Set (p ⊔ q) where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _∨_ {p q : Level} (A : Set p) (B : Set q) : Set (p ⊔ q) where
  inj₁ : A → A ∨ B
  inj₂ : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ {p q : Level} (A : Set p) (B : Set q) : Set (p ⊔ q) where
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record RField {ℓ : Level} (R : Set ℓ) : Set (lsuc ℓ) where
  field
    zero : R
    one  : R
    add  : R → R → R
    opp  : R → R
    mul  : R → R → R
    le   : R → R → Set ℓ
    lt   : R → R → Set ℓ
    abs  : R → R

    add-comm         : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc        : (x y z : R) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero         : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-opp          : (x : R) → add (opp x) x ≡ zero
    add-right-cancel : (x y z : R) → add x z ≡ add y z → x ≡ y

    mul-comm       : (x y : R) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc      : (x y z : R) → mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one        : (x : R) → mul x one ≡ x
    dist-l         : (x y z : R) →
                     mul x (add y z) ≡ add (mul x y) (mul x z)
    opp-involutive : (x : R) → opp (opp x) ≡ x

    add-le-compat : (x y z : R) → le x y → le (add x z) (add y z)
    mul-le-compat : (x y z : R) → le zero z → le x y →
                    le (mul x z) (mul y z)
    zero-le-one   : le zero one
    le-total      : (x y : R) → le x y ∨ le y x
    le-dec        : (x y : R) → le x y ∨ Not (le x y)

    le-opp      : (x y : R) → le x y → le (opp y) (opp x)
    le-antisymm : (x y : R) → le x y → le y x → x ≡ y
    lt-opp      : (x y : R) → lt x y → lt (opp y) (opp x)
    le-refl     : (x : R) → le x x
    le-trans    : (x y z : R) → le x y → le y z → le x z
    lt-def      : (x y : R) → lt x y ↔ (le x y ∧ Not (x ≡ y))

    abs-pos      : (x : R) → le zero x → abs x ≡ x
    abs-neg      : (x : R) → le x zero → abs x ≡ opp x
    abs-nonneg   : (x : R) → le zero (abs x)
    abs-opp      : (x : R) → abs (opp x) ≡ abs x
    abs-triangle : (x y : R) →
                   le (abs (add x y)) (add (abs x) (abs y))

record Integral {ℓ : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
                (RF : RField R) : Set (lsuc ℓ) where
  open RField RF

  field
    sigma : (R → Set ℓ) → (R → R) → R

    sigma-mul-const : (D : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) (c : R) →
      sigma D (λ x → mul c (f x)) ≡ mul c (sigma D f)
    sigma-congr : (D : R → Set ℓ) (f g : R → R) →
      ((x : R) → D x → f x ≡ g x) →
      sigma D f ≡ sigma D g
    sigma-zero : (D : R → Set ℓ) →
      sigma D (λ _ → zero) ≡ zero
    sigma-add : (D : R → Set ℓ) (f g : R → R) →
      sigma D (λ x → add (f x) (g x)) ≡
      add (sigma D f) (sigma D g)

    sigma-union-disjoint :
      (D E : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) →
      ((x : R) → D x → E x → ⊥ {ℓ}) →
      sigma (λ x → D x ∨ E x) f ≡
      add (sigma D f) (sigma E f)
    sigma-le : (D : R → Set ℓ) (f g : R → R) →
      ((x : R) → D x → le (f x) (g x)) →
      le (sigma D f) (sigma D g)
    sigma-dom-congr : (D E : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) →
      ((x : R) → D x ↔ E x) →
      sigma D f ≡ sigma E f

module PredicateStatements {ℓ : Level} {R : Set ℓ} where
  union : (R → Set ℓ) → (R → Set ℓ) → R → Set ℓ
  union D E x = D x ∨ E x

  inter : (R → Set ℓ) → (R → Set ℓ) → R → Set ℓ
  inter D E x = D x ∧ E x

  preimage : (R → R) → (R → Set ℓ) → R → Set ℓ
  preimage g D x = D (g x)

  preimage-union : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  preimage-union =
    (D E : R → Set ℓ) (g : R → R) (x : R) →
    preimage g (union D E) x ↔
    (preimage g D x ∨ preimage g E x)

  preimage-inter : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  preimage-inter =
    (D E : R → Set ℓ) (g : R → R) (x : R) →
    preimage g (inter D E) x ↔
    (preimage g D x ∧ preimage g E x)

  preimage-comp : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  preimage-comp =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (g h : R → R) (x : R) →
    preimage g (preimage h D) x ↔
    preimage (λ y → h (g y)) D x

module OrderedStatements {ℓ : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
                         (RF : RField R) where
  open RField RF
  open PredicateStatements {R = R}

  Iic : R → R → Set ℓ
  Iic c x = le x c

  Ioi : R → R → Set ℓ
  Ioi c x = lt c x

  Iio : R → R → Set ℓ
  Iio c x = lt x c

  lt-irrefl : Set ℓ
  lt-irrefl =
    (x : R) → Not (lt x x)

  lt-trans-strict : Set ℓ
  lt-trans-strict =
    (x y z : R) → lt x y → lt y z → lt x z

  preimage-neg-Ioi : Set ℓ
  preimage-neg-Ioi =
    (c x : R) →
    preimage opp (Ioi c) x ↔ lt x (opp c)

  preimage-neg-Iic : Set ℓ
  preimage-neg-Iic =
    (c x : R) →
    preimage opp (Iic c) x ↔ Iic x (opp c)

module IntegralStatements {ℓ : Level} {R : Set ℓ}
                          (RF : RField R) (I : Integral RF) where
  open RField RF
  open Integral I
  open PredicateStatements {R = R}
  open OrderedStatements RF

  integral-neg : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  integral-neg =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) →
    sigma D (λ x → opp (f x)) ≡ opp (sigma D f)

  integral-sub : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  integral-sub =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (f g : R → R) →
    sigma D (λ x → add (f x) (opp (g x))) ≡
    add (sigma D f) (opp (sigma D g))

  sigma-empty : Set ℓ
  sigma-empty =
    (f : R → R) →
    sigma (λ _ → ⊥) f ≡ zero

  sigma-bilinear : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  sigma-bilinear =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (f g : R → R) (c d : R) →
    sigma D (λ x → add (mul c (f x)) (mul d (g x))) ≡
    add (mul c (sigma D f)) (mul d (sigma D g))

  sigma-le-monotone : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  sigma-le-monotone =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (f g : R → R) →
    ((x : R) → D x → le (f x) (g x)) →
    le (sigma D f) (sigma D g)

  sigma-nonneg : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  sigma-nonneg =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) →
    ((x : R) → D x → le zero (f x)) →
    le zero (sigma D f)

  sigma-split : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  sigma-split =
    (D P : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) →
    ((x : R) → D x → P x ∨ Not (P x)) →
    sigma D f ≡
    add (sigma (λ x → D x ∧ P x) f)
        (sigma (λ x → D x ∧ Not (P x)) f)

  sigma-preimage-neg-Ioi : Set ℓ
  sigma-preimage-neg-Ioi =
    (f : R → R) (c : R) →
    sigma (preimage opp (Ioi c)) f ≡
    sigma (Iio (opp c)) f

  sigma-abs-bound : Set (lsuc ℓ)
  sigma-abs-bound =
    (D : R → Set ℓ) (f : R → R) →
    le (abs (sigma D f))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic integral_comp_neg_Iic. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val is_integral_context_def = new_definition (
  "is_integral_context_def",
  ``is_integral_context
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (opp : 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (le : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (lt : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (absR : 'r -> 'r)
      (sigma : ('r -> bool) -> ('r -> 'r) -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add (opp x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. add x z = add y z ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul x oneR = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      (!x. opp (opp x) = x) /\
      (!x y z. le x y ==> le (add x z) (add y z)) /\
      (!x y z. le zero z ==> le x y ==> le (mul x z) (mul y z)) /\
      le zero oneR /\
      (!x y. le x y \/ le y x) /\
      (!x y. le x y \/ ~(le x y)) /\
      (!x y. le x y ==> le (opp y) (opp x)) /\
      (!x y. le x y ==> le y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y. lt x y ==> lt (opp y) (opp x)) /\
      (!x. le x x) /\
      (!x y z. le x y ==> le y z ==> le x z) /\
      (!x y. (lt x y <=> le x y /\ ~(x = y))) /\
      (!x. le zero x ==> absR x = x) /\
      (!x. le x zero ==> absR x = opp x) /\
      (!x. le zero (absR x)) /\
      (!x. absR (opp x) = absR x) /\
      (!x y. le (absR (add x y)) (add (absR x) (absR y))) /\
      (!D f c.
         sigma D (\x. mul c (f x)) = mul c (sigma D f)) /\
      (!D f g.
         (!x. D x ==> f x = g x) ==> sigma D f = sigma D g) /\
      (!D. sigma D (\x. zero) = zero) /\
      (!D f g.
         sigma D (\x. add (f x) (g x)) =
         add (sigma D f) (sigma D g)) /\
      (!D E f.
         (!x. D x ==> E x ==> F) ==>
         sigma (\x. D x \/ E x) f =
         add (sigma D f) (sigma E f)) /\
      (!D f g.
         (!x. D x ==> le (f x) (g x)) ==>
         le (sigma D f) (sigma D g)) /\
      (!D E f.
         (!x. (D x <=> E x)) ==> sigma D f = sigma E f)``);

val iic_def = new_definition (
  "iic_def",
  ``iic (le : 'r -> 'r -> bool) c x <=> le x c``);

val ioi_def = new_definition (
  "ioi_def",
  ``ioi (lt : 'r -> 'r -> bool) c x <=> lt c x``);

val iio_def = new_definition (
  "iio_def",
  ``iio (lt : 'r -> 'r -> bool) c x <=> lt x c``);

val unionD_def = new_definition (
  "unionD_def",
  ``unionD (D : 'r -> bool) E x <=> D x \/ E x``);

val interD_def = new_definition (
  "interD_def",
  ``interD (D : 'r -> bool) E x <=> D x /\ E x``);

val preimage_def = new_definition (
  "preimage_def",
  ``preimage (g : 'r -> 'r) (D : 'r -> bool) x <=> D (g x)``);

val lt_irrefl =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma x.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      ~(lt x x)``;

val lt_trans_strict =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma x y z.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      lt x y ==> lt y z ==> lt x z``;

val preimage_union =
  ``!(D : 'r -> bool) E (g : 'r -> 'r) x.
      (preimage g (unionD D E) x <=>
       preimage g D x \/ preimage g E x)``;

val preimage_inter =
  ``!(D : 'r -> bool) E (g : 'r -> 'r) x.
      (preimage g (interD D E) x <=>
       preimage g D x /\ preimage g E x)``;

val preimage_neg_Ioi =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma c x.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      (preimage opp (ioi lt c) x <=> lt x (opp c))``;

val preimage_neg_Iic =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma c x.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      (preimage opp (iic le c) x <=> iic le x (opp c))``;

val preimage_comp =
  ``!(D : 'r -> bool) (g : 'r -> 'r) h x.
      (preimage g (preimage h D) x <=>
       preimage (\y. h (g y)) D x)``;

val integral_neg =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r).
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      sigma D (\x. opp (f x)) = opp (sigma D f)``;

val integral_sub =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r) g.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      sigma D (\x. add (f x) (opp (g x))) =
      add (sigma D f) (opp (sigma D g))``;

val sigma_empty =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma (f : 'r -> 'r).
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      sigma (\x. F) f = zero``;

val sigma_bilinear =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r) g c d.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      sigma D (\x. add (mul c (f x)) (mul d (g x))) =
      add (mul c (sigma D f)) (mul d (sigma D g))``;

val sigma_le_monotone =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r) g.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      (!x. D x ==> le (f x) (g x)) ==>
      le (sigma D f) (sigma D g)``;

val sigma_nonneg =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r).
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      (!x. D x ==> le zero (f x)) ==>
      le zero (sigma D f)``;

val sigma_split =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (P : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r).
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      (!x. D x ==> P x \/ ~(P x)) ==>
      sigma D f =
      add (sigma (\x. D x /\ P x) f)
          (sigma (\x. D x /\ ~(P x)) f)``;

val sigma_preimage_neg_Ioi =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (f : 'r -> 'r) c.
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      sigma (preimage opp (ioi lt c)) f =
      sigma (iio lt (opp c)) f``;

val sigma_abs_bound =
  ``!(zero : 'r) oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma
      (D : 'r -> bool) (f : 'r -> 'r).
      is_integral_context zero oneR add opp mul le lt absR sigma ==>
      le (absR (sigma D f)) (sigma D (\x. absR (f x)))``;

val _ = export_theory();
