begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being non empty set,
      zero,oneR being Element of R,
      add,mul being BinOp of R,
      opp,absR being Function of R,R,
      I being Function of [:bool R,Funcs(R,R):],R,
      leR,ltR being Relation of R
  st
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      add.(x,y) = add.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      add.(add.(x,y),z) = add.(x,add.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      add.(x,zero) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      add.(opp.x,x) = zero) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R st
      add.(x,z) = add.(y,z)
      holds x = y) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      mul.(x,y) = mul.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mul.(mul.(x,y),z) = mul.(x,mul.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mul.(x,oneR) = x) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mul.(x,add.(y,z)) =
        add.(mul.(x,y),mul.(x,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      opp.(opp.x) = x) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R st
      [x,y] in leR
      holds [add.(x,z),add.(y,z)] in leR) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R st
      [zero,z] in leR & [x,y] in leR
      holds [mul.(x,z),mul.(y,z)] in leR) &
    [zero,oneR] in leR &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      [x,y] in leR or [y,x] in leR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      [x,y] in leR or not [x,y] in leR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R st
      [x,y] in leR
      holds [opp.y,opp.x] in leR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R st
      [x,y] in leR & [y,x] in leR
      holds x = y) &
    (for x,y being Element of R st
      [x,y] in ltR
      holds [opp.y,opp.x] in ltR) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      [x,x] in leR) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R st
      [x,y] in leR & [y,z] in leR
      holds [x,z] in leR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      ([x,y] in ltR iff [x,y] in leR & x <> y)) &
    (for x being Element of R st
      [zero,x] in leR
      holds absR.x = x) &
    (for x being Element of R st
      [x,zero] in leR
      holds absR.x = opp.x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      [zero,absR.x] in leR) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      absR.(opp.x) = absR.x) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      [absR.(add.(x,y)),add.(absR.x,absR.y)] in leR) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,h being Function of R,R,
         c being Element of R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        h.x = mul.(c,f.x))
      holds I.(D,h) = mul.(c,I.(D,f))) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,g being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R st x in D holds
        f.x = g.x)
      holds I.(D,f) = I.(D,g)) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         zf being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds zf.x = zero)
      holds I.(D,zf) = zero) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,g,h being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        h.x = add.(f.x,g.x))
      holds I.(D,h) =
        add.(I.(D,f),I.(D,g))) &
    (for D,E being Subset of R,
         f being Function of R,R st
      D misses E
      holds I.(D \/ E,f) =
        add.(I.(D,f),I.(E,f))) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,g being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R st x in D holds
        [f.x,g.x] in leR)
      holds [I.(D,f),I.(D,g)] in leR) &
    (for D,E being Subset of R,
         f being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        (x in D iff x in E))
      holds I.(D,f) = I.(E,f))
  holds
    (for x being Element of R holds
      not [x,x] in ltR) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R st
      [x,y] in ltR & [y,z] in ltR
      holds [x,z] in ltR) &
    (for D,E being Subset of R,
         g being Function of R,R
      holds g"(D \/ E) = (g"D) \/ (g"E)) &
    (for D,E being Subset of R,
         g being Function of R,R
      holds g"(D /\ E) = (g"D) /\ (g"E)) &
    (for c,x being Element of R holds
      ([c,opp.x] in ltR iff [x,opp.c] in ltR)) &
    (for c,x being Element of R holds
      ([opp.x,c] in leR iff [opp.c,x] in leR)) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         g,h,k being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        k.x = h.(g.x))
      holds g"(h"D) = k"D) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,nf being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        nf.x = opp.(f.x))
      holds I.(D,nf) = opp.(I.(D,f))) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,g,subf being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        subf.x = add.(f.x,opp.(g.x)))
      holds I.(D,subf) =
        add.(I.(D,f),opp.(I.(D,g)))) &
    (for D being empty Subset of R,
         f being Function of R,R
      holds I.(D,f) = zero) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,g,lin being Function of R,R,
         c,d being Element of R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        lin.x = add.(mul.(c,f.x),mul.(d,g.x)))
      holds I.(D,lin) =
        add.(mul.(c,I.(D,f)),mul.(d,I.(D,g)))) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,g being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R st x in D holds
        [f.x,g.x] in leR)
      holds [I.(D,f),I.(D,g)] in leR) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R st x in D holds
        [zero,f.x] in leR)
      holds [zero,I.(D,f)] in leR) &
    (for D,P being Subset of R,
         f being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R st x in D holds
        x in P or not x in P)
      holds I.(D,f) =
        add.(I.(D /\ P,f),I.(D \ P,f))) &
    (for U,V being Subset of R,
         f being Function of R,R,
         c being Element of R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        (x in U iff [c,x] in ltR)) &
      (for x being Element of R holds
        (x in V iff [x,opp.c] in ltR))
      holds I.(opp"U,f) = I.(V,f)) &
    (for D being Subset of R,
         f,af being Function of R,R st
      (for x being Element of R holds
        af.x = absR.(f.x))
      holds [absR.(I.(D,f)),I.(D,af)] in leR)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: integral_comp_neg_Iic
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact integral_comp_neg_Iic:
% abstract ordered algebra, interval preimages under negation, and integral identities.
% This file contains no proof.

integral_comp_neg_Iic[
  R: TYPE+,
  zero: R,
  one: R,
  add: [R, R -> R],
  opp: [R -> R],
  mul: [R, R -> R],
  le: [R, R -> bool],
  lt: [R, R -> bool],
  absR: [R -> R],
  sigma: [[R -> bool], [R -> R] -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  rfield_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R): add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): add(opp(x), x) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        add(x, z) = add(y, z) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(x, add(y, z)) = add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): opp(opp(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        le(x, y) IMPLIES le(add(x, z), add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        le(zero, z) IMPLIES
          (le(x, y) IMPLIES le(mul(x, z), mul(y, z))))
      AND le(zero, one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): le(x, y) OR le(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): le(x, y) OR NOT le(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        le(x, y) IMPLIES le(opp(y), opp(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        le(x, y) IMPLIES (le(y, x) IMPLIES x = y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        lt(x, y) IMPLIES lt(opp(y), opp(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): le(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        le(x, y) IMPLIES (le(y, z) IMPLIES le(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        lt(x, y) = (le(x, y) AND NOT (x = y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        le(zero, x) IMPLIES absR(x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        le(x, zero) IMPLIES absR(x) = opp(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): le(zero, absR(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): absR(opp(x)) = absR(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        le(absR(add(x, y)), add(absR(x), absR(y))))

  integral_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]), (c: R):
      sigma(D, LAMBDA (x: R): mul(c, f(x))) =
        mul(c, sigma(D, f)))
      AND (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f, g: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R): D(x) IMPLIES f(x) = g(x))
          IMPLIES sigma(D, f) = sigma(D, g))
      AND (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]):
        sigma(D, LAMBDA (x: R): zero) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f, g: [R -> R]):
        sigma(D, LAMBDA (x: R): add(f(x), g(x))) =
          add(sigma(D, f), sigma(D, g)))
      AND (FORALL (D, E: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R): D(x) IMPLIES (E(x) IMPLIES FALSE))
          IMPLIES
            sigma(LAMBDA (x: R): D(x) OR E(x), f) =
              add(sigma(D, f), sigma(E, f)))
      AND (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f, g: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R): D(x) IMPLIES le(f(x), g(x)))
          IMPLIES le(sigma(D, f), sigma(D, g)))
      AND (FORALL (D, E: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R): D(x) = E(x))
          IMPLIES sigma(D, f) = sigma(E, f))

  integral_context: bool = rfield_laws AND integral_laws

  iic(c: R): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): le(x, c)

  ioi(c: R): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): lt(c, x)

  iio(c: R): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): lt(x, c)

  unionD(D, E: [R -> bool]): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): D(x) OR E(x)

  interD(D, E: [R -> bool]): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): D(x) AND E(x)

  preimage(g: [R -> R], D: [R -> bool]): [R -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (x: R): D(g(x))

  lt_irrefl: bool =
    rfield_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x: R): NOT lt(x, x))

  lt_trans_strict: bool =
    rfield_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        lt(x, y) IMPLIES (lt(y, z) IMPLIES lt(x, z)))

  preimage_union: bool =
    (FORALL (D, E: [R -> bool]), (g: [R -> R]), (x: R):
      preimage(g, unionD(D, E))(x) =
        (preimage(g, D)(x) OR preimage(g, E)(x)))

  preimage_inter: bool =
    (FORALL (D, E: [R -> bool]), (g: [R -> R]), (x: R):
      preimage(g, interD(D, E))(x) =
        (preimage(g, D)(x) AND preimage(g, E)(x)))

  preimage_neg_Ioi: bool =
    rfield_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (c, x: R):
        preimage(opp, ioi(c))(x) = lt(x, opp(c)))

  preimage_neg_Iic: bool =
    rfield_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (c, x: R):
        preimage(opp, iic(c))(x) = iic(x)(opp(c)))

  preimage_comp: bool =
    (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (g, h: [R -> R]), (x: R):
      preimage(g, preimage(h, D))(x) =
        preimage(LAMBDA (y: R): h(g(y)), D)(x))

  integral_neg: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]):
        sigma(D, LAMBDA (x: R): opp(f(x))) =
          opp(sigma(D, f)))

  integral_sub: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f, g: [R -> R]):
        sigma(D, LAMBDA (x: R): add(f(x), opp(g(x)))) =
          add(sigma(D, f), opp(sigma(D, g))))

  sigma_empty: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]):
        sigma(LAMBDA (x: R): FALSE, f) = zero)

  sigma_bilinear: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f, g: [R -> R]), (c, d: R):
        sigma(
          D,
          LAMBDA (x: R):
            add(mul(c, f(x)), mul(d, g(x)))) =
          add(mul(c, sigma(D, f)), mul(d, sigma(D, g))))

  sigma_le_monotone: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f, g: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R): D(x) IMPLIES le(f(x), g(x)))
          IMPLIES le(sigma(D, f), sigma(D, g)))

  sigma_nonneg: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R): D(x) IMPLIES le(zero, f(x)))
          IMPLIES le(zero, sigma(D, f)))

  sigma_split: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D, P: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]):
        (FORALL (x: R):
          D(x) IMPLIES (P(x) OR NOT P(x)))
          IMPLIES
            sigma(D, f) =
              add(
                sigma(LAMBDA (x: R): D(x) AND P(x), f),
                sigma(LAMBDA (x: R): D(x) AND NOT P(x), f)))

  sigma_preimage_neg_Ioi: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f: [R -> R]), (c: R):
        sigma(preimage(opp, ioi(c)), f) =
          sigma(iio(opp(c)), f))

  sigma_abs_bound: bool =
    integral_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (D: [R -> bool]), (f: [R -> R]):
        le(
          absR(sigma(D, f)),
          sigma(D, LAMBDA (x: R): absR(f(x)))))
END integral_comp_neg_Iic

title: lattice_like
content:
universe u

class LatticeLike (A : Type u) where
  le   : A → A → Prop
  inf  : A → A → A
  sup  : A → A → A

  le_refl  : ∀ x, le x x
  le_trans : ∀ {x y z}, le x y → le y z → le x z
  le_antisym : ∀ {x y}, le x y → le y x → x = y

  le_inf_left  : ∀ a b, le (inf a b) a
  le_inf_right : ∀ a b, le (inf a b) b
  le_inf_intro : ∀ {c a b}, le c a → le c b → le c (inf a b)

  le_sup_left  : ∀ a b, le a (sup a b)
  le_sup_right : ∀ a b, le b (sup a b)
  sup_le_intro : ∀ {a b c}, le a c → le b c → le (sup a b) c

namespace LatticeLike

variable {A : Type u} [L : LatticeLike A]

infix:50 " ≤ " => LatticeLike.le
infixl:65 " ⊓ " => LatticeLike.inf
infixl:70 " ⊔ " => LatticeLike.sup

theorem inf_comm (a b : A) : a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a := by sorry
theorem sup_comm (a b : A) : a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a := by sorry
theorem inf_assoc (a b c : A) : (a ⊓ b) ⊓ c = a ⊓ (b ⊓ c) := by sorry
theorem sup_assoc (a b c : A) : (a ⊔ b) ⊔ c = a ⊔ (b ⊔ c) := by sorry
theorem inf_absorption (a b : A) : a ⊓ (a ⊔ b) = a := by sorry
theorem sup_absorption (a b : A) : a ⊔ (a ⊓ b) = a := by sorry
end LatticeLike

title: lattice_like

content:
theory lattice_like
  imports Main
begin

locale lattice_like =
  fixes le  :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"  (infix "\<preceq>" 50)
    and inf :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"   (infixl "\<sqinter>" 60)
    and sup :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"   (infixl "\<squnion>" 65)
  assumes le_refl   : "\<And>x. x \<preceq> x"
    and   le_trans  : "\<And>x y z. x \<preceq> y \<Longrightarrow> y \<preceq> z \<Longrightarrow> x \<preceq> z"
    and   le_antisym: "\<And>x y. x \<preceq> y \<Longrightarrow> y \<preceq> x \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
    and   le_inf_left  : "\<And>a b. inf a b \<preceq> a"
    and   le_inf_right : "\<And>a b. inf a b \<preceq> b"
    and   le_inf_intro : "\<And>c a b. c \<preceq> a \<Longrightarrow> c \<preceq> b \<Longrightarrow> c \<preceq> inf a b"
    and   le_sup_left  : "\<And>a b. a \<preceq> sup a b"
    and   le_sup_right : "\<And>a b. b \<preceq> sup a b"
    and   sup_le_intro : "\<And>a b c. a \<preceq> c \<Longrightarrow> b \<preceq> c \<Longrightarrow> sup a b \<preceq> c"
begin

lemma inf_comm: "a \<sqinter> b = b \<sqinter> a"
  sorry
lemma sup_comm: "a \<squnion> b = b \<squnion> a"
  sorry
lemma inf_assoc: "(a \<sqinter> b) \<sqinter> c = a \<sqinter> (b \<sqinter> c)"
  sorry
lemma sup_assoc: "(a \<squnion> b) \<squnion> c = a \<squnion> (b \<squnion> c)"
  sorry
lemma inf_absorption: "a \<sqinter> (a \<squnion> b) = a"
  sorry
lemma sup_absorption: "a \<squnion> (a \<sqinter> b) = a"
  sorry
end

end

title: lattice_like
lattice_like
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact lattice_like: on an
;; arbitrary carrier, a partial order with infimum and supremum operations
;; satisfying their universal properties has commutative and associative meet
;; and join and satisfies both absorption laws. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces represent the source's arbitrary type,
;; relation, and binary operations directly, without finite enumerations or
;; lookup tables. Every typing and lattice-like law is explicit below.

(defstub lattice-like-element-p (x) t)
(defstub lattice-like-le (x y) t)
(defstub lattice-like-inf (x y) t)
(defstub lattice-like-sup (x y) t)

(defun-sk lattice-like-operation-closure-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b))
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p (lattice-like-inf a b))
      (lattice-like-element-p (lattice-like-sup a b))))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-le-reflexive-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (lattice-like-element-p x)
     (lattice-like-le x x))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-le-transitive-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p x)
      (lattice-like-element-p y)
      (lattice-like-element-p z)
      (lattice-like-le x y)
      (lattice-like-le y z))
     (lattice-like-le x z))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-le-antisymmetric-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p x)
      (lattice-like-element-p y)
      (lattice-like-le x y)
      (lattice-like-le y x))
     (equal x y))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-inf-lower-bounds-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b))
     (and
      (lattice-like-le (lattice-like-inf a b) a)
      (lattice-like-le (lattice-like-inf a b) b)))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-inf-greatest-p ()
  (forall (c a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p c)
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b)
      (lattice-like-le c a)
      (lattice-like-le c b))
     (lattice-like-le c (lattice-like-inf a b)))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-sup-upper-bounds-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b))
     (and
      (lattice-like-le a (lattice-like-sup a b))
      (lattice-like-le b (lattice-like-sup a b))))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-sup-least-p ()
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b)
      (lattice-like-element-p c)
      (lattice-like-le a c)
      (lattice-like-le b c))
     (lattice-like-le (lattice-like-sup a b) c))))

(defun lattice-like-structure-p ()
  (and
   (lattice-like-operation-closure-p)
   (lattice-like-le-reflexive-p)
   (lattice-like-le-transitive-p)
   (lattice-like-le-antisymmetric-p)
   (lattice-like-inf-lower-bounds-p)
   (lattice-like-inf-greatest-p)
   (lattice-like-sup-upper-bounds-p)
   (lattice-like-sup-least-p)))

(defun-sk lattice-like-inf-commutative-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b))
     (equal
      (lattice-like-inf a b)
      (lattice-like-inf b a)))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-sup-commutative-p ()
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b))
     (equal
      (lattice-like-sup a b)
      (lattice-like-sup b a)))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-inf-associative-p ()
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b)
      (lattice-like-element-p c))
     (equal
      (lattice-like-inf (lattice-like-inf a b) c)
      (lattice-like-inf a (lattice-like-inf b c))))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-sup-associative-p ()
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (lattice-like-element-p a)
      (lattice-like-element-p b)
      (lattice-like-element-p c))
     (equal
      (lattice-like-sup (lattice-like-sup a b) c)
      (lattice-like-sup a (lattice-like-sup b c))))))

(defun-sk lattice-like-inf-absorption-p ()

      (lattice-like-element-p a)

      (lattice-like-sup a (lattice-like-inf a b))

   (lattice-like-inf-commutative-p)

   (lattice-like-sup-associative-p)

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic lattice_like. This file contains no
-- proof.

module lattice_like where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

record LatticeLike {ℓ : Level} (A : Set ℓ) : Set (lsuc ℓ) where
  field
    le  : A → A → Set ℓ
    inf : A → A → A
    sup : A → A → A

    le-refl    : (x : A) → le x x
    le-trans   : (x y z : A) → le x y → le y z → le x z
    le-antisym : (x y : A) → le x y → le y x → x ≡ y

    le-inf-left  : (a b : A) → le (inf a b) a
    le-inf-right : (a b : A) → le (inf a b) b
    le-inf-intro :
      (c a b : A) → le c a → le c b → le c (inf a b)

    le-sup-left  : (a b : A) → le a (sup a b)
    le-sup-right : (a b : A) → le b (sup a b)
    sup-le-intro :
      (a b c : A) → le a c → le b c → le (sup a b) c

module LatticeLikeStatements
  {ℓ : Level} {A : Set ℓ} (L : LatticeLike A) where

  open LatticeLike L

  inf-comm : Set ℓ
  inf-comm =
    (a b : A) → inf a b ≡ inf b a

  sup-comm : Set ℓ
  sup-comm =
    (a b : A) → sup a b ≡ sup b a

  inf-assoc : Set ℓ
  inf-assoc =
    (a b c : A) → inf (inf a b) c ≡ inf a (inf b c)

  sup-assoc : Set ℓ
  sup-assoc =
    (a b c : A) → sup (sup a b) c ≡ sup a (sup b c)

  inf-absorption : Set ℓ
  inf-absorption =
    (a b : A) → inf a (sup a b) ≡ a

  sup-absorption : Set ℓ
  sup-absorption =
    (a b : A) → sup a (inf a b) ≡ a

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact lattice_like:
  partial-order, meet, and join laws on the whole ambient type, together with
  commutativity, associativity, and absorption identities. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val lattice_like_def = new_definition (
  "lattice_like_def",
  ``lattice_like (le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
                  (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
                  (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x. le_rel x x) /\
      (!x y z. le_rel x y ==> le_rel y z ==> le_rel x z) /\
      (!x y. le_rel x y ==> le_rel y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!a b. le_rel (inf_op a b) a) /\
      (!a b. le_rel (inf_op a b) b) /\
      (!c a b. le_rel c a ==> le_rel c b ==> le_rel c (inf_op a b)) /\
      (!a b. le_rel a (sup_op a b)) /\
      (!a b. le_rel b (sup_op a b)) /\
      (!a b c. le_rel a c ==> le_rel b c ==> le_rel (sup_op a b) c)``);

val inf_comm =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      lattice_like le_rel inf_op sup_op ==>
      !a b. inf_op a b = inf_op b a``;

val sup_comm =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      lattice_like le_rel inf_op sup_op ==>
      !a b. sup_op a b = sup_op b a``;

val inf_assoc =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      lattice_like le_rel inf_op sup_op ==>
      !a b c. inf_op (inf_op a b) c = inf_op a (inf_op b c)``;

val sup_assoc =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      lattice_like le_rel inf_op sup_op ==>
      !a b c. sup_op (sup_op a b) c = sup_op a (sup_op b c)``;

val inf_absorption =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      lattice_like le_rel inf_op sup_op ==>
      !a b. inf_op a (sup_op a b) = a``;

val sup_absorption =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (inf_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sup_op : 'a -> 'a -> 'a).
      lattice_like le_rel inf_op sup_op ==>
      !a b. sup_op a (inf_op a b) = a``;

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic lattice_like. This file contains no
% proof.

lattice_like[
  A: TYPE,
  le_rel: [A, A -> bool],
  inf_op: [A, A -> A],
  sup_op: [A, A -> A]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  lattice_like_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): le_rel(inf_op(a, b), a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): le_rel(inf_op(a, b), b))
      AND (FORALL (c, a, b: A):
        le_rel(c, a) AND le_rel(c, b) IMPLIES
          le_rel(c, inf_op(a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): le_rel(a, sup_op(a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): le_rel(b, sup_op(a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        le_rel(a, c) AND le_rel(b, c) IMPLIES
          le_rel(sup_op(a, b), c))

  inf_comm: bool =
    lattice_like_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: A): inf_op(a, b) = inf_op(b, a))

  sup_comm: bool =
    lattice_like_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: A): sup_op(a, b) = sup_op(b, a))

  inf_assoc: bool =
    lattice_like_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        inf_op(inf_op(a, b), c) = inf_op(a, inf_op(b, c)))

  sup_assoc: bool =
    lattice_like_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        sup_op(sup_op(a, b), c) = sup_op(a, sup_op(b, c)))

  inf_absorption: bool =
    lattice_like_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: A): inf_op(a, sup_op(a, b)) = a)

  sup_absorption: bool =
    lattice_like_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: A): sup_op(a, inf_op(a, b)) = a)
END lattice_like

content:
class AbsField (R : Type) where
  zero  : R
  one   : R
  add   : R → R → R
  mul   : R → R → R
  opp   : R → R
  abs   : R → R
  le    : R → R → Prop
  lt    : R → R → Prop


  NatAlt     : Type
  NatAltle   : NatAlt → NatAlt → Prop
  NatAltMax  : NatAlt → NatAlt → NatAlt
  le_max_left  : ∀ x y, NatAltle x (NatAltMax x y)
  le_max_right : ∀ x y, NatAltle y (NatAltMax x y)

  add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_opp   : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero
  opp_add   : ∀ x y, opp (add x y) = add (opp x) (opp y)
  mul_comm  : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one   : ∀ x, mul x one = x

  le_refl   : ∀ x, le x x
  le_trans  : ∀ x y z, le x y → le y z → le x z
  add_le_add : ∀ a b c d, le a b → le c d → le (add a c) (add b d)

  abs_nonneg : ∀ x, le zero (abs x)
  abs_triangle : ∀ x y, le (abs (add x y)) (add (abs x) (abs y))
  abs_opp : ∀ x, abs (opp x) = abs x
  abs_sub_symm : ∀ x y, abs (add x (opp y)) = abs (add y (opp x))


  sub_decomp : ∀ x y z, add x (opp z) = add (add x (opp y)) (add y (opp z))
  sub_eq_zero : ∀ x y, add x (opp y) = zero → x = y

  eq_of_forall_eps2 : ∀ x, (∀ eps, lt zero eps → le (abs x) (add eps eps)) → x = zero

namespace Limits

variable {R : Type} [AR : AbsField R]




def sub (x y : R) : R := AbsField.add x (AbsField.opp y)

def limit (u : (AbsField.NatAlt (R := R)) → R) (l : R) : Prop :=
  ∀ eps : R, AbsField.lt AbsField.zero eps →
    ∃ N : AbsField.NatAlt (R := R),
      ∀ n : AbsField.NatAlt (R := R),
        AbsField.NatAltle (R := R) N n →
          AbsField.le (AbsField.abs (sub (u n) l)) eps

theorem sub_self_zero (x : R) : sub x x = AbsField.zero := by sorry
theorem sub_decomp (x y z : R) : sub x z = AR.add (sub x y) (sub y z) := by sorry
theorem abs_sub_triangle (x y z : R) :
  AbsField.le (AbsField.abs (sub x z)) (AbsField.add (AbsField.abs (sub x y)) (AbsField.abs (sub y z))) := by sorry
theorem abs_sub_nonneg (x y : R) : AR.le AR.zero (AR.abs (sub x y)) := by sorry
theorem limit_unique (u : (AbsField.NatAlt (R := R)) → R) (l m : R) :
  limit u l → limit u m → l = m := by sorry
end Limits

theory limits_uniqueness
  imports Main
begin

locale abs_field =
  fixes zero    :: "'r"
    and one     :: "'r"
    and add     :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"   (infixl "+R" 65)
    and mul     :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"   (infixl "*R" 70)
    and opp     :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and absV    :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and le      :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"  (infix "\<preceq>" 50)
    and lt      :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"  (infix "\<prec>" 50)

    and natLe   :: "'n \<Rightarrow> 'n \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and natMax  :: "'n \<Rightarrow> 'n \<Rightarrow> 'n"
  assumes le_max_left    : "\<And>x y. natLe x (natMax x y)"
    and   le_max_right   : "\<And>x y. natLe y (natMax x y)"
    and   add_comm       : "\<And>x y. x +R y = y +R x"
    and   add_assoc      : "\<And>x y z. (x +R y) +R z = x +R (y +R z)"
    and   add_zero       : "\<And>x. x +R zero = x"
    and   add_opp        : "\<And>x. x +R opp x = zero"
    and   opp_add        : "\<And>x y. opp (x +R y) = opp x +R opp y"
    and   le_refl        : "\<And>x. x \<preceq> x"
    and   le_trans       : "\<And>x y z. x \<preceq> y \<Longrightarrow> y \<preceq> z \<Longrightarrow> x \<preceq> z"
    and   add_le_add     : "\<And>a b c d. a \<preceq> b \<Longrightarrow> c \<preceq> d \<Longrightarrow> a +R c \<preceq> b +R d"
    and   abs_nonneg     : "\<And>x. zero \<preceq> absV x"
    and   abs_triangle   : "\<And>x y. absV (x +R y) \<preceq> absV x +R absV y"
    and   abs_sub_symm   : "\<And>x y. absV (x +R opp y) = absV (y +R opp x)"
    and   sub_decomp     : "\<And>x y z. x +R opp z = (x +R opp y) +R (y +R opp z)"
    and   sub_eq_zero    : "\<And>x y. x +R opp y = zero \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
    and   eq_of_forall_eps2 :
            "\<And>x. (\<forall>eps. zero \<prec> eps \<longrightarrow> absV x \<preceq> eps +R eps) \<Longrightarrow> x = zero"
begin





definition sub :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  where "sub x y \<equiv> x +R opp y"

definition limit :: "('n \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "limit u l \<equiv>
    \<forall>eps. zero \<prec> eps \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>N. \<forall>n. natLe N n \<longrightarrow> absV (sub (u n) l) \<preceq> eps)"





lemma sub_self_zero: "sub x x = zero"
  sorry
lemma sub_decomp_lem: "sub x z = (sub x y) +R (sub y z)"
  sorry
lemma abs_sub_triangle:
  "absV (sub x z) \<preceq> absV (sub x y) +R absV (sub y z)"
  sorry
lemma abs_sub_symm_lem: "absV (sub x y) = absV (sub y x)"
  sorry




theorem limit_unique:
  assumes Hl: "limit u l" and Hm: "limit u m"
  shows "l = m"
  sorry
end

end

     !eps. lt zero eps ==>
       ?N. !n. natLe N n ==> le (absV (sub (u n) l)) eps`;;

let abs_sub_triangle =
  `!(absV:A->A) (le:A->A->bool) (add:A->A->A) (sub:A->A->A) (x:A) (y:A) (z:A).
      (!u v w. sub u w = add (sub u v) (sub v w)) /\
      (!u v. le (absV (add u v)) (add (absV u) (absV v))) /\
      (!u v w. le u v ==> le v w ==> le u w) ==>
      le (absV (sub x z)) (add (absV (sub x y)) (absV (sub y z)))`;;

let limit_unique =
  `!zero add absV le lt sub natLe natMax u l m.
      (!x y. natLe x (natMax x y)) /\
      (!x y. natLe y (natMax x y)) /\
      (!x y z. sub x z = add (sub x y) (sub y z)) /\
      (!x y. absV (sub x y) = absV (sub y x)) /\
      (!x y z. le x y ==> le y z ==> le x z) /\
      (!a b c d. le a b ==> le c d ==> le (add a c) (add b d)) /\
      (!x y. le (absV (add x y)) (add (absV x) (absV y))) /\
      (!x y. sub x y = zero ==> x = y) /\
      (!x. (!eps. lt zero eps ==> le (absV x) (add eps eps)) ==> x = zero) /\
      limit zero lt absV le sub natLe u l ==>
      limit zero lt absV le sub natLe u m ==>
      l = m`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact limits_uniqueness:
;; uniqueness of a sequence limit in an abstract absolute-valued ordered
;; structure with an arbitrary directed index type. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces represent arbitrary value and index types,
;; their operations and relations, and an arbitrary sequence. Carrier
;; predicates restrict quantifiers without enumerating either domain.

(defstub limits-uniqueness-r-p (r-type value) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-n-p (n-type index) t)

(defstub limits-uniqueness-zero (r-type) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-one (r-type) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-add (r-type left right) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-mul (r-type left right) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-opp (r-type value) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-abs (r-type value) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-le (r-type left right) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-lt (r-type left right) t)

(defstub limits-uniqueness-nle (n-type left right) t)
(defstub limits-uniqueness-nmax (n-type left right) t)

(defstub limits-uniqueness-sequence-value
  (r-type n-type sequence index)
  t)

(defun limits-uniqueness-sub (r-type x y)
  (limits-uniqueness-add
   r-type
   x
   (limits-uniqueness-opp r-type y)))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-operation-closure-p
    (r-type n-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
      (and
       (limits-uniqueness-r-p
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-opp r-type x))
       (limits-uniqueness-r-p
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-abs r-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
       (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type y))
      (and
       (limits-uniqueness-r-p
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-add r-type x y))
       (limits-uniqueness-r-p
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-mul r-type x y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type x)
       (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type y))
      (limits-uniqueness-n-p
       n-type (limits-uniqueness-nmax n-type x y))))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-sequence-typed-p
    (r-type n-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type n)
     (limits-uniqueness-r-p
      r-type
      (limits-uniqueness-sequence-value
       r-type n-type sequence n)))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-directed-p (n-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type x)
      (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type y))
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-nle
       n-type x (limits-uniqueness-nmax n-type x y))
      (limits-uniqueness-nle
       n-type y (limits-uniqueness-nmax n-type x y))))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-unary-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
     (let ((zero (limits-uniqueness-zero r-type))
           (one (limits-uniqueness-one r-type)))
       (and
        (equal (limits-uniqueness-add r-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (limits-uniqueness-add
          r-type x (limits-uniqueness-opp r-type x))
         zero)
        (equal (limits-uniqueness-mul r-type x one) x)
        (limits-uniqueness-le r-type x x)
        (limits-uniqueness-le
         r-type zero (limits-uniqueness-abs r-type x))
        (equal
         (limits-uniqueness-abs
          r-type (limits-uniqueness-opp r-type x))
         (limits-uniqueness-abs r-type x)))))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-binary-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type y))
     (and
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-add r-type x y)
       (limits-uniqueness-add r-type y x))
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-opp
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-add r-type x y))
       (limits-uniqueness-add
        r-type
        (limits-uniqueness-opp r-type x)
        (limits-uniqueness-opp r-type y)))
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-mul r-type x y)
       (limits-uniqueness-mul r-type y x))
      (limits-uniqueness-le
       r-type
       (limits-uniqueness-abs
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-add r-type x y))
       (limits-uniqueness-add
        r-type
        (limits-uniqueness-abs r-type x)
        (limits-uniqueness-abs r-type y)))
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-abs
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type x y))
       (limits-uniqueness-abs
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type y x)))
      (implies
       (equal
        (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type x y)
        (limits-uniqueness-zero r-type))
       (equal x y))))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-ternary-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type y)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-add
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-add r-type x y) z)
       (limits-uniqueness-add
        r-type x (limits-uniqueness-add r-type y z)))
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-mul
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-mul r-type x y) z)
       (limits-uniqueness-mul
        r-type x (limits-uniqueness-mul r-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (limits-uniqueness-le r-type x y)
        (limits-uniqueness-le r-type y z))
       (limits-uniqueness-le r-type x z))
      (equal
       (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type x z)
       (limits-uniqueness-add
        r-type
        (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type x y)
        (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type y z)))))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-add-monotone-p (r-type)
  (forall (a b c d)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type a)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type b)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type c)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type d)
      (limits-uniqueness-le r-type a b)
      (limits-uniqueness-le r-type c d))
     (limits-uniqueness-le
      r-type
      (limits-uniqueness-add r-type a c)
      (limits-uniqueness-add r-type b d)))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-small-for-all-positive-eps-p
    (r-type x)
  (forall (eps)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type eps)
      (limits-uniqueness-lt
       r-type (limits-uniqueness-zero r-type) eps))
     (limits-uniqueness-le
      r-type
      (limits-uniqueness-abs r-type x)
      (limits-uniqueness-add r-type eps eps)))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-epsilon-separation-p (r-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
      (limits-uniqueness-small-for-all-positive-eps-p
       r-type x))
     (equal x (limits-uniqueness-zero r-type)))))

(defun limits-uniqueness-structure-p (r-type n-type)
  (and
   (limits-uniqueness-r-p
    r-type (limits-uniqueness-zero r-type))
   (limits-uniqueness-r-p
    r-type (limits-uniqueness-one r-type))
   (limits-uniqueness-operation-closure-p r-type n-type)
   (limits-uniqueness-directed-p n-type)
   (limits-uniqueness-unary-laws-p r-type)
   (limits-uniqueness-binary-laws-p r-type)
   (limits-uniqueness-ternary-laws-p r-type)
   (limits-uniqueness-add-monotone-p r-type)
   (limits-uniqueness-epsilon-separation-p r-type)))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-abs-sub-triangle-statement ()
  (forall (r-type n-type x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-structure-p r-type n-type)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type x)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type y)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type z))
     (limits-uniqueness-le
      r-type
      (limits-uniqueness-abs
       r-type (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type x z))
      (limits-uniqueness-add
       r-type
       (limits-uniqueness-abs
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type x y))
       (limits-uniqueness-abs
        r-type (limits-uniqueness-sub r-type y z)))))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-eventually-p
    (r-type n-type sequence limit-value eps threshold)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type n)
      (limits-uniqueness-nle n-type threshold n))
     (limits-uniqueness-le
      r-type
      (limits-uniqueness-abs
       r-type
       (limits-uniqueness-sub
        r-type
        (limits-uniqueness-sequence-value
         r-type n-type sequence n)
        limit-value))
      eps))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-threshold-exists-p
    (r-type n-type sequence limit-value eps)
  (exists (threshold)
    (and
     (limits-uniqueness-n-p n-type threshold)
     (limits-uniqueness-eventually-p
      r-type n-type sequence limit-value eps threshold))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-limit-p
    (r-type n-type sequence limit-value)
  (forall (eps)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type eps)
      (limits-uniqueness-lt
       r-type (limits-uniqueness-zero r-type) eps))
     (limits-uniqueness-threshold-exists-p
      r-type n-type sequence limit-value eps))))

(defun-sk limits-uniqueness-statement ()
  (forall (r-type n-type sequence l m)
    (implies
     (and
      (limits-uniqueness-structure-p r-type n-type)
      (limits-uniqueness-sequence-typed-p
       r-type n-type sequence)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type l)
      (limits-uniqueness-r-p r-type m)
      (limits-uniqueness-limit-p
       r-type n-type sequence l)
      (limits-uniqueness-limit-p
       r-type n-type sequence m))
     (equal l m))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic limits_uniqueness. This file contains
-- no proof.

module limits_uniqueness where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

record AbsField (R N : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zero : R
    one  : R
    add  : R → R → R
    mul  : R → R → R
    opp  : R → R
    abs  : R → R
    le   : R → R → Set
    lt   : R → R → Set

    nat-le  : N → N → Set
    nat-max : N → N → N
    nat-le-max-left  : (x y : N) → nat-le x (nat-max x y)
    nat-le-max-right : (x y : N) → nat-le y (nat-max x y)

    add-comm  : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : R) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero  : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-opp   : (x : R) → add x (opp x) ≡ zero
    opp-add   : (x y : R) → opp (add x y) ≡ add (opp x) (opp y)
    mul-comm  : (x y : R) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc : (x y z : R) → mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one   : (x : R) → mul x one ≡ x

    le-refl    : (x : R) → le x x
    le-trans   : (x y z : R) → le x y → le y z → le x z
    add-le-add : (a b c d : R) →
                 le a b → le c d → le (add a c) (add b d)

    abs-nonneg   : (x : R) → le zero (abs x)
    abs-triangle : (x y : R) →
                   le (abs (add x y)) (add (abs x) (abs y))
    abs-opp      : (x : R) → abs (opp x) ≡ abs x
    abs-sub-symm : (x y : R) →
                   abs (add x (opp y)) ≡ abs (add y (opp x))

    sub-decomp : (x y z : R) →
                 add x (opp z) ≡
                 add (add x (opp y)) (add y (opp z))
    sub-eq-zero : (x y : R) → add x (opp y) ≡ zero → x ≡ y

    eq-of-forall-eps2 : (x : R) →
      ((eps : R) → lt zero eps → le (abs x) (add eps eps)) →
      x ≡ zero

module Limits {R N : Set} (A : AbsField R N) where
  open AbsField A

  sub : R → R → R
  sub x y = add x (opp y)

  Limit : (N → R) → R → Set
  Limit u l =
    (eps : R) →
    lt zero eps →
    Σ N (λ cutoff →
      (n : N) →
      nat-le cutoff n →
      le (abs (sub (u n) l)) eps)

  sub-self-zero : Set
  sub-self-zero =
    (x : R) → sub x x ≡ zero

  sub-decomp-statement : Set
  sub-decomp-statement =
    (x y z : R) → sub x z ≡ add (sub x y) (sub y z)

  abs-sub-triangle : Set
  abs-sub-triangle =
    (x y z : R) →
    le (abs (sub x z)) (add (abs (sub x y)) (abs (sub y z)))

  abs-sub-nonneg : Set
  abs-sub-nonneg =
    (x y : R) → le zero (abs (sub x y))

  limit-unique : Set
  limit-unique =
    (u : N → R) (l m : R) →
    Limit u l →
    Limit u m →
    l ≡ m

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact limits_uniqueness:
  uniqueness of a sequence limit in an abstract absolute-value setting. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val limits_abs_field_def = new_definition (
  "limits_abs_field_def",
  ``limits_abs_field
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (natMax : 'n -> 'n -> 'n) <=>
      (!x y. natLe x (natMax x y)) /\
      (!x y. natLe y (natMax x y)) /\
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x. addR x zeroR = x) /\
      (!x. addR x (oppR x) = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. oppR (addR x y) = addR (oppR x) (oppR y)) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x. mulR x oneR = x) /\
      (!x. leR x x) /\
      (!x y z. leR x y ==> leR y z ==> leR x z) /\
      (!a b c d.
         leR a b ==> leR c d ==> leR (addR a c) (addR b d)) /\
      (!x. leR zeroR (absV x)) /\
      (!x y.
         leR (absV (addR x y)) (addR (absV x) (absV y))) /\
      (!x. absV (oppR x) = absV x) /\
      (!x y.
         absV (addR x (oppR y)) = absV (addR y (oppR x))) /\
      (!x y z.
         addR x (oppR z) =
           addR (addR x (oppR y)) (addR y (oppR z))) /\
      (!x y. addR x (oppR y) = zeroR ==> x = y) /\
      (!x.
         (!eps.
            ltR zeroR eps ==>
            leR (absV x) (addR eps eps)) ==>
         x = zeroR)``);

val limits_sub_def = new_definition (
  "limits_sub_def",
  ``limits_sub (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (oppR : 'r -> 'r) x y =
      addR x (oppR y)``);

val limits_limit_def = new_definition (
  "limits_limit_def",
  ``limits_limit
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (u : 'n -> 'r) (l : 'r) <=>
      !eps.
        ltR zeroR eps ==>
        ?N. !n.
          natLe N n ==>
          leR (absV (limits_sub addR oppR (u n) l)) eps``);

val sub_self_zero =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (natMax : 'n -> 'n -> 'n).
      limits_abs_field zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR absV
        leR ltR natLe natMax ==>
      !x. limits_sub addR oppR x x = zeroR``;

val sub_decomp =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (natMax : 'n -> 'n -> 'n).
      limits_abs_field zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR absV
        leR ltR natLe natMax ==>
      !x y z.
        limits_sub addR oppR x z =
          addR (limits_sub addR oppR x y)
               (limits_sub addR oppR y z)``;

val abs_sub_triangle =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (natMax : 'n -> 'n -> 'n).
      limits_abs_field zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR absV
        leR ltR natLe natMax ==>
      !x y z.
        leR (absV (limits_sub addR oppR x z))
          (addR (absV (limits_sub addR oppR x y))
                (absV (limits_sub addR oppR y z)))``;

val abs_sub_nonneg =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (natMax : 'n -> 'n -> 'n).
      limits_abs_field zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR absV
        leR ltR natLe natMax ==>
      !x y. leR zeroR (absV (limits_sub addR oppR x y))``;

val limit_unique =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (absV : 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (ltR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (natLe : 'n -> 'n -> bool) (natMax : 'n -> 'n -> 'n)
      (u : 'n -> 'r) (l : 'r) (m : 'r).
      limits_abs_field zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR absV
        leR ltR natLe natMax ==>

title: limits_uniqueness
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic limits_uniqueness. This file contains
% no proof.

limits_uniqueness[
  R: TYPE+,
  N: TYPE+,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R],
  oppR: [R -> R],
  absV: [R -> R],
  leR: [R, R -> bool],
  ltR: [R, R -> bool],
  natLe: [N, N -> bool],
  natMax: [N, N -> N]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  abs_field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: N): natLe(x, natMax(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: N): natLe(y, natMax(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, oppR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        oppR(addR(x, y)) = addR(oppR(x), oppR(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): leR(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        leR(x, y) AND leR(y, z) IMPLIES leR(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c, d: R):
        leR(a, b) AND leR(c, d) IMPLIES
          leR(addR(a, c), addR(b, d)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): leR(zeroR, absV(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        leR(absV(addR(x, y)), addR(absV(x), absV(y))))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): absV(oppR(x)) = absV(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        absV(addR(x, oppR(y))) = absV(addR(y, oppR(x))))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        addR(x, oppR(z)) =
          addR(addR(x, oppR(y)), addR(y, oppR(z))))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        addR(x, oppR(y)) = zeroR IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        (FORALL (eps: R):
          ltR(zeroR, eps) IMPLIES
            leR(absV(x), addR(eps, eps)))
          IMPLIES x = zeroR)

  subR(x, y: R): R = addR(x, oppR(y))

  limit(u: [N -> R], l: R): bool =
    FORALL (eps: R):
      ltR(zeroR, eps) IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (bound: N):
          FORALL (n: N):
            natLe(bound, n) IMPLIES
              leR(absV(subR(u(n), l)), eps))

  abs_sub_triangle: bool =
    abs_field_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        leR(
          absV(subR(x, z)),
          addR(absV(subR(x, y)), absV(subR(y, z)))))

  limit_unique: bool =
    abs_field_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (u: [N -> R]), (l, m: R):
        limit(u, l) AND limit(u, m) IMPLIES l = m)
END limits_uniqueness

content:
class Field (R : Type) where
  zero    : R
  one     : R
  add     : R → R → R
  mul     : R → R → R
  opp     : R → R
  add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_opp   : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero
  mul_comm  : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one   : ∀ x, mul x one = x
  dist_l    : ∀ a x y, mul a (add x y) = add (mul a x) (mul a y)

namespace Lin

variable {R : Type} [FR : Field R]
open Field

infixl:65  "+R"  => Field.add
infixl:70  "*R"  => Field.mul
prefix:100 "-R"  => Field.opp

class VSpace (R : Type) [Field R] (V : Type) where
  zeroV : V
  addV  : V → V → V
  oppV  : V → V
  smul  : R → V → V
  addV_comm  : ∀ u v, addV u v = addV v u
  addV_assoc : ∀ u v w, addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)
  addV_zero  : ∀ u, addV u zeroV = u
  addV_opp   : ∀ u, addV u (oppV u) = zeroV
  smul_addV  : ∀ a u v, smul a (addV u v) = addV (smul a u) (smul a v)
  addR_smul  : ∀ a b u, smul (a +R b) u = addV (smul a u) (smul b u)
  mul_smul   : ∀ a b u, smul (a *R b) u = smul a (smul b u)
  one_smul   : ∀ u, smul Field.one u = u
  smul_zero  : ∀ a, smul a zeroV = zeroV

attribute [simp] VSpace.addV_zero VSpace.smul_zero

infixl:65  "+V"  => VSpace.addV
notation:70 a " •V " u => VSpace.smul a u

structure LMap (V W : Type) [VSpace R V] [VSpace R W] where
  toFun : V → W
  map_add : ∀ u v, toFun (VSpace.addV (R:=R) u v)
             = VSpace.addV (R:=R) (toFun u) (toFun v)
  map_smul : ∀ a u, toFun (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a u)
             = VSpace.smul (R:=R) a (toFun u)

attribute [simp] LMap.map_add LMap.map_smul

variable {V W U : Type}
variable [VSpace R V] [VSpace R W] [VSpace R U]

def ker (L : LMap (R:=R) V W) : V → Prop := fun x => L.toFun x = VSpace.zeroV (R:=R)
def im  (L : LMap (R:=R) V W) : W → Prop := fun y => ∃ x, L.toFun x = y

def comp (g : LMap (R:=R) W U) (f : LMap (R:=R) V W) : LMap (R:=R) V U :=
{ toFun := fun x => g.toFun (f.toFun x)
, map_add := by sorry
theorem ker_add {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {x y : V} :
  ker L x → ker L y → ker L (VSpace.addV (R:=R) x y) := by sorry
theorem ker_smul {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {a : R} {x : V} :
  ker L x → ker L (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a x) := by sorry
theorem im_add {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {y z : W} :
  im L y → im L z → im L (VSpace.addV (R:=R) y z) := by sorry
theorem im_smul {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {a : R} {y : W} :
  im L y → im L (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a y) := by sorry
end Lin

content:
theory linear_map
  imports Main
begin





locale linear_map_setup =
  fixes zeroV :: "'v"
    and addV  :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"         (infixl "+V" 65)
    and smul  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"           (infixr "\<cdot>V" 70)
    and zeroW :: "'w"
    and addW  :: "'w \<Rightarrow> 'w \<Rightarrow> 'w"         (infixl "+W" 65)
    and smulW :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'w \<Rightarrow> 'w"           (infixr "\<cdot>W" 70)
    and toFun :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'w"

  assumes addV_comm  : "\<And>u v. u +V v = v +V u"
    and   addV_assoc : "\<And>u v w. (u +V v) +V w = u +V (v +V w)"
    and   addV_zero  : "\<And>u. u +V zeroV = u"
    and   smul_zeroV : "\<And>a. a \<cdot>V zeroV = zeroV"

    and   addW_comm  : "\<And>u v. u +W v = v +W u"
    and   addW_assoc : "\<And>u v w. (u +W v) +W w = u +W (v +W w)"
    and   addW_zero  : "\<And>u. u +W zeroW = u"
    and   smulW_zero : "\<And>a. a \<cdot>W zeroW = zeroW"

    and   map_add    : "\<And>u v. toFun (u +V v) = toFun u +W toFun v"
    and   map_smul   : "\<And>a u. toFun (a \<cdot>V u) = a \<cdot>W toFun u"
begin





definition ker :: "'v \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "ker x \<equiv> toFun x = zeroW"

definition im :: "'w \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "im y \<equiv> \<exists>x. toFun x = y"





lemma ker_add:
  assumes "ker x" "ker y" shows "ker (x +V y)"
  sorry
lemma ker_smul:
  assumes "ker x" shows "ker (a \<cdot>V x)"
  sorry




lemma im_add:
  assumes "im y" "im z" shows "im (y +W z)"
  sorry
lemma im_smul:
  assumes "im y" shows "im (a \<cdot>W y)"
  sorry
end

end

        (bf-lm-mul-r scalar-type y x))))

       (equal

(defun bf-lm-field-p (scalar-type)

   (bf-lm-scalar-member-p

   (bf-lm-scalar-member-p

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic linear_map. This file contains no
-- proof.

module linear_map where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

record Field {ℓ : Level} (R : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    zero : R
    one  : R
    add  : R → R → R
    mul  : R → R → R
    opp  : R → R

    add-comm  : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : R) →
                add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero  : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-opp   : (x : R) → add x (opp x) ≡ zero

    mul-comm  : (x y : R) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc : (x y z : R) →
                mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one   : (x : R) → mul x one ≡ x
    dist-left : (a x y : R) →
                mul a (add x y) ≡ add (mul a x) (mul a y)

record VSpace {ℓR ℓV : Level} {R : Set ℓR}
              (F : Field R) (V : Set ℓV) : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV) where
  open Field F

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV  : V → V → V
    oppV  : V → V
    smul  : R → V → V

    addV-comm  : (u v : V) → addV u v ≡ addV v u
    addV-assoc : (u v w : V) →
                 addV (addV u v) w ≡ addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero  : (u : V) → addV u zeroV ≡ u
    addV-opp   : (u : V) → addV u (oppV u) ≡ zeroV

    smul-addV : (a : R) (u v : V) →
                smul a (addV u v) ≡ addV (smul a u) (smul a v)
    add-smul  : (a b : R) (u : V) →
                smul (add a b) u ≡ addV (smul a u) (smul b u)
    mul-smul  : (a b : R) (u : V) →
                smul (mul a b) u ≡ smul a (smul b u)
    one-smul  : (u : V) → smul one u ≡ u
    smul-zero : (a : R) → smul a zeroV ≡ zeroV

record LMap
  {ℓR ℓV ℓW : Level}
  {R : Set ℓR} {V : Set ℓV} {W : Set ℓW}
  (F : Field R) (SV : VSpace F V) (SW : VSpace F W)
  : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV ⊔ ℓW) where

  field
    toFun : V → W
    map-add : (u v : V) →
      toFun (VSpace.addV SV u v) ≡
      VSpace.addV SW (toFun u) (toFun v)
    map-smul : (a : R) (u : V) →
      toFun (VSpace.smul SV a u) ≡
      VSpace.smul SW a (toFun u)

module LinearMapStatements
  {ℓR ℓV ℓW : Level}
  {R : Set ℓR} {V : Set ℓV} {W : Set ℓW}
  (F : Field R) (SV : VSpace F V) (SW : VSpace F W)
  (L : LMap F SV SW) where

  ker : V → Set ℓW
  ker x = LMap.toFun L x ≡ VSpace.zeroV SW

  im : W → Set (ℓV ⊔ ℓW)
  im y = Σ V (λ x → LMap.toFun L x ≡ y)

  ker-add : Set (ℓV ⊔ ℓW)
  ker-add =
    (x y : V) →
    ker x →
    ker y →
    ker (VSpace.addV SV x y)

  ker-smul : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV ⊔ ℓW)
  ker-smul =
    (a : R) (x : V) →
    ker x →
    ker (VSpace.smul SV a x)

  im-add : Set (ℓV ⊔ ℓW)
  im-add =
    (y z : W) →
    im y →
    im z →
    im (VSpace.addV SW y z)

  im-smul : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓV ⊔ ℓW)
  im-smul =
    (a : R) (y : W) →
    im y →
    im (VSpace.smul SW a y)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact linear_map: kernels
  and images of linear maps are closed under vector addition and scalar
  multiplication. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val babel_field_def = new_definition (
  "babel_field_def",
  ``babel_field (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x. addR x zeroR = x) /\
      (!x. addR x (oppR x) = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x. mulR x oneR = x) /\
      (!a x y. mulR a (addR x y) = addR (mulR a x) (mulR a y))``);

val babel_vspace_def = new_definition (
  "babel_vspace_def",
  ``babel_vspace (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'r -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!u v. addV u v = addV v u) /\
      (!u v w. addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)) /\
      (!u. addV u zeroV = u) /\
      (!u. addV u (oppV u) = zeroV) /\
      (!a u v. smul a (addV u v) = addV (smul a u) (smul a v)) /\
      (!a b u. smul (addR a b) u = addV (smul a u) (smul b u)) /\
      (!a b u. smul (mulR a b) u = smul a (smul b u)) /\
      (!u. smul oneR u = u) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroV = zeroV)``);

val babel_linear_map_def = new_definition (
  "babel_linear_map_def",
  ``babel_linear_map
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smulV : 'r -> 'v -> 'v)
      (addW : 'w -> 'w -> 'w) (smulW : 'r -> 'w -> 'w)
      (toFun : 'v -> 'w) <=>
      (!u v. toFun (addV u v) = addW (toFun u) (toFun v)) /\
      (!a u. toFun (smulV a u) = smulW a (toFun u))``);

val babel_linear_map_context_def = new_definition (
  "babel_linear_map_context_def",
  ``babel_linear_map_context
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'r -> 'v -> 'v)
      (zeroW : 'w) (addW : 'w -> 'w -> 'w) (oppW : 'w -> 'w)
      (smulW : 'r -> 'w -> 'w) (toFun : 'v -> 'w) <=>
      babel_field zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR /\
      babel_vspace oneR addR mulR zeroV addV oppV smulV /\
      babel_vspace oneR addR mulR zeroW addW oppW smulW /\
      babel_linear_map addV smulV addW smulW toFun``);

val babel_ker_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ker_def",
  ``babel_ker (toFun : 'v -> 'w) (zeroW : 'w) x <=>
      toFun x = zeroW``);

val babel_im_def = new_definition (
  "babel_im_def",
  ``babel_im (toFun : 'v -> 'w) y <=>
      ?x. toFun x = y``);

val ker_add =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'r -> 'v -> 'v)
      (zeroW : 'w) (addW : 'w -> 'w -> 'w) (oppW : 'w -> 'w)
      (smulW : 'r -> 'w -> 'w) (toFun : 'v -> 'w).
      babel_linear_map_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smulV zeroW addW oppW smulW toFun ==>
      !x y.
        babel_ker toFun zeroW x ==>
        babel_ker toFun zeroW y ==>
        babel_ker toFun zeroW (addV x y)``;

val ker_smul =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'r -> 'v -> 'v)
      (zeroW : 'w) (addW : 'w -> 'w -> 'w) (oppW : 'w -> 'w)
      (smulW : 'r -> 'w -> 'w) (toFun : 'v -> 'w).
      babel_linear_map_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smulV zeroW addW oppW smulW toFun ==>
      !a x.
        babel_ker toFun zeroW x ==>
        babel_ker toFun zeroW (smulV a x)``;

val im_add =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'r -> 'v -> 'v)
      (zeroW : 'w) (addW : 'w -> 'w -> 'w) (oppW : 'w -> 'w)
      (smulW : 'r -> 'w -> 'w) (toFun : 'v -> 'w).
      babel_linear_map_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smulV zeroW addW oppW smulW toFun ==>
      !y z.
        babel_im toFun y ==>
        babel_im toFun z ==>
        babel_im toFun (addW y z)``;

val im_smul =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (oppV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'r -> 'v -> 'v)
      (zeroW : 'w) (addW : 'w -> 'w -> 'w) (oppW : 'w -> 'w)
      (smulW : 'r -> 'w -> 'w) (toFun : 'v -> 'w).
      babel_linear_map_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroV addV oppV smulV zeroW addW oppW smulW toFun ==>
      !a y.
        babel_im toFun y ==>
        babel_im toFun (smulW a y)``;

val _ = export_theory();

          ( addV x ( addV u v ) ) )
      ) ) )
      /\
      (
        ( A.v x
          ( ( addV x zeroV ) =V x )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( A.v x
            ( ( addV x ( oppV x ) ) =V zeroV )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( A.r a ( A.v x ( A.v u
              ( ( smulV a ( addV x u ) )
                =V
                ( addV ( smulV a x ) ( smulV a u ) ) )
            ) ) )
            /\
            (
              ( A.r a ( A.r b ( A.v x
                ( ( smulV ( addR a b ) x )
                  =V
                  ( addV ( smulV a x ) ( smulV b x ) ) )
              ) ) )
              /\
              (
                ( A.r a ( A.r b ( A.v x
                  ( ( smulV ( mulR a b ) x )
                    =V
                    ( smulV a ( smulV b x ) ) )
                ) ) )
                /\
                (
                  ( A.v x
                    ( ( smulV oneR x ) =V x )
                  )
                  /\
                  ( A.r a
                    ( ( smulV a zeroV ) =V zeroV )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

$(
  Target-vector-space structure over the same scalar operations.
$)
vspace-w-def $a |- (
  VSpaceW
  <->
  (
    ( A.w y ( A.w z
      ( ( addW y z ) =W ( addW z y ) )
    ) )
    /\
    (
      ( A.w y ( A.w z ( A.w w
        ( ( addW ( addW y z ) w )
          =W
          ( addW y ( addW z w ) ) )
      ) ) )
      /\
      (
        ( A.w y
          ( ( addW y zeroW ) =W y )
        )
        /\
        (
          ( A.w y
            ( ( addW y ( oppW y ) ) =W zeroW )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( A.r a ( A.w y ( A.w z
              ( ( smulW a ( addW y z ) )
                =W
                ( addW ( smulW a y ) ( smulW a z ) ) )
            ) ) )
            /\
            (
              ( A.r a ( A.r b ( A.w y
                ( ( smulW ( addR a b ) y )
                  =W
                  ( addW ( smulW a y ) ( smulW b y ) ) )
              ) ) )
              /\
              (
                ( A.r a ( A.r b ( A.w y
                  ( ( smulW ( mulR a b ) y )
                    =W
                    ( smulW a ( smulW b y ) ) )
                ) ) )
                /\
                (
                  ( A.w y
                    ( ( smulW oneR y ) =W y )
                  )
                  /\
                  ( A.r a
                    ( ( smulW a zeroW ) =W zeroW )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

$(
  A linear map preserves vector addition and scalar multiplication.
$)
linear-map-def $a |- (
  ( LinearMap L )
  <->
  (
    ( A.v x ( A.v u
      ( ( app L ( addV x u ) )
        =W
        ( addW ( app L x ) ( app L u ) ) )
    ) )
    /\
    ( A.r a ( A.v x
      ( ( app L ( smulV a x ) )
        =W
        ( smulW a ( app L x ) ) )
    ) )
  )
) $.

kernel-def $a |- (
  ( Ker L x )
  <->
  ( ( app L x ) =W zeroW )
) $.

image-def $a |- (
  ( Im L y )
  <->
  ( E.v x
    ( ( app L x ) =W y )
  )
) $.

$(
  The translated theorem family: the kernel and image of a linear map are
  closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
$)
${
  theorem-field-hyp $e |- Field $.
  theorem-vspace-v-hyp $e |- VSpaceV $.
  theorem-vspace-w-hyp $e |- VSpaceW $.
  theorem-linear-map-hyp $e |- ( LinearMap L ) $.

  ${
    ker-add-x-hyp $e |- ( Ker L x ) $.
    ker-add-u-hyp $e |- ( Ker L u ) $.

    ker-add $a |- ( Ker L ( addV x u ) ) $.
  $}

  ${
    ker-smul-x-hyp $e |- ( Ker L x ) $.

    ker-smul $a |- ( Ker L ( smulV a x ) ) $.
  $}

  ${
    im-add-y-hyp $e |- ( Im L y ) $.
    im-add-z-hyp $e |- ( Im L z ) $.

    im-add $a |- ( Im L ( addW y z ) ) $.
  $}

  ${
    im-smul-y-hyp $e |- ( Im L y ) $.

    im-smul $a |- ( Im L ( smulW a y ) ) $.
  $}
$}

title: linear_map
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic linear_map. This file contains no
:: proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1,
    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1;
  notations XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_2;

begin

:: Kernel and image closure for a linear map.
::$P-
theorem
  for R,V,W being non empty set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      oppR being UnOp of R,
      zeroV being Element of V,
      addV being BinOp of V,
      oppV being UnOp of V,
      smulV being Function of [:R,V:],V,
      zeroW being Element of W,
      addW being BinOp of W,
      oppW being UnOp of W,
      smulW being Function of [:R,W:],W,
      toFun being Function of V,W
  st
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,y) = addR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(x,y),z) = addR.(x,addR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,zeroR) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,oppR.x) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,y) = mulR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(x,y),z) = mulR.(x,mulR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,oneR) = x) &
    (for a,x,y being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,addR.(x,y)) =
        addR.(mulR.(a,x),mulR.(a,y))) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,v) = addV.(v,u)) &
    (for u,v,w being Element of V holds
      addV.(addV.(u,v),w) = addV.(u,addV.(v,w))) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,zeroV) = u) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,oppV.u) = zeroV) &
    (for a being Element of R, u,v being Element of V holds
      smulV.(a,addV.(u,v)) =
        addV.(smulV.(a,u),smulV.(a,v))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      smulV.(addR.(a,b),u) =
        addV.(smulV.(a,u),smulV.(b,u))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      smulV.(mulR.(a,b),u) = smulV.(a,smulV.(b,u))) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      smulV.(oneR,u) = u) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      smulV.(a,zeroV) = zeroV) &
    (for y,z being Element of W holds
      addW.(y,z) = addW.(z,y)) &
    (for y,z,w being Element of W holds
      addW.(addW.(y,z),w) = addW.(y,addW.(z,w))) &
    (for y being Element of W holds
      addW.(y,zeroW) = y) &
    (for y being Element of W holds
      addW.(y,oppW.y) = zeroW) &
    (for a being Element of R, y,z being Element of W holds
      smulW.(a,addW.(y,z)) =
        addW.(smulW.(a,y),smulW.(a,z))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, y being Element of W holds
      smulW.(addR.(a,b),y) =
        addW.(smulW.(a,y),smulW.(b,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, y being Element of W holds
      smulW.(mulR.(a,b),y) = smulW.(a,smulW.(b,y))) &
    (for y being Element of W holds
      smulW.(oneR,y) = y) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      smulW.(a,zeroW) = zeroW) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      toFun.(addV.(u,v)) = addW.(toFun.u,toFun.v)) &
    (for a being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      toFun.(smulV.(a,u)) = smulW.(a,toFun.u))
  holds
    (for x,u being Element of V
      st toFun.x = zeroW & toFun.u = zeroW
      holds toFun.(addV.(x,u)) = zeroW) &
    (for a being Element of R, x being Element of V
      st toFun.x = zeroW
      holds toFun.(smulV.(a,x)) = zeroW) &
    (for y,z being Element of W
      st (ex x being Element of V st toFun.x = y) &
         (ex u being Element of V st toFun.u = z)
      holds ex v being Element of V st toFun.v = addW.(y,z)) &
    (for a being Element of R, y being Element of W
      st ex x being Element of V st toFun.x = y
      holds ex u being Element of V st toFun.u = smulW.(a,y))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: linear_map
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic linear_map. This file contains no
% proof.

linear_map[
  R: TYPE+,
  V: TYPE+,
  W: TYPE+,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R],
  oppR: [R -> R],
  zeroV: V,
  addV: [V, V -> V],
  oppV: [V -> V],
  smulV: [R, V -> V],
  zeroW: W,
  addW: [W, W -> W],
  oppW: [W -> W],
  smulW: [R, W -> W],
  toFun: [V -> W]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R): addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, oppR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, x, y: R):
        mulR(a, addR(x, y)) =
          addR(mulR(a, x), mulR(a, y)))

  vspace_v_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): addV(u, v) = addV(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        addV(addV(u, v), w) = addV(u, addV(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): addV(u, zeroV) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): addV(u, oppV(u)) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (u, v: V):
        smulV(a, addV(u, v)) =
          addV(smulV(a, u), smulV(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (u: V):
        smulV(addR(a, b), u) =
          addV(smulV(a, u), smulV(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (u: V):
        smulV(mulR(a, b), u) = smulV(a, smulV(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): smulV(oneR, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (a: R): smulV(a, zeroV) = zeroV)

  vspace_w_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: W): addW(u, v) = addW(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: W):
        addW(addW(u, v), w) = addW(u, addW(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: W): addW(u, zeroW) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: W): addW(u, oppW(u)) = zeroW)
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (u, v: W):
        smulW(a, addW(u, v)) =
          addW(smulW(a, u), smulW(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (u: W):
        smulW(addR(a, b), u) =
          addW(smulW(a, u), smulW(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (u: W):
        smulW(mulR(a, b), u) = smulW(a, smulW(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: W): smulW(oneR, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (a: R): smulW(a, zeroW) = zeroW)

  linear_map_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V):
      toFun(addV(u, v)) = addW(toFun(u), toFun(v)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (u: V):
        toFun(smulV(a, u)) = smulW(a, toFun(u)))

  linear_context: bool =
    field_laws
      AND vspace_v_laws
      AND vspace_w_laws
      AND linear_map_laws

  ker(x: V): bool = toFun(x) = zeroW

  im(y: W): bool = EXISTS (x: V): toFun(x) = y

  ker_add: bool =
    linear_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: V):
        ker(x) AND ker(y) IMPLIES ker(addV(x, y)))

  ker_smul: bool =
    linear_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a: R), (x: V):
        ker(x) IMPLIES ker(smulV(a, x)))

  im_add: bool =
    linear_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (y, z: W):
        im(y) AND im(z) IMPLIES im(addW(y, z)))

  im_smul: bool =
    linear_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a: R), (y: W):
        im(y) IMPLIES im(smulW(a, y)))

  linear_map_closure: bool =
    ker_add AND ker_smul AND im_add AND im_smul
END linear_map

title: polynomial
content:
inductive mynat : Type
| O  : mynat
| S  : mynat → mynat
deriving DecidableEq

open mynat

def mynat_add : mynat → mynat → mynat
| O,        m => m
| (S n'),   m => S (mynat_add n' m)

theorem mynat_add_O_left (m : mynat) :
  mynat_add O m = m := rfl

theorem mynat_add_S_left (n m : mynat) :
  mynat_add (S n) m = S (mynat_add n m) := rfl

inductive mynat_le : mynat → mynat → Prop
| le_n  : ∀ n, mynat_le n n
| le_S  : ∀ n m, mynat_le n m → mynat_le n (S m)

open mynat_le

theorem mynat_zero_le (n : mynat) : mynat_le O n := by sorry
theorem mynat_add_zero_r : ∀ n, mynat_add n O = n := by sorry
theorem mynat_succ_le_succ {n m : mynat} :
  mynat_le n m → mynat_le (S n) (S m) := by sorry
theorem mynat_add_S_r : ∀ m n, mynat_add m (S n) = S (mynat_add m n) := by sorry
theorem mynat_add_comm : ∀ n m, mynat_add n m = mynat_add m n := by sorry

inductive mylist (A : Type) : Type
| nilL  : mylist A
| consL : A → mylist A → mylist A

namespace mylist

notation h "::L" t => mylist.consL  h t

end mylist

open mylist


inductive InL {A : Type} (x : A) : mylist A → Prop
| In_head : ∀ xs, InL x (x ::L xs)
| In_tail : ∀ y xs, InL (x := x) xs → InL (x := x) (y ::L xs)

inductive NoDupL {A : Type} : mylist A → Prop
| ND_nil  : NoDupL mylist.nilL
| ND_cons : ∀ x xs, (¬ InL x xs) → NoDupL xs → NoDupL (x ::L xs)

def lengthL {A : Type} : mylist A → mynat
| mylist.nilL    => O
| (_ ::L tl)=> S (lengthL tl)

class ring (R : Type) where
  (zero      : R)
  (opp       : R → R)
  (one       : R)
  (add       : R → R → R)
  (mul       : R → R → R)

  (one_neq_zero  : one ≠ zero)

  (add_comm  : ∀ x y,    add x y = add y x)
  (add_assoc : ∀ x y z,  add (add x y) z = add x (add y z))
  (add_zero  : ∀ x,      add x zero = x)
  (add_opp   : ∀ x,      add x (opp x) = zero)

  (mul_comm  : ∀ x y,    mul x y = mul y x)
  (mul_assoc : ∀ x y z,  mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z))
  (mul_one   : ∀ x,      mul x one = x)
  (dist_l    : ∀ x y z,  mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))
  (mul_zero  : ∀ x,      mul x zero = zero)

  (no_zero_div :
    ∀ x y, mul x y = zero → x = zero ∨ y = zero)

notation:35 "-R " x   => ring.opp x
section Polynomial

variable {R : Type} [rR : ring R]
variable {polynomial : Type} [rP : ring polynomial]


variable (degree    : polynomial → mynat)
variable (monomial  : mynat → R → polynomial)
variable (eval      : polynomial → R → R)



local notation:55 x " -R " y => rR.add x (rR.opp y)


def X (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) : polynomial :=
  monomial (S O) rR.one

def C (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) (c : R) : polynomial :=
  monomial O c

def X_minus (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) (a : R) : polynomial :=
  rP.add (X monomial) (C monomial (rR.opp a))


axiom C_zero    : C monomial rR.zero = rP.zero
axiom C_one     : C monomial rR.one  = rP.one

axiom deg_zero  : degree rP.zero = O

axiom eval_add  : ∀ (p q : polynomial) (x : R), eval (rP.add p q) x = rR.add (eval p x) (eval q x)
axiom eval_mul  : ∀ (p q : polynomial) (x : R), eval (rP.mul p q) x = rR.mul (eval p x) (eval q x)
axiom eval_C    : ∀ (c : R) (x : R),   eval (C monomial c) x = c
axiom eval_X    : ∀ (x : R),     eval (X monomial) x     = x

axiom deg_C        : ∀ (c : R), c ≠ rR.zero → degree (C monomial c) = O
axiom deg_constant : ∀ (p : polynomial), degree p = O ↔ ∃ c : R, p = C monomial c
axiom deg_X_minus  : ∀ (a : R), degree (X_minus monomial a) = S O
axiom deg_mul      : ∀ (p q : polynomial), p ≠ rP.zero → q ≠ rP.zero →
                      degree (rP.mul p q) = mynat_add (degree p) (degree q)



axiom euclid_X_minus :
  ∀ p a, ∃ (q r' : polynomial),
    (p = rP.add (rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)) r') ∧ (degree r' = O)







theorem sub_eq_zero_l : ∀ a b : R, rR.add a (rR.opp b) = rR.zero → a = b := by sorry
def is_root (eval : polynomial → R → R) (a : R) (p : polynomial) : Prop := eval p a = rR.zero




theorem root_factor
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (a : R) :
  is_root eval a p → ∃ q : polynomial, p = rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)
:= by sorry
theorem root_transfer
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p q : polynomial) (a b : R) :
  p = rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a) →
  b ≠ a →
  is_root eval b p →
  is_root eval b q
:= by sorry
theorem roots_le_degree
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (xs : mylist R) :
  NoDupL xs →
  (∀ a, InL a xs → is_root eval a p) →
  p ≠ rP.zero →
  mynat_le (lengthL xs) (degree p)
:= by sorry
def poly_of_roots (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) : mylist R → polynomial
| mylist.nilL       => rP.one
| mylist.consL a xs => rP.mul (X_minus monomial a) (poly_of_roots monomial xs)


theorem X_minus_nonzero
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) :
  ∀ a, (X_minus monomial a) ≠ rP.zero := by sorry
theorem constant_root_zero
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (a : R) :
  degree p = O → is_root eval a p → p = rP.zero := by sorry
theorem root_of_product
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p q : polynomial) (a : R) :
  is_root eval a (rP.mul p q) → is_root eval a p ∨ is_root eval a q := by sorry
theorem root_scale_constant
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (c a : R) :
  c ≠ rR.zero → (is_root eval a p ↔ is_root eval a (rP.mul (C monomial c) p)) := by sorry
theorem poly_of_roots_nonzero
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) :
  ∀ (xs : mylist R), poly_of_roots monomial xs ≠ rP.zero := by sorry
theorem deg_poly_of_roots
  (xs : mylist R) :
  degree (poly_of_roots monomial xs) = lengthL xs := by sorry
theorem root_factor_list
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R) :
  ∀ (p : polynomial) (xs : mylist R),
    NoDupL xs →
    (∀ a, InL a xs → is_root eval a p) →
    ∃ q, p = rP.mul q (poly_of_roots monomial xs)
:= by sorry
theorem degree_factorisation :
  ∀ (p : polynomial) (xs : mylist R) (q : polynomial),
    p = rP.mul q (poly_of_roots monomial xs) →
    q ≠ rP.zero →
    degree p = mynat_add (degree q) (lengthL xs)
:= by sorry
end Polynomial

Proof.

Inductive mylist (A : Type) : Type :=
