Infix "::L" := consL (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive InL {A : Type} (x : A) : mylist A -> Prop :=
| In_head : forall xs,      InL x (x ::L xs)
| In_tail : forall y xs, InL x xs -> InL x (y ::L xs).

Inductive NoDupL {A : Type} : mylist A -> Prop :=
| ND_nil  : NoDupL nilL
| ND_cons : forall x xs, (~ InL x xs) -> NoDupL xs -> NoDupL (x ::L xs).

Fixpoint lengthL {A : Type} (xs : mylist A) : mynat :=
  match xs with
  | nilL      => O
  | _ ::L tl  => S (lengthL tl)
  end.

Class ring (R : Type) := {
  zero      : R;
  opp       : R -> R;
  one       : R;
  add       : R -> R -> R;
  mul       : R -> R -> R;

  one_neq_zero  : one <> zero;

  add_comm  : forall x y,    add x y = add y x;
  add_assoc : forall x y z,  add (add x y) z = add x (add y z);
  add_zero  : forall x,      add x zero = x;
  add_opp   : forall x,      add x (opp x) = zero;

  mul_comm  : forall x y,    mul x y = mul y x;
  mul_assoc : forall x y z,  mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z);
  mul_one   : forall x,      mul x one = x;
  dist_l    : forall x y z,  mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z);
  mul_zero  : forall x,      mul x zero = zero;
  
  no_zero_div :
    forall x y, mul x y = zero -> x = zero \/ y = zero
}.

Notation "x +R y" := (add x y) (at level 50, left associativity).
Notation "-R x"    := (opp x)    (at level 35).
Notation "x -R y"  := (add x (opp y)) (at level 55).
Notation "x *R y"  := (mul x y)  (at level 40).

Section Polynomial.
  Context {R : Type} `{ring R}.

  Context {polynomial : Type} `{ring polynomial}.

  Variable degree    : polynomial -> mynat.
  Variable monomial  : mynat -> R -> polynomial.

  Variable eval : polynomial -> R -> R.

  Definition X          : polynomial := monomial (S O) one.
  Definition C (c:R)    : polynomial := monomial O c.
  Definition X_minus (a:R) : polynomial := X +R C (-R a).

  Axiom C_zero : C zero = zero.
  Axiom C_one         : C one = one.

  Axiom deg_zero      : degree zero = O.

  Axiom eval_add     : forall p q x,     eval (p +R q) x = eval p x +R eval q x.
  Axiom eval_mul     : forall p q x,     eval (p *R q) x = eval p x *R eval q x.
  Axiom eval_C       : forall c x,       eval (C c) x   = c.
  Axiom eval_X       : forall x,         eval X x       = x.

  Axiom deg_C        : forall c, c <> zero -> degree (C c) = O.
  Axiom deg_constant : forall p, degree p = O <-> exists c, p = C c.
  Axiom deg_X_minus  : forall a,         degree (X_minus a) = S O.
  Axiom deg_mul      : forall p q,
    p <> zero -> q <> zero ->
    degree (p *R q) = mynat_add (degree p) (degree q).

   Axiom euclid_X_minus :
    forall p a, exists q r,
      p = q *R X_minus a +R r
      /\ degree r = O.

  
  Lemma sub_eq_zero_l `{ring R} : forall a b, a -R b = zero -> a = b.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma root_factor :
    forall p a, eval p a = zero ->
      exists q, p = q *R X_minus a.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma root_transfer :
    forall p q a b,
      p = q *R X_minus a ->
      b <> a ->
      eval p b = zero ->
      eval q b = zero.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Definition root (a:R) (p:polynomial) : Prop := eval p a = zero.

  Theorem roots_le_degree :
    forall p (xs:mylist R),
      NoDupL xs ->
      (forall a, InL a xs -> root a p) ->
      p <> zero ->
      mynat_le (lengthL xs) (degree p).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Fixpoint poly_of_roots (xs : mylist R) : polynomial :=
  match xs with
  | nilL        => one
  | consL a xs' => X_minus a *R poly_of_roots xs'
  end.

  Lemma X_minus_nonzero : forall a, X_minus a <> zero.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma constant_root_zero :
    forall p a, degree p = O -> root a p -> p = zero.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma root_of_product :
    forall p q a, root a (p *R q) -> root a p \/ root a q.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma root_scale_constant :
    forall p c a, c <> zero -> (root a p <-> root a (C c *R p)).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma poly_of_roots_nonzero : forall xs, poly_of_roots xs <> zero.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma deg_poly_of_roots :
    forall xs, degree (poly_of_roots xs) = lengthL xs.
Proof.
Admitted.


  Lemma root_factor_list :
  forall p xs,
    NoDupL xs ->
    (forall a, InL a xs -> root a p) ->
    exists q, p = q *R poly_of_roots xs.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma degree_factorisation :
    forall p xs q,
      p = q *R poly_of_roots xs ->
      q <> zero ->
      degree p = mynat_add (degree q) (lengthL xs).
Proof.
Admitted.

End Polynomial.

title: polynomial
content:
theory polynomial
  imports Main
begin






datatype mynat = Nat_O | Nat_S mynat

fun mynat_add :: "mynat \<Rightarrow> mynat \<Rightarrow> mynat" where
  "mynat_add Nat_O m = m"
| "mynat_add (Nat_S n') m = Nat_S (mynat_add n' m)"

lemma mynat_add_O_left: "mynat_add Nat_O m = m"
  sorry
lemma mynat_add_S_left: "mynat_add (Nat_S n) m = Nat_S (mynat_add n m)"
  sorry
inductive mynat_le :: "mynat \<Rightarrow> mynat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  le_n : "mynat_le n n"
| le_S : "mynat_le n m \<Longrightarrow> mynat_le n (Nat_S m)"

lemma mynat_zero_le: "mynat_le Nat_O n"
  sorry
lemma mynat_add_zero_r: "mynat_add n Nat_O = n"
  sorry
lemma mynat_succ_le_succ: "mynat_le n m \<Longrightarrow> mynat_le (Nat_S n) (Nat_S m)"
  sorry
lemma mynat_add_S_r: "mynat_add m (Nat_S n) = Nat_S (mynat_add m n)"
  sorry
lemma mynat_add_comm: "mynat_add n m = mynat_add m n"
  sorry




datatype 'a mylist = NilL | ConsL 'a "'a mylist"

inductive InL :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a mylist \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  In_head : "InL x (ConsL x xs)"
| In_tail : "InL x xs \<Longrightarrow> InL x (ConsL y xs)"

inductive NoDupL :: "'a mylist \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  ND_nil  : "NoDupL NilL"
| ND_cons : "\<not> InL x xs \<Longrightarrow> NoDupL xs \<Longrightarrow> NoDupL (ConsL x xs)"

fun lengthL :: "'a mylist \<Rightarrow> mynat" where
  "lengthL NilL = Nat_O"
| "lengthL (ConsL _ rest) = Nat_S (lengthL rest)"





locale polynomial_setup =
  fixes zero_r :: "'r"
    and one_r  :: "'r"
    and opp_r  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and add_r  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"  (infixl \<open>+R\<close> 65)
    and mul_r  :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"  (infixl \<open>*R\<close> 70)
    and zero_p :: "'p"
    and one_p  :: "'p"
    and opp_p  :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and add_p  :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"  (infixl \<open>+P\<close> 65)
    and mul_p  :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"  (infixl \<open>*P\<close> 70)
    and degree   :: "'p \<Rightarrow> mynat"
    and monomial :: "mynat \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and eval     :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  assumes
    r_one_neq_zero  : "one_r \<noteq> zero_r"
  and r_add_comm    : "\<And>x y.   x +R y = y +R x"
  and r_add_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x +R y) +R z = x +R (y +R z)"
  and r_add_zero    : "\<And>x.     x +R zero_r = x"
  and r_add_opp     : "\<And>x.     x +R opp_r x = zero_r"
  and r_mul_comm    : "\<And>x y.   x *R y = y *R x"
  and r_mul_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x *R y) *R z = x *R (y *R z)"
  and r_mul_one     : "\<And>x.     x *R one_r = x"
  and r_dist_l      : "\<And>x y z. x *R (y +R z) = (x *R y) +R (x *R z)"
  and r_mul_zero    : "\<And>x.     x *R zero_r = zero_r"
  and r_no_zero_div : "\<And>x y.   x *R y = zero_r \<Longrightarrow> x = zero_r \<or> y = zero_r"
  and p_one_neq_zero : "one_p \<noteq> zero_p"
  and p_add_comm    : "\<And>x y.   x +P y = y +P x"
  and p_add_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x +P y) +P z = x +P (y +P z)"
  and p_add_zero    : "\<And>x.     x +P zero_p = x"
  and p_add_opp     : "\<And>x.     x +P opp_p x = zero_p"
  and p_mul_comm    : "\<And>x y.   x *P y = y *P x"
  and p_mul_assoc   : "\<And>x y z. (x *P y) *P z = x *P (y *P z)"
  and p_mul_one     : "\<And>x.     x *P one_p = x"
  and p_dist_l      : "\<And>x y z. x *P (y +P z) = (x *P y) +P (x *P z)"
  and p_mul_zero    : "\<And>x.     x *P zero_p = zero_p"
  and p_no_zero_div : "\<And>x y.   x *P y = zero_p \<Longrightarrow> x = zero_p \<or> y = zero_p"
  and deg_zero      : "degree zero_p = Nat_O"
  and eval_add      : "\<And>p q x. eval (p +P q) x = eval p x +R eval q x"
  and eval_mul      : "\<And>p q x. eval (p *P q) x = eval p x *R eval q x"
  and eval_C_ax     : "\<And>c x.   eval (monomial Nat_O c) x = c"
  and eval_X_ax     : "\<And>x.     eval (monomial (Nat_S Nat_O) one_r) x = x"
  and deg_C_ax      : "\<And>c.     c \<noteq> zero_r \<Longrightarrow> degree (monomial Nat_O c) = Nat_O"
  and deg_constant  : "\<And>p.     (degree p = Nat_O) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>c. p = monomial Nat_O c)"
  and deg_X_minus_ax : "\<And>a.    degree (monomial (Nat_S Nat_O) one_r +P monomial Nat_O (opp_r a)) = Nat_S Nat_O"
  and deg_mul       : "\<And>p q.   p \<noteq> zero_p \<Longrightarrow> q \<noteq> zero_p \<Longrightarrow>
                                 degree (p *P q) = mynat_add (degree p) (degree q)"
  and C_zero_ax     : "monomial Nat_O zero_r = zero_p"
  and C_one_ax      : "monomial Nat_O one_r = one_p"
  and euclid_X_minus_ax :
       "\<And>p a. \<exists>q r.
          p = q *P (monomial (Nat_S Nat_O) one_r +P monomial Nat_O (opp_r a)) +P r
          \<and> degree r = Nat_O"
begin





definition X :: "'p" where
  "X = monomial (Nat_S Nat_O) one_r"

definition C :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'p" where
  "C c = monomial Nat_O c"

definition X_minus :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'p" where
  "X_minus a = X +P C (opp_r a)"

fun poly_of_roots :: "'r mylist \<Rightarrow> 'p" where
  "poly_of_roots NilL = one_p"
| "poly_of_roots (ConsL a xs) = X_minus a *P poly_of_roots xs"

definition is_root :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_root a p \<longleftrightarrow> eval p a = zero_r"





lemma X_minus_unfold:
  "X_minus a = monomial (Nat_S Nat_O) one_r +P monomial Nat_O (opp_r a)"
  unfolding X_minus_def X_def C_def
  sorry
lemma eval_C: "eval (C c) x = c"
  unfolding C_def
  sorry
lemma eval_X: "eval X x = x"
  unfolding X_def
  sorry
lemma deg_X_minus: "degree (X_minus a) = Nat_S Nat_O"
  sorry
lemma C_zero: "C zero_r = zero_p"
  unfolding C_def
  sorry
lemma C_one: "C one_r = one_p"
  unfolding C_def
  sorry
lemma deg_C: "c \<noteq> zero_r \<Longrightarrow> degree (C c) = Nat_O"
  unfolding C_def
  sorry
lemma euclid_X_minus: "\<exists>q r. p = q *P X_minus a +P r \<and> degree r = Nat_O"
  using euclid_X_minus_ax[of p a]
  sorry




lemma r_opp_add: "opp_r x +R x = zero_r"
  sorry
lemma r_add_zero_l: "zero_r +R x = x"
  sorry




lemma sub_eq_zero_l: "x +R opp_r y = zero_r \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
  sorry




lemma eval_X_minus: "eval (X_minus a) b = b +R opp_r a"
  unfolding X_minus_def
  sorry




lemma X_minus_nonzero: "X_minus a \<noteq> zero_p"
  sorry




lemma p_add_zero_l: "zero_p +P x = x"
  sorry
lemma p_mul_zero_l: "zero_p *P x = zero_p"
  sorry
lemma p_mul_one_l: "one_p *P x = x"
  sorry




lemma root_factor: "is_root a p \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>q. p = q *P X_minus a"
  sorry




lemma root_transfer:
  "p = q *P X_minus a \<Longrightarrow> b \<noteq> a \<Longrightarrow> is_root b p \<Longrightarrow> is_root b q"
  sorry




lemma roots_le_degree:
  "NoDupL xs \<Longrightarrow> (\<forall>a. InL a xs \<longrightarrow> is_root a p) \<Longrightarrow> p \<noteq> zero_p \<Longrightarrow>
   mynat_le (lengthL xs) (degree p)"
  sorry




lemma constant_root_zero:
  "degree p = Nat_O \<Longrightarrow> is_root a p \<Longrightarrow> p = zero_p"
  sorry




lemma root_of_product:
  "is_root a (p *P q) \<Longrightarrow> is_root a p \<or> is_root a q"
  sorry




lemma root_scale_constant:
  "c \<noteq> zero_r \<Longrightarrow> (is_root a p \<longleftrightarrow> is_root a (C c *P p))"
  sorry




lemma poly_of_roots_nonzero: "poly_of_roots xs \<noteq> zero_p"
  sorry




lemma deg_poly_of_roots: "degree (poly_of_roots xs) = lengthL xs"
  sorry




lemma root_factor_list:
  "NoDupL xs \<Longrightarrow> (\<forall>a. InL a xs \<longrightarrow> is_root a p) \<Longrightarrow>
   \<exists>q. p = q *P poly_of_roots xs"
  sorry




lemma degree_factorisation:
  "p = q *P poly_of_roots xs \<Longrightarrow> q \<noteq> zero_p \<Longrightarrow>
   degree p = mynat_add (degree q) (lengthL xs)"
  sorry
end

end

title: polynomial
polynomial
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact polynomial: degree,
;; evaluation, linear root factors, products of roots, and the distinct-roots
;; bound over a generic commutative ring/polynomial interface with no zero
;; divisors. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent the arbitrary coefficient ring,
;; polynomial ring, degree, monomial, and evaluation operations.  Ring tags
;; select carriers and operations; an interface tag selects degree, monomial,
;; and evaluation functions.  Every typing and algebraic law is explicit in
;; the predicates below.

(defstub bf-polynomial-element-p (ring value) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-zero (ring) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-one (ring) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-opp (ring value) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-add (ring left right) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-mul (ring left right) t)

(defstub bf-polynomial-degree (interface polynomial) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-monomial (interface degree coefficient) t)
(defstub bf-polynomial-eval (interface polynomial coefficient) t)

(defun bf-polynomial-c (interface coefficient)
  (bf-polynomial-monomial interface 0 coefficient))

(defun bf-polynomial-x (interface coefficient-ring)
  (bf-polynomial-monomial
   interface 1 (bf-polynomial-one coefficient-ring)))

(defun bf-polynomial-x-minus
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring a)
  (bf-polynomial-add
   polynomial-ring
   (bf-polynomial-x interface coefficient-ring)
   (bf-polynomial-c
    interface (bf-polynomial-opp coefficient-ring a))))

(defun bf-polynomial-root-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial a)
  (equal
   (bf-polynomial-eval interface polynomial a)
   (bf-polynomial-zero coefficient-ring)))

;; Native ACL2 naturals and proper lists are constructor-preserving encodings
;; of the source mynat and mylist datatypes.

(defun bf-polynomial-ring-list-p (ring xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (bf-polynomial-element-p ring (car xs))
       (bf-polynomial-ring-list-p ring (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun bf-polynomial-member-p (value xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (or
       (equal value (car xs))
       (bf-polynomial-member-p value (cdr xs)))
    nil))

(defun bf-polynomial-no-duplicates-p (xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (and
       (not (bf-polynomial-member-p (car xs) (cdr xs)))
       (bf-polynomial-no-duplicates-p (cdr xs)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun bf-polynomial-poly-of-roots
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring xs)
  (if (consp xs)
      (bf-polynomial-mul
       polynomial-ring
       (bf-polynomial-x-minus
        interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring (car xs))
       (bf-polynomial-poly-of-roots
        interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring (cdr xs)))
    (bf-polynomial-one polynomial-ring)))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-all-roots-p
    (interface coefficient-ring xs polynomial)
  (forall (a)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-polynomial-element-p coefficient-ring a)
      (bf-polynomial-member-p a xs))
     (bf-polynomial-root-p
      interface coefficient-ring polynomial a))))

;; The source ring class is a commutative ring with one distinct from zero and
;; no zero divisors.  Closure conditions make the source typing explicit in
;; ACL2's untyped logic.

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (bf-polynomial-element-p ring x)
      (and
       (bf-polynomial-element-p
        ring (bf-polynomial-opp ring x))
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-add
         ring x (bf-polynomial-zero ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-add
         ring x (bf-polynomial-opp ring x))
        (bf-polynomial-zero ring))
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-mul
         ring x (bf-polynomial-one ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-mul
         ring x (bf-polynomial-zero ring))
        (bf-polynomial-zero ring))))
     (implies
      (and
       (bf-polynomial-element-p ring x)
       (bf-polynomial-element-p ring y))
      (and
       (bf-polynomial-element-p
        ring (bf-polynomial-add ring x y))
       (bf-polynomial-element-p
        ring (bf-polynomial-mul ring x y))
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-add ring x y)
        (bf-polynomial-add ring y x))
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-mul ring x y)
        (bf-polynomial-mul ring y x))
       (implies
        (equal
         (bf-polynomial-mul ring x y)
         (bf-polynomial-zero ring))
        (or
         (equal x (bf-polynomial-zero ring))
         (equal y (bf-polynomial-zero ring))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (bf-polynomial-element-p ring x)
       (bf-polynomial-element-p ring y)
       (bf-polynomial-element-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-add
         ring (bf-polynomial-add ring x y) z)
        (bf-polynomial-add
         ring x (bf-polynomial-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-mul
         ring (bf-polynomial-mul ring x y) z)
        (bf-polynomial-mul
         ring x (bf-polynomial-mul ring y z)))
       (equal
        (bf-polynomial-mul
         ring x (bf-polynomial-add ring y z))
        (bf-polynomial-add
         ring
         (bf-polynomial-mul ring x y)
         (bf-polynomial-mul ring x z))))))))

(defun bf-polynomial-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (bf-polynomial-element-p
    ring (bf-polynomial-zero ring))
   (bf-polynomial-element-p
    ring (bf-polynomial-one ring))
   (not
    (equal
     (bf-polynomial-one ring)
     (bf-polynomial-zero ring)))
   (bf-polynomial-ring-laws-p ring)))

;; These helpers retain the source existential quantifiers used by the
;; degree-zero characterization and division by a linear factor.

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-constant-representation-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial)
  (exists (coefficient)
    (and
     (bf-polynomial-element-p coefficient-ring coefficient)
     (equal
      polynomial
      (bf-polynomial-c interface coefficient)))))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-linear-division-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring polynomial a)
  (exists (quotient remainder)
    (and
     (bf-polynomial-element-p polynomial-ring quotient)
     (bf-polynomial-element-p polynomial-ring remainder)
     (equal
      polynomial
      (bf-polynomial-add
       polynomial-ring
       (bf-polynomial-mul
        polynomial-ring
        quotient
        (bf-polynomial-x-minus
         interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring a))
       remainder))
     (equal
      (bf-polynomial-degree interface remainder)
      0))))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-monomial-closure-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring)
  (forall (n c)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (bf-polynomial-element-p coefficient-ring c))
     (bf-polynomial-element-p
      polynomial-ring
      (bf-polynomial-monomial interface n c)))))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-degree-closure-p
    (interface polynomial-ring)
  (forall (p)
    (implies
     (bf-polynomial-element-p polynomial-ring p)
     (natp (bf-polynomial-degree interface p)))))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-eval-closure-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring)
  (forall (p x)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-polynomial-element-p polynomial-ring p)
      (bf-polynomial-element-p coefficient-ring x))
     (bf-polynomial-element-p
      coefficient-ring
      (bf-polynomial-eval interface p x)))))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-eval-add-law-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring)
  (forall (p q x)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-polynomial-element-p polynomial-ring p)
      (bf-polynomial-element-p polynomial-ring q)
      (bf-polynomial-element-p coefficient-ring x))
     (equal
      (bf-polynomial-eval
       interface
       (bf-polynomial-add polynomial-ring p q)
       x)
      (bf-polynomial-add
       coefficient-ring
       (bf-polynomial-eval interface p x)
       (bf-polynomial-eval interface q x))))))

(defun-sk bf-polynomial-eval-mul-law-p
    (interface coefficient-ring polynomial-ring)

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic polynomial. This file contains no
-- proof.

module polynomial where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 2 _∨_
infix 1 _↔_

data ⊥ : Set where

_≠_ : ∀ {a} {A : Set a} → A → A → Set a
x ≠ y = x ≡ y → ⊥

record _∧_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _∨_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record _↔_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data MyNat : Set where
  zeroN : MyNat
  succN : MyNat → MyNat

mynat-add : MyNat → MyNat → MyNat
mynat-add zeroN     m = m
mynat-add (succN n) m = succN (mynat-add n m)

data MyNatLe : MyNat → MyNat → Set where
  le-refl : (n : MyNat) → MyNatLe n n
  le-step : {n m : MyNat} → MyNatLe n m → MyNatLe n (succN m)

mynat-add-zero-left : Set
mynat-add-zero-left =
  (m : MyNat) → mynat-add zeroN m ≡ m

mynat-add-succ-left : Set
mynat-add-succ-left =
  (n m : MyNat) →
  mynat-add (succN n) m ≡ succN (mynat-add n m)

mynat-zero-le : Set
mynat-zero-le =
  (n : MyNat) → MyNatLe zeroN n

mynat-add-zero-right : Set
mynat-add-zero-right =
  (n : MyNat) → mynat-add n zeroN ≡ n

mynat-succ-le-succ : Set
mynat-succ-le-succ =
  (n m : MyNat) →
  MyNatLe n m →
  MyNatLe (succN n) (succN m)

mynat-add-succ-right : Set
mynat-add-succ-right =
  (m n : MyNat) →
  mynat-add m (succN n) ≡ succN (mynat-add m n)

mynat-add-comm : Set
mynat-add-comm =
  (n m : MyNat) → mynat-add n m ≡ mynat-add m n

data MyList {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  nilL  : MyList A
  consL : A → MyList A → MyList A

data InL {a : Level} {A : Set a} (x : A) : MyList A → Set a where
  in-head : {xs : MyList A} → InL x (consL x xs)
  in-tail : {y : A} {xs : MyList A} →
            InL x xs → InL x (consL y xs)

data NoDupL {a : Level} {A : Set a} : MyList A → Set a where
  nd-nil  : NoDupL nilL
  nd-cons : {x : A} {xs : MyList A} →
            (InL x xs → ⊥) →
            NoDupL xs →
            NoDupL (consL x xs)

lengthL : ∀ {a} {A : Set a} → MyList A → MyNat
lengthL nilL         = zeroN
lengthL (consL _ xs) = succN (lengthL xs)

record Ring {ℓ : Level} (A : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    zero : A
    opp  : A → A
    one  : A
    add  : A → A → A
    mul  : A → A → A

    one-neq-zero : one ≠ zero

    add-comm  : (x y : A) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : A) →
                add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero  : (x : A) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-opp   : (x : A) → add x (opp x) ≡ zero

    mul-comm  : (x y : A) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc : (x y z : A) →
                mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one   : (x : A) → mul x one ≡ x
    dist-left : (x y z : A) →
                mul x (add y z) ≡ add (mul x y) (mul x z)
    mul-zero  : (x : A) → mul x zero ≡ zero

    no-zero-divisors :
      (x y : A) →
      mul x y ≡ zero →
      (x ≡ zero) ∨ (y ≡ zero)

module RingStatements
  {ℓ : Level} {A : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Ring A) where

  open Ring structure

  sub-eq-zero-left : Set ℓ
  sub-eq-zero-left =
    (a b : A) →
    add a (opp b) ≡ zero →
    a ≡ b

record PolynomialStructure
  {ℓR ℓP : Level} {R : Set ℓR} {P : Set ℓP}
  (base : Ring R) (poly : Ring P) : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP) where

  field
    degree   : P → MyNat
    monomial : MyNat → R → P
    eval     : P → R → R

    C-zero :
      monomial zeroN (Ring.zero base) ≡ Ring.zero poly
    C-one :
      monomial zeroN (Ring.one base) ≡ Ring.one poly
    deg-zero :
      degree (Ring.zero poly) ≡ zeroN

    eval-add :
      (p q : P) (x : R) →
      eval (Ring.add poly p q) x ≡
      Ring.add base (eval p x) (eval q x)
    eval-mul :
      (p q : P) (x : R) →
      eval (Ring.mul poly p q) x ≡
      Ring.mul base (eval p x) (eval q x)
    eval-C :
      (c x : R) →
      eval (monomial zeroN c) x ≡ c
    eval-X :
      (x : R) →
      eval (monomial (succN zeroN) (Ring.one base)) x ≡ x

    deg-C :
      (c : R) →
      c ≠ Ring.zero base →
      degree (monomial zeroN c) ≡ zeroN
    deg-constant :
      (p : P) →
      (degree p ≡ zeroN) ↔
      Σ R (λ c → p ≡ monomial zeroN c)
    deg-X-minus :
      (a : R) →
      degree
        (Ring.add poly
          (monomial (succN zeroN) (Ring.one base))
          (monomial zeroN (Ring.opp base a)))
      ≡ succN zeroN
    deg-mul :
      (p q : P) →
      p ≠ Ring.zero poly →
      q ≠ Ring.zero poly →
      degree (Ring.mul poly p q) ≡
      mynat-add (degree p) (degree q)

    euclid-X-minus :
      (p : P) (a : R) →
      Σ P (λ q →
        Σ P (λ r →
          (p ≡
            Ring.add poly
              (Ring.mul poly q
                (Ring.add poly
                  (monomial (succN zeroN) (Ring.one base))
                  (monomial zeroN (Ring.opp base a))))
              r)
          ∧ (degree r ≡ zeroN)))

module PolynomialStatements
  {ℓR ℓP : Level} {R : Set ℓR} {P : Set ℓP}
  (base : Ring R) (poly : Ring P)
  (structure : PolynomialStructure base poly) where

  open PolynomialStructure structure

  X : P
  X = monomial (succN zeroN) (Ring.one base)

  C : R → P
  C c = monomial zeroN c

  X-minus : R → P
  X-minus a =
    Ring.add poly X (C (Ring.opp base a))

  is-root : R → P → Set ℓR
  is-root a p = eval p a ≡ Ring.zero base

  poly-of-roots : MyList R → P
  poly-of-roots nilL =
    Ring.one poly
  poly-of-roots (consL a xs) =
    Ring.mul poly (X-minus a) (poly-of-roots xs)

  root-factor : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  root-factor =
    (p : P) (a : R) →
    is-root a p →
    Σ P (λ q → p ≡ Ring.mul poly q (X-minus a))

  root-transfer : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  root-transfer =
    (p q : P) (a b : R) →
    p ≡ Ring.mul poly q (X-minus a) →
    b ≠ a →
    is-root b p →
    is-root b q

  roots-le-degree : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  roots-le-degree =
    (p : P) (xs : MyList R) →
    NoDupL xs →
    ((a : R) → InL a xs → is-root a p) →
    p ≠ Ring.zero poly →
    MyNatLe (lengthL xs) (degree p)

  X-minus-nonzero : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  X-minus-nonzero =
    (a : R) → X-minus a ≠ Ring.zero poly

  constant-root-zero : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  constant-root-zero =
    (p : P) (a : R) →
    degree p ≡ zeroN →
    is-root a p →
    p ≡ Ring.zero poly

  root-of-product : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  root-of-product =
    (p q : P) (a : R) →
    is-root a (Ring.mul poly p q) →
    is-root a p ∨ is-root a q

  root-scale-constant : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  root-scale-constant =
    (p : P) (c a : R) →
    c ≠ Ring.zero base →
    is-root a p ↔
    is-root a (Ring.mul poly (C c) p)

  poly-of-roots-nonzero : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  poly-of-roots-nonzero =
    (xs : MyList R) →
    poly-of-roots xs ≠ Ring.zero poly

  deg-poly-of-roots : Set ℓR
  deg-poly-of-roots =
    (xs : MyList R) →
    degree (poly-of-roots xs) ≡ lengthL xs

  root-factor-list : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  root-factor-list =
    (p : P) (xs : MyList R) →
    NoDupL xs →
    ((a : R) → InL a xs → is-root a p) →
    Σ P (λ q → p ≡ Ring.mul poly q (poly-of-roots xs))

  degree-factorisation : Set (ℓR ⊔ ℓP)
  degree-factorisation =
    (p : P) (xs : MyList R) (q : P) →
    p ≡ Ring.mul poly q (poly-of-roots xs) →
    q ≠ Ring.zero poly →
    degree p ≡ mynat-add (degree q) (lengthL xs)

title: polynomial
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact polynomial:
  factorization by linear root factors and the bound on distinct roots of a
  nonzero polynomial over an abstract integral domain. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val babel_mynat_add_def = new_definition (
  "babel_mynat_add_def",
  ``babel_mynat_add (n : num) m = n + m``);

val babel_mynat_le_def = new_definition (
  "babel_mynat_le_def",
  ``babel_mynat_le (n : num) m <=> n <= m``);

val babel_InL_def = new_definition (
  "babel_InL_def",
  ``babel_InL (x : 'a) (xs : 'a list) <=> MEM x xs``);

val babel_NoDupL_def = new_definition (
  "babel_NoDupL_def",
  ``babel_NoDupL (xs : 'a list) <=> ALL_DISTINCT xs``);

val babel_lengthL_def = new_definition (
  "babel_lengthL_def",
  ``babel_lengthL (xs : 'a list) = LENGTH xs``);

val mynat_add_O_left =
  ``!(m : num). babel_mynat_add 0 m = m``;

val mynat_add_S_left =
  ``!(n : num) m.
      babel_mynat_add (SUC n) m = SUC (babel_mynat_add n m)``;

val mynat_zero_le =
  ``!(n : num). babel_mynat_le 0 n``;

val mynat_add_zero_r =
  ``!(n : num). babel_mynat_add n 0 = n``;

val mynat_succ_le_succ =
  ``!(n : num) m.
      babel_mynat_le n m ==> babel_mynat_le (SUC n) (SUC m)``;

val mynat_add_S_r =
  ``!(m : num) n.
      babel_mynat_add m (SUC n) = SUC (babel_mynat_add m n)``;

val mynat_add_comm =
  ``!(n : num) m. babel_mynat_add n m = babel_mynat_add m n``;

val babel_integral_domain_def = new_definition (
  "babel_integral_domain_def",
  ``babel_integral_domain
      (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (oppA : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      ~(oneA = zeroA) /\
      (!x y. addA x y = addA y x) /\
      (!x y z. addA (addA x y) z = addA x (addA y z)) /\
      (!x. addA x zeroA = x) /\
      (!x. addA x (oppA x) = zeroA) /\
      (!x y. mulA x y = mulA y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulA (mulA x y) z = mulA x (mulA y z)) /\
      (!x. mulA x oneA = x) /\
      (!x y z.
         mulA x (addA y z) = addA (mulA x y) (mulA x z)) /\
      (!x. mulA x zeroA = zeroA) /\
      (!x y. mulA x y = zeroA ==> x = zeroA \/ y = zeroA)``);

val babel_X_def = new_definition (
  "babel_X_def",
  ``babel_X (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p) (oneR : 'r) =
      monomial (SUC 0) oneR``);

val babel_C_def = new_definition (
  "babel_C_def",
  ``babel_C (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p) (c : 'r) =
      monomial 0 c``);

val babel_X_minus_def = new_definition (
  "babel_X_minus_def",
  ``babel_X_minus
      (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p) (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (oneR : 'r) (a : 'r) =
      addP (babel_X monomial oneR) (babel_C monomial (oppR a))``);

val babel_is_root_def = new_definition (
  "babel_is_root_def",
  ``babel_is_root (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (zeroR : 'r)
      (a : 'r) (p : 'p) <=>
      eval p a = zeroR``);

val babel_poly_of_roots_def = new_definition (
  "babel_poly_of_roots_def",
  ``babel_poly_of_roots
      (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p) (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (oneP : 'p) (xs : 'r list) =
      FOLDR
        (\a acc. mulP (babel_X_minus monomial addP oppR oneR a) acc)
        oneP xs``);

val babel_poly_context_def = new_definition (
  "babel_poly_context_def",
  ``babel_poly_context
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      babel_integral_domain zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR /\
      babel_integral_domain zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP /\
      babel_C monomial zeroR = zeroP /\
      babel_C monomial oneR = oneP /\
      degree zeroP = 0 /\
      (!p q x. eval (addP p q) x = addR (eval p x) (eval q x)) /\
      (!p q x. eval (mulP p q) x = mulR (eval p x) (eval q x)) /\
      (!c x. eval (babel_C monomial c) x = c) /\
      (!x. eval (babel_X monomial oneR) x = x) /\
      (!c. ~(c = zeroR) ==> degree (babel_C monomial c) = 0) /\
      (!p. degree p = 0 <=> ?c. p = babel_C monomial c) /\
      (!a.
         degree (babel_X_minus monomial addP oppR oneR a) = SUC 0) /\
      (!p q.
         ~(p = zeroP) /\ ~(q = zeroP) ==>
         degree (mulP p q) =
           babel_mynat_add (degree p) (degree q)) /\
      (!p a.
         ?q r.
           p =
             addP
               (mulP q (babel_X_minus monomial addP oppR oneR a))
               r /\
           degree r = 0)``);

val sub_eq_zero_l =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) (a : 'r) b.
      babel_integral_domain zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR ==>
      addR a (oppR b) = zeroR ==>
      a = b``;

val root_factor =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) (a : 'r).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      babel_is_root eval zeroR a p ==>
      ?q. p = mulP q (babel_X_minus monomial addP oppR oneR a)``;

val root_transfer =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) q (a : 'r) b.
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      p = mulP q (babel_X_minus monomial addP oppR oneR a) ==>
      ~(b = a) ==>
      babel_is_root eval zeroR b p ==>
      babel_is_root eval zeroR b q``;

val roots_le_degree =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) (xs : 'r list).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      babel_NoDupL xs ==>
      (!a. babel_InL a xs ==> babel_is_root eval zeroR a p) ==>
      ~(p = zeroP) ==>
      babel_mynat_le (babel_lengthL xs) (degree p)``;

val X_minus_nonzero =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (a : 'r).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      ~(babel_X_minus monomial addP oppR oneR a = zeroP)``;

val constant_root_zero =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) (a : 'r).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      degree p = 0 ==>
      babel_is_root eval zeroR a p ==>
      p = zeroP``;

val root_of_product =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) q (a : 'r).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      babel_is_root eval zeroR a (mulP p q) ==>
      babel_is_root eval zeroR a p \/
      babel_is_root eval zeroR a q``;

val root_scale_constant =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) (c : 'r) a.
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      ~(c = zeroR) ==>
      (babel_is_root eval zeroR a p <=>
       babel_is_root eval zeroR a (mulP (babel_C monomial c) p))``;

val poly_of_roots_nonzero =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (xs : 'r list).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      ~(babel_poly_of_roots monomial addP oppR oneR mulP oneP xs =
        zeroP)``;

val deg_poly_of_roots =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (xs : 'r list).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      degree
        (babel_poly_of_roots monomial addP oppR oneR mulP oneP xs) =
      babel_lengthL xs``;

val root_factor_list =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r) (p : 'p) (xs : 'r list).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      babel_NoDupL xs ==>
      (!a. babel_InL a xs ==> babel_is_root eval zeroR a p) ==>
      ?q.
        p =
          mulP q
            (babel_poly_of_roots
              monomial addP oppR oneR mulP oneP xs)``;

val degree_factorisation =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroP : 'p) (oneP : 'p)
      (addP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p) (mulP : 'p -> 'p -> 'p)
      (oppP : 'p -> 'p)
      (degree : 'p -> num) (monomial : num -> 'r -> 'p)
      (eval : 'p -> 'r -> 'r)
      (p : 'p) (xs : 'r list) (q : 'p).
      babel_poly_context zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR
        zeroP oneP addP mulP oppP degree monomial eval ==>
      p =
        mulP q
          (babel_poly_of_roots monomial addP oppR oneR mulP oneP xs) ==>
      ~(q = zeroP) ==>
      degree p =
        babel_mynat_add (degree q) (babel_lengthL xs)``;

val _ = export_theory();

title: polynomial
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal polynomial artifact:
  roots, linear factors, products of roots, and the bound on distinct roots
  by polynomial degree. This file contains no proof.
$)

$(
  This many-sorted second-order encoding keeps the source's custom naturals,
  coefficient values, polynomials, and coefficient lists distinct. Binder
  positions have atomic variable-only syntactic classes. Typed equality is
  Leibniz equality, the two ring and polynomial contexts are exact
  biconditional packages, and the inductive objects and predicates use
  free-constructor and least-closure characterizations. Every mathematical
  declaration is an unproved $a statement; there are no $p statements.
$)

$c
  nvar rvar pvar lvar
  nat rterm pterm list
  npred rpred ppred lpred nrel rlrel
  wff |-
  ( )
  Nat_O Nat_S natAdd natLe NatInductive
  zeroR oneR oppR addR mulR
  zeroP oneP oppP addP mulP
  degree monomial eval X C Xminus
  NilL ConsL InL NoDupL lengthL ListInductive PolyRoots Root
  =N =R =P =L
  -. -> <-> /\ \/
  A.n A.r A.p A.l E.r E.p
  A.NP A.RP A.PP A.LP A.NR A.RL
  RingR RingP PolyContext
$.

$v
  nv mv kv av bv cv pv qv rv lv tv
  n m k a b c x y z p q r s xs ys
  un ur up ul unr url ph ps
$.

$d nv mv kv $.
$d av bv cv $.
$d pv qv rv $.
$d lv tv $.

nat-var-term $a nat nv $.

nat-zero-term $a nat Nat_O $.

r-one-term $a rterm oneR $.

forall-nat-formula $a wff ( A.n nv ph ) $.

nat-eq-formula $a wff ( n =N m ) $.
r-eq-formula $a wff ( a =R b ) $.

nat-le-formula $a wff ( natLe n m ) $.

list-inductive-formula $a wff ListInductive $.
ring-r-formula $a wff RingR $.
ring-p-formula $a wff RingP $.
poly-context-formula $a wff PolyContext $.

$(
  Typed Leibniz equality: two terms are equal exactly when every predicate
  of their sort has the same truth value on them.
$)
nat-equality-definition $a |- (
  ( n =N m ) <-> ( A.NP un ( ( un n ) <-> ( un m ) ) )
) $.
r-equality-definition $a |- (
  ( a =R b ) <-> ( A.RP ur ( ( ur a ) <-> ( ur b ) ) )
) $.

  ( p =P q ) <-> ( A.PP up ( ( up p ) <-> ( up q ) ) )
) $.
list-equality-definition $a |- (
  ( xs =L ys ) <-> ( A.LP ul ( ( ul xs ) <-> ( ul ys ) ) )
) $.

$(
  Explicit reflexivity and congruence give the Leibniz relations their
  required substitution behavior for every operation and predicate below.
$)
nat-equality-reflexive $a |- ( n =N n ) $.
r-equality-reflexive $a |- ( a =R a ) $.
p-equality-reflexive $a |- ( p =P p ) $.
list-equality-reflexive $a |- ( xs =L xs ) $.

${
  nat-succ-congruence-hyp $e |- ( n =N m ) $.
  nat-succ-congruence $a |- ( ( Nat_S n ) =N ( Nat_S m ) ) $.
$}
${
  nat-add-congruence-left-hyp $e |- ( n =N k ) $.
  nat-add-congruence-left $a |- (
    ( natAdd n m ) =N ( natAdd k m )
  ) $.
$}
${
  nat-add-congruence-right-hyp $e |- ( n =N k ) $.
  nat-add-congruence-right $a |- (
    ( natAdd m n ) =N ( natAdd m k )
  ) $.
$}
${
  nat-le-congruence-left-hyp $e |- ( n =N k ) $.
  nat-le-congruence-left $a |- (
    ( natLe n m ) <-> ( natLe k m )
  ) $.
$}

$(
  The custom natural sort is the free inductive algebra on Nat_O and Nat_S:
  the constructors are disjoint and injective, and every constructor-closed
  predicate contains every natural.
$)
nat-inductive-definition $a |- (
  NatInductive <->
  (
    ( A.n nv ( -. ( ( Nat_S nv ) =N Nat_O ) ) )
    /\
    (
      ( A.n nv ( A.n mv (
        ( ( Nat_S nv ) =N ( Nat_S mv ) ) -> ( nv =N mv )
      ) ) )
      /\
      ( A.NP un (
        (
          ( un Nat_O )
          /\
          ( A.n nv ( ( un nv ) -> ( un ( Nat_S nv ) ) ) )
        )
        ->
        ( A.n nv ( un nv ) )
      ) )
    )
  )
) $.
nat-inductive $a |- NatInductive $.

nat-add-o-def $a |- ( ( natAdd Nat_O m ) =N m ) $.
nat-add-s-def $a |- (
  ( natAdd ( Nat_S n ) m ) =N ( Nat_S ( natAdd n m ) )
) $.

$(
  natLe is the least relation containing reflexivity and closed under the
  source le_S constructor.
$)
nat-le-definition $a |- (
  ( natLe n m ) <->
  ( A.NR unr (
    (
      ( A.n nv ( unr nv nv ) )
      /\
      ( A.n nv ( A.n mv (
        ( unr nv mv ) -> ( unr nv ( Nat_S mv ) )
      ) ) )
    )
    ->
    ( unr n m )
  ) )
) $.

nat-le-refl $a |- ( natLe n n ) $.
${
  nat-le-step-hyp $e |- ( natLe n m ) $.
  nat-le-step $a |- ( natLe n ( Nat_S m ) ) $.
$}
mynat-add-o-left $a |- ( ( natAdd Nat_O m ) =N m ) $.
mynat-add-s-left $a |- (
  ( natAdd ( Nat_S n ) m ) =N ( Nat_S ( natAdd n m ) )
) $.
mynat-zero-le $a |- ( natLe Nat_O n ) $.
mynat-add-zero-r $a |- ( ( natAdd n Nat_O ) =N n ) $.
${
  mynat-succ-le-succ-hyp $e |- ( natLe n m ) $.
  mynat-succ-le-succ $a |- ( natLe ( Nat_S n ) ( Nat_S m ) ) $.
$}
mynat-add-s-r $a |- (
  ( natAdd m ( Nat_S n ) ) =N ( Nat_S ( natAdd m n ) )
) $.
mynat-add-comm $a |- (
  ( natAdd n m ) =N ( natAdd m n )
) $.

$(
  Coefficient lists are the free inductive algebra on NilL and ConsL.
$)
list-inductive-definition $a |- (
  ListInductive <->
  (
    ( A.r av ( A.l lv (
      -. ( ( ConsL av lv ) =L NilL )
    ) ) )
    /\
    (
      ( A.r av ( A.r bv ( A.l lv ( A.l tv (
        ( ( ConsL av lv ) =L ( ConsL bv tv ) )
        ->
        ( ( av =R bv ) /\ ( lv =L tv ) )
      ) ) ) ) )
      /\
      ( A.LP ul (
        (
          ( ul NilL )
          /\
          ( A.r av ( A.l lv (
            ( ul lv ) -> ( ul ( ConsL av lv ) )
          ) ) )
        )
        ->
        ( A.l lv ( ul lv ) )
      ) )
    )
  )
) $.
list-inductive $a |- ListInductive $.

$(
  InL and NoDupL are their source inductive predicates, expressed as
  intersections of all relations or predicates closed under the constructors.
$)
in-list-definition $a |- (
  ( InL a xs ) <->
  ( A.RL url (
    (
      ( A.r av ( A.l lv ( url av ( ConsL av lv ) ) ) )
      /\
      ( A.r av ( A.r bv ( A.l lv (
        ( url av lv ) -> ( url av ( ConsL bv lv ) )
      ) ) ) )
    )
    ->
    ( url a xs )
  ) )
) $.

no-dup-definition $a |- (
  ( NoDupL xs ) <->
  ( A.LP ul (
    (
      ( ul NilL )
      /\
      ( A.r av ( A.l lv (
        (
          ( -. ( InL av lv ) )
          /\
          ( ul lv )
        )
        ->
        ( ul ( ConsL av lv ) )
      ) ) )
    )
    ->
    ( ul xs )
  ) )
) $.

in-list-head $a |- ( InL a ( ConsL a xs ) ) $.
${
  in-list-tail-hyp $e |- ( InL a xs ) $.
  in-list-tail $a |- ( InL a ( ConsL b xs ) ) $.
$}
no-dup-nil $a |- ( NoDupL NilL ) $.
${

  no-dup-cons-tail-hyp $e |- ( NoDupL xs ) $.
  no-dup-cons $a |- ( NoDupL ( ConsL a xs ) ) $.
$}
length-nil-def $a |- ( ( lengthL NilL ) =N Nat_O ) $.
length-cons-def $a |- (
  ( lengthL ( ConsL a xs ) ) =N ( Nat_S ( lengthL xs ) )
) $.

$(
  RingR and RingP are definitionally equivalent to exactly the source class
  fields, with all source universal scopes explicit.
$)
ring-r-definition $a |- (
  RingR <->
  (
    ( -. ( oneR =R zeroR ) )
    /\
    (
      ( A.r av ( A.r bv (
        ( addR av bv ) =R ( addR bv av )
      ) ) )
      /\
      (
        ( A.r av ( A.r bv ( A.r cv (
          ( addR ( addR av bv ) cv )
          =R
          ( addR av ( addR bv cv ) )
        ) ) ) )
        /\
        (
          ( A.r av ( ( addR av zeroR ) =R av ) )
          /\
          (
            ( A.r av ( ( addR av ( oppR av ) ) =R zeroR ) )
            /\
            (
              ( A.r av ( A.r bv (
                ( mulR av bv ) =R ( mulR bv av )
              ) ) )
              /\
              (
                ( A.r av ( A.r bv ( A.r cv (
                  ( mulR ( mulR av bv ) cv )
                  =R
                  ( mulR av ( mulR bv cv ) )
                ) ) ) )
                /\
                (
                  ( A.r av ( ( mulR av oneR ) =R av ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( A.r av ( A.r bv ( A.r cv (
                      ( mulR av ( addR bv cv ) )
                      =R
                      ( addR ( mulR av bv ) ( mulR av cv ) )
                    ) ) ) )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( A.r av ( ( mulR av zeroR ) =R zeroR ) )
                      /\
                      ( A.r av ( A.r bv (
                        ( ( mulR av bv ) =R zeroR )
                        ->
                        ( ( av =R zeroR ) \/ ( bv =R zeroR ) )
                      ) ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

ring-p-definition $a |- (
  RingP <->
  (
    ( -. ( oneP =P zeroP ) )
    /\
    (
      ( A.p pv ( A.p qv (
        ( addP pv qv ) =P ( addP qv pv )
      ) ) )
      /\
      (
        ( A.p pv ( A.p qv ( A.p rv (
          ( addP ( addP pv qv ) rv )
          =P
          ( addP pv ( addP qv rv ) )
        ) ) ) )
        /\
        (
          ( A.p pv ( ( addP pv zeroP ) =P pv ) )
          /\
          (
            ( A.p pv ( ( addP pv ( oppP pv ) ) =P zeroP ) )
            /\
            (
              ( A.p pv ( A.p qv (
                ( mulP pv qv ) =P ( mulP qv pv )
              ) ) )
              /\
              (
                ( A.p pv ( A.p qv ( A.p rv (
                  ( mulP ( mulP pv qv ) rv )
                  =P
                  ( mulP pv ( mulP qv rv ) )
                ) ) ) )
                /\
                (
                  ( A.p pv ( ( mulP pv oneP ) =P pv ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( A.p pv ( A.p qv ( A.p rv (
                      ( mulP pv ( addP qv rv ) )
                      =P
                      ( addP ( mulP pv qv ) ( mulP pv rv ) )
                    ) ) ) )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( A.p pv ( ( mulP pv zeroP ) =P zeroP ) )
                      /\
                      ( A.p pv ( A.p qv (
                        ( ( mulP pv qv ) =P zeroP )
                        ->
                        ( ( pv =P zeroP ) \/ ( qv =P zeroP ) )
                      ) ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

x-def $a |- ( X =P ( monomial ( Nat_S Nat_O ) oneR ) ) $.
c-def $a |- ( ( C a ) =P ( monomial Nat_O a ) ) $.
xminus-def $a |- (
  ( Xminus a ) =P ( addP X ( C ( oppR a ) ) )
) $.
root-def $a |- (
  ( Root a p ) <-> ( ( eval p a ) =R zeroR )
) $.
poly-roots-nil-def $a |- (
  ( PolyRoots NilL ) =P oneP
) $.
poly-roots-cons-def $a |- (
  ( PolyRoots ( ConsL a xs ) )
  =P
  ( mulP ( Xminus a ) ( PolyRoots xs ) )
) $.

$(
  PolyContext is exactly the two source ring structures and every primitive
  polynomial axiom. No additional or hidden assumption is packaged by it.
$)
poly-context-definition $a |- (
  PolyContext <->
  (
    RingR
    /\
    (
      RingP
      /\
      (
        ( ( C zeroR ) =P zeroP )
        /\
        (
          ( ( C oneR ) =P oneP )
          /\
          (
            ( ( degree zeroP ) =N Nat_O )
            /\
            (
              ( A.p pv ( A.p qv ( A.r av (
                ( eval ( addP pv qv ) av )
                =R
                ( addR ( eval pv av ) ( eval qv av ) )
              ) ) ) )
              /\
              (
                ( A.p pv ( A.p qv ( A.r av (
                  ( eval ( mulP pv qv ) av )
                  =R
                  ( mulR ( eval pv av ) ( eval qv av ) )
                ) ) ) )
                /\
                (
                  ( A.r av ( A.r bv (
                    ( eval ( C av ) bv ) =R av
                  ) ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( A.r av ( ( eval X av ) =R av ) )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( A.r av (
                        ( -. ( av =R zeroR ) )
                        ->
                        ( ( degree ( C av ) ) =N Nat_O )
                      ) )
                      /\
                      (
                        ( A.p pv (
                          ( ( degree pv ) =N Nat_O )
                          <->
                          ( E.r av ( pv =P ( C av ) ) )
                        ) )
                        /\
                        (
                          ( A.r av (
                            ( degree ( Xminus av ) )
                            =N
                            ( Nat_S Nat_O )
                          ) )
                          /\
                          (
                            ( A.p pv ( A.p qv (
                              (
                                ( -. ( pv =P zeroP ) )
                                /\
                                ( -. ( qv =P zeroP ) )
                              )
                              ->
                              (
                                ( degree ( mulP pv qv ) )
                                =N
                                ( natAdd ( degree pv ) ( degree qv ) )
                              )
                            ) ) )
                            /\
                            ( A.p pv ( A.r av (
                              E.p qv ( E.p rv (
                                (
                                  pv
                                  =P
                                  ( addP
                                    ( mulP qv ( Xminus av ) )
                                    rv
                                  )
                                )
                                /\
                                ( ( degree rv ) =N Nat_O )
                              ) )
                            ) ) )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  ring-r-hyp $e |- RingR $.
  r-one-neq-zero $a |- ( -. ( oneR =R zeroR ) ) $.
  r-add-comm $a |- ( ( addR a b ) =R ( addR b a ) ) $.
  r-add-assoc $a |- (
    ( addR ( addR a b ) c ) =R ( addR a ( addR b c ) )
  ) $.
  r-add-zero $a |- ( ( addR a zeroR ) =R a ) $.
  r-add-opp $a |- ( ( addR a ( oppR a ) ) =R zeroR ) $.
  r-mul-comm $a |- ( ( mulR a b ) =R ( mulR b a ) ) $.
  r-mul-assoc $a |- (
    ( mulR ( mulR a b ) c ) =R ( mulR a ( mulR b c ) )
  ) $.
  r-mul-one $a |- ( ( mulR a oneR ) =R a ) $.
  r-dist-left $a |- (
    ( mulR a ( addR b c ) )
    =R
    ( addR ( mulR a b ) ( mulR a c ) )
  ) $.
  r-mul-zero $a |- ( ( mulR a zeroR ) =R zeroR ) $.
  r-no-zero-div $a |- (
    ( ( mulR a b ) =R zeroR )
    ->
    ( ( a =R zeroR ) \/ ( b =R zeroR ) )
  ) $.
  ${
    sub-eq-zero-l-hyp $e |- (
      ( addR a ( oppR b ) ) =R zeroR
    ) $.
    sub-eq-zero-l $a |- ( a =R b ) $.
  $}
$}

${
  ring-p-hyp $e |- RingP $.
  p-one-neq-zero $a |- ( -. ( oneP =P zeroP ) ) $.
  p-add-comm $a |- ( ( addP p q ) =P ( addP q p ) ) $.
  p-add-assoc $a |- (
    ( addP ( addP p q ) r ) =P ( addP p ( addP q r ) )
  ) $.
  p-add-zero $a |- ( ( addP p zeroP ) =P p ) $.
  p-add-opp $a |- ( ( addP p ( oppP p ) ) =P zeroP ) $.
  p-mul-comm $a |- ( ( mulP p q ) =P ( mulP q p ) ) $.
  p-mul-assoc $a |- (
    ( mulP ( mulP p q ) r ) =P ( mulP p ( mulP q r ) )
  ) $.
  p-mul-one $a |- ( ( mulP p oneP ) =P p ) $.
  p-dist-left $a |- (
    ( mulP p ( addP q r ) )
    =P
    ( addP ( mulP p q ) ( mulP p r ) )
  ) $.
  p-mul-zero $a |- ( ( mulP p zeroP ) =P zeroP ) $.
  p-no-zero-div $a |- (
    ( ( mulP p q ) =P zeroP )
    ->
    ( ( p =P zeroP ) \/ ( q =P zeroP ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  poly-context-hyp $e |- PolyContext $.
  context-ring-r $a |- RingR $.
  context-ring-p $a |- RingP $.
  c-zero $a |- ( ( C zeroR ) =P zeroP ) $.
  c-one $a |- ( ( C oneR ) =P oneP ) $.
  deg-zero $a |- ( ( degree zeroP ) =N Nat_O ) $.
  eval-add $a |- (
    ( eval ( addP p q ) a )
    =R
    ( addR ( eval p a ) ( eval q a ) )
  ) $.
  eval-mul $a |- (
    ( eval ( mulP p q ) a )
    =R
    ( mulR ( eval p a ) ( eval q a ) )
  ) $.
  eval-c $a |- ( ( eval ( C c ) a ) =R c ) $.
  eval-x $a |- ( ( eval X a ) =R a ) $.
  deg-c $a |- (
    ( -. ( c =R zeroR ) )
    ->
    ( ( degree ( C c ) ) =N Nat_O )
  ) $.
  deg-constant $a |- (
    ( ( degree p ) =N Nat_O )
    <->
    ( E.r av ( p =P ( C av ) ) )
  ) $.
  deg-xminus $a |- (
    ( degree ( Xminus a ) ) =N ( Nat_S Nat_O )
  ) $.
  deg-mul $a |- (
    (
      ( -. ( p =P zeroP ) )
      /\
      ( -. ( q =P zeroP ) )
    )
    ->
    (
      ( degree ( mulP p q ) )
      =N
      ( natAdd ( degree p ) ( degree q ) )
    )
  ) $.
  euclid-xminus $a |- (
    E.p qv ( E.p rv (
      (
        p =P ( addP ( mulP qv ( Xminus a ) ) rv )
      )
      /\
      ( ( degree rv ) =N Nat_O )
    ) )
  ) $.

  ${
    root-factor-root-hyp $e |- ( Root a p ) $.
    root-factor $a |- (
      E.p qv ( p =P ( mulP qv ( Xminus a ) ) )
    ) $.
  $}

  ${
    root-transfer-factor-hyp $e |- (
      p =P ( mulP q ( Xminus a ) )
    ) $.
    root-transfer-distinct-hyp $e |- ( -. ( b =R a ) ) $.
    root-transfer-root-hyp $e |- ( Root b p ) $.
    root-transfer $a |- ( Root b q ) $.
  $}

  ${
    roots-le-degree-nodup-hyp $e |- ( NoDupL xs ) $.
    roots-le-degree-roots-hyp $e |- (
      A.r av ( ( InL av xs ) -> ( Root av p ) )
    ) $.
    roots-le-degree-nonzero-hyp $e |- ( -. ( p =P zeroP ) ) $.
    roots-le-degree $a |- (
      natLe ( lengthL xs ) ( degree p )
    ) $.
  $}

  xminus-nonzero $a |- ( -. ( ( Xminus a ) =P zeroP ) ) $.

  ${
    constant-root-zero-degree-hyp $e |- (
      ( degree p ) =N Nat_O
    ) $.
    constant-root-zero-root-hyp $e |- ( Root a p ) $.
    constant-root-zero $a |- ( p =P zeroP ) $.
  $}

  ${
    root-of-product-hyp $e |- ( Root a ( mulP p q ) ) $.
    root-of-product $a |- (
      ( Root a p ) \/ ( Root a q )
    ) $.
  $}

  ${
    root-scale-constant-nonzero-hyp $e |- (
      -. ( c =R zeroR )
    ) $.
    root-scale-constant $a |- (
      ( Root a p )
      <->
      ( Root a ( mulP ( C c ) p ) )
    ) $.
  $}

  poly-roots-nonzero $a |- (
    -. ( ( PolyRoots xs ) =P zeroP )
  ) $.

  deg-poly-roots $a |- (
    ( degree ( PolyRoots xs ) ) =N ( lengthL xs )
  ) $.

  ${
    root-factor-list-nodup-hyp $e |- ( NoDupL xs ) $.
    root-factor-list-roots-hyp $e |- (
      A.r av ( ( InL av xs ) -> ( Root av p ) )
    ) $.
    root-factor-list $a |- (
      E.p qv ( p =P ( mulP qv ( PolyRoots xs ) ) )
    ) $.
  $}

  ${
    degree-factorisation-factor-hyp $e |- (
      p =P ( mulP q ( PolyRoots xs ) )
    ) $.
    degree-factorisation-nonzero-hyp $e |- (
      -. ( q =P zeroP )
    ) $.
    degree-factorisation $a |- (
      ( degree p )
      =N
      ( natAdd ( degree q ) ( lengthL xs ) )
    ) $.
  $}
$}
