content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic polynomial. This file contains no
:: proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, ZFMISC_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, NAT_1, NUMBERS, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL4,
    XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, ARYTM_3, CARD_1, BINOP_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XXREAL_0, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, BINOP_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1,
    XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1, BINOP_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

:: The custom natural numbers are represented by Mizar's native naturals.
::$P-
theorem
  (for n being Nat holds 0 + n = n) &
  (for n,m being Nat holds (n + 1) + m = (n + m) + 1) &
  (for n being Nat holds 0 <= n) &
  (for n being Nat holds n + 0 = n) &
  (for n,m being Nat st n <= m holds n + 1 <= m + 1) &
  (for m,n being Nat holds m + (n + 1) = (m + n) + 1) &
  (for n,m being Nat holds n + m = m + n)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Abstract polynomial context and its root/factorization consequences.
::$P-
theorem
  for R,P being non empty set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      oppR being UnOp of R,
      zeroP,oneP being Element of P,
      addP,mulP being BinOp of P,
      oppP being UnOp of P,
      degree being Function of P,NAT,
      monomial being Function of [:NAT,R:],P,
      eval being Function of [:P,R:],R,
      xminus being Function of R,P,
      rootProd being Function of R*,P
  st
    oneR <> zeroR &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,y) = addR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(x,y),z) = addR.(x,addR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,zeroR) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,oppR.x) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,y) = mulR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(x,y),z) = mulR.(x,mulR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,oneR) = x) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,addR.(y,z)) =
        addR.(mulR.(x,y),mulR.(x,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,zeroR) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R st
      mulR.(x,y) = zeroR
      holds x = zeroR or y = zeroR) &
    oneP <> zeroP &
    (for x,y being Element of P holds
      addP.(x,y) = addP.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of P holds
      addP.(addP.(x,y),z) = addP.(x,addP.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      addP.(x,zeroP) = x) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      addP.(x,oppP.x) = zeroP) &
    (for x,y being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,y) = mulP.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of P holds
      mulP.(mulP.(x,y),z) = mulP.(x,mulP.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,oneP) = x) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,addP.(y,z)) =
        addP.(mulP.(x,y),mulP.(x,z))) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,zeroP) = zeroP) &
    (for x,y being Element of P st
      mulP.(x,y) = zeroP
      holds x = zeroP or y = zeroP) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      xminus.a =
        addP.(monomial.(1,oneR),monomial.(0,oppR.a))) &
    monomial.(0,zeroR) = zeroP &
    monomial.(0,oneR) = oneP &
    degree.zeroP = 0 &
    (for p,q being Element of P, x being Element of R holds
      eval.(addP.(p,q),x) =
        addR.(eval.(p,x),eval.(q,x))) &
    (for p,q being Element of P, x being Element of R holds
      eval.(mulP.(p,q),x) =
        mulR.(eval.(p,x),eval.(q,x))) &
    (for c,x being Element of R holds
      eval.(monomial.(0,c),x) = c) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      eval.(monomial.(1,oneR),x) = x) &
    (for c being Element of R st c <> zeroR holds
      degree.(monomial.(0,c)) = 0) &
    (for p being Element of P holds
      degree.p = 0 iff
        ex c being Element of R st p = monomial.(0,c)) &
    (for a being Element of R holds degree.(xminus.a) = 1) &
    (for p,q being Element of P st p <> zeroP & q <> zeroP holds
      degree.(mulP.(p,q)) = degree.p + degree.q) &
    (for p being Element of P, a being Element of R
      ex q,r being Element of P st
        p = addP.(mulP.(q,xminus.a),r) & degree.r = 0) &
    rootProd.(<*>R) = oneP &
    (for a being Element of R, xs being FinSequence of R holds
      rootProd.(<*a*>^xs) =
        mulP.(xminus.a,rootProd.xs))
  holds
    (for a,b being Element of R st
      addR.(a,oppR.b) = zeroR
      holds a = b) &
    (for p being Element of P, a being Element of R st
      eval.(p,a) = zeroR
      holds ex q being Element of P st
        p = mulP.(q,xminus.a)) &
    (for p,q being Element of P, a,b being Element of R st
      p = mulP.(q,xminus.a) & b <> a & eval.(p,b) = zeroR
      holds eval.(q,b) = zeroR) &
    (for p being Element of P, xs being FinSequence of R st
      xs is one-to-one &
      (for a being Element of R st a in rng xs
        holds eval.(p,a) = zeroR) &
      p <> zeroP
      holds len xs <= degree.p) &
    (for a being Element of R holds xminus.a <> zeroP) &
    (for p being Element of P, a being Element of R st
      degree.p = 0 & eval.(p,a) = zeroR
      holds p = zeroP) &
    (for p,q being Element of P, a being Element of R st
      eval.(mulP.(p,q),a) = zeroR
      holds eval.(p,a) = zeroR or eval.(q,a) = zeroR) &
    (for p being Element of P, c,a being Element of R st
      c <> zeroR
      holds
        (eval.(p,a) = zeroR iff
          eval.(mulP.(monomial.(0,c),p),a) = zeroR)) &
    (for xs being FinSequence of R holds
      rootProd.xs <> zeroP) &
    (for xs being FinSequence of R holds
      degree.(rootProd.xs) = len xs) &
    (for p being Element of P, xs being FinSequence of R st
      xs is one-to-one &
      (for a being Element of R st a in rng xs
        holds eval.(p,a) = zeroR)
      holds ex q being Element of P st
        p = mulP.(q,rootProd.xs)) &
    (for p,q being Element of P, xs being FinSequence of R st
      p = mulP.(q,rootProd.xs) & q <> zeroP
      holds degree.p = degree.q + len xs)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: polynomial
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact polynomial: roots,
% factorization, and degree bounds in an integral-domain-style polynomial context.
% This file contains no proof.

polynomial[
  R: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  oppR: [R -> R],
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R],
  zeroP: P,
  oneP: P,
  oppP: [P -> P],
  addP: [P, P -> P],
  mulP: [P, P -> P],
  degree: [P -> nat],
  monomial: [nat, R -> P],
  eval: [P, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  mynat_add(n, m: nat): nat = n + m

  mynat_le(n, m: nat): bool = n <= m

  inL(a: R, xs: list[R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(b, ys): a = b OR inL(a, ys)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  noDupL(xs: list[R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(a, ys): NOT inL(a, ys) AND noDupL(ys)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  lengthL(xs: list[R]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES xs OF
      null: 0,
      cons(a, ys): lengthL(ys) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  mynat_add_O_left: bool =
    FORALL (m: nat): mynat_add(0, m) = m

  mynat_add_S_left: bool =
    FORALL (n, m: nat):
      mynat_add(n + 1, m) = mynat_add(n, m) + 1

  mynat_zero_le: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat): mynat_le(0, n)

  mynat_add_zero_r: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat): mynat_add(n, 0) = n

  mynat_succ_le_succ: bool =
    FORALL (n, m: nat):
      mynat_le(n, m) IMPLIES mynat_le(n + 1, m + 1)

  mynat_add_S_r: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      mynat_add(m, n + 1) = mynat_add(m, n) + 1

  mynat_add_comm: bool =
    FORALL (n, m: nat): mynat_add(n, m) = mynat_add(m, n)

  X: P = monomial(1, oneR)

  C(c: R): P = monomial(0, c)

  X_minus(a: R): P = addP(X, C(oppR(a)))

  is_root(a: R, p: P): bool = eval(p, a) = zeroR

  poly_of_roots(xs: list[R]): RECURSIVE P =
    CASES xs OF
      null: oneP,
      cons(a, ys): mulP(X_minus(a), poly_of_roots(ys))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  ringR_laws: bool =
    NOT (oneR = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, oppR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(x, addR(y, z)) =
          addR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, zeroR) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mulR(x, y) = zeroR IMPLIES
          x = zeroR OR y = zeroR)

  ringP_laws: bool =
    NOT (oneP = zeroP)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: P): addP(x, y) = addP(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: P):
        addP(addP(x, y), z) = addP(x, addP(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: P): addP(x, zeroP) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: P): addP(x, oppP(x)) = zeroP)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: P): mulP(x, y) = mulP(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: P):
        mulP(mulP(x, y), z) = mulP(x, mulP(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: P): mulP(x, oneP) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: P):
        mulP(x, addP(y, z)) =
          addP(mulP(x, y), mulP(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: P): mulP(x, zeroP) = zeroP)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: P):
        mulP(x, y) = zeroP IMPLIES
          x = zeroP OR y = zeroP)

  polynomial_laws: bool =
    C(zeroR) = zeroP
      AND C(oneR) = oneP
      AND degree(zeroP) = 0
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P), (x: R):
        eval(addP(p, q), x) =
          addR(eval(p, x), eval(q, x)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P), (x: R):
        eval(mulP(p, q), x) =
          mulR(eval(p, x), eval(q, x)))
      AND (FORALL (c, x: R): eval(C(c), x) = c)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): eval(X, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (c: R):
        NOT (c = zeroR) IMPLIES degree(C(c)) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (p: P):
        (degree(p) = 0) =
          (EXISTS (c: R): p = C(c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R): degree(X_minus(a)) = 1)
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        NOT (p = zeroP) AND NOT (q = zeroP) IMPLIES
          degree(mulP(p, q)) =
            mynat_add(degree(p), degree(q)))
      AND (FORALL (p: P), (a: R):
        EXISTS (q, r: P):
          p = addP(mulP(q, X_minus(a)), r)
            AND degree(r) = 0)

  polynomial_context: bool =
    ringR_laws
      AND ringP_laws
      AND polynomial_laws

  sub_eq_zero_l: bool =
    ringR_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b: R):
        addR(a, oppR(b)) = zeroR IMPLIES a = b)

  root_factor: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: P), (a: R):
        is_root(a, p) IMPLIES
          (EXISTS (q: P): p = mulP(q, X_minus(a))))

  root_transfer: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q: P), (a, b: R):
        p = mulP(q, X_minus(a))
          AND NOT (b = a)
          AND is_root(b, p)
        IMPLIES is_root(b, q))

  roots_le_degree: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: P), (xs: list[R]):
        noDupL(xs)
          AND (FORALL (a: R):
            inL(a, xs) IMPLIES is_root(a, p))
          AND NOT (p = zeroP)
        IMPLIES mynat_le(lengthL(xs), degree(p)))

  X_minus_nonzero: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a: R): NOT (X_minus(a) = zeroP))

  constant_root_zero: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: P), (a: R):
        degree(p) = 0
          AND is_root(a, p)
        IMPLIES p = zeroP)

  root_of_product: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q: P), (a: R):
        is_root(a, mulP(p, q)) IMPLIES
          is_root(a, p) OR is_root(a, q))

  root_scale_constant: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: P), (c, a: R):
        NOT (c = zeroR) IMPLIES
          (is_root(a, p) =
            is_root(a, mulP(C(c), p))))

  poly_of_roots_nonzero: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (xs: list[R]):
        NOT (poly_of_roots(xs) = zeroP))

  deg_poly_of_roots: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (xs: list[R]):
        degree(poly_of_roots(xs)) = lengthL(xs))

  root_factor_list: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p: P), (xs: list[R]):
        noDupL(xs)
          AND (FORALL (a: R):
            inL(a, xs) IMPLIES is_root(a, p))
        IMPLIES
          (EXISTS (q: P):
            p = mulP(q, poly_of_roots(xs))))

  degree_factorisation: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p, q: P), (xs: list[R]):
        p = mulP(q, poly_of_roots(xs))
          AND NOT (q = zeroP)
        IMPLIES
          degree(p) =
            mynat_add(degree(q), lengthL(xs)))
END polynomial

title: probability
content:
inductive mynat : Type
| O  : mynat
| S  : mynat → mynat
deriving DecidableEq

open mynat

def mynat_add : mynat → mynat → mynat
| O,        m => m
| (S n'),   m => S (mynat_add n' m)

theorem mynat_add_O_left (m : mynat) :
  mynat_add O m = m := rfl

theorem mynat_add_S_left (n m : mynat) :
  mynat_add (S n) m = S (mynat_add n m) := rfl

inductive mylist (A : Type) : Type
| nilL  : mylist A
| consL : A → mylist A → mylist A

namespace mylist

notation h "::L" t => mylist.consL h t

def mapL {A B : Type} (f : A → B) : mylist A → mylist B
| mylist.nilL    => mylist.nilL
| (x ::L xs)     => f x ::L mapL f xs

def fold_add {R : Type} (add : R → R → R) (z : R) : mylist R → R
| mylist.nilL    => z
| (x ::L xs)     => add x (fold_add add z xs)

end mylist

open mylist

inductive InL {A : Type} (x : A) : mylist A → Prop
| In_head : ∀ xs, InL x (x ::L xs)
| In_tail : ∀ y xs, InL (x := x) xs → InL (x := x) (y ::L xs)

inductive NoDupL {A : Type} : mylist A → Prop
| ND_nil  : NoDupL mylist.nilL
| ND_cons : ∀ x xs, (¬ InL x xs) → NoDupL xs → NoDupL (x ::L xs)

class ring (R : Type) where
  (zero      : R)
  (opp       : R → R)
  (one       : R)
  (add       : R → R → R)
  (mul       : R → R → R)

  (one_neq_zero  : one ≠ zero)

  (add_comm  : ∀ x y,    add x y = add y x)
  (add_assoc : ∀ x y z,  add (add x y) z = add x (add y z))
  (add_zero  : ∀ x,      add x zero = x)
  (add_opp   : ∀ x,      add x (opp x) = zero)

  (mul_comm  : ∀ x y,    mul x y = mul y x)
  (mul_assoc : ∀ x y z,  mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z))
  (mul_one   : ∀ x,      mul x one = x)
  (dist_l    : ∀ x y z,  mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))
  (mul_zero  : ∀ x,      mul x zero = zero)

  (no_zero_div :
    ∀ x y, mul x y = zero → x = zero ∨ y = zero)

notation:35 "-R " x   => ring.opp x

section Probability

variable {R : Type} [rR : ring R]
variable {Ω : Type}

def event (Ω : Type) := Ω → Prop

def ev_false : event Ω := fun _ => False
def ev_true  : event Ω := fun _ => True

def ev_inter (A B : event Ω) : event Ω := fun ω => A ω ∧ B ω
def ev_union (A B : event Ω) : event Ω := fun ω => A ω ∨ B ω
def ev_compl (A : event Ω)   : event Ω := fun ω => ¬ A ω
def ev_diff (A B : event Ω)  : event Ω := fun ω => A ω ∧ ¬ B ω

theorem ev_inter_comm (A B : event Ω) : ∀ ω, (ev_inter A B) ω ↔ (ev_inter B A) ω := by sorry
theorem ev_union_comm (A B : event Ω) : ∀ ω, (ev_union A B) ω ↔ (ev_union B A) ω := by sorry
theorem ev_inter_assoc (A B C : event Ω) : ∀ ω,
  (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) C) ω ↔ (ev_inter A (ev_inter B C)) ω := by sorry
theorem ev_union_assoc (A B C : event Ω) : ∀ ω,
  (ev_union (ev_union A B) C) ω ↔ (ev_union A (ev_union B C)) ω := by sorry
theorem ev_inter_distrib_left (A B C : event Ω) : ∀ ω,
  (ev_inter A (ev_union B C)) ω ↔ (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A C)) ω := by sorry
def disjoint (A B : event Ω) : Prop := ∀ ω, ¬ ((ev_inter A B) ω)

def pairwise_disjoint : mylist (event Ω) → Prop
| mylist.nilL      => True
| (_ ::L mylist.nilL) => True
| (A ::L (B ::L xs))  => disjoint A B ∧ (∀ C, InL C (B ::L xs) → disjoint A C) ∧ pairwise_disjoint (B ::L xs)

def bigUnion : mylist (event Ω) → event Ω
| mylist.nilL      => ev_false
| (A ::L xs)       => ev_union A (bigUnion xs)

variable (prob : event Ω → R)

axiom prob_ext : ∀ {A B : event Ω}, (∀ ω, A ω ↔ B ω) → prob A = prob B
axiom prob_false : prob ev_false = rR.zero
axiom prob_true  : prob ev_true  = rR.one

axiom prob_union : ∀ (A B : event Ω),
  prob (ev_union A B) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob B) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))))

axiom prob_compl : ∀ (A : event Ω), prob (ev_compl A) = rR.add rR.one (rR.opp (prob A))

axiom em : ∀ p : Prop, p ∨ ¬ p

axiom cprob : event Ω → event Ω → R
axiom cprob_mul : ∀ A B, prob (ev_inter A B) = rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B)

def indep (A B : event Ω) : Prop := prob (ev_inter A B) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)

local notation:55 x " -R " y => rR.add x (rR.opp y)

axiom opp_zero  : rR.opp rR.zero = rR.zero
axiom opp_opp   : ∀ x, rR.opp (rR.opp x) = x
axiom opp_mul_right : ∀ x y, rR.mul x (rR.opp y) = rR.opp (rR.mul x y)
axiom opp_mul_left  : ∀ x y, rR.mul (rR.opp x) y = rR.opp (rR.mul x y)

axiom prob_union_disjoint : ∀ (A B : event Ω), disjoint A B → prob (ev_union A B) = rR.add (prob A) (prob B)
axiom disjoint_head_tail : ∀ (A : event Ω) (xs : mylist (event Ω)), pairwise_disjoint (A ::L xs) → disjoint A (bigUnion xs)

theorem prob_union_comm (A B : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A) := by sorry
theorem prob_union_idem (A : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union A A) = prob A := by sorry
theorem prob_diff (A B : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A -R prob (ev_inter A B) := by sorry
theorem bayes_symm (A B : event Ω) :
  rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B) = rR.mul (cprob B A) (prob A) := by sorry
theorem law_total_prob (A B : event Ω) :
  prob A = rR.add (rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B)) (rR.mul (cprob A (ev_compl B)) (prob (ev_compl B))) := by sorry
theorem prob_union_indep (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B →
  prob (ev_union A B) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob B) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)))) := by sorry
theorem indep_compl_right (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) A (ev_compl B) := by sorry
theorem indep_symm (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) B A := by sorry
theorem indep_compl_left (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) (ev_compl A) B := by sorry
axiom indep_compl_both (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) (ev_compl A) (ev_compl B)

theorem prob_bigUnion_disjoint
  (xs : mylist (event Ω))
  (hp : pairwise_disjoint xs) :
  prob (bigUnion xs)
    = mylist.fold_add rR.add rR.zero (mylist.mapL prob xs) := by sorry
theorem prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero
  (xs : mylist (event Ω))
  (hp : pairwise_disjoint xs)
  (hzero : ∀ A, InL A xs → prob A = rR.zero) :
  prob (bigUnion xs) = rR.zero := by sorry
axiom inclusion_exclusion_three (A B C : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union (ev_union A B) C)
    = rR.add (prob A)
      (rR.add (prob B)
        (rR.add (prob C)
          (rR.opp (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B))
                 (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A C))
                         (rR.add (prob (ev_inter B C))
                                 (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) C)))))))))

end Probability

title: probability
content:
Inductive mynat : Type :=
| O : mynat
| S : mynat -> mynat.

Inductive mylist (A : Type) : Type :=
| nilL  : mylist A
| consL : A -> mylist A -> mylist A.

Arguments nilL  {A}.
Arguments consL {A} _ _.
Infix "::L" := consL (at level 60, right associativity).

Inductive InL {A : Type} (x : A) : mylist A -> Prop :=
| In_head : forall xs,      InL x (x ::L xs)
| In_tail : forall y xs, InL x xs -> InL x (y ::L xs).

Inductive NoDupL {A : Type} : mylist A -> Prop :=
| ND_nil  : NoDupL nilL
| ND_cons : forall x xs, (~ InL x xs) -> NoDupL xs -> NoDupL (x ::L xs).

Fixpoint mapL {A B} (f : A -> B) (xs : mylist A) : mylist B :=
  match xs with
  | nilL => nilL
  | consL x xs => consL (f x) (mapL f xs)
  end.

Class ring (R : Type) := {
  zero      : R;
  opp       : R -> R;
  one       : R;
  add       : R -> R -> R;
  mul       : R -> R -> R;

  one_neq_zero  : one <> zero;

  add_comm  : forall x y,    add x y = add y x;
  add_assoc : forall x y z,  add (add x y) z = add x (add y z);
  add_zero  : forall x,      add x zero = x;
  add_opp   : forall x,      add x (opp x) = zero;

  mul_comm  : forall x y,    mul x y = mul y x;
  mul_assoc : forall x y z,  mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z);
  mul_one   : forall x,      mul x one = x;
  dist_l    : forall x y z,  mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z);
  mul_zero  : forall x,      mul x zero = zero;

  no_zero_div : forall x y, mul x y = zero -> x = zero \/ y = zero
}.

Notation "x +R y" := (add x y) (at level 50, left associativity).
Notation "-R x"    := (opp x)    (at level 35).
Notation "x -R y"  := (add x (opp y)) (at level 55).
Notation "x *R y"  := (mul x y)  (at level 40).

Section Probability.
  Context {R : Type} `{ring R}.
  Variable Omega : Type.

  Definition event := Omega -> Prop.
  Definition ev_false : event := fun _ => False.
  Definition ev_true  : event := fun _ => True.
  Definition ev_inter (A B : event) : event := fun w => A w /\ B w.
  Definition ev_union (A B : event) : event := fun w => A w \/ B w.
  Definition ev_compl (A : event)   : event := fun w => ~ A w.
  Definition ev_diff  (A B : event) : event := fun w => A w /\ ~ B w.

  Definition disjoint (A B : event) : Prop := forall w, ~ (A w /\ B w).

  Inductive pairwise_disjoint : mylist event -> Prop :=
  | pd_nil  : pairwise_disjoint nilL
  | pd_one  : forall A, pairwise_disjoint (A ::L nilL)
  | pd_cons : forall A B xs,
      disjoint A B -> (forall C, InL C (B ::L xs) -> disjoint A C) ->
      pairwise_disjoint (B ::L xs) ->
      pairwise_disjoint (A ::L B ::L xs).

  Fixpoint bigUnion (xs : mylist event) : event :=
    match xs with
    | nilL        => ev_false
    | consL A xs' => ev_union A (bigUnion xs')
    end.

  Variable prob : event -> R.

  Axiom prob_ext : forall A B, (forall w, A w <-> B w) -> prob A = prob B.
  Axiom prob_false : prob ev_false = zero.
  Axiom prob_true  : prob ev_true  = one.
  Axiom prob_union : forall A B,
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R (prob B +R -R (prob (ev_inter A B))).
  Axiom prob_compl : forall A, prob (ev_compl A) = one +R -R (prob A).

  Axiom classic : forall P:Prop, P \/ ~ P.

  Variable cprob : event -> event -> R.
  Axiom cprob_mul : forall A B, prob (ev_inter A B) = cprob A B *R prob B.

  Definition indep (A B : event) : Prop :=
    prob (ev_inter A B) = prob A *R prob B.


  Axiom opp_zero  : opp zero = zero.
  Axiom opp_opp   : forall x, opp (opp x) = x.
  Axiom opp_mul_right : forall x y, x *R (opp y) = opp (x *R y).
  Axiom opp_mul_left  : forall x y, (opp x) *R y = opp (x *R y).

  Axiom prob_union_disjoint : forall A B, disjoint A B -> prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R prob B.
  Axiom disjoint_head_tail : forall A xs, pairwise_disjoint (A ::L xs) -> disjoint A (bigUnion xs).

  Lemma prob_union_comm A B :
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma prob_union_idem A : prob (ev_union A A) = prob A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma prob_diff A B : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A -R prob (ev_inter A B).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma bayes_symm A B : cprob A B *R prob B = cprob B A *R prob A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma law_total_prob A B :
    prob A = cprob A B *R prob B +R cprob A (ev_compl B) *R prob (ev_compl B).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma prob_union_indep A B : indep A B ->
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R (prob B +R -R (prob A *R prob B)).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma indep_symm A B : indep A B -> indep B A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma indep_compl_right A B : indep A B -> indep A (ev_compl B).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma indep_compl_left A B : indep A B -> indep (ev_compl A) B.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Axiom indep_compl_both : forall A B, indep A B -> indep (ev_compl A) (ev_compl B).

  Fixpoint fold_add (xs : mylist R) : R :=
    match xs with
    | nilL => zero
    | consL x xs' => x +R fold_add xs'
    end.

  Lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint : forall xs,
    pairwise_disjoint xs -> prob (bigUnion xs) = fold_add (mapL prob xs).
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero : forall xs,
    pairwise_disjoint xs -> (forall A, InL A xs -> prob A = zero) -> prob (bigUnion xs) = zero.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Axiom inclusion_exclusion_three : forall A B C,
    prob (ev_union (ev_union A B) C)
      = prob A +R (prob B +R (prob C +R -R (prob (ev_inter A B) +R (prob (ev_inter A C) +R (prob (ev_inter B C) +R -R (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) C))))))).

End Probability.

theory probability
  imports Main
begin

datatype 'a mylist = NilL | ConsL 'a "'a mylist"

primrec mapL :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> 'a mylist \<Rightarrow> 'b mylist" where
  "mapL f NilL        = NilL"
| "mapL f (ConsL x xs) = ConsL (f x) (mapL f xs)"

primrec fold_addL :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a mylist \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "fold_addL add z NilL        = z"
| "fold_addL add z (ConsL x xs) = add x (fold_addL add z xs)"

inductive InL :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a mylist \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  In_head : "InL x (ConsL x xs)"
| In_tail : "InL x xs \<Longrightarrow> InL x (ConsL y xs)"

inductive NoDupL :: "'a mylist \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  ND_nil  : "NoDupL NilL"
| ND_cons : "\<lbrakk>\<not> InL x xs; NoDupL xs\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> NoDupL (ConsL x xs)"

type_synonym 'a event = "'a \<Rightarrow> bool"

definition ev_false :: "'a event" where "ev_false \<equiv> \<lambda>_. False"
definition ev_true  :: "'a event" where "ev_true  \<equiv> \<lambda>_. True"
definition ev_inter :: "'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event"
  where "ev_inter A B \<equiv> \<lambda>\<omega>. A \<omega> \<and> B \<omega>"
definition ev_union :: "'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event"
  where "ev_union A B \<equiv> \<lambda>\<omega>. A \<omega> \<or> B \<omega>"
definition ev_compl :: "'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event"
  where "ev_compl A \<equiv> \<lambda>\<omega>. \<not> A \<omega>"
definition ev_diff  :: "'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event"
  where "ev_diff A B \<equiv> \<lambda>\<omega>. A \<omega> \<and> \<not> B \<omega>"

definition disjoint :: "'a event \<Rightarrow> 'a event \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "disjoint A B \<equiv> \<forall>\<omega>. \<not> (A \<omega> \<and> B \<omega>)"

fun pairwise_disjoint :: "('a event) mylist \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "pairwise_disjoint NilL = True"
| "pairwise_disjoint (ConsL _ NilL) = True"
| "pairwise_disjoint (ConsL A (ConsL B xs)) =
     (disjoint A B \<and>
      (\<forall>C. InL C (ConsL B xs) \<longrightarrow> disjoint A C) \<and>
      pairwise_disjoint (ConsL B xs))"

primrec bigUnion :: "('a event) mylist \<Rightarrow> 'a event" where
  "bigUnion NilL         = ev_false"
| "bigUnion (ConsL A xs) = ev_union A (bigUnion xs)"



lemma ev_inter_comm:
  "\<forall>\<omega>. ev_inter A B \<omega> \<longleftrightarrow> ev_inter B A \<omega>"
  sorry
lemma ev_union_comm:
  "\<forall>\<omega>. ev_union A B \<omega> \<longleftrightarrow> ev_union B A \<omega>"
  sorry
lemma ev_inter_assoc:
  "\<forall>\<omega>. ev_inter (ev_inter A B) C \<omega> \<longleftrightarrow> ev_inter A (ev_inter B C) \<omega>"
  sorry
lemma ev_union_assoc:
  "\<forall>\<omega>. ev_union (ev_union A B) C \<omega> \<longleftrightarrow> ev_union A (ev_union B C) \<omega>"
  sorry
lemma ev_inter_distrib_left:
  "\<forall>\<omega>. ev_inter A (ev_union B C) \<omega> \<longleftrightarrow> ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A C) \<omega>"
  sorry

lemma disjoint_bigUnion:
  "(\<forall>C. InL C xs \<longrightarrow> disjoint A C) \<Longrightarrow> disjoint A (bigUnion xs)"
  sorry

locale probability_setup =
  fixes zero one :: "'r"
    and add       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"   (infixl "+R" 65)
    and opp       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and mul       :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"   (infixl "*R" 70)
    and prob      :: "('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and cprob     :: "('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'r"

  assumes
    add_comm      : "\<And>x y.   x +R y = y +R x"
    and add_assoc : "\<And>x y z. (x +R y) +R z = x +R (y +R z)"
    and add_zero  : "\<And>x.     x +R zero = x"
    and add_opp   : "\<And>x.     x +R opp x = zero"
    and mul_comm  : "\<And>x y.   x *R y = y *R x"
    and mul_assoc : "\<And>x y z. (x *R y) *R z = x *R (y *R z)"
    and mul_one   : "\<And>x.     x *R one = x"
    and dist_l    : "\<And>x y z. x *R (y +R z) = (x *R y) +R (x *R z)"
    and mul_zero  : "\<And>x.     x *R zero = zero"
    and opp_zero  : "opp zero = zero"
    and opp_opp   : "\<And>x.     opp (opp x) = x"
    and opp_mul_right : "\<And>x y. x *R opp y = opp (x *R y)"
    and opp_mul_left  : "\<And>x y. opp x *R y = opp (x *R y)"

    and prob_ext  : "\<And>A B. (\<forall>\<omega>. A \<omega> \<longleftrightarrow> B \<omega>) \<Longrightarrow> prob A = prob B"
    and prob_false_ax : "prob ev_false = zero"
    and prob_true_ax  : "prob ev_true  = one"
    and prob_union_ax :
          "\<And>A B. prob (ev_union A B) =
           prob A +R (prob B +R opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))"
    and prob_compl_ax : "\<And>A. prob (ev_compl A) = one +R opp (prob A)"
    and cprob_mul     : "\<And>A B. prob (ev_inter A B) = cprob A B *R prob B"
    and prob_union_disjoint :
          "\<And>A B. disjoint A B \<Longrightarrow>
           prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R prob B"
    and disjoint_head_tail :
          "\<And>A xs. pairwise_disjoint (ConsL A xs) \<Longrightarrow>
           disjoint A (bigUnion xs)"
    and indep_compl_both_ax :
          "\<And>A B. prob (ev_inter A B) = prob A *R prob B \<Longrightarrow>
           prob (ev_inter (ev_compl A) (ev_compl B)) =
           prob (ev_compl A) *R prob (ev_compl B)"
    and inclusion_exclusion_three :
          "\<And>A B C.
           prob (ev_union (ev_union A B) C) =
           prob A +R (prob B +R (prob C +R
             opp (prob (ev_inter A B) +R
                  (prob (ev_inter A C) +R
                   (prob (ev_inter B C) +R
                    opp (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) C)))))))"
begin





lemma zero_add: "zero +R x = x"
  sorry
lemma add_opp_comm: "opp x +R x = zero"
  sorry

lemma sub_of_eq: "a = b +R c \<Longrightarrow> c = a +R opp b"
  sorry




definition indep :: "('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "indep A B \<equiv> prob (ev_inter A B) = prob A *R prob B"





lemma prob_union_comm:
  "prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A)"
  sorry
lemma prob_union_idem:
  "prob (ev_union A A) = prob A"
  sorry




lemma prob_diff:
  "prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A +R opp (prob (ev_inter A B))"
  sorry




lemma bayes_symm:
  "cprob A B *R prob B = cprob B A *R prob A"
  sorry




lemma law_total_prob:
  "prob A =
   cprob A B *R prob B +R cprob A (ev_compl B) *R prob (ev_compl B)"
  sorry




lemma prob_union_indep:
  "indep A B \<Longrightarrow>
   prob (ev_union A B) =
   prob A +R (prob B +R opp (prob A *R prob B))"
  sorry




lemma indep_symm: "indep A B \<Longrightarrow> indep B A"
  sorry
lemma indep_compl_right: "indep A B \<Longrightarrow> indep A (ev_compl B)"
  sorry
lemma indep_compl_left: "indep A B \<Longrightarrow> indep (ev_compl A) B"
  sorry
lemma indep_compl_both: "indep A B \<Longrightarrow> indep (ev_compl A) (ev_compl B)"
  sorry




lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint:
  "pairwise_disjoint xs \<Longrightarrow>
   prob (bigUnion xs) = fold_addL (+R) zero (mapL prob xs)"
  sorry




lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero:
  "pairwise_disjoint xs \<Longrightarrow>
   (\<forall>A. InL A xs \<longrightarrow> prob A = zero) \<Longrightarrow>
   prob (bigUnion xs) = zero"
  sorry
end

end

probability
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal corpus artifact probability:
;; probability identities for arbitrary events over an arbitrary outcome type,
;; valued in an arbitrary commutative ring satisfying the source laws. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent the source's arbitrary types, events,
;; operations, probability function, and conditional-probability function.
;; Carrier predicates restrict quantifiers without enumerating any domain, and
;; function tags select arbitrary functions rather than finite lookup tables.

(defstub bf-pr-ring-member-p (ring-type value) t)
(defstub bf-pr-outcome-member-p (outcome-type value) t)
(defstub bf-pr-event-p (outcome-type event) t)
(defstub bf-pr-event-holds (outcome-type event outcome) t)

(defstub bf-pr-zero (ring-type) t)
(defstub bf-pr-one (ring-type) t)
(defstub bf-pr-add (ring-type left right) t)
(defstub bf-pr-mul (ring-type left right) t)
(defstub bf-pr-opp (ring-type value) t)

(defstub bf-pr-ev-false (outcome-type) t)
(defstub bf-pr-ev-true (outcome-type) t)
(defstub bf-pr-ev-inter (outcome-type left right) t)
(defstub bf-pr-ev-union (outcome-type left right) t)
(defstub bf-pr-ev-compl (outcome-type event) t)

(defstub bf-pr-prob
  (ring-type outcome-type prob-function event)
  t)
(defstub bf-pr-cprob
  (ring-type outcome-type cprob-function left right)
  t)

(defun bf-pr-sub (ring-type x y)
  (bf-pr-add ring-type x (bf-pr-opp ring-type y)))

(defun bf-pr-ev-diff (outcome-type a b)
  (bf-pr-ev-inter
   outcome-type a (bf-pr-ev-compl outcome-type b)))

;; Native ACL2 naturals and true lists present the source's Peano naturals and
;; inductive finite lists.

(defun bf-pr-mynat-add (n m)
  (if (zp n)
      m
    (+ 1 (bf-pr-mynat-add (- n 1) m))))

(defun bf-pr-event-list-p (outcome-type events)
  (if (consp events)
      (and
       (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type (car events))
       (bf-pr-event-list-p outcome-type (cdr events)))
    (equal events nil)))

(defun bf-pr-in-l-p (event events)
  (if (member-equal event events) t nil))

(defun bf-pr-no-duplicates-p (events)
  (if (consp events)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car events) (cdr events)))
       (bf-pr-no-duplicates-p (cdr events)))
    (equal events nil)))

(defun bf-pr-no-dup-l-p (outcome-type events)
  (and
   (bf-pr-event-list-p outcome-type events)
   (bf-pr-no-duplicates-p events)))

;; Ring structure and the four additional negation laws hold over every member
;; of the arbitrary carrier. Closure records the source result types.

(defun-sk bf-pr-ring-laws-p (ring-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (bf-pr-ring-member-p ring-type x)
      (and
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p
        ring-type (bf-pr-opp ring-type x))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-add ring-type x (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
        x)
       (equal
        (bf-pr-add ring-type x (bf-pr-opp ring-type x))
        (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul ring-type x (bf-pr-one ring-type))
        x)
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul ring-type x (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
        (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-opp ring-type (bf-pr-opp ring-type x))
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p ring-type x)
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p ring-type y))
      (and
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p
        ring-type (bf-pr-add ring-type x y))
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p
        ring-type (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-add ring-type x y)
        (bf-pr-add ring-type y x))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y)
        (bf-pr-mul ring-type y x))
       (implies
        (equal
         (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y)
         (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
        (or
         (equal x (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
         (equal y (bf-pr-zero ring-type))))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul ring-type x (bf-pr-opp ring-type y))
        (bf-pr-opp
         ring-type (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y)))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul ring-type (bf-pr-opp ring-type x) y)
        (bf-pr-opp
         ring-type (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p ring-type x)
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p ring-type y)
       (bf-pr-ring-member-p ring-type z))
      (and
       (equal
        (bf-pr-add
         ring-type (bf-pr-add ring-type x y) z)
        (bf-pr-add
         ring-type x (bf-pr-add ring-type y z)))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul
         ring-type (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y) z)
        (bf-pr-mul
         ring-type x (bf-pr-mul ring-type y z)))
       (equal
        (bf-pr-mul
         ring-type x (bf-pr-add ring-type y z))
        (bf-pr-add
         ring-type
         (bf-pr-mul ring-type x y)
         (bf-pr-mul ring-type x z))))))))

(defun bf-pr-ring-p (ring-type)
  (and
   (bf-pr-ring-member-p
    ring-type (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
   (bf-pr-ring-member-p
    ring-type (bf-pr-one ring-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (bf-pr-one ring-type)
     (bf-pr-zero ring-type)))
   (equal
    (bf-pr-opp ring-type (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
    (bf-pr-zero ring-type))
   (bf-pr-ring-laws-p ring-type)))

;; Event objects are reified predicates. Evaluation and extensionality give
;; them function-like equality on the arbitrary outcome carrier; the Boolean
;; constructors have their pointwise source meanings and remain events.

(defun-sk bf-pr-event-ext-equal-p (outcome-type a b)
  (forall (outcome)
    (implies
     (bf-pr-outcome-member-p outcome-type outcome)
     (iff
      (bf-pr-event-holds outcome-type a outcome)
      (bf-pr-event-holds outcome-type b outcome)))))

(defun-sk bf-pr-event-laws-p (outcome-type)
  (forall (a b outcome)
    (and
     (implies
      (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type a)
      (and
       (bf-pr-event-p
        outcome-type (bf-pr-ev-compl outcome-type a))
       (implies
        (bf-pr-outcome-member-p outcome-type outcome)
        (iff
         (bf-pr-event-holds
          outcome-type
          (bf-pr-ev-compl outcome-type a)
          outcome)
         (not
          (bf-pr-event-holds outcome-type a outcome))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type a)
       (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type b))
      (and
       (bf-pr-event-p
        outcome-type (bf-pr-ev-inter outcome-type a b))
       (bf-pr-event-p
        outcome-type (bf-pr-ev-union outcome-type a b))
       (implies
        (bf-pr-outcome-member-p outcome-type outcome)
        (and
         (iff
          (bf-pr-event-holds
           outcome-type
           (bf-pr-ev-inter outcome-type a b)
           outcome)
          (and
           (bf-pr-event-holds outcome-type a outcome)
           (bf-pr-event-holds outcome-type b outcome)))
         (iff

      (bf-pr-all-prob-zero-p
       ring-type outcome-type prob-function events))
     (equal
      (bf-pr-prob
       ring-type
       outcome-type
       prob-function
       (bf-pr-big-union outcome-type events))
      (bf-pr-zero ring-type)))))

(defun-sk
    babel-formal-probability-inclusion-exclusion-three-statement ()
  (forall
    (ring-type outcome-type prob-function cprob-function a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (bf-pr-base-context-p
       ring-type outcome-type prob-function cprob-function)
      (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type a)
      (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type b)
      (bf-pr-event-p outcome-type c))
     (bf-pr-inclusion-exclusion-formula-p
      ring-type outcome-type prob-function a b c))))

(defun babel-formal-probability-statement ()
  (and
   (babel-formal-probability-mynat-add-o-left-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-mynat-add-s-left-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-ev-inter-comm-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-ev-union-comm-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-ev-inter-assoc-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-ev-union-assoc-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-ev-inter-distrib-left-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-disjoint-head-tail-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-prob-union-disjoint-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-prob-union-comm-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-prob-union-idem-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-prob-diff-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-bayes-symm-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-law-total-prob-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-prob-union-indep-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-indep-compl-right-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-indep-symm-statement)
   (babel-formal-probability-indep-compl-left-statement)

title: probability
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact probability: event algebra,
-- conditional probability, independence, disjoint finite unions, and inclusion-exclusion over
-- a generic ring-valued probability context. This file contains no proof.

module probability where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

data ⊥ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

record ⊤ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where
  constructor tt

infixr 4 _∧_
record _∧_ {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
           (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  constructor _,_
  field
    and-left  : A
    and-right : B

infixr 3 _∨_
data _∨_ {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
         (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  or-left  : A → A ∨ B
  or-right : B → A ∨ B

infix 8 ¬_
¬_ : {ℓ : Level} → Set ℓ → Set ℓ
¬_ {ℓ} A = A → ⊥ {ℓ}

infix 2 _↔_
record _↔_ {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
           (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) : Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  field
    iff-forward  : A → B
    iff-backward : B → A

infix 4 _≢_
_≢_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≢ y = x ≡ y → ⊥

data MyNat : Set where
  O : MyNat
  S : MyNat → MyNat

mynat-add : MyNat → MyNat → MyNat
mynat-add O       m = m
mynat-add (S n)   m = S (mynat-add n m)

mynat-add-O-left : Set
mynat-add-O-left =
  (m : MyNat) → mynat-add O m ≡ m

mynat-add-S-left : Set
mynat-add-S-left =
  (n m : MyNat) → mynat-add (S n) m ≡ S (mynat-add n m)

infixr 5 _∷L_
data MyList {ℓ : Level} (A : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  nilL : MyList A
  _∷L_ : A → MyList A → MyList A

infix 4 _∈L_
data _∈L_ {ℓ : Level} {A : Set ℓ}
            (x : A) : MyList A → Set ℓ where
  in-head : {xs : MyList A} → x ∈L (x ∷L xs)
  in-tail : {y : A} {xs : MyList A} →
            x ∈L xs → x ∈L (y ∷L xs)

data NoDupL {ℓ : Level} {A : Set ℓ} : MyList A → Set ℓ where
  nd-nil  : NoDupL nilL
  nd-cons : {x : A} {xs : MyList A} →
            ¬ (x ∈L xs) → NoDupL xs → NoDupL (x ∷L xs)

mapL : {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level} {A : Set ℓ₁} {B : Set ℓ₂} →
       (A → B) → MyList A → MyList B
mapL f nilL       = nilL
mapL f (x ∷L xs)  = f x ∷L mapL f xs

fold-add : {ℓ : Level} {A : Set ℓ} →
           (A → A → A) → A → MyList A → A
fold-add add zero nilL       = zero
fold-add add zero (x ∷L xs)  = add x (fold-add add zero xs)

Event : Set → Set₁
Event Ω = Ω → Set

ev-false : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω
ev-false _ = ⊥

ev-true : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω
ev-true _ = ⊤

ev-inter : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω → Event Ω → Event Ω
ev-inter A B ω = A ω ∧ B ω

ev-union : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω → Event Ω → Event Ω
ev-union A B ω = A ω ∨ B ω

ev-compl : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω → Event Ω
ev-compl A ω = ¬ (A ω)

ev-diff : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω → Event Ω → Event Ω
ev-diff A B ω = A ω ∧ ¬ (B ω)

Disjoint : {Ω : Set} → Event Ω → Event Ω → Set
Disjoint {Ω} A B =
  (ω : Ω) → ¬ (ev-inter A B ω)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {Ω : Set} → MyList (Event Ω) → Set₁
PairwiseDisjoint nilL = ⊤
PairwiseDisjoint (A ∷L nilL) = ⊤
PairwiseDisjoint {Ω} (A ∷L (B ∷L xs)) =
  Disjoint A B ∧
  (((C : Event Ω) → C ∈L (B ∷L xs) → Disjoint A C) ∧
   PairwiseDisjoint (B ∷L xs))

bigUnion : {Ω : Set} → MyList (Event Ω) → Event Ω
bigUnion nilL       = ev-false
bigUnion (A ∷L xs)  = ev-union A (bigUnion xs)

module EventStatements {Ω : Set} where

  ev-inter-comm : Set₁
  ev-inter-comm =
    (A B : Event Ω) → (ω : Ω) →
    ev-inter A B ω ↔ ev-inter B A ω

  ev-union-comm : Set₁
  ev-union-comm =
    (A B : Event Ω) → (ω : Ω) →
    ev-union A B ω ↔ ev-union B A ω

  ev-inter-assoc : Set₁
  ev-inter-assoc =
    (A B C : Event Ω) → (ω : Ω) →
    ev-inter (ev-inter A B) C ω ↔
    ev-inter A (ev-inter B C) ω

  ev-union-assoc : Set₁
  ev-union-assoc =
    (A B C : Event Ω) → (ω : Ω) →
    ev-union (ev-union A B) C ω ↔
    ev-union A (ev-union B C) ω

  ev-inter-distrib-left : Set₁
  ev-inter-distrib-left =
    (A B C : Event Ω) → (ω : Ω) →
    ev-inter A (ev-union B C) ω ↔
    ev-union (ev-inter A B) (ev-inter A C) ω

record Ring (R : Set) : Set where
  field
    zero : R
    opp  : R → R
    one  : R
    add  : R → R → R
    mul  : R → R → R

    one-neq-zero : one ≢ zero

    add-comm  : (x y : R) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-assoc : (x y z : R) →
                add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-zero  : (x : R) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-opp   : (x : R) → add x (opp x) ≡ zero

    mul-comm  : (x y : R) → mul x y ≡ mul y x
    mul-assoc : (x y z : R) →
                mul (mul x y) z ≡ mul x (mul y z)
    mul-one   : (x : R) → mul x one ≡ x
    dist-left : (x y z : R) →
                mul x (add y z) ≡ add (mul x y) (mul x z)
    mul-zero  : (x : R) → mul x zero ≡ zero

    no-zero-div :
      (x y : R) →
      mul x y ≡ zero →
      (x ≡ zero) ∨ (y ≡ zero)

Indep :
  {R Ω : Set} →
  Ring R →
  (Event Ω → R) →
  Event Ω → Event Ω → Set
Indep ring prob A B =
  prob (ev-inter A B) ≡
  Ring.mul ring (prob A) (prob B)

record ProbabilityContext
  (R Ω : Set) (ring : Ring R) : Set₁ where

  open Ring ring

  field
    prob  : Event Ω → R
    cprob : Event Ω → Event Ω → R

    prob-ext :
      {A B : Event Ω} →
      ((ω : Ω) → A ω ↔ B ω) →
      prob A ≡ prob B

    prob-false : prob ev-false ≡ zero
    prob-true  : prob ev-true ≡ one

    prob-union :
      (A B : Event Ω) →
      prob (ev-union A B) ≡
      add (prob A)
          (add (prob B) (opp (prob (ev-inter A B))))

    prob-compl :
      (A : Event Ω) →
      prob (ev-compl A) ≡ add one (opp (prob A))

    excluded-middle : (P : Set) → P ∨ ¬ P

    cprob-mul :
      (A B : Event Ω) →
      prob (ev-inter A B) ≡ mul (cprob A B) (prob B)

    opp-zero      : opp zero ≡ zero
    opp-opp       : (x : R) → opp (opp x) ≡ x
    opp-mul-right : (x y : R) →
                    mul x (opp y) ≡ opp (mul x y)
    opp-mul-left  : (x y : R) →
                    mul (opp x) y ≡ opp (mul x y)

    prob-union-disjoint :
      (A B : Event Ω) →
      Disjoint A B →
      prob (ev-union A B) ≡ add (prob A) (prob B)

    disjoint-head-tail :
      (A : Event Ω) (xs : MyList (Event Ω)) →
      PairwiseDisjoint (A ∷L xs) →
      Disjoint A (bigUnion xs)

module ProbabilityStatements
  {R Ω : Set}
  (ring : Ring R)
  (context : ProbabilityContext R Ω ring) where

  open Ring ring
  open ProbabilityContext context

  prob-union-comm : Set₁
  prob-union-comm =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    prob (ev-union A B) ≡ prob (ev-union B A)

  prob-union-idem : Set₁
  prob-union-idem =
    (A : Event Ω) →
    prob (ev-union A A) ≡ prob A

  prob-diff : Set₁
  prob-diff =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    prob (ev-diff A B) ≡
    add (prob A) (opp (prob (ev-inter A B)))

  bayes-symm : Set₁
  bayes-symm =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    mul (cprob A B) (prob B) ≡
    mul (cprob B A) (prob A)

  law-total-prob : Set₁
  law-total-prob =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    prob A ≡
    add (mul (cprob A B) (prob B))
        (mul (cprob A (ev-compl B))
             (prob (ev-compl B)))

  prob-union-indep : Set₁
  prob-union-indep =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    Indep ring prob A B →
    prob (ev-union A B) ≡
    add (prob A)
      (add (prob B)
        (opp (mul (prob A) (prob B))))

  indep-compl-right : Set₁
  indep-compl-right =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    Indep ring prob A B →
    Indep ring prob A (ev-compl B)

  indep-symm : Set₁
  indep-symm =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    Indep ring prob A B →
    Indep ring prob B A

  indep-compl-left : Set₁
  indep-compl-left =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    Indep ring prob A B →
    Indep ring prob (ev-compl A) B

  indep-compl-both : Set₁
  indep-compl-both =
    (A B : Event Ω) →
    Indep ring prob A B →
    Indep ring prob (ev-compl A) (ev-compl B)

  prob-bigUnion-disjoint : Set₁
  prob-bigUnion-disjoint =
    (xs : MyList (Event Ω)) →
    PairwiseDisjoint xs →
    prob (bigUnion xs) ≡
    fold-add add zero (mapL prob xs)

  prob-bigUnion-disjoint-zero : Set₁
  prob-bigUnion-disjoint-zero =
    (xs : MyList (Event Ω)) →
    PairwiseDisjoint xs →
    ((A : Event Ω) → A ∈L xs → prob A ≡ zero) →
    prob (bigUnion xs) ≡ zero

  inclusion-exclusion-three : Set₁
  inclusion-exclusion-three =
    (A B C : Event Ω) →
    prob (ev-union (ev-union A B) C) ≡
    add (prob A)
      (add (prob B)
        (add (prob C)
          (opp
            (add (prob (ev-inter A B))
              (add (prob (ev-inter A C))
                (add (prob (ev-inter B C))
                  (opp
                    (prob
                      (ev-inter (ev-inter A B) C)))))))))

title: probability
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact probability: abstract event
  algebra and finite probability identities over a commutative integral-domain-like carrier.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val _ = new_theory "hello";

val babel_mynat_add_def = new_definition (
  "babel_mynat_add_def",
  ``babel_mynat_add (n : num) m = n + m``);

val babel_InL_def = new_definition (
  "babel_InL_def",
  ``babel_InL (x : 'a) (xs : 'a list) <=> MEM x xs``);

val babel_NoDupL_def = new_definition (
  "babel_NoDupL_def",
  ``babel_NoDupL (xs : 'a list) <=> ALL_DISTINCT xs``);

val babel_mapL_def = new_definition (
  "babel_mapL_def",
  ``babel_mapL (f : 'a -> 'b) (xs : 'a list) = MAP f xs``);

val babel_fold_add_def = new_definition (
  "babel_fold_add_def",
  ``babel_fold_add (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (zero : 'a)
      (xs : 'a list) =
      FOLDR add zero xs``);

val mynat_add_O_left =
  ``!(m : num). babel_mynat_add 0 m = m``;

val mynat_add_S_left =
  ``!(n : num) m.
      babel_mynat_add (SUC n) m = SUC (babel_mynat_add n m)``;

val babel_integral_domain_def = new_definition (
  "babel_integral_domain_def",
  ``babel_integral_domain
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      ~(oneR = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x. addR x zeroR = x) /\
      (!x. addR x (oppR x) = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x. mulR x oneR = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
      (!x. mulR x zeroR = zeroR) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = zeroR ==> x = zeroR \/ y = zeroR)``);

val babel_subR_def = new_definition (
  "babel_subR_def",
  ``babel_subR (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (x : 'r) y =
      addR x (oppR y)``);

val babel_ev_false_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ev_false_def",
  ``babel_ev_false : 'w -> bool = (\w. F)``);

val babel_ev_true_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ev_true_def",
  ``babel_ev_true : 'w -> bool = (\w. T)``);

val babel_ev_inter_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ev_inter_def",
  ``babel_ev_inter (A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool) =
      (\w. A w /\ B w)``);

val babel_ev_union_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ev_union_def",
  ``babel_ev_union (A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool) =
      (\w. A w \/ B w)``);

val babel_ev_compl_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ev_compl_def",
  ``babel_ev_compl (A : 'w -> bool) = (\w. ~(A w))``);

val babel_ev_diff_def = new_definition (
  "babel_ev_diff_def",
  ``babel_ev_diff (A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool) =
      (\w. A w /\ ~(B w))``);

val babel_disjoint_def = new_definition (
  "babel_disjoint_def",
  ``babel_disjoint (A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool) <=>
      !w. ~(A w /\ B w)``);

val babel_pairwise_disjoint_def = new_definition (
  "babel_pairwise_disjoint_def",
  ``babel_pairwise_disjoint (xs : ('w -> bool) list) <=>
      !i j.
        i < j /\ j < LENGTH xs ==>
        babel_disjoint (EL i xs) (EL j xs)``);

val babel_bigUnion_def = new_definition (
  "babel_bigUnion_def",
  ``babel_bigUnion (xs : ('w -> bool) list) =
      (\w. ?A. MEM A xs /\ A w)``);

val babel_indep_def = new_definition (
  "babel_indep_def",
  ``babel_indep
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B <=>
      prob (babel_ev_inter A B) = mulR (prob A) (prob B)``);

val babel_inclusion_exclusion_three_def = new_definition (
  "babel_inclusion_exclusion_three_def",
  ``babel_inclusion_exclusion_three
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool) (C : 'w -> bool) <=>
      prob (babel_ev_union (babel_ev_union A B) C) =
      addR (prob A)
        (addR (prob B)
          (addR (prob C)
            (oppR
              (addR (prob (babel_ev_inter A B))
                (addR (prob (babel_ev_inter A C))
                  (addR (prob (babel_ev_inter B C))
                    (oppR
                      (prob
                        (babel_ev_inter (babel_ev_inter A B) C)))))))))``);

val ev_inter_comm =
  ``!(A : 'w -> bool) B w.
      (babel_ev_inter A B w <=> babel_ev_inter B A w)``;

val ev_union_comm =
  ``!(A : 'w -> bool) B w.
      (babel_ev_union A B w <=> babel_ev_union B A w)``;

val ev_inter_assoc =
  ``!(A : 'w -> bool) B C w.
      (babel_ev_inter (babel_ev_inter A B) C w <=>
       babel_ev_inter A (babel_ev_inter B C) w)``;

val ev_union_assoc =
  ``!(A : 'w -> bool) B C w.
      (babel_ev_union (babel_ev_union A B) C w <=>
       babel_ev_union A (babel_ev_union B C) w)``;

val ev_inter_distrib_left =
  ``!(A : 'w -> bool) B C w.
      (babel_ev_inter A (babel_ev_union B C) w <=>
       babel_ev_union
         (babel_ev_inter A B) (babel_ev_inter A C) w)``;

val babel_probability_context_def = new_definition (
  "babel_probability_context_def",
  ``babel_probability_context
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r) <=>
      babel_integral_domain zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR /\
      (!(A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool).
         (!(w : 'w). A w <=> B w) ==>
         prob A = prob B) /\
      prob (babel_ev_false : 'w -> bool) = zeroR /\
      prob (babel_ev_true : 'w -> bool) = oneR /\
      (!(A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool).
         prob (babel_ev_union A B) =
         addR (prob A)
           (addR (prob B) (oppR (prob (babel_ev_inter A B))))) /\
      (!(A : 'w -> bool).
         prob (babel_ev_compl A) =
         addR oneR (oppR (prob A))) /\
      (!(A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool).
         prob (babel_ev_inter A B) =
         mulR (cprob A B) (prob B)) /\
      oppR zeroR = zeroR /\
      (!(x : 'r). oppR (oppR x) = x) /\
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r).
         mulR x (oppR y) = oppR (mulR x y)) /\
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r).
         mulR (oppR x) y = oppR (mulR x y)) /\
      (!(A : 'w -> bool) (B : 'w -> bool).
         babel_disjoint A B ==>
         prob (babel_ev_union A B) = addR (prob A) (prob B)) /\
      (!(A : 'w -> bool) (xs : ('w -> bool) list).
         babel_pairwise_disjoint (A::xs) ==>
         babel_disjoint A (babel_bigUnion xs))``);

val prob_union_comm =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      prob (babel_ev_union A B) = prob (babel_ev_union B A)``;

val prob_union_idem =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool).
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      prob (babel_ev_union A A) = prob A``;

val prob_diff =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      prob (babel_ev_diff A B) =
      babel_subR addR oppR (prob A) (prob (babel_ev_inter A B))``;

val bayes_symm =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      mulR (cprob A B) (prob B) =
      mulR (cprob B A) (prob A)``;

val law_total_prob =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      prob A =
      addR
        (mulR (cprob A B) (prob B))
        (mulR (cprob A (babel_ev_compl B))
          (prob (babel_ev_compl B)))``;

val prob_union_indep =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR A B ==>
      prob (babel_ev_union A B) =
      addR (prob A)
        (addR (prob B) (oppR (mulR (prob A) (prob B))))``;

val indep_compl_right =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR A B ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR A (babel_ev_compl B)``;

val indep_symm =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR A B ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR B A``;

val indep_compl_left =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR A B ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR (babel_ev_compl A) B``;

val indep_compl_both =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR A B ==>
      babel_indep prob mulR
        (babel_ev_compl A) (babel_ev_compl B)``;

val prob_bigUnion_disjoint =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (xs : ('w -> bool) list).
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_pairwise_disjoint xs ==>
      prob (babel_bigUnion xs) =
      babel_fold_add addR zeroR (babel_mapL prob xs)``;

val prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (xs : ('w -> bool) list).
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_pairwise_disjoint xs ==>
      (!A. babel_InL A xs ==> prob A = zeroR) ==>
      prob (babel_bigUnion xs) = zeroR``;

val inclusion_exclusion_three =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (oppR : 'r -> 'r)
      (prob : ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (cprob : ('w -> bool) -> ('w -> bool) -> 'r)
      (A : 'w -> bool) B C.
      babel_probability_context
        zeroR oneR addR mulR oppR prob cprob ==>
      babel_inclusion_exclusion_three addR oppR prob A B C``;

val _ = export_theory();

  and conditional-probability maps are schematic variables.
  ProbContext contains the common probability laws used by the derived
  results; the two non-indexed source axioms are stated under that same
  probability context.
  All mathematical declarations and translated results are unproved $a
  assertions.  This database contains no proof statements.

:: Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal corpus artifact probability:
:: event algebra, probability identities, conditional probability,
:: independence, and finite disjoint unions. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies BINOP_1, VECTSP_1, XBOOLE_0, ALGSTR_0, SUBSET_1, MESFUNC1,
      RELAT_1, LATTICES, ARYTM_3, FUNCSDOM, VECTSP_2, SUPINF_2, CARD_1,
      STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, ARYTM_1, GROUP_1, EQREL_1, TARSKI, SETFAM_1,
      MSSUBFAM, INT_2, GCD_1, FUNCT_7, NUMBERS, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, NAT_1, CARD_3;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_2, VECTSP_1;
 constructors BINOP_2, VECTSP_2, MONOID_0, RELSET_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, MEMBERED, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, STRUCT_0, VECTSP_1, MONOID_0,
      XREAL_0;
 requirements SUBSET, BOOLE;
 definitions VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities VECTSP_1;
 expansions VECTSP_1, XBOOLE_0;

begin

:: Events are represented extensionally by subsets of Omega. Thus the
:: source's probability extensionality law is built into equality here.

:: ev_inter_comm
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being set,
      A,B being Subset of Omega
  holds A /\ B = B /\ A
proof
end;
::$P+

:: ev_union_comm
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being set,
      A,B being Subset of Omega
  holds A \/ B = B \/ A
proof
end;
::$P+

:: ev_inter_assoc
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being set,
      A,B,C being Subset of Omega
  holds (A /\ B) /\ C = A /\ (B /\ C)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: ev_union_assoc
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being set,
      A,B,C being Subset of Omega
  holds (A \/ B) \/ C = A \/ (B \/ C)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: ev_inter_distrib_left
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being set,
      A,B,C being Subset of Omega
  holds A /\ (B \/ C) = (A /\ B) \/ (A /\ C)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: prob_union_comm
::$P-
theorem
  for Omega being set,
      R being domRing,
      prob being Function of bool Omega, R,
      cprob being Function of [:bool Omega,bool Omega:], R,
      A,B being Subset of Omega
  st prob/.({} Omega) = 0.R &

title: probability
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact probability: event
% operations, abstract probability laws, independence, and finite disjoint unions.
% This file contains no proof.

probability[
  R: TYPE+,
  Omega: TYPE,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R],
  oppR: [R -> R],
  prob: [[Omega -> bool] -> R],
  cprob: [[Omega -> bool], [Omega -> bool] -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [Omega -> bool]

  ev_false: event =
    LAMBDA (w: Omega): FALSE

  ev_true: event =
    LAMBDA (w: Omega): TRUE

  ev_inter(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (w: Omega): A(w) AND B(w)

  ev_union(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (w: Omega): A(w) OR B(w)

  ev_compl(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (w: Omega): NOT A(w)

  ev_diff(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (w: Omega): A(w) AND NOT B(w)

  inL(A: event, xs: list[event]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(B, ys): A = B OR inL(A, ys)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  noDupL(xs: list[event]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(A, ys): NOT inL(A, ys) AND noDupL(ys)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  disjoint(A, B: event): bool =
    FORALL (w: Omega): NOT (A(w) AND B(w))

  pairwiseDisjoint(xs: list[event]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES xs OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(A, ys):
        CASES ys OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(B, zs):
            disjoint(A, B)
              AND (FORALL (C: event):
                inL(C, cons(B, zs)) IMPLIES disjoint(A, C))
              AND pairwiseDisjoint(cons(B, zs))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  bigUnionF(xs: list[event]): RECURSIVE event =
    CASES xs OF
      null: ev_false,
      cons(A, ys): ev_union(A, bigUnionF(ys))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  mapProb(xs: list[event]): RECURSIVE list[R] =
    CASES xs OF
      null: null,
      cons(A, ys): cons(prob(A), mapProb(ys))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  foldAdd(xs: list[R]): RECURSIVE R =
    CASES xs OF
      null: zeroR,
      cons(x, ys): addR(x, foldAdd(ys))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  indep(A, B: event): bool =
    prob(ev_inter(A, B)) = mulR(prob(A), prob(B))

  ring_laws: bool =
    NOT (oneR = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): addR(x, oppR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(x, addR(y, z)) =
          addR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mulR(x, zeroR) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mulR(x, y) = zeroR IMPLIES x = zeroR OR y = zeroR)

  excluded_middle_assumption: bool =
    FORALL (p: bool): p OR NOT p

  probability_assumptions: bool =
    (FORALL (A, B: event):
      (FORALL (w: Omega): A(w) = B(w)) IMPLIES
        prob(A) = prob(B))
      AND prob(ev_false) = zeroR
      AND prob(ev_true) = oneR
      AND (FORALL (A, B: event):
        prob(ev_union(A, B)) =
          addR(prob(A),
            addR(prob(B), oppR(prob(ev_inter(A, B))))))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        prob(ev_compl(A)) = addR(oneR, oppR(prob(A))))
      AND excluded_middle_assumption
      AND (FORALL (A, B: event):
        prob(ev_inter(A, B)) =
          mulR(cprob(A, B), prob(B)))
      AND oppR(zeroR) = zeroR
      AND (FORALL (x: R): oppR(oppR(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mulR(x, oppR(y)) = oppR(mulR(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mulR(oppR(x), y) = oppR(mulR(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: event):
        disjoint(A, B) IMPLIES
          prob(ev_union(A, B)) = addR(prob(A), prob(B)))
      AND (FORALL (A: event), (xs: list[event]):
        pairwiseDisjoint(cons(A, xs)) IMPLIES
          disjoint(A, bigUnionF(xs)))

  probability_context: bool =
    ring_laws AND probability_assumptions

  ev_inter_comm: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: event), (w: Omega):
      ev_inter(A, B)(w) = ev_inter(B, A)(w)

  ev_union_comm: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: event), (w: Omega):
      ev_union(A, B)(w) = ev_union(B, A)(w)

  ev_inter_assoc: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: event), (w: Omega):
      ev_inter(ev_inter(A, B), C)(w) =
        ev_inter(A, ev_inter(B, C))(w)

  ev_union_assoc: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: event), (w: Omega):
      ev_union(ev_union(A, B), C)(w) =
        ev_union(A, ev_union(B, C))(w)

  ev_inter_distrib_left: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: event), (w: Omega):
      ev_inter(A, ev_union(B, C))(w) =
        ev_union(ev_inter(A, B), ev_inter(A, C))(w)

  prob_union_comm: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        prob(ev_union(A, B)) = prob(ev_union(B, A)))

  prob_union_idem: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A: event):
        prob(ev_union(A, A)) = prob(A))

  prob_diff: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        prob(ev_diff(A, B)) =
          addR(prob(A), oppR(prob(ev_inter(A, B)))))

  bayes_symm: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        mulR(cprob(A, B), prob(B)) =
          mulR(cprob(B, A), prob(A)))

  law_total_prob: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        prob(A) =
          addR(
            mulR(cprob(A, B), prob(B)),
            mulR(cprob(A, ev_compl(B)), prob(ev_compl(B)))))

  prob_union_indep: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        indep(A, B) IMPLIES
          prob(ev_union(A, B)) =
            addR(prob(A),
              addR(prob(B),
                oppR(mulR(prob(A), prob(B))))))

  indep_compl_right: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        indep(A, B) IMPLIES indep(A, ev_compl(B)))

  indep_symm: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        indep(A, B) IMPLIES indep(B, A))

  indep_compl_left: bool =
    probability_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A, B: event):
        indep(A, B) IMPLIES indep(ev_compl(A), B))

  indep_compl_both_assumption: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: event):
      indep(A, B) IMPLIES
        indep(ev_compl(A), ev_compl(B))

  post_independence_context: bool =
    probability_context AND indep_compl_both_assumption

  prob_bigUnion_disjoint: bool =
    post_independence_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (xs: list[event]):
        pairwiseDisjoint(xs) IMPLIES
          prob(bigUnionF(xs)) = foldAdd(mapProb(xs)))

  prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero: bool =
    post_independence_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (xs: list[event]):
        pairwiseDisjoint(xs) IMPLIES
          ((FORALL (A: event):
            inL(A, xs) IMPLIES prob(A) = zeroR)
            IMPLIES prob(bigUnionF(xs)) = zeroR))

  inclusion_exclusion_three_assumption: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: event):
      prob(ev_union(ev_union(A, B), C)) =
        addR(prob(A),
          addR(prob(B),
            addR(prob(C),
              oppR(
                addR(prob(ev_inter(A, B)),
                  addR(prob(ev_inter(A, C)),
                    addR(prob(ev_inter(B, C)),
                      oppR(
                        prob(ev_inter(ev_inter(A, B), C))))))))))
END probability

universe u

namespace SetAlgebra

variable {X : Type u}

axiom classic : ∀ P : Prop, P ∨ ¬ P

def sUnion (A B : X → Prop) : X → Prop := fun x => A x ∨ B x
def sInter (A B : X → Prop) : X → Prop := fun x => A x ∧ B x
def sCompl (A : X → Prop) : X → Prop := fun x => ¬ A x

infixl:65  " ∪s " => sUnion
infixl:70  " ∩s " => sInter
prefix:100 "ᶜs" => sCompl

theorem inter_distrib_left (A B C : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, (A ∩s (B ∪s C)) x ↔ ((A ∩s B) ∪s (A ∩s C)) x := by sorry
theorem inter_distrib_right (A B C : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, ((A ∪s B) ∩s C) x ↔ ((A ∩s C) ∪s (B ∩s C)) x := by sorry
theorem de_morgan_union (A B : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, (ᶜs (A ∪s B)) x ↔ (ᶜs A ∩s ᶜs B) x := by sorry
theorem de_morgan_inter (A B : X → Prop) :
  ∀ x, (ᶜs (A ∩s B)) x ↔ (ᶜs A ∪s ᶜs B) x := by sorry
end SetAlgebra

Section SetAlgebra.
  Variable X : Type.
  Axiom classic : forall P:Prop, P \/ ~P.

  Definition sUnion (A B : X -> Prop) : X -> Prop := fun x => A x \/ B x.
  Definition sInter (A B : X -> Prop) : X -> Prop := fun x => A x /\ B x.
  Definition sCompl (A : X -> Prop) : X -> Prop := fun x => ~ A x.

  Lemma inter_distrib_left (A B C : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sInter A (sUnion B C)) x <-> (sUnion (sInter A B) (sInter A C)) x.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma inter_distrib_right (A B C : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sInter (sUnion A B) C) x <-> (sUnion (sInter A C) (sInter B C)) x.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma de_morgan_union (A B : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sCompl (sUnion A B)) x <-> (sInter (sCompl A) (sCompl B)) x.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma de_morgan_inter (A B : X -> Prop) :
    forall x, (sCompl (sInter A B)) x <-> (sUnion (sCompl A) (sCompl B)) x.
Proof.
Admitted.

End SetAlgebra.

theory set_algebra
  imports Main
begin

definition sUnion :: "('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool)"
  where "sUnion A B \<equiv> \<lambda>x. A x \<or> B x"

definition sInter :: "('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool)"
  where "sInter A B \<equiv> \<lambda>x. A x \<and> B x"

definition sCompl :: "('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool)"
  where "sCompl A \<equiv> \<lambda>x. \<not> A x"

lemma inter_distrib_left:

  sorry

  "\<forall>x. sCompl (sInter A B) x \<longleftrightarrow> sUnion (sCompl A) (sCompl B) x"
  sorry
end

-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic set_algebra. This file contains no
-- proof.

module set_algebra where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)

infixr 2 _∨_
infixr 3 _∧_
infix 2 _↔_

data ⊥ : Set where

data _∨_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  inj₁ : A → A ∨ B
  inj₂ : B → A ∨ B

record _∧_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

Not : ∀ {a : Level} → Set a → Set a
Not A = A → ⊥

ExcludedMiddle : (p : Level) → Set (lsuc p)
ExcludedMiddle p = (P : Set p) → P ∨ Not P

sUnion :
  ∀ {x p : Level} {X : Set x} →
  (X → Set p) → (X → Set p) → X → Set p
sUnion A B element = A element ∨ B element

sInter :
  ∀ {x p : Level} {X : Set x} →
  (X → Set p) → (X → Set p) → X → Set p
sInter A B element = A element ∧ B element

sCompl :
  ∀ {x p : Level} {X : Set x} →
  (X → Set p) → X → Set p
sCompl A element = Not (A element)

module SetAlgebraStatements
  {x p : Level} {X : Set x} where

  inter-distrib-left : Set (x ⊔ lsuc p)
  inter-distrib-left =
    ExcludedMiddle p →
    (A B C : X → Set p) →
    (element : X) →
    sInter A (sUnion B C) element ↔
    sUnion (sInter A B) (sInter A C) element

  inter-distrib-right : Set (x ⊔ lsuc p)
  inter-distrib-right =
    ExcludedMiddle p →
    (A B C : X → Set p) →
    (element : X) →
    sInter (sUnion A B) C element ↔
    sUnion (sInter A C) (sInter B C) element

  de-morgan-union : Set (x ⊔ lsuc p)
  de-morgan-union =
    ExcludedMiddle p →
    (A B : X → Set p) →
    (element : X) →
    sCompl (sUnion A B) element ↔
    sInter (sCompl A) (sCompl B) element

  de-morgan-inter : Set (x ⊔ lsuc p)
  de-morgan-inter =
    ExcludedMiddle p →
    (A B : X → Set p) →
    (element : X) →
    sCompl (sInter A B) element ↔
    sUnion (sCompl A) (sCompl B) element

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact set_algebra, concerning pointwise
% distributivity and De Morgan laws for predicate-valued sets. This file contains no proof.

set_algebra[Ambient: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  SetPred: TYPE = [Ambient -> bool]

  sUnion(A, B: SetPred): SetPred =
    LAMBDA (x: Ambient): A(x) OR B(x)

  sInter(A, B: SetPred): SetPred =
    LAMBDA (x: Ambient): A(x) AND B(x)

  sCompl(A: SetPred): SetPred =
    LAMBDA (x: Ambient): NOT A(x)

  inter_distrib_left: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: SetPred), (x: Ambient):
      sInter(A, sUnion(B, C))(x) =
        sUnion(sInter(A, B), sInter(A, C))(x)

  inter_distrib_right: bool =
    FORALL (A, B, C: SetPred), (x: Ambient):
      sInter(sUnion(A, B), C)(x) =
        sUnion(sInter(A, C), sInter(B, C))(x)

  de_morgan_union: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: SetPred), (x: Ambient):
      sCompl(sUnion(A, B))(x) =
        sInter(sCompl(A), sCompl(B))(x)

  de_morgan_inter: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: SetPred), (x: Ambient):
      sCompl(sInter(A, B))(x) =
        sUnion(sCompl(A), sCompl(B))(x)

  set_algebra_statement: bool =
    inter_distrib_left
      AND inter_distrib_right
      AND de_morgan_union
      AND de_morgan_inter
END set_algebra

universe u

class DecidableEqAlt (A : Type u) where
  decEq : (x y : A) → Bool

class ZeroAlt (A : Type u) where
  zero : A

class OneAlt (A : Type u) where
  one : A

class Preorder (A : Type u) where
  le    : A → A → Prop
  refl  : ∀ x, le x x
  trans : ∀ {x y z}, le x y → le y z → le x z

infix:50 " ≤ " => Preorder.le

class ZeroLEOneClass (A : Type u) [ZeroAlt A] [OneAlt A] [Preorder A] : Prop where
  zero_le_one  : (ZeroAlt.zero : A) ≤ (OneAlt.one : A)
  zero_le_zero : (ZeroAlt.zero : A) ≤ (ZeroAlt.zero : A)

namespace Matrix
  variable (m : Type u) [DecidableEqAlt m]
  variable (α : Type u) [ZeroAlt α] [OneAlt α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]
  abbrev matrix := m → m → α


  def One_matrix : matrix m α :=
      fun i j => if DecidableEqAlt.decEq i j then OneAlt.one else ZeroAlt.zero

  theorem zero_le_one_elem
    (i j : m) : (ZeroAlt.zero : α) ≤ One_matrix m α i j := by sorry
  def Zero_matrix : matrix m α := fun _ _ => ZeroAlt.zero

  def matrix_le (A B : matrix m α) : Prop := ∀ i j, A i j ≤ B i j

  theorem Zero_le_One_matrix : matrix_le m α (Zero_matrix m α) (One_matrix m α) := by sorry
  theorem matrix_le_refl (A : matrix m α) : matrix_le m α A A := by sorry
  theorem matrix_le_trans (A B C : matrix m α) :
      matrix_le m α A B → matrix_le m α B C → matrix_le m α A C := by sorry
  def matrix_eq (A B : matrix m α) : Prop := ∀ i j, A i j = B i j

  theorem matrix_eq_refl (A : matrix m α) : matrix_eq m α A A := by sorry
  theorem matrix_eq_sym (A B : matrix m α) : matrix_eq m α A B → matrix_eq m α B A := by sorry
  theorem matrix_eq_trans (A B C : matrix m α) :
      matrix_eq m α A B → matrix_eq m α B C → matrix_eq m α A C := by sorry
  theorem matrix_eq_le (A B : matrix m α) :
      matrix_eq m α A B → matrix_le m α A B ∧ matrix_le m α B A := by sorry
  class PartialOrder (A : Type u) [Preorder A] : Prop where
    le_antisym : ∀ {x y : A}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y

  variable [PartialOrder α]

  theorem matrix_le_antisymm (A B : matrix m α) :
      matrix_le m α A B → matrix_le m α B A → matrix_eq m α A B := by sorry
end Matrix
