Class DecidableEqAlt (A : Type) := {
  dec_eq : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y}
}.

Class ZeroAlt (A : Type) := zero : A.
Class OneAlt  (A : Type) := one  : A.

Class Preorder (A : Type) := {
  le                  : A -> A -> Prop;
  Preorder_Reflexive  : forall x,       le x x;
  Preorder_Transitive : forall x y z,   le x y -> le y z -> le x z
}.

Infix "≤" := le (at level 70, no associativity).

Class ZeroLEOneClass (A : Type)
      `{ZeroAlt A} `{OneAlt A} `{Preorder A} := {
  zero_le_one : zero ≤ (one : A);
  zero_le_zero : zero ≤ (zero : A)
}.

Section Matrix.
  Variable (m : Type).
  Context `{DecidableEqAlt m}.

  Variable (α : Type).
  Context `{ZeroLEOneClass α}.

  Definition matrix := m -> m -> α.

  Definition One_matrix : matrix :=
    fun i j => if dec_eq i j then one else zero.

  Lemma zero_le_one_elem (i j : m) :
    zero ≤ (One_matrix : matrix) i j.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Definition Zero_matrix : matrix := fun _ _ => zero.

  Definition matrix_le (A B : matrix) : Prop :=
    forall i j, A i j ≤ B i j.
  Infix "≤ₘ" := matrix_le (at level 70).

  Lemma Zero_le_One_matrix : Zero_matrix ≤ₘ One_matrix.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma matrix_le_refl (A : matrix) : A ≤ₘ A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma matrix_le_trans (A B C : matrix) :
    A ≤ₘ B -> B ≤ₘ C -> A ≤ₘ C.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Definition matrix_eq (A B : matrix) : Prop :=
    forall i j, A i j = B i j.
  Infix "≃ₘ" := matrix_eq (at level 70).

  Lemma matrix_eq_refl (A : matrix) : A ≃ₘ A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma matrix_eq_sym (A B : matrix) : A ≃ₘ B -> B ≃ₘ A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma matrix_eq_trans (A B C : matrix) :
    A ≃ₘ B -> B ≃ₘ C -> A ≃ₘ C.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Lemma matrix_eq_le (A B : matrix) :
    A ≃ₘ B -> A ≤ₘ B /\ B ≤ₘ A.
Proof.
Admitted.

  Class PartialOrder (A : Type) `{Preorder A} := {
    le_antisym : forall x y, x ≤ y -> y ≤ x -> x = y
  }.
  Context {PO : PartialOrder α}.

  Lemma matrix_le_antisymm (A B : matrix) :
    A ≤ₘ B -> B ≤ₘ A -> A ≃ₘ B.
Proof.
Admitted.
End Matrix.

theory zero_le_one_elem
  imports Main
begin

locale zero_le_one_setup =
  fixes decEq      :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and zero       :: "'a"
    and one        :: "'a"
    and le         :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"   (infix "\<preceq>" 50)
    and le_antisym :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes le_refl      : "\<And>x. x \<preceq> x"
    and   le_trans     : "\<And>x y z. x \<preceq> y \<Longrightarrow> y \<preceq> z \<Longrightarrow> x \<preceq> z"
    and   zero_le_one  : "zero \<preceq> one"
    and   zero_le_zero : "zero \<preceq> zero"
    and   le_antisym   : "\<And>x y. x \<preceq> y \<Longrightarrow> y \<preceq> x \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
begin

definition One_matrix :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  where "One_matrix i j \<equiv> if decEq i j then one else zero"

definition Zero_matrix :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  where "Zero_matrix \<equiv> \<lambda>_ _. zero"

definition matrix_le :: "('m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "matrix_le A B \<equiv> \<forall>i j. A i j \<preceq> B i j"

definition matrix_eq :: "('m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "matrix_eq A B \<equiv> \<forall>i j. A i j = B i j"

lemma zero_le_one_elem: "zero \<preceq> One_matrix i j"
  sorry
lemma Zero_le_One_matrix: "matrix_le Zero_matrix One_matrix"
  sorry
lemma matrix_le_refl: "matrix_le A A"
  sorry
lemma matrix_le_trans: "matrix_le A B \<Longrightarrow> matrix_le B C \<Longrightarrow> matrix_le A C"
  sorry
lemma matrix_eq_refl: "matrix_eq A A"
  sorry
lemma matrix_eq_sym: "matrix_eq A B \<Longrightarrow> matrix_eq B A"
  sorry
lemma matrix_eq_trans: "matrix_eq A B \<Longrightarrow> matrix_eq B C \<Longrightarrow> matrix_eq A C"
  sorry
lemma matrix_eq_le: "matrix_eq A B \<Longrightarrow> matrix_le A B \<and> matrix_le B A"
  sorry
lemma matrix_le_antisymm: "matrix_le A B \<Longrightarrow> matrix_le B A \<Longrightarrow> matrix_eq A B"
  sorry
end

end

;; Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact zero_le_one_elem:
;; identity/zero matrices and their pointwise preorder/equality laws over
;; arbitrary index and element carriers. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

(defstub zloe-index-p (index-type x) t)
(defstub zloe-element-p (element-type x) t)

(defstub zloe-dec-eq (index-type x y) t)
(defstub zloe-zero (element-type) t)
(defstub zloe-one (element-type) t)
(defstub zloe-le (element-type x y) t)

;; Arbitrary source matrices are first-order codes interpreted by this stub.
(defstub zloe-base-matrix-entry
  (index-type element-type matrix-code i j)
  t)

(defun zloe-zero-matrix ()
  (list :zloe-zero-matrix))

(defun zloe-one-matrix ()
  (list :zloe-one-matrix))

(defun zloe-matrix-entry
    (index-type element-type matrix i j)
  (cond
   ((equal matrix (zloe-zero-matrix))
    (zloe-zero element-type))
   ((equal matrix (zloe-one-matrix))
    (if (zloe-dec-eq index-type i j)
        (zloe-one element-type)
      (zloe-zero element-type)))
   (t
    (zloe-base-matrix-entry
     index-type element-type matrix i j))))

(defun-sk zloe-dec-eq-boolean-p (index-type)
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and
      (zloe-index-p index-type i)
      (zloe-index-p index-type j))
     (booleanp (zloe-dec-eq index-type i j)))))

(defun-sk zloe-matrix-typed-p
    (index-type element-type matrix)
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and
      (zloe-index-p index-type i)
      (zloe-index-p index-type j))
     (zloe-element-p
      element-type
      (zloe-matrix-entry
       index-type element-type matrix i j)))))

(defun-sk zloe-preorder-refl-p (element-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (zloe-element-p element-type x)
     (zloe-le element-type x x))))

(defun-sk zloe-preorder-trans-p (element-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (zloe-element-p element-type x)
      (zloe-element-p element-type y)
      (zloe-element-p element-type z)
      (zloe-le element-type x y)
      (zloe-le element-type y z))
     (zloe-le element-type x z))))

(defun-sk zloe-order-antisymmetric-p (element-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (zloe-element-p element-type x)
      (zloe-element-p element-type y)
      (zloe-le element-type x y)
      (zloe-le element-type y x))
     (equal x y))))

(defun zloe-context-p (index-type element-type)
  (and
   (zloe-element-p element-type (zloe-zero element-type))
   (zloe-element-p element-type (zloe-one element-type))
   (zloe-dec-eq-boolean-p index-type)
   (zloe-preorder-refl-p element-type)
   (zloe-preorder-trans-p element-type)
   (zloe-le

title: zero_le_one_elem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic zero_le_one_elem. This file contains
-- no proof.

module zero_le_one_elem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

record DecidableEqAlt {m : Level} (M : Set m) : Set m where
  field
    decEq : M → M → Bool

record ZeroAlt {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  field
    zero : A

record OneAlt {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  field
    one : A

record Preorder {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    le       : A → A → Set a
    le-refl  : (x : A) → le x x
    le-trans : (x y z : A) → le x y → le y z → le x z

record ZeroLEOneClass
  {a : Level} {A : Set a}
  (Z : ZeroAlt A) (O : OneAlt A) (P : Preorder A) : Set a where
  field
    zero-le-one :
      Preorder.le P (ZeroAlt.zero Z) (OneAlt.one O)
    zero-le-zero :
      Preorder.le P (ZeroAlt.zero Z) (ZeroAlt.zero Z)

record PartialOrder
  {a : Level} {A : Set a} (P : Preorder A) : Set a where
  field
    le-antisym :
      (x y : A) →
      Preorder.le P x y →
      Preorder.le P y x →
      x ≡ y

record _∧_ {p q : Level} (P : Set p) (Q : Set q) : Set (p ⊔ q) where
  field
    left  : P
    right : Q

choose : ∀ {a : Level} {A : Set a} → Bool → A → A → A
choose true  x _ = x
choose false _ y = y

module MatrixStatements
  {m a : Level} {M : Set m} {A : Set a}
  (D : DecidableEqAlt M)
  (Z : ZeroAlt A)
  (O : OneAlt A)
  (P : Preorder A)
  (C : ZeroLEOneClass Z O P) where

  zeroA : A
  zeroA = ZeroAlt.zero Z

  oneA : A
  oneA = OneAlt.one O

  leA : A → A → Set a
  leA = Preorder.le P

  Matrix : Set (m ⊔ a)
  Matrix = M → M → A

  oneMatrix : Matrix
  oneMatrix i j =
    choose (DecidableEqAlt.decEq D i j) oneA zeroA

  zeroMatrix : Matrix
  zeroMatrix _ _ = zeroA

  matrixLe : Matrix → Matrix → Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrixLe X Y = (i j : M) → leA (X i j) (Y i j)

  matrixEq : Matrix → Matrix → Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrixEq X Y = (i j : M) → X i j ≡ Y i j

  zero-le-one-elem : Set (m ⊔ a)
  zero-le-one-elem =
    (i j : M) → leA zeroA (oneMatrix i j)

  zero-le-one-matrix : Set (m ⊔ a)
  zero-le-one-matrix =
    matrixLe zeroMatrix oneMatrix

  matrix-le-refl : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-le-refl =
    (X : Matrix) → matrixLe X X

  matrix-le-trans : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-le-trans =
    (X Y W : Matrix) →
    matrixLe X Y →
    matrixLe Y W →
    matrixLe X W

  matrix-eq-refl : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-eq-refl =
    (X : Matrix) → matrixEq X X

  matrix-eq-sym : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-eq-sym =
    (X Y : Matrix) →
    matrixEq X Y →
    matrixEq Y X

  matrix-eq-trans : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-eq-trans =
    (X Y W : Matrix) →
    matrixEq X Y →
    matrixEq Y W →
    matrixEq X W

  matrix-eq-le : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-eq-le =
    (X Y : Matrix) →
    matrixEq X Y →
    matrixLe X Y ∧ matrixLe Y X

  matrix-le-antisymm : Set (m ⊔ a)
  matrix-le-antisymm =
    PartialOrder P →
    (X Y : Matrix) →
    matrixLe X Y →
    matrixLe Y X →
    matrixEq X Y

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal artifact zero_le_one_elem:
  zero and one matrices, pointwise matrix order, and pointwise matrix equality.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val one_matrix_def = new_definition (
  "one_matrix_def",
  ``one_matrix (decEq : 'm -> 'm -> bool) (oneA : 'a) (zeroA : 'a)
      (i : 'm) (j : 'm) =
      if decEq i j then oneA else zeroA``);

val zero_matrix_def = new_definition (
  "zero_matrix_def",
  ``zero_matrix (zeroA : 'a) (i : 'm) (j : 'm) = zeroA``);

val matrix_le_def = new_definition (
  "matrix_le_def",
  ``matrix_le (le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (A0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a) (B0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a) <=>
      !i j. le_rel (A0 i j) (B0 i j)``);

val matrix_eq_def = new_definition (
  "matrix_eq_def",
  ``matrix_eq (A0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a) (B0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a) <=>
      !i j. A0 i j = B0 i j``);

val zero_le_one_elem =
  ``!(decEq : 'm -> 'm -> bool) (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (i : 'm) (j : 'm).
      le_rel zeroA oneA ==>
      le_rel zeroA zeroA ==>
      le_rel zeroA (one_matrix decEq oneA zeroA i j)``;

val zero_le_one_matrix =
  ``!(decEq : 'm -> 'm -> bool) (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      le_rel zeroA oneA ==>
      le_rel zeroA zeroA ==>
      matrix_le le_rel (zero_matrix zeroA)
        (one_matrix decEq oneA zeroA)``;

val matrix_le_refl =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      (!x. le_rel x x) ==>
      !A0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a. matrix_le le_rel A0 A0``;

val matrix_le_trans =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      (!x y z. le_rel x y ==> le_rel y z ==> le_rel x z) ==>
      !A0 B0 C0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a.
        matrix_le le_rel A0 B0 ==>
        matrix_le le_rel B0 C0 ==>
        matrix_le le_rel A0 C0``;

val matrix_eq_refl =
  ``!A0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a. matrix_eq A0 A0``;

val matrix_eq_sym =
  ``!A0 B0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a.
      matrix_eq A0 B0 ==> matrix_eq B0 A0``;

val matrix_eq_trans =
  ``!A0 B0 C0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a.
      matrix_eq A0 B0 ==>
      matrix_eq B0 C0 ==>
      matrix_eq A0 C0``;

val matrix_eq_le =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      (!x. le_rel x x) ==>
      !A0 B0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a.
        matrix_eq A0 B0 ==>
        matrix_le le_rel A0 B0 /\ matrix_le le_rel B0 A0``;

val matrix_le_antisymm =
  ``!(le_rel : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      (!x y. le_rel x y ==> le_rel y x ==> x = y) ==>
      !A0 B0 : 'm -> 'm -> 'a.
        matrix_le le_rel A0 B0 ==>
        matrix_le le_rel B0 A0 ==>
        matrix_eq A0 B0``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Babel-formal artifact zero_le_one_elem:
  the identity/zero matrices and all nine indexed pointwise preorder and
  equality statements. This database contains no proof.
$)

$(
  Bound indices and elements have dedicated variable-only syntactic sorts.
  Distinct-variable conditions on the definitions prevent binder capture.
$)

$c
  ivar evar index elem matrix wff |-
  ( )
  -> /\ \/ <-> -. =e
  A.i A.e
  decEq ite le entry matrixLe matrixEq
  zero one ZeroM OneM
$.

$v
  iv jv ev fv gv
  i j x y z
  A B C
  ph ps
$.

biv $f ivar iv $.
bjv $f ivar jv $.
bev $f evar ev $.
bfv $f evar fv $.
bgv $f evar gv $.

ii $f index i $.
ij $f index j $.
ex $f elem x $.
ey $f elem y $.
ez $f elem z $.
mA $f matrix A $.
mB $f matrix B $.
mC $f matrix C $.
wph $f wff ph $.
wps $f wff ps $.

$d iv jv $.
$d ev fv gv $.

index-variable-term $a index iv $.
element-variable-term $a elem ev $.

zero-term $a elem zero $.
one-term $a elem one $.
zero-matrix-term $a matrix ZeroM $.
one-matrix-term $a matrix OneM $.

matrix-entry-term $a elem ( entry A i j ) $.
ite-term $a elem ( ite ph x y ) $.

dec-eq-formula $a wff ( decEq i j ) $.
le-formula $a wff ( le x y ) $.
element-equality $a wff ( x =e y ) $.
matrix-le-formula $a wff ( matrixLe A B ) $.
matrix-eq-formula $a wff ( matrixEq A B ) $.

implication $a wff ( ph -> ps ) $.
conjunction $a wff ( ph /\ ps ) $.
disjunction $a wff ( ph \/ ps ) $.
biconditional $a wff ( ph <-> ps ) $.
negation $a wff ( -. ph ) $.
forall-index $a wff ( A.i iv ph ) $.
forall-element $a wff ( A.e ev ph ) $.

${
  ite-definition $a |- (
    ( z =e ( ite ph x y ) )
    <->
    (
      ( ph /\ ( z =e x ) )
      \/
      ( ( -. ph ) /\ ( z =e y ) )
    )
  ) $.

  dec-eq-cases $a |- (
    ( decEq i j ) \/ ( -. ( decEq i j ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d iv jv $.
  zero-matrix-definition $a |- (
    A.i iv
      ( A.i jv
        ( ( entry ZeroM iv jv ) =e zero ) )
  ) $.

  one-matrix-definition $a |- (
    A.i iv
      ( A.i jv
        (
          ( entry OneM iv jv )
          =e
          ( ite ( decEq iv jv ) one zero )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d iv jv $.
  $d iv A $.
  $d iv B $.
  $d jv A $.
  $d jv B $.

  matrix-le-definition $a |- (
    ( matrixLe A B )
    <->
    ( A.i iv
      ( A.i jv
        ( le ( entry A iv jv ) ( entry B iv jv ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.

  matrix-eq-definition $a |- (
    ( matrixEq A B )
    <->
    ( A.i iv
      ( A.i jv
        ( ( entry A iv jv ) =e ( entry B iv jv ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  preorder-refl $e |- (
    A.e ev ( le ev ev )
  ) $.

  preorder-trans $e |- (
    A.e ev
      ( A.e fv
        ( A.e gv
          (
            ( le ev fv )
            ->
            ( ( le fv gv ) -> ( le ev gv ) )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.

  zero-le-one $e |- ( le zero one ) $.
  zero-le-zero $e |- ( le zero zero ) $.

  zero-le-one-elem $a |- (
    le zero ( entry OneM i j )
  ) $.

  zero-le-one-matrix $a |- (
    matrixLe ZeroM OneM
  ) $.

  matrix-le-refl $a |- (
    matrixLe A A
  ) $.

  ${
    matrix-le-trans-left $e |- ( matrixLe A B ) $.
    matrix-le-trans-right $e |- ( matrixLe B C ) $.
    matrix-le-trans $a |- ( matrixLe A C ) $.
  $}

  matrix-eq-refl $a |- (
    matrixEq A A
  ) $.

  ${
    matrix-eq-sym-hyp $e |- ( matrixEq A B ) $.
    matrix-eq-sym $a |- ( matrixEq B A ) $.
  $}

  ${
    matrix-eq-trans-left $e |- ( matrixEq A B ) $.
    matrix-eq-trans-right $e |- ( matrixEq B C ) $.
    matrix-eq-trans $a |- ( matrixEq A C ) $.
  $}

  ${
    matrix-eq-le-hyp $e |- ( matrixEq A B ) $.
    matrix-eq-le $a |- (
      ( matrixLe A B ) /\ ( matrixLe B A )
    ) $.
  $}

  ${
    partial-order-antisym $e |- (
      A.e ev
        ( A.e fv
          (
            ( le ev fv )
            ->
            ( ( le fv ev ) -> ( ev =e fv ) )
          )
        )
    ) $.

    matrix-le-antisymm-left $e |- ( matrixLe A B ) $.
    matrix-le-antisymm-right $e |- ( matrixLe B A ) $.
    matrix-le-antisymm $a |- ( matrixEq A B ) $.
  $}
$}

title: zero_le_one_elem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic zero_le_one_elem. This file contains
:: no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, ZFMISC_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, MARGREL1, XBOOLEAN, BINOP_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, MARGREL1, BINOP_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1,
    MARGREL1, BINOP_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, MARGREL1;
  requirements SUBSET, BOOLE;
  equalities XBOOLEAN;

begin

:: zero_le_one_elem
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      decEq being Function of [:M,M:],BOOLEAN,
      zero,one being Element of A,
      leR being Relation of A,A,
      OM being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    [zero,one] in leR &
    [zero,zero] in leR &
    (for x,y being Element of M
      holds OM.(x,y) = IFEQ(decEq.(x,y),TRUE,one,zero))
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds [zero,OM.(i,j)] in leR
proof
end;
::$P+

:: Zero_le_One_matrix
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      decEq being Function of [:M,M:],BOOLEAN,
      zero,one being Element of A,
      leR being Relation of A,A,
      OM,ZM being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    [zero,one] in leR &
    [zero,zero] in leR &
    (for x,y being Element of M
      holds OM.(x,y) = IFEQ(decEq.(x,y),TRUE,one,zero)) &
    (for x,y being Element of M
      holds ZM.(x,y) = zero)
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds [ZM.(i,j),OM.(i,j)] in leR
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_le_refl
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      leR being Relation of A,A,
      MA being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    for x being Element of A
      holds [x,x] in leR
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MA.(i,j),MA.(i,j)] in leR
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_le_trans
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      leR being Relation of A,A,
      MA,MB,MC being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    (for x,y,z being Element of A
      st [x,y] in leR & [y,z] in leR
      holds [x,z] in leR) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MA.(i,j),MB.(i,j)] in leR) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MB.(i,j),MC.(i,j)] in leR)
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MA.(i,j),MC.(i,j)] in leR
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_eq_refl
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      MA being Function of [:M,M:],A
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds MA.(i,j) = MA.(i,j)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_eq_sym
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      MA,MB being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds MA.(i,j) = MB.(i,j)
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds MB.(i,j) = MA.(i,j)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_eq_trans
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      MA,MB,MC being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds MA.(i,j) = MB.(i,j)) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds MB.(i,j) = MC.(i,j))
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds MA.(i,j) = MC.(i,j)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_eq_le
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      leR being Relation of A,A,
      MA,MB being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    (for x being Element of A
      holds [x,x] in leR) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds MA.(i,j) = MB.(i,j))
  holds
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MA.(i,j),MB.(i,j)] in leR) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MB.(i,j),MA.(i,j)] in leR)
proof
end;
::$P+

:: matrix_le_antisymm
::$P-
theorem
  for M,A being non empty set,
      leR being Relation of A,A,
      MA,MB being Function of [:M,M:],A
  st
    (for x,y being Element of A
      st [x,y] in leR & [y,x] in leR
      holds x = y) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MA.(i,j),MB.(i,j)] in leR) &
    (for i,j being Element of M
      holds [MB.(i,j),MA.(i,j)] in leR)
  holds
    for i,j being Element of M
      holds MA.(i,j) = MB.(i,j)

title: zero_le_one_elem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Babel-formal topic zero_le_one_elem. This file contains no
% proof.

zero_le_one_elem[
  M: TYPE,
  A: TYPE+,
  decEq: [M, M -> bool],
  zero: A,
  one: A,
  le_rel: [A, A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [M, M -> A]

  preorder_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))

  zero_le_one_laws: bool =
    le_rel(zero, one) AND le_rel(zero, zero)

  zero_le_one_context: bool =
    preorder_laws AND zero_le_one_laws

  partial_order_laws: bool =
    preorder_laws
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)

  One_matrix(i, j: M): A =
    IF decEq(i, j) THEN one ELSE zero ENDIF

  Zero_matrix(i, j: M): A = zero

  matrix_le(A0, B0: matrix): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: M): le_rel(A0(i, j), B0(i, j))

  matrix_eq(A0, B0: matrix): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: M): A0(i, j) = B0(i, j)

  zero_le_one_elem: bool =
    zero_le_one_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (i, j: M):
        le_rel(zero, One_matrix(i, j)))

  Zero_le_One_matrix: bool =
    zero_le_one_context IMPLIES
      matrix_le(Zero_matrix, One_matrix)

  matrix_le_refl: bool =
    preorder_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A0: matrix): matrix_le(A0, A0))

  matrix_le_trans: bool =
    preorder_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A0, B0, C0: matrix):
        matrix_le(A0, B0) IMPLIES
          matrix_le(B0, C0) IMPLIES matrix_le(A0, C0))

  matrix_eq_refl: bool =
    FORALL (A0: matrix): matrix_eq(A0, A0)

  matrix_eq_sym: bool =
    FORALL (A0, B0: matrix):
      matrix_eq(A0, B0) IMPLIES matrix_eq(B0, A0)

  matrix_eq_trans: bool =
    FORALL (A0, B0, C0: matrix):
      matrix_eq(A0, B0) IMPLIES
        matrix_eq(B0, C0) IMPLIES matrix_eq(A0, C0)

  matrix_eq_le: bool =
    preorder_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A0, B0: matrix):
        matrix_eq(A0, B0) IMPLIES
          (matrix_le(A0, B0) AND matrix_le(B0, A0)))

  matrix_le_antisymm: bool =
    partial_order_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A0, B0: matrix):
        matrix_le(A0, B0) IMPLIES
          matrix_le(B0, A0) IMPLIES matrix_eq(A0, B0))
END zero_le_one_elem
